A stability claim is only as good as its reference hull. We report every result split by the number of reference phases behind it and argue that benchmarks should do the same.

AI.tldr: 用GRPO强化学习对齐晶体材料的生成模型（随机插值+离散流匹配），通过直接优化原子类型转移似然，将mSUN产率从13.4%提升至45.5%，同时揭示了奖励利用漏洞与社区指标的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 晶体材料生成模型通常只被训练去匹配结构数据库的分布，其训练目标并不指向具体设计目标（如目标性质）。逆向材料设计需要能对齐到黑盒奖励函数的方法。
AI.method: 采用group-relative policy optimization（GRPO），将基于随机插值与离散流匹配的生成模型与通用黑盒奖励函数对齐；原子类型由离散流生成，GRPO的策略梯度直接作用于原子类型转移的似然，这区别于以往针对扩散/流模型的强化学习方法。并引入提升mSUN产率的奖励函数。
AI.result: mSUN产率从预训练模型的13.4%提升到强化模型的45.5%（经社区基准评测）；该奖励同样提升了基于潜空间去噪扩散模型的强化学习框架表现。同时发现直接强化原子类型转移似然会导致奖励利用，需要显式防护。
AI.conclusion: 直接强化原子类型转移似然可有效对齐生成模型，但存在奖励利用风险需加防护。分析还暴露社区指标缺陷：不同堆积的单元素结构被计为mSUN而虚增指标。稳定性声明依赖于参考凸包，建议基准按参考相数量分别报告结果。

title: Teaching Agents to Code Reliably
summary: Autonomous coding agents solve repository issues by reading code, running commands, editing files, and submitting patches. Extra inference-time compute yields gains only when it produces a useful repair and supplies reliable evidence for choosing one. Three behaviors decide both, and we argue they are teachable rather than byproducts of scale, so a policy can carry them instead of a scaffold. Location diversity remains narrow, since attempts return to the same site and extra samples add no coverage. Edit diversity is left unexploited, since methodologies that differ resolve complementary issues no single run reaches. Verification misleads, since a test the agent writes for its own patch accepts many incorrect ones. Directing search by execution feedback and scoring each patch against its own reverted tree resolves 52.8% of SWE-bench Verified using 48.1% of the agent-steps an eight-sample baseline spends. Training moves these behaviors into the policy. On the 270 issues held out from SFT and RL training, weighted supervised fine-tuning raises pass@1 from 31.9% to 35.2% and pass@8 from 46.7% to 51.1%. A reinforcement objective then trains the verifier against gold-labeled repairs and incorrect variants, crediting the assertions that detect them. It raises pass@1 to 43.0% and pass@8 to 60.7%, lifts verifier precision from 26.8% to 41.7%, and more than halves false acceptance. Resolution improves on two of three out-of-distribution suites and verifier precision on all three, and the gains hold at 7B, 14B, and 30B against published coder baselines.

AI.tldr: 自主编码代理通过训练策略（而非依赖脚手架）习得位置多样性、编辑多样性与验证能力，用执行反馈引导搜索，在SWE-bench Verified达52.8%，并通过SFT与RL显著提升pass@1/pass@8及验证器精度。
AI.motivation: 现有代理在增加推理算力时收益有限：定位尝试重复导致覆盖不足；方法差异带来的编辑多样性未被利用；自写测试验证不可靠，会接受错误补丁。作者认为这三种行为可被训练进策略而非仅靠规模的副产品。
AI.method: 用执行反馈引导搜索，并将每个补丁与其回退后的代码树对照打分以提高验证可靠性。随后通过加权监督微调将行为写入策略，再用强化学习目标训练验证器，使其对抗金标准修复与错误变体，奖励能识别错误的断言。
AI.result: 执行反馈引导使SWE-bench Verified解决率52.8%，仅用八样本基线48.1%的代理步数。SFT将pass@1从31.9%升至35.2%，pass@8从46.7%升至51.1%；RL再提升至pass@1 43.0%、pass@8 60.7%，验证器精度从26.8%升至41.7%，误接受减半。在三个OOD套件中两个解决率提升、三个验证精度均提升，且7B/14B/30B均优于已发布编码基线。
AI.conclusion: 位置与编辑多样性及可靠验证是可教的策略行为，通过SFT与RL注入可显著提升编码代理的解决率与验证精度，并在不同模型规模与分布外任务上一致有效。

title: SearchJev: A Fast and Calibrated System-1 Model for Search Agents
summary: Search agents repeatedly make short decisions about relevance, evidence sufficiency, and search actions. Using generative language models for these decisions introduces latency and unreliable confidence. We present SearchJev, a fast and calibrated System-1 model that separates search decisions from System-2 reasoning and generation. Given a search state and a decision schema, SearchJev directly scores legal options without autoregressive output generation. We propose Soft-Label Learning for Calibrated Decisions (SLCD) to learn decision probabilities from uncertain supervision and calibrate their confidence. In a dual-system search agent, SearchJev handles short decisions and delegates uncertain judgments to System 2, which retains planning, query generation, and answer composition. We also introduce SearchDecision-Bench, a benchmark unifying six types of search decisions for training and evaluation. On SearchDecision-Bench, SEARCHJEV improves decision quality over same-size Qwen3.5 autoregressive models, achieves 5.2-5.3 times faster decisions, and reduces average expected calibration error by 41-74%. On BrowseComp-Plus, the dual-system agents achieve a 3.7-4.7 times speedup in active search time while improving answer accuracy from 45% to up to 54%.

AI.tldr: SearchJev 是一个快速且校准良好的 System-1 模型，将搜索决策从 System-2 推理生成中分离，通过直接打分合法选项（无需自回归生成）并结合 Soft-Label Learning 校准置信度，在双系统搜索代理中处理短决策，将不确定判断交给 System 2。
AI.motivation: 搜索代理需反复做相关性、证据充分性、搜索动作等短决策，而用生成式语言模型做这些决策带来延迟和不可靠置信度的问题。
AI.method: 提出 SearchJev：给定搜索状态和决策 schema，直接对合法选项打分，不做自回归输出生成；提出 SLCD（Soft-Label Learning for Calibrated Decisions），从不确定监督中学习决策概率并校准置信度；在双系统搜索代理中，SearchJev 处理短决策，把不确定判断委托给保留规划、查询生成与答案组织的 System 2；并构建 SearchDecision-Bench 统一六类搜索决策。
AI.result: 在 SearchDecision-Bench 上，决策质量优于同规模 Qwen3.5 自回归模型，决策速度提升 5.2-5.3 倍，平均期望校准误差降低 41-74%；在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，双系统代理主动搜索时间加速 3.7-4.7 倍，答案准确率从 45% 提升至最高 54%。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离短决策与推理生成并结合校准学习，SearchJev 能在保持甚至提升准确率的同时大幅提升搜索代理效率与决策置信度可靠性。

title: BAIBAICHUCHU at the NTCIR-19 FinArg-3 Task: When Is Maximum Possible Profit Predictable from Investor Text?
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Both authors contributed equally. Selected for oral presentation at NTCIR-19 (FinArg-3 Social Media Subtask)
summary:
The BAIBAICHUCHU team participated in the Social Media Subtask of NTCIR-19 FinArg-3, ranking Chinese investor posts by Maximum Possible Profit (MPP). A three-track ensemble of lexical features, a FinArg-2-pre-finetuned MacBERT ranker, and an LLM judge reaches 0.734 in post-grouped development evaluation, but our best official run scores 0.517. All twelve submitted runs lie between 0.4598 and 0.5402, and our 26 unanimous three-track pairs score 0.500.
  A post-hoc audit finds that the submitted judge applied a long-only rule to bearish posts although MPP is stance-aware. Correcting it changes 28 of 87 official predictions without changing accuracy, yet lowers development accuracy from 0.680 to 0.622: a regime-specific semantic shortcut improved validation fit.
  We decompose ranking into directional text, volatility and horizon, and pairwise margin. A running-extremum model predicts $σ\sqrt{T}$ scaling, observed ex post in 502 price-aligned posts from a separate July 2026 collection. Pre-posting volatility scaled by the post-specific observation horizon, $σ_{\mathrm{pre},20}\sqrt{N_i}$, is associated with a later truncated-horizon MPP proxy (Spearman $ρ=0.320$; ticker-cluster 95% CI [0.133,0.466]) and correctly orders 61.4% of unequal-outcome pairs. Transferred text is nearly uncorrelated with the July outcome ($ρ=0.055$) and adds little conditional on this score and stance. Development reliability rises from about 0.60 to 0.93 as the labeled MPP gap widens. An earlier ERAI result of 0.6207 rules out universal unpredictability as a simple explanation. Evaluation should jointly consider text, market regime, historical volatility, horizon, and pair composition.

AI.tldr: BAIBAICHUCHU队伍在NTCIR-19 FinArg-3社交媒体子任务中排序中文投资者帖子：三路集成开发集达0.734，但官方仅0.517；事后审计发现裁判对看跌帖误用long-only规则，修正后不改变准确率却降低开发集表现，揭示制度相关语义捷径；波动率×持有期评分与MPP代理相关（ρ=0.320，配对排序61.4%），文本迁移几乎无预测力。
AI.motivation: 论文动机在于评估预测最大可能收益（MPP）排序任务中，模型在开发集与官方测试集间存在巨大性能落差，且MPP本身依赖市场行情与立场，现有评估可能因制度特定的语义捷径而产生虚高验证拟合，需厘清文本、波动率、持有期与配对构成等因素的真实贡献。
AI.method: 方法包括：构建词法特征、FinArg-2预微调MacBERT排序器与LLM裁判三路集成；事后审计标签构造器并修正long-only规则；将排序分解为方向性文本、波动率与持有期、配对边际；采用running-extremum模型预测σ√T尺度，并用发帖前波动率σ_pre,20√N_i与截断持有期MPP代理做相关及配对排序分析。
AI.result: 结果为：开发集0.734、官方最佳0.517，全部12次提交在0.4598–0.5402之间，26个三路一致配对为0.500；修正规则影响87条官方预测中的28条但准确率不变，开发集准确率由0.680降至0.622；σ_pre,20√N_i与MPP代理Spearman ρ=0.320（ticker-cluster 95% CI [0.133,0.466]），正确排序61.4%不等结果配对；迁移文本与7月结果几乎无关（ρ=0.055），条件增量很小；开发集可靠性随标记MPP差距扩大由约0.60升至0.93；早期ERAI结果0.6207排除完全不可预测解释。
AI.conclusion: 结论：评估应联合考虑文本、市场制度、历史波动率、持有期与配对构成；制度特定的语义捷径可能夸大验证拟合，而波动率×持有期评分具备一定可迁移的排序信号，文本迁移贡献有限。

title: FADE: Frame-Aware Diffusion-Transformer-based Multi-Concept Erasure for Video Unlearning
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models can reproduce copyrighted, violent, or explicit content, which motivates concept erasure: removing designated concepts from a pretrained model while preserving its behavior on everything else. Existing T2V erasure methods leave two problems open. Their frame-agnostic suppression can leave isolated frames in which an erased concept resurfaces, a frame-reactivation gap that clip-level averages obscure; and they are usually evaluated with one target concept or category at a time. We propose Frame-Aware Diffusion Erasure (FADE), a multi-concept video unlearning framework. FADE first applies a joint closed-form key/value edit that suppresses all target concepts, then trains per-concept frame-aware low-rank adapters whose strength is gated by the frame index and the denoising timestep to remove residual per-frame leakage. Each adapter is trained with the other targets' prompts as hard negatives, which keeps the concept-specific components of different adapters well separated, and a similarity-based soft router combines the adapters according to the prompt. With 16 concepts (objects, artistic styles, and nudity) erased from a single Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone, FADE reduces the residual accuracy on the object benchmark to 4.9%, against 15.5% for the strongest of eight baselines, while keeping the VBench average within 0.9% of the unedited model. The ranking is unchanged under a VLM judge and a blinded human study, and the advantage over the strongest baseline carries over to prompts that combine several erased concepts, to 30 simultaneously erased celebrity identities, and to Wan2.1-T2V-14B, CogVideoX-2B, and HunyuanVideo-1.5.

AI.tldr: 提出FADE，多概念视频遗忘框架，通过联合闭式K/V编辑与逐概念帧感知LoRA消除残余泄漏。
AI.motivation: 现有T2V概念擦除方法存在两个问题：帧无关抑制会留下被擦除概念复现的孤立帧（clip级平均掩盖了帧级复现）；且通常只针对单一概念或类别评估。
AI.method: FADE先做联合闭式key/value编辑抑制所有目标概念，再训练逐概念、帧感知的低秩适配器，其强度由帧索引和去噪时间步门控以去除残余逐帧泄漏。每个适配器以其他目标的prompt作为难负例训练以分离概念特异性成分，并用基于相似度的软路由器按prompt组合适配器。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B上擦除16个概念，物体基准残余准确率降至4.9%（最强基线15.5%），VBench平均仅比未编辑模型低0.9%。排序在VLM评判和盲测人类研究中一致，优势还可扩展到多概念组合prompt、30个名人身份及Wan2.1-T2V-14B、CogVideoX-2B、HunyuanVideo-1.5。
AI.conclusion: FADE有效解决T2V多概念擦除中的帧级复现与多概念评估问题，在保持生成质量的同时显著降低残余泄漏，并具备跨模型与跨场景的泛化性。

title: Incentive Alignment in Online Experimentation
summary: Evaluating the causal effect of new features is a central goal for online platforms. While recent literature addresses limited testing traffic via centralized portfolio optimization, this perspective abstracts away a critical institutional reality: experimentation is operationally decentralized. The experimenters who develop new features also dictate which hypotheses to test, and they are typically rewarded based on empirical average treatment effects that are prone to upward bias. Left unchecked, this principal-agent conflict can severely erode platform value, a structural failure that conventional centralized levers, such as significance thresholds and traffic budgets, cannot resolve. By reframing experimentation as an incentive design problem, we demonstrate that two practical mechanisms, sample splitting and shrinkage, can effectively bridge this gap. Sample splitting aligns incentives perfectly at a bounded traffic cost, while shrinkage consumes no additional traffic and guarantees that interventions with negative expected effects are strictly unprofitable to field.

AI.tldr: 本文从激励设计视角研究在线平台去中心化实验中的主代理冲突，提出样本分割与收缩两种机制来对齐实验者激励、保证平台价值。
AI.motivation: 现有文献通过集中式组合优化解决测试流量有限问题，但忽略了实验在操作上是去中心化的：开发新功能的实验者同时决定测试哪些假设，且通常按易被高估的经验平均处理效应获得奖励。这种主代理冲突会侵蚀平台价值，传统的显著性阈值和流量预算等集中式手段无法解决。
AI.method: 将实验重新表述为激励设计问题，分析两种实际机制：样本分割（sample splitting）与收缩（shrinkage）。
AI.result: 样本分割在有限的流量成本下能完美对齐激励；收缩不消耗额外流量，并保证具有负期望效应的干预措施在投放时严格无利可图。
AI.conclusion: 通过激励设计视角可有效弥合去中心化实验中的主代理冲突，样本分割和收缩为平台提供了可操作的解决方案。

title: RETRACE: From Entangled Repair Histories to Reusable Experience for CI Repair
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly reuse prior experience, but most approaches assume that problems and solutions are already aligned. Software histories rarely provide this alignment: a pull request (PR) may contain multiple continuous integration (CI) problems, failed attempts, reverted edits, and unrelated changes, obscuring which changes resolve each problem. We present RETRACE, a framework for reconstructing problem-level repair experience from such histories. RETRACE combines an endpoint view that reasons backward from changes retained in the passing revision with a development view that traces repair evolution forward through commit history. CI execution evidence reconciles the two views, and the recovered experience is represented at three abstraction levels, from concrete fixes to transferable repair patterns. For new failures, RETRACE retrieves relevant problem-level experience to guide repair. On CI-REPAIR-BENCH, comprising 565 PR-level repairs from 101 repositories across 12 failure categories, RETRACE improves mini-SWE-agent Pass@1 from 19.6% to 31.9% with MiniMax-M2.5 and from 23.3% to 32.8% with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On a matched subset, Codex improves from 15.5% to 27.5%. Combining both views consistently outperforms either alone, showing that recovering problem-change alignment enables historical CI repairs to serve as reusable repair experience.

AI.tldr: RETRACE 从软件仓库历史中重构"问题级"修复经验，通过端点视角与开发视角结合，将历史 CI 修复转化为可复用经验来指导新故障修复。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 复用历史经验时，通常假设问题与解决方案已对齐，但软件历史（如 PR）混杂多个 CI 问题、失败尝试、回退编辑和无关改动，难以确定哪些改动解决了哪个问题，因此需要恢复问题-改动对齐。
AI.method: RETRACE 结合两种视角：端点视角从通过修订中保留的改动反向推理；开发视角沿提交历史正向追踪修复演化。CI 执行证据用于调和两视角，恢复的经验按三个抽象层次表示（从具体修复到可迁移的修复模式）。对新的失败，检索相关的问题级经验来指导修复。
AI.result: 在 CI-REPAIR-BENCH（565 个 PR 级修复，覆盖 101 个仓库、12 类失败）上：mini-SWE-agent 的 Pass@1 从 19.6% 提升至 31.9%（MiniMax-M2.5），从 23.3% 提升至 32.8%（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）；匹配子集上 Codex 从 15.5% 提升至 27.5%。两视角结合持续优于单一视角。
AI.conclusion: 恢复问题-改动对齐能使历史 CI 修复作为可复用的修复经验，显著提升 LLM agent 的自动化修复能力。

title: AgentDiscover: Autonomous Discovery with Minimal Search Scaffolding
summary: Frameworks that use large language models for scientific discovery typically rely on a fixed, human-designed algorithm that decides what the model sees at each step, leaving the model only the role of proposer. The model knows nothing of the search beyond what it is shown. As models grow more capable, a question arises: does a search strategy chosen by a human before the run scale better than promoting the model from proposer to planner and letting it own the search? The Bitter Lesson suggests that choosing the strategy in advance is the kind of hand-designed structure that general methods eventually outscale. We introduce AgentDiscover, in which a coding agent plans the search using its context as working memory, runs experiments, and records every attempt in a database of ideas, candidates, and their relations. This database serves as the agent's long-term memory and is structured so that the selection rules of classical algorithms such as MAP-Elites and Monte Carlo tree search each reduce to a single query, which the agent is free to use, combine, or replace. A server maintains the database and steers the agent after every submission, keeping it on course over long runs. In our experiments, AgentDiscover is more cost-efficient than existing frameworks, reaching better scores at lower cost. On tasks in kernel engineering, biology, algorithm design, and mathematics, AgentDiscover outperforms prior discovery frameworks. Its programs would have placed first among human competitors in seven past AtCoder heuristic contests, and on eleven mathematical and systems optimization tasks it matches or exceeds every baseline that uses the same model. Our code is available at https://github.com/mhdfb/AgentDiscover.

AI.tldr: AgentDiscover让编码智能体从"提议者"升级为"规划者"，用上下文做工作记忆、用数据库做长期记忆来主导科学发现搜索，在多项任务上以更低成本超过现有框架。
AI.motivation: 现有科学发现框架依赖固定的人工设计算法决定模型每一步看到什么，模型仅充当提议者，无法掌握搜索全局。随着模型能力增强，需探讨：人类预先选定的搜索策略是否比让模型自己主导搜索更具扩展性。Bitter Lesson暗示预先设计策略终将被通用方法超越。
AI.method: 提出AgentDiscover：编码智能体用其上下文作为工作记忆来规划搜索、运行实验，并把每次尝试记录进一个包含想法、候选及关系的数据库。该数据库作为长期记忆，结构化到使MAP-Elites、蒙特卡洛树搜索等经典算法的选择规则各可化简为一次查询，智能体可自由使用、组合或替换。服务器维护数据库并在每次提交后引导智能体，保证长程运行不偏航。
AI.result: 成本效率优于现有框架，以更低成本达到更好分数；在核工程、生物学、算法设计、数学任务上超越先前发现框架；其程序在七个往届AtCoder启发式竞赛中可列为人类选手第一；在十一个数学与系统优化任务上，匹配或超过所有使用同一模型的基线。
AI.conclusion: 让模型从提议者升级为搜索规划者、以数据库作为长期记忆并由服务器持续引导，是更可扩展且高效的科学发现范式，验证了Bitter Lesson关于通用方法终将超越人工预设结构的观点。

title: Behavioral History Outperforms Descriptions of the Person for LLM Synthetic Personas
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic personas representing survey respondents. Their validity as substitutes for particular respondents depends on whether they reproduce individuals' decisions. We examine what information helps synthetic respondents predict each individual's later choices, using five conditions that add progressively richer information: no personal information, demographics, personality traits, cognitive scores, and finally the respondent's earlier survey choices as behavioral history. We use a two-wave panel of 845 US adults who completed measures of 14 behavioral biases (spanning risk, time preferences, overconfidence, and reasoning), so each respondent's earlier answers provide a human test-retest benchmark; in the behavioral-history condition, all items that score the target bias are withheld. At the population level, the average number of biases per respondent in every condition is close to the human average (7.1-8.1 biases, against 7.1 for humans). This aggregate similarity masks differences in variance: persona descriptions recover only 53-67% of human between-person variation, whereas adding behavioral history restores it to approximately the human level. At the individual level, description-based personas achieve only 7-12% of the informedness observed in human test-retest responses, while adding behavioral history raises this to 28%. The condition including behavioral history has the highest estimated informedness in all 17 demographic groups, whereas description-based conditions provide little or no information for some groups. Synthetic responses also exhibit stronger education- and income-related differences than human responses. For LLM synthetic personas, a respondent's past answers add more to individual-level prediction than a description of who they are.

AI.tldr: 用845人两波面板检验LLM合成受访者：人口统计、人格、认知等描述只能恢复个体差异的53-67%、informedness仅7-12%；加入受访者过往答题（行为史）后可提升至接近人类水平（informedness 28%），是预测个体选择最有效的信息。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用作合成受访者替代真实调查对象，但其有效性取决于能否复现个体的真实决策；需要厘清哪些信息能帮助合成受访者预测每个人的具体选择。
AI.method: 使用845名美国成年人两波面板数据，测量14种行为偏差（风险、时间偏好、过度自信、推理）；设5个信息递增条件：无个人信息、人口统计、人格特质、认知得分、过往答题行为史；诊断目标偏差的题目在行为史条件下被剔除，并以人类重测成绩作为基准。
AI.result: 群体层面各条件平均偏差数都接近人类（7.1-8.1 vs 7.1），但掩盖了方差差异：描述型人设只恢复53-67%的人际差异，加行为史后接近人类水平；个体层面描述型informedness仅7-12%（人类重测基准），加行为史升至28%；含行为史条件在全部17个人口组中informedness最高，描述型对部分群体几乎无信息；合成回答的教育、收入差异强于人类。
AI.conclusion: 对LLM合成受访者而言，受访者的过往答案是比"他是谁"的描述更有价值的个体级预测信息。

title: Quality-Aware Cross-Model Computation Reuse
summary: An intermediate result computed by one model can be reused by other models to perform their tasks. Existing work mainly focuses on practical execution, leaving a theoretical gap in optimizing reuse decisions. This optimization faces two challenges: quality uncertainty, because the effect of reuse on task quality is uncertain across models, and coupled scheduling, because tasks need to share the cost of preparing reusable results. These challenges compound each other: quality must be learned online, but the shared preparation structure makes scheduling NP-hard even with known quality, breaking the key assumption in existing methods. We formulate cross-model computation reuse as an online decision problem and develop the Quality-Aware Reuse Scheduling (QARS) algorithm to address it. For quality uncertainty, QARS learns task-dependent reuse quality from selected, possibly delayed feedback and uses optimistic estimates to guide decisions. For coupled scheduling, it jointly chooses which results to prepare and which tasks should use them, adapting scheduling accuracy to the remaining quality uncertainty. For the considered problem, our analysis separates learning and optimization error in regret and quantifies the tradeoff between scheduling accuracy and computation. Completing the quality-aware stopping rule yields $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ regret while preserving feasibility. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of QARS in optimizing cross-model reuse, reducing the combined cost of computation and quality loss by up to 18.0%, and mean regret by 63.9% over the strongest scheduling baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文将跨模型计算复用建模为在线决策问题，提出QARS算法，兼顾质量不确定性与耦合调度，实现约O(√T)遗憾并显著降低成本。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模型复用研究侧重实际执行，缺乏复用决策的理论优化。优化面临两大挑战：模型间复用对任务质量的影响不确定（质量不确定性），以及任务需分担可复用结果的准备成本（耦合调度），且二者相互交织，使问题即使质量已知也具NP难特性，现有方法的假设不再成立。
AI.method: 提出质量感知复用调度（QARS）算法：针对质量不确定性，从被选取且可能延迟的反馈中学习任务相关的复用质量，并用乐观估计指导决策；针对耦合调度，联合选择准备哪些结果及哪些任务使用它们，使调度精度自适应剩余质量不确定性；分析将学习误差与优化误差分离于遗憾中，刻画调度精度与计算量的权衡，并给出质量感知停止规则。
AI.result: 完成质量感知停止规则后获得Õ(√T)遗憾并保持可行性；实验表明QARS有效优化跨模型复用，相比最强调度基线，计算与质量损失组合成本最多降低18.0%，平均遗憾降低63.9%。
AI.conclusion: QARS为跨模型计算复用提供了兼具理论保证与实用效果的在线调度方案，在质量不确定与耦合调度并存下实现低遗憾与成本优化。

title: Do Language Models Need a Trainable Input Embedding Table? Fixed Minimal Token Codes at 1.7B-Class Scale
summary: A trainable input embedding table assigns each vocabulary item an independently adjustable vector. We investigate whether this token-specific parameterization is required for substantial language-modeling capability, or whether a shared Transformer can learn from fixed token identities. We compare three decoder-only language models trained from scratch with the same tokenizer, contextual backbone, untied output-head architecture, and training recipe, with a target budget of 100 billion prediction tokens per model. Their input interfaces are a learned table, canonical 16-bit token-ID codes, and one fixed invertible recoding over GF(2). The fixed codes are repeated to model width without an additional trainable input projection. Both fixed-code models acquire substantial capabilities: canonical codes achieve 52.40\% HellaSwag normalized accuracy, 70.51\% PIQA accuracy, and 42.75\% LAMBADA accuracy. The learned-input control performs better on several evaluations, including HellaSwag and LAMBADA, so these results establish viability rather than performance parity. The fixed interfaces remove 100.7 million trainable parameters, yielding 1.711B-parameter models, but parameter reduction is not the central result. These single-run experiments distinguish architectural necessity from empirical utility: independently trainable token-specific input vectors are not required for the observed capabilities. A fixed identity interface also provides a controlled setting for studying representation learning downstream of an immutable input, without establishing where particular capabilities are localized.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨语言模型是否必须使用可训练的词嵌入表，比较三种输入接口（学习型表、固定16位token ID码、GF(2)固定可逆编码）训练的语言模型。固定编码模型也获得了显著能力，表明token特定的可训练输入向量并非语言建模能力的必要前提，而是可行性证明而非性能对等。
AI.motivation: 可训练输入嵌入表为每个词表项分配独立可调向量。作者质疑：这种token特定的参数化是否是获得实质语言建模能力所必需的，还是共享Transformer可以仅从固定的token身份中学习。
AI.method: 从零训练三个仅解码器语言模型，使用相同分词器、上下文主干、非绑定输出头架构和训练配方，每模型目标预算1000亿预测token。输入接口分别为：学习型嵌入表、规范16位token ID码、GF(2)上的一个固定可逆重编码。固定码直接重复到模型宽度，无需额外可训练输入投影。
AI.result: 两个固定编码模型均获得显著能力：规范码达到52.40% HellaSwag归一化准确率、70.51% PIQA准确率、42.75% LAMBADA准确率。学习输入对照在HellaSwag和LAMBADA等评测上表现更好。固定接口减少了1.007亿可训练参数，得到17.11亿参数模型，但参数减少并非核心结果。
AI.conclusion: 这些单次实验区分了架构必要性与经验效用：独立可训练的token特定输入向量并非所观察能力的必要条件。固定身份接口也为研究不可变输入下游的表示学习提供了受控环境，但未确定特定能力的位置。

title: Masked Privileged-Information Distillation for Multimodal Skin Lesion Classification Under Missing Clinical Metadata
summary: Multimodal skin lesion classification combines clinical images with patient metadata to improve diagnostic accuracy. However, complete metadata available during training may be only partially accessible at deployment, and resource-constrained settings additionally require computational efficiency. We address these challenges with a privileged-information distillation framework in which a multimodal teacher trained on complete metadata supervises a 9.2x smaller student trained with randomly masked clinical fields. Clinical fields are masked as whole groups at a per-sample rate drawn from U(0,1), so one training run covers the full metadata availability range. Fusion is residual, with metadata added as a gated correction to an unconditional image base. On the PAD-UFES-20 dataset, distillation under masked training improves balanced accuracy over cross-entropy training at every availability level, by an average of +4.7 points versus +1.8 points without masking. The masked student loses only 7.8 balanced-accuracy points as metadata decreases from complete to absent, compared with 36.6 points for the same student trained on complete metadata, highlighting the role of masked training in graceful degradation beyond distillation alone. Grad-CAM visualizations further show that the masked student's attention generally remains lesion-centered as metadata is withdrawn. The resulting compact model targets point-of-care settings, where clinical metadata is often incomplete.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种特权信息蒸馏框架，用完整元数据训练的多模态教师模型指导一个小9.2倍、随机掩码临床字段的学生模型，实现皮肤病变分类在元数据部分缺失时的优雅退化。
AI.motivation: 多模态皮肤病变分类结合临床图像与患者元数据可提升诊断精度，但部署时元数据往往只有部分可用，且资源受限场景额外要求计算效率。
AI.method: 采用特权信息蒸馏：教师用完整元数据训练，学生用随机掩码临床字段训练。临床字段按U(0,1)逐样本速率整组掩码，使单次训练覆盖完整元数据可用范围。融合为残差式，元数据以门控校正形式加到无条件图像基座上。
AI.result: 在PAD-UFES-20数据集上，掩码训练下蒸馏在所有可用性水平均优于交叉熵训练，平均提升+4.7点（无掩码仅+1.8点）。掩码学生从完整到无元数据仅损失7.8平衡准确率点，而同一学生在完整元数据训练下损失36.6点。Grad-CAM显示掩码学生在元数据撤除时注意力仍集中于病变区域。
AI.conclusion: 掩码训练带来超越蒸馏本身的优雅退化能力，所得紧凑模型适用于临床元数据常不完整的即时诊疗场景。

title: The Complexity of Computing Nash Equilibria in Colonel Blotto Games
summary:
We study the complexity of Nash equilibrium computation in discrete Colonel Blotto games. For two-player general-sum Colonel Blotto with monotonic piecewise-constant battlefield payoffs, we show that computing an inverse-polynomial approximate Nash equilibrium is PPAD-hard, even with only two battlefields and a constant number of pieces per battlefield, thereby resolving an open question of [KPF+25]. Allowing more battlefields, the hardness persists when every battlefield payoff is $2$-piecewise constant with respect to either player's allocation. A general PPAD-membership theorem for multiplayer Blotto with arbitrary local reward functions then implies PPAD-completeness for both hardness results.
  Motivated by fixed-rank bimatrix games, we then identify a tractable frontier within two-player general-sum Colonel Blotto. If the social payoff has rank-$r$ structure, then, for every fixed $r$, an $\varepsilon$-Nash equilibrium can be computed in time polynomial in $B_1,B_2,k$, and $1/\varepsilon$. Thus constant-rank two-player Colonel Blotto remains tractable despite its exponentially large pure strategy spaces.
  Finally, we study multiplayer winner-takes-all Colonel Blotto with player-specific battlefield values and uncover a sharp tie-breaking frontier. If every highest bidder receives her full battlefield value, an exact pure Nash equilibrium can be computed in polynomial time for arbitrary binary-encoded budgets. In contrast, under ordinary equal splitting among highest bidders, we prove that computing an inverse-polynomial-accuracy Nash equilibrium is PPAD-hard even with only five players. This resolves an open question posed in concurrent work by Bichler and Ghosh [BG26], who established PPAD-hardness in the same player-specific equal-splitting setting when the number of players grows with the instance and asked whether hardness persists for a constant number of players.

AI.tldr: 本文研究离散Colonel Blotto博弈中Nash均衡计算的复杂度，证明一般情形PPAD-完备，识别常秩可解边界，并揭示多人赢者通吃博弈的平局处理分界。
AI.motivation: Colonel Blotto博弈纯策略空间指数大，其Nash均衡计算复杂度长期存在开放问题，尤其是二人一般和、常数战场与常数玩家情形的PPAD难解性及可解边界尚不清楚。
AI.method: 通过归约证明二人单调分段常数战场收益下求逆多项式近似Nash均衡是PPAD-hard；给出多玩家Blotto任意局部奖励函数的PPAD成员性定理；利用社交收益秩-r结构设计多项式时间算法；分析多人赢者通吃下玩家专属价值与不同平局规则的影响。
AI.result: 证明二人、仅两个战场、每战场常数块数即PPAD-hard；更多战场且2-分段常数仍难解，结合成员性得PPAD-完备。常秩r二人一般和可在poly(B1,B2,k,1/ε)内求ε-Nash。赢者通吃下若最高出价者得全额则纯Nash可多项式求解；普通均分时五玩家即PPAD-hard。
AI.conclusion: 完整刻画了离散Colonel Blotto均衡计算的复杂度边界：一般情形PPAD-完备，常秩结构可解，平局规则导致从多项式可解到PPAD-hard的相变，并解决多个开放问题。

title: Towards Automatically Pruning Logging Code with Coding Agents: How Far Are We?
summary: Logging code supports debugging, monitoring, and software maintenance, but excessive logging can add noise, impose runtime overhead, and obscure diagnostic information. While prior research has extensively studied logging code generation and modification, logging removal remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we study developer logging removal practices and explore the use of coding agents for this task. We extract and manually validate logging removal cases from Python and Java repositories and derive 10 removal patterns and 11 removal reasons that characterize how and why logging code was removed in real-world software changes. We further construct LogRem, a dataset of 387 real-world cases covering direct logging statement removal, logging infrastructure removal, and logging replacement. We evaluate four coding agents with multiple model settings and compare their outputs with accepted real-world changes. Although 95.6% to 100.0% of outputs pass validity checks, only 11.1% to 19.6% remove the same logging code as the corresponding real-world change while preserving unrelated code. Agents differ through missed removals, extra removals, and unrelated code edits, with substantial variation across logging removal categories and trajectories. Execution cost varies widely, but higher cost does not consistently yield closer alignment. Commit messages and developer discussions provide the largest alignment gains, while taxonomy guidance consistently reduces runtime. Overall, our study establishes logging removal as a distinct software maintenance task and shows that reliable automation depends on accurately determining removal scope while preserving necessary code. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to examine logging code removal from this perspective.

AI.tldr: 首个系统研究日志代码移除任务，构建LogRem数据集并评估四种编码代理的表现。
AI.motivation: 日志代码支持调试与维护，但过度日志会带来噪声、运行时开销并掩盖诊断信息。已有研究多关注日志生成和修改，日志移除研究相对不足。
AI.method: 从Python和Java仓库提取并人工验证日志移除案例，归纳10种移除模式和11种移除原因；构建包含387个真实案例的LogRem数据集，覆盖日志语句移除、日志基础设施移除和日志替换三类；用多种模型设置评估四种编码代理，并与真实变更对比。
AI.result: 95.6%–100.0%的输出通过有效性检查，但仅11.1%–19.6%与真实变更移除相同日志代码并保留无关代码。代理差异体现在遗漏移除、多余移除和无关代码编辑，且在不同类别与轨迹间差异显著。执行成本波动大，成本更高并不必然更贴近真实变更；提交信息和开发者讨论带来最大对齐提升，分类指导持续降低运行时。
AI.conclusion: 日志移除是一种独立的软件维护任务，可靠自动化依赖准确判断移除范围并保留必要代码。这是首个从该视角研究日志代码移除的工作。

title: COVER: Learning to Accept More in Selective Sleep Staging
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures; code and frozen-result reproduction: https://github.com/Kevin11Kaikai/COVER-Selective-Sleep-Staging
summary: Traditional sleep-staging methods apply the same model to every EEG epoch. Such uniform deployment expends computation on epochs that a smaller model could handle reliably, motivating cascades in which a primary classifier accepts its reliable predictions and defers the remainder to a more capable model. In this paper, we study the first stage of such a cascade: maximizing the coverage of fixed primary predictions subject to a prescribed accepted-risk target. We propose COVER (COVerage-oriented Error Ranking), which integrates two key innovations: (i) auxiliary-informed primary-error learning, which replaces maximum softmax probability (MSP) with a learned error score while preserving the primary labels, and (ii) fixed-scale scorer refinement, which builds on this score to directly maximize coverage under an empirical accepted-risk constraint rather than error-prediction accuracy over all epochs. We evaluate COVER on Sleep-EDF-20 at a 5% accepted-risk target, with subjects held out from all fitting and selection. Auxiliary-informed error learning raises mean subject coverage from 31.5% for MSP to 48.8% at similar subject-equal risk. At equal acceptance volume, with MSP accepting the same number of epochs as the learned scorer in each subject (20,639 in total), errors fall from 1,467 to 867. Fixed-scale refinement then adds 1.7 percentage points of coverage over its initialization in nested development, and COVER attains the highest mean coverage among eight evaluated scorers, 50.4% at 4.5% subject-equal risk, above the selective-ranking baseline SELE (49.3%) and the probability-fusion comparator DuoF (43.6%). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to combine auxiliary-informed primary-error learning with fixed-scale coverage refinement for selective sleep staging, offering a basis for reliability-aware allocation of computation in cascaded sleep staging.

AI.tldr: 提出COVER方法，通过辅助信息驱动的误差学习与固定尺度评分精炼，在受控风险下最大化睡眠分期主分类器的覆盖率，为级联计算奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 传统睡眠分期对所有EEG片段使用同一模型，计算浪费；级联方案可用小模型处理可靠片段、其余交给更强模型，但需最大化主模型在给定接受风险下的覆盖率。
AI.method: COVER含两项创新：(i)辅助信息驱动的主模型误差学习，用学习的误差分数替代MSP，同时保留主标签；(ii)固定尺度评分精炼，在经验接受风险约束下直接最大化覆盖率，而非优化全体片段的误差预测精度。
AI.result: Sleep-EDF-20、5%接受风险、被试留出：误差学习将平均覆盖率由MSP的31.5%提升至48.8%；同等接受量(20,639)下错误从1467降至867；固定尺度精炼在嵌套开发中再增1.7个百分点；COVER在八种评分器中覆盖率最高，50.4%@4.5%风险，优于SELE(49.3%)和DuoF(43.6%)。
AI.conclusion: 首次将辅助信息驱动的主模型误差学习与固定尺度覆盖率精炼结合用于选择性睡眠分期，为级联睡眠分期中可靠性感知的计算分配提供了基础。

title: SkillScriptBench: Benchmarking Self-Evolution of Executable Agent Skill Packages Beyond Markdown
summary: Executable Agent Skills combine natural-language instructions and scripts into reusable packages for LLM agents, and revising them requires fixing errors without breaking correct behavior. Existing benchmarks do not systematically distinguish documentation repair, script repair, and preservation when evaluating skill self-evolution. We introduce SkillScriptBench, a 350-task benchmark designed to evaluate these capabilities separately. From a survey of over 35,000 GitHub-hosted Skill roots, we select 100 packages and construct 150 repair tasks. Each task pairs a package containing injected script faults with a maintenance request and executable checks of the required behavior. A complementary controlled track contains 200 tasks from 50 packages, each evaluated under the same maintenance request in four states: clean, documentation faults, script faults, and faults in both. Across four LLMs, methods that edit both documentation and scripts can repair script faults but do not consistently outperform Markdown-only revision on documentation repair or preservation. We therefore introduce AST-Guided Skill Revision, which uses abstract syntax trees and calling relationships to link maintenance requirements to relevant code locations. It restricts script edits to these locations and updates the documentation to match the revised scripts. Averaged across models, this revision stage yields absolute gains in repair success of 21.9% for Raw Package and 27.7% for CoEvoSkills on faulty packages. Absolute gains in the proportion of tasks solved in all three runs reach 20.8% and 31.5%, respectively, indicating more consistent repair success across repeated runs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SkillScriptBench 基准（350 任务）区分文档修复、脚本修复与保持能力，并引入 AST-Guided Skill Revision 方法，通过 AST 与调用关系定位代码位置来修复技能。修复成功率提升最高达 27.7%。
AI.motivation: 可执行 Agent Skills 需要在不破坏正确行为的前提下修复错误，但现有基准未系统区分文档修复、脚本修复和保持能力，难以评估技能自演化效果。
AI.method: 构建 SkillScriptBench：从 35,000+ GitHub Skill 中选 100 个包构造 150 个修复任务，另设 200 任务受控轨道（clean、文档故障、脚本故障、两者兼具四状态）。并提出 AST-Guided Skill Revision，利用抽象语法树和调用关系将维护需求映射到相关代码位置，限制脚本编辑范围并同步更新文档。
AI.result: 四种 LLM 上，同时编辑文档与脚本的方法能修复脚本故障，但在文档修复与保持上不稳定优于仅 Markdown 修订。AST-Guided Skill Revision 平均带来修复成功绝对提升：Raw Package 21.9%、CoEvoSkills 27.7%；三次运行全部成功的任务比例提升 20.8% 与 31.5%。
AI.conclusion: AST-Guided 修订通过精确定位代码位置并同步文档，显著提升修复成功率与跨运行一致性，优于直接改写方案。

title: Search Engines Never Say No: How Frozen Agents React When the Retrieval Tool Refuses
summary: A search tool never says no: it returns its top-k passages even when the index holds no answer, so the agent sees irrelevant text instead of a miss signal. We ask what frozen search agents do when the tool refuses instead. On an index-hole testbed (257 NQ and 300 HotpotQA questions run with and without their gold passages in a 21M-passage BM25 index), seven agents receive one of five refusal wordings. An un-announced one-sentence refusal raises abstention on unanswerable questions from 23% to 97% on average for Qwen3-8B/32B and from 28% to 57% for Claude Haiku 4.5, cutting wrong answers almost one-for-one and beating a system-prompt instruction by 51 points on average. Search-R1 ignores the refusal and fabricates retrievals; Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 answer from memory (abstention +2 points) and obey a system-prompt directive instead (+16). We also found that wording matters: an explanation beats a bare token; a directive inside the observation is decisive for Haiku; a soft warning is useless. Realistic triggers, from a lightweight score-based predictor to an LLM grounding judge, fall well short of the oracle, and all land on a benefit-versus-signal-quality curve that prices any trigger by its recall at a fixed false-refusal budget: for compliant agents the bottleneck is the detector inside the tool, not the agent, and the curve tells future detector work what each point of recall is worth.

AI.tldr: 论文研究当检索工具拒绝返回（返回"未找到"信号）而非总是返回top-k时，冻结搜索代理的行为。在包含257个NQ和300个HotpotQA问题的索引空洞测试平台上，测试7个代理对5种拒绝措辞的反应。
AI.motivation: 搜索工具从不说"不"，即使索引中没有答案也返回top-k段落，导致代理看到无关文本而非缺失信号。作者想探究当工具真正拒绝时，冻结搜索代理会如何反应。
AI.method: 构建索引空洞测试平台（257个NQ和300个HotpotQA问题，分别在21M段落BM25索引中有/无黄金段落情况下运行），7个代理接收5种不同的拒绝措辞。
AI.result: 未预告的一句话拒绝使Qwen3-8B/32B在不可回答问题上的弃权率从23%升至97%，Claude Haiku 4.5从28%升至57%，几乎一对一减少错误答案，平均比系统提示指令高51分。Search-R1忽略拒绝并捏造检索；Claude Sonnet 5.5和Opus 5.5从记忆作答（弃权+2分），服从系统提示指令（+16）。措辞很重要：解释优于单纯token；观察中的指令对Haiku起决定作用；软警告无用。现实触发器（基于分数的预测器到LLM接地判断器）远不及oracle，都落在收益-信号质量曲线上。
AI.conclusion: 对合规代理而言，瓶颈是工具内部的检测器而非代理本身，该曲线为未来检测器研究指明每一点召回率的价值。

title: Periscope: Extending Frozen Language Models Beyond Their Context Window
summary: A language model reads long text in one quadratic forward pass, stops at the context window, and loses accuracy with length before reaching it. We ask whether the read can be factorized when deciding over a finite set: which document is relevant, which option is supported, which passage is the evidence. Periscope, a training-free inference method, arranges the $N$ chunks of a text on a $K{\times}K$ grid with $K{=}\lceil\sqrt{N}\rceil$ and asks a frozen model the same question about $K$ local spans of consecutive chunks and $K$ strided spans that sample the whole text, reading the log-odds of every answer at one token. Each answer takes its best local and strided score, and scoring every chunk by its two spans gives an evidence map at no further cost, whose peak is the chunk behind the answer. Every probe is about $\sqrt{sc}$ tokens for a text of $s$ tokens and chunk size $c$, so a window of $W$ tokens reaches $W^{2}/c$ tokens at $s^{1.5}$ cost. The map replaces the long read. On LongBench v2, reading only the $K$ chunks the map ranks highest, 9k tokens, matches the same model's best window read across windows from 32k to 1M tokens, and on InfiniteBench, where the median context is 150k tokens, it leads the best window read by 5 points. The same map ranks BRIGHT's long-document corpora with the best NDCG@10 of six methods. Each call caches only one probe, so a 27B model reads 4.5M-token contexts on one 80GB GPU, where a single pass would need 296GB of cache. A long read then needs a GPU that holds the model, not one that holds the text.

AI.tldr: Periscope 是一种免训练推理方法，将长文本分块排成 K×K 网格，通过对局部和跨步跨度提问，用 $O(s^{1.5})$ 成本生成证据图，仅读取最高分块即可在长上下文任务上匹敌或超越最优窗口读取，并大幅降低显存需求。
AI.motivation: 语言模型一次性读取长文本受限于二次复杂度和上下文窗口，且在达到窗口上限前精度就随长度下降。作者希望将"长读取"分解为在有限选项集上的判定（哪篇文档相关、哪个选项被支持、哪段是证据），从而避免对全文的昂贵一次前向。
AI.method: Periscope 将文本的 N 个块排成 K×K 网格（K=⌈√N⌉）。对 K 个连续的局部跨度和 K 个覆盖全文的跨步跨度，用冻结模型问同一问题，并在同一个 token 处读取各答案的 log-odds。每个答案取最佳局部与跨步分数；给每块按两个跨度打分即免费得到证据图，其峰值指向答案所在块。每次探测约 √(sc) tokens，使窗口 W 可覆盖 W²/c tokens，成本为 s^1.5。每次调用只缓存一个探测。
AI.result: 在 LongBench v2 上，仅读取证据图排名最高的 K 个块（9k tokens）即可匹配同模型从 32k 到 1M 窗口的最佳完整读取；在 InfiniteBench（中位上下文 150k tokens）上领先最佳窗口读取 5 分。证据图在 BRIGHT 长文档语料上取得六种方法中最优的 NDCG@10。27B 模型可在单张 80GB GPU 上处理 4.5M token 上下文，而单次完整前向需 296GB 缓存。
AI.conclusion: 长文本读取可被分解并通过证据图替代，使长读取只需能容纳模型的 GPU，而非能容纳文本的 GPU，显著降低显存并保持甚至提升精度。

title: Verifier-Guided Synthetic Augmentation for 3D Human Shape Generation
summary: Limited training data diversity constrains generative modeling of 3D human bodies: conservative models remain close to observed examples, whereas exploratory models often violate basic body proportions. We introduce a verifier-guided augmentation framework that uses global and mode-local PCA to generate inexpensive candidates, screens them using correspondence-derived skeletal proportions and body-part geometry, and retrains a diffusion model on accepted candidates. Elastic registration provides both the modal structure used by distributed PCA and the dense anatomical correspondence needed for scalable screening without per-candidate body-model fitting. A blinded human study supports the verifier as a conservative gatekeeper, favoring verifier-accepted over rejected outputs. We evaluate full-pool verifier acceptance separately from the coverage and departure of accepted samples and combine them through EAUC. On 4,498 registered DFAUST surfaces, distributed-PCA augmentation achieves 86.32% acceptance, the highest CP-AUC (0.871), and the highest EAUC (0.752), improving EAUC by 32% over real-only and self-augmented diffusion. These results show that mode-local, verifier-guided proposals broaden diffusion generation while maintaining high agreement with calibrated body measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出验证器引导的数据增强框架，用全局与局部PCA生成候选并通过骨骼比例与身体几何筛选，重训扩散模型以提升3D人体生成多样性且不破坏比例。
AI.motivation: 3D人体生成受训练数据多样性限制：保守模型贴近样本、探索模型违反人体比例。
AI.method: 基于弹性配准的分布式PCA生成候选，利用对应关系推导骨骼比例与部位几何做验证筛除，重训扩散模型；用EAUC结合接受率与覆盖度评估。
AI.result: 在4,498个DFAUST表面上，分布式PCA增强达86.32%接受率、最高CP-AUC 0.871与EAUC 0.752，EAUC较真实仅用与自增强扩散提升32%。
AI.conclusion: 模式局部、验证器引导的候选生成可在保持高比例一致性的同时拓宽扩散生成范围。

title: Parallelism or Concession? Concurrency-Aware Procurement Negotiation for Agentic Commerce
summary: Agentic buyers can cheaply fork a procurement task into many parallel negotiations, but concurrency is not free: every thread consumes resources, and simultaneous agreements create cancellation and commitment risk. We study a one-unit post-order sourcing problem with a single hard-deadline negotiation window, in which a planner jointly chooses the number of seller-facing negotiators and a common procurement price cap. The model combines a product-specific acceptance curve with fulfillment loss, per-thread cost, and excess-commitment cost. We establish three structural results. First, holding the per-thread acceptance target fixed, the marginal value of another negotiator decays geometrically, yielding a conditional concurrency threshold. Second, under a convex quantile curve, parallelism substitutes for concession: more concurrent negotiators imply a weakly lower per-thread acceptance target and price cap. Third, when prices are more dispersed, Agentic buyers benefit by searching harder for bargains, but suffer when they instead try to guarantee procurement by offering higher prices. We operationalize these results in the Concurrency-Aware Negotiation Optimizer (CANO), a deterministic optimizer that jointly determines the optimal negotiation concurrency and procurement price cap for an agentic procurement system. Across different analytic market configurations and extensive Monte Carlo, finite-data, non-Gaussian, and correlated-seller stress tests, CANO consistently outperforms common heuristic policies while validating the predicted structural properties.

AI.tldr: 研究智能体采购中并发谈判数量与价格上限的联合优化问题，提出CANO优化器，并证明三个结构性结论。
AI.motivation: 智能体买家可低成本将采购任务拆分为多路并行谈判，但并发有成本：每条线程消耗资源，同时达成协议会带来取消与承诺风险。因此需要同时决定谈判线程数与统一采购价格上限。
AI.method: 构建单单位、后下单、单一硬截止谈判窗口的采购模型，融合产品特定接受曲线、履约损失、每线程成本与超额承诺成本；提出确定性优化器CANO，联合求解最优谈判并发度与采购价格上限。
AI.result: 证明三个结构性结论：(1)固定每线程接受目标时，增加谈判者的边际价值几何衰减，存在条件性并发阈值；(2)凸分位曲线下，并行可替代让步，并发越多则每线程接受目标与价格上限越弱更低；(3)价格更分散时，更努力搜寻便宜货有利，但试图以更高价格保证采购则受损。在多种解析市场配置及蒙特卡洛、有限数据、非高斯、相关卖家压力测试中，CANO持续优于常见启发式策略并验证了结构性质。
AI.conclusion: CANO能有效联合优化并发谈判数与价格上限，验证了理论预测的结构性质，并优于常见启发式方法，为智能体采购系统的并发谈判设计提供依据。

title: Asymmetric Repository Lineage Modeling and Verifier-Guided Coordination in Concurrent AI Coding Agents
summary: Concurrent AI coding agents create a coordination problem in which cheap signals may prioritize work, but only an executable checker can establish the property being claimed. We study this separation through a property-scoped verification contract and MERGEGYM, a three-track benchmark for open-time scope forecasting, replay- conditioned conflict resolution, and scheduling. On a stratified 715-pair lineage set (167 textual conflicts), 79 conflicts (47.3%) occur despite disjoint authored file sets. This is an operationally important proxy mismatch expected from three-way merge: authored PR diffs are measured against PR-specific bases, whereas the checker compares both heads to their common merge base. A standalone lineage-union rule reaches held-out AUROC 0.877; a 12-feature logistic model reaches 0.882 [0.845, 0.917] with PR-AUC 0.661, and an untuned random forest on the same decision-time features reaches 0.902 [0.875, 0.928] with PR-AUC 0.701. At a 33.3% held-out replay budget, the logistic and random-forest models recover 81.2% and 82.9% of conflicts, respectively. Patch reconstruction succeeds for 48/79 zero- overlap conflicts and all 48 become clean; the other 31 cases are inconclusive, so this check validates the expected three-way-merge explanation rather than claiming a new Git mechanism. In T1, a zero-shot LLM reaches AUC 0.704 and LLM-plus- metadata fusion 0.740. In T3, a decision-time gate de-overlaps a median 91.7% of labeled scope collisions at 65.0% makespan inflation under frozen-label replay. Because local git merge-tree replay is already cheap in our logs (median 0.02 s), we do not claim that lineage triage saves this checker alone: when exact replay is cheap, verify everything. All empirical guarantees in this paper remain limited to textual mergeability or the explicitly stated frozen-label scheduling target.

AI.tldr: 本文研究并发AI编码代理的协调问题：廉价信号只能用于优先级排序，只有可执行检查器才能确立所声称的性质。作者提出"性质范围验证契约"及MERGEGYM三轨基准，研究开放时范围预测、回放条件下的冲突消解与调度。在715对分层血统集上，79个冲突（47.3%）出现在无文件重叠情况下；随机森林预测达AUROC 0.902，在33.3%回放预算下恢复82.9%冲突；补丁重建验证了三方合并解释；T1零样本LLM达0.704。作者强调当本地replay廉价时应验证一切。
AI.motivation: 并发AI编码代理产生协调问题：廉价信号可优先化工作，但只有可执行检查器能确立被声称的性质。作者关注这一分离，并探究为何授权文件集不相交时仍出现冲突——即三方合并在PR diff测量基准上的代理失配问题。
AI.method: 提出性质范围验证契约与MERGEGYM三轨基准（T1开放时范围预测、T2回放条件冲突消解、T3调度）。在715对分层血统集（167个文本冲突）上，对比独立血统并集规则、12特征逻辑回归与随机森林，进行补丁重建实验，并在T1/T3上进行LLM与决策时门控评估。
AI.result: 79个冲突（47.3%）出现在无文件重叠情况。血统并集规则AUROC 0.877；逻辑回归0.882、PR-AUC 0.661；随机森林0.902、PR-AUC 0.701。33.3%回放预算下逻辑回归与随机森林分别恢复81.2%和82.9%冲突。补丁重建48/79成功且全部清洁，另31例不确定。T1零样本LLM AUC 0.704，融合元数据0.740。T3决策门控中位去重叠91.7%范围碰撞，makespan膨胀65.0%。
AI.conclusion: 当本地git merge-tree回放已很廉价（中位0.02秒）时，作者不主张血统分诊单独节省检查器成本，而是主张"回放廉价时，验证一切"。所有经验保证仅限于文本可合并性或明确说明的冻结标签调度目标。补丁重建验证了预期三方合并解释，而非声称新Git机制。

title: TreeWalker: Partial Evaluation for Grouped Tree-Ensemble Inference
comment: 23 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/Shopify/treewalker
summary:
Many inference workloads evaluate a trained tree ensemble on row groups that share feature values: discrete-time survival models expand each patient into $G$ time steps, click-through-rate models score every item in a search session, and scenario analyses vary a few inputs while holding the rest fixed. Standard inference treats each row independently and repeats the shared work $G$ times.
  We present TreeWalker, which applies partial evaluation to grouped inference: constant features are static, varying features dynamic. It walks each tree once per group, partitions a row bitmask at varying splits, and skips empty subtrees. Training is unchanged: TreeWalker reads standard LightGBM and XGBoost models.
  We prove a structural work decomposition: per-tree work splits into the constant-projected subtree size $|T_c|$, $G$ leaf writes, and a predicate-mask provisioning cost $Q$. For the trace evaluator, per-row work approaches a $(d_v+1)/(d+1)$ fraction of a row-independent walk as $G \to \infty$.
  On Intel, TreeWalker is 2.5-3.2$\times$ faster than a row-independent traversal at the reference configuration ($T=500$, $L=8$) and 6.8-7.8$\times$ faster at $G=128$ on the survival datasets, with larger gains on Arm. On a scenario-analysis benchmark it is faster in all 16 configurations on both architectures. For f64 models, outputs match treelite's GTIL up to summation order; for f32 models, f64 accumulation is closer to a Kahan-compensated reference than native f32 on 99.98% of rows and never farther.

AI.tldr: TreeWalker 通过部分求值实现分组推理，将常量特征视为静态、变化特征视为动态，每棵树每次分组只遍历一次，跳过空子树，在多种基准上显著加速且保持精度。
AI.motivation: 许多推理负载在共享特征值的行组上评估树集成（如生存模型按时间步展开、CTR 模型对一次会话中所有物品打分、情景分析只改变少量输入），标准推理逐行独立处理，重复了共享工作 G 次，造成浪费。
AI.method: 提出 TreeWalker，对分组推理应用部分求值：常量特征为静态、变化特征为动态。每组每棵树只走一遍，在变化分裂处划分行位掩码并跳过空子树。训练不变，直接读取标准 LightGBM 与 XGBoost 模型。理论上给出工作量分解：每棵树工作分为常量投影子树大小 |T_c|、G 次叶写入以及谓词掩码供给成本 Q。
AI.result: 在 Intel 上，参考配置（T=500, L=8）比逐行独立遍历快 2.5-3.2 倍，G=128 时在生存数据集上快 6.8-7.8 倍，Arm 上增益更大；情景分析基准上两种架构全部 16 种配置均更快。精度方面，f64 模型输出与 treelite GTIL 在求和顺序内一致；f32 模型用 f64 累加在 99.98% 行上比原生 f32 更接近 Kahan 补偿参考，且从不更差。
AI.conclusion: TreeWalker 利用分组推理中的共享特征，通过部分求值显著加速树集成推理，并给出结构性的工作量分解与渐近分析，同时保持与现有实现的数值一致性。

title: Exploration-Preserving Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves reasoning, while the allocation of learning signal shapes which solutions remain accessible under repeated sampling. Group-relative objectives assign equal advantages to equally rewarded responses, making aggregate credit proportional to sampled mode frequency. We introduce Exploration-Preserving Policy Optimization (ExPPO), a lightweight advantage-shaping rule that redistributes credit using prompt-relative, length-normalized response surprisal and prompt pass rate. ExPPO combines bounded shaping with shared normalization to preserve verifier polarity and approximately maintain each prompt group's total absolute sequence-advantage mass. Our analysis characterizes response-level credit allocation alongside sampled mode updates, deriving local conditions for gains in entropy and correct-mode discovery. Experiments show improved in-domain and out-of-domain reasoning coverage, higher aggregate response accuracy, and strong coverage at large sampling budgets. A controlled multi-answer evaluation further demonstrates increased correct-mode yield and gains in diversity among verified-correct responses. Code is available at https://github.com/jinhangzhan/ExPPO

AI.tldr: 提出 ExPPO，一种轻量级优势塑形规则，用 prompt 相对、长度归一化的响应 surprisal 与 prompt 通过率重新分配信用，在保持验证器极性与组内优势质量近似不变的前提下提升推理覆盖与准确性。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励的强化学习能提升推理能力，但学习信号的分配方式决定了重复采样下哪些解法仍然可及。组相对目标给相同奖励的响应分配相同优势，使聚合信用与采样到的模式频率成正比，容易偏向高频模式、削弱探索。
AI.method: 提出 ExPPO：一种轻量级优势塑形规则，基于 prompt 相对的、长度归一化的响应 surprisal 以及 prompt 通过率来重新分配信用。方法结合有界塑形与共享归一化，以保持验证器极性，并近似维持每个 prompt 组的总绝对序列优势质量。论文同时从响应级信用分配与采样模式更新的角度进行分析，推导熵增与正确模式发现的局部条件。
AI.result: 实验显示域内与域外推理覆盖提升、总体响应准确率更高，并在大采样预算下保持强覆盖。受控多答案评测进一步表明正确模式产出增加，且验证为正确的响应之间多样性提升。
AI.conclusion: ExPPO 通过再分配组相对优势中的信用，在保持验证器信号方向与组内优势规模的同时改善探索与推理覆盖，为大采样预算下的多样正确解发现提供了一种简单有效的方案。代码已开源。

title: OpticalRec: Unified Optical Vision-Language Representation for Multimodal Recommendation
summary: Recent advances in vision-language modeling have substantially improved multimodal encoding, retrieval and reasoning. Yet for multimodal recommendation, encoding rich item vision-language semantic interactions remains a long-standing bottleneck, which hampers accurate item representation learning and user-item matching. Mainstream approaches primarily adopt independent encoding of vision and language modality followed by rigid late fusion such as concatenation, inherently omitting native vision-language interactions and introducing cross-modal semantic distortion. To address this challenge, we propose OpticalRec, the first visual-space unified encoding paradigm for multimodal collaborative filtering, a fundamental recommendation setting. Instead of isolated modality-specific encoding, OpticalRec renders item textual metadata as visual glyphs, enabling native image-text interaction within the visual encoder - the perceptual encoding level. The resulting representations are further processed by the language decoder - the semantic encoding level, allowing OpticalRec to exploit the dual-attention mechanism of modern vision-language models that previous encoding methods omitted. OpticalRec's efficacy is theoretically supported by mutual information analysis and empirically demonstrated through superior performance across strong baselines and benchmarks. As a plug-and-play module, OpticalRec (1) introduces minimal cost, (2) is robust against rendered text font, color and layout, etc., and (3) integrates seamlessly into existing multimodal collaborative filtering models.

AI.tldr: 提出 OpticalRec，首个面向多模态协同过滤的视觉空间统一编码范式，将文本元数据渲染为视觉字形，在视觉编码器内实现原生图文交互，经语言解码器进一步语义编码，利用双注意力机制。
AI.motivation: 多模态推荐中，编码丰富的物品视觉-语言语义交互是长期瓶颈。主流方法独立编码视觉与语言模态，再做拼接等刚性后期融合，忽略了原生跨模态交互，导致跨模态语义失真，影响物品表示学习与用户-物品匹配。
AI.method: OpticalRec 将物品文本元数据渲染为视觉字形，在视觉编码器（感知编码层）内实现原生图文交互；所得表示再由语言解码器（语义编码层）处理，从而利用现代视觉语言模型的双注意力机制。理论上有互信息分析支撑。
AI.result: 在多个强基线与基准上取得更优性能；作为即插即用模块，成本开销极小，对渲染文本的字体、颜色、布局等具有鲁棒性，可无缝集成到现有多模态协同过滤模型中。
AI.conclusion: OpticalRec 通过视觉空间统一编码范式有效解决多模态协同过滤中的跨模态交互缺失问题，兼具理论支撑、性能优势与良好的实用性。

title: IdeaScientist: Orchestrating Agents for Grounded Scientific Ideation
summary: Despite rapid progress in automating scientific research, generating promising and well grounded research solutions remains a central challenge. We isolate research ideation as a standalone task and build our solution on the intuition that a challenge in one field can often be addressed by a mechanism that solved an analogous challenge in another. Accordingly, we introduce IdeaScientist, which decomposes ideation into gap finding, innovation, and report writing, and trains each role with reinforcement learning. These roles identify limitations in related work, draw solution intuitions from analogous problem settings, and develop those intuitions into complete research proposals. To facilitate discovery of insights across domains, we construct the Svalbard Idea Vault, a corpus of 2.77M decomposed research ideas for retrieval, training, and temporally controlled evaluation. Our evaluation restricts access to literature available before a cutoff date and assesses how closely proposed directions align with those later explored in 15K papers authored by human researchers. On Qwen3.6-27B, IdeaScientist outperforms the strongest open-source autoresearch baseline by 14.0%, driven mainly by gains in novelty. On this 27B open backbone, IdeaScientist even outperforms Claude Code SDK with Claude-4.8-Opus and Codex SDK with GPT-5.4, by up to 5.9%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 IdeaScientist，将科研构思拆解为"发现空白—创新—撰写报告"三个角色并用强化学习分别训练，借助类比迁移跨领域洞见；构建含277万条分解研究想法的 Svalbard Idea Vault 语料库，并通过时间截断式评测验证其生成的研究方案在新颖性和与人类后续工作的契合度上超越现有开源及商业基线。
AI.motivation: 自动科研虽进展迅速，但生成有前景且论证充分的科研解法仍是核心难题。作者将"研究构思"独立为一项任务，其直觉是：一个领域的挑战常可被另一领域已解决类比问题的机制所攻克，因此需要跨领域检索与迁移洞见。此外，缺乏高质量分解想法语料和大规模时间可控评测也是障碍。
AI.method: IdeaScientist 将构思分解为三个阶段/角色：gap finding（识别相关工作的局限）、innovation（从类比问题设定中提取解法直觉并发展为完整提案）、report writing。每个角色用强化学习单独训练。为支撑跨领域洞见发现，构建 Svalbard Idea Vault——含2.77M条分解研究想法的语料库，用于检索、训练和时间可控评测。评测限制只使用截断日期前的文献，并衡量所提方向与人类研究者后续15K篇论文探索方向的契合程度。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.6-27B 上，IdeaScientist 比最强开源自动科研基线高 14.0%，主要来自新颖性提升；在该27B开源骨干上，甚至超过 Claude Code SDK + Claude-4.8-Opus 和 Codex SDK + GPT-5.4，最高领先 5.9%。
AI.conclusion: 通过角色分解+强化学习与跨领域类比检索，可在中等规模开源模型上实现优于大型闭源系统辅助的科研构思能力，配套语料库与时间可控评测为可复现、无数据泄漏的评测提供了范式。

title: VolS-GS: Relightable Gaussian Splatting with Volumetric Subsurface Scattering
summary: We present VolS-GS, a relightable Gaussian splatting framework that reconstructs objects from one-light-at-a-time (OLAT) captures and renders them under novel lighting and viewpoints. Relightable Gaussian Splatting methods typically model appearance independently at each primitive, which makes non-local effects difficult to represent. This limitation is particularly apparent for subsurface scattering, where light entering the object at one location can emerge at another. Rather than modeling this effect solely with a neural network or a local kernel at each primitive, we use the spatial support of the Gaussian scene as the domain of a differentiable finite-volume transport solver, so that light can propagate through the object's interior. A small network predicts scattering and absorption coefficients for each Gaussian, and the solve redistributes incident light through the resulting field. The coefficients are fit to images rather than measured, so the solve supplies a transport-shaped path for aggregating per-primitive appearance, not a measurement of the material. To keep the learned shadow and specular terms from taking over the other components, our shadow term is predicted from visibility together with the transmittances and the scattering the solve produces, and a regularizer suppresses specular highlights in regions the shadow term predicts to be unlit. Experiments on three OLAT benchmarks show that VolS-GS consistently improves relighting quality on held-out lights and views.

AI.tldr: VolS-GS提出一种可重光照的高斯泼溅框架，用可微有限体积传输求解器代替逐基元独立建模，从而表示次表面散射等非局部效应，在三个OLAT基准上提升了重光照质量。
AI.motivation: 现有可重光照高斯泼溅方法在每个基元上独立建模外观，难以表示非局部效应，尤其是次表面散射——光从一处进入、从另一处射出。仅靠神经网络或局部核难以刻画这一现象。
AI.method: 以Gaussian场景的空间支撑作为可微有限体积传输求解器的求解域，让光在物体内部传播。小型网络为每个Gaussian预测散射与吸收系数，求解器据此重分布入射光；系数通过图像拟合而非实际测量获得。为抑制阴影与高光项相互干扰，阴影项由可见性、透射率及求解产生的散射共同预测，并加入正则项抑制阴影判为未照亮区域的高光。
AI.result: 在三个OLAT基准上的实验表明，VolS-GS在未见过的光照和视角下均稳定提升重光照质量。
AI.conclusion: 将物理传输求解引入高斯场景可有效表示次表面散射等非局部效应，为可重光照泼溅提供了一条传输塑形的外观聚合路径，而非材料测量。

title: On MMS allocations with few items
summary: We consider the problem of allocating $m$ indivisible items to $n$ agents. For $n \ge 2$, we define $μ(n)$ as the largest $m$ for which every allocation instance with $n$ agents and $m$ items has an allocation that gives each agent at least her maximin share (MMS). We prove that for general monotone valuations, $μ(n) = n + Θ(\log n)$. This holds both for goods and for chores. For arbitrary valuations (not monotone), we prove that $μ(n) = \log n + O(1)$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不可分物品的MMS分配保证问题，证明单调估值下 μ(n)=n+Θ(log n)，非单调估值下 μ(n)=log n+O(1)。
AI.motivation: 研究在多少个物品数 m 以内，n 个代理的任意分配实例都保证存在每个代理至少获得其最大最小份额（MMS）的分配，从而刻画 MMS 保证的紧界。
AI.method: 定义阈值函数 μ(n)，在 goods 与 chores 两种情形下分析单调估值，并进一步分析非单调（任意）估值。
AI.result: 一般单调估值下 μ(n)=n+Θ(log n)，对 goods 和 chores 均成立；任意（非单调）估值下 μ(n)=log n+O(1)。
AI.conclusion: 给出 MMS 分配存在性的精确渐近刻画，揭示单调性与非单调估值下保证阈值存在显著差异。

title: Agent Skill Evolution: How Revisions Affect Coding Agents
summary: Agent Skills, the SKILL.md files that tell an LLM coding agent how a project works, are revised like code, yet what a revision does to the agent is unknown. From 2,608 first/last revision pairs of 3,159 Skills, we characterize how Skills evolve and how they change together with the configuration of the agent's harness. We then focus on rule changes, revisions that add or remove a rule we can check automatically, such as "run allium check". We measure their effect on 21 models in single answers and on four agents in a sandbox, and their cost on 20 of these models and the four agents. Most revisions (55%) change a rule or procedure, and commits that revise a Skill change harness files such as CLAUDE.md more often than other commits of the same size. Across 16 open-weight models, an added rule raises compliance in a single answer by +0.41 on average. Across the four agents, the rate at which the agent takes the required action rises by +0.23 on average (+0.16 to +0.36), and for the three agents that blind judges assessed, final correctness rises by +0.10 on average (+0.06 to +0.14). The gain comes mainly from rules that name a command or path the old Skill did not mention. Real tools load a Skill's body only when the agent decides it needs it. In that setting the four agents keep about half of the action gain on average (51%), and the three open models about 38%. A revision adds 18-19% input tokens to a single answer and no detectable cost to an agent episode, while loading a Skill's body raises the tokens of an episode by 50% on average.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Agent Skills（SKILL.md文件）的修订如何影响编码agent的行为。基于3,159个Skills的2,608对首末修订，作者刻画了Skills的演化规律，并测量规则类修订对21个模型单次回答及4个agent沙箱任务的影响与成本。
AI.motivation: Agent Skills像代码一样被修订，但修订对agent究竟产生什么影响尚不清楚，缺乏实证刻画。
AI.method: 从3,159个Skills中提取2,608对首末修订，分析Skills演化及其与harness配置的共变；聚焦"规则修订"（可自动检查的增删规则），在21个模型的单次回答和4个沙箱agent上测量效果，并评估20个模型与4个agent的成本；另设工具按需加载Skill body的真实场景做对比。
AI.result: 55%的修订改变了规则或流程；修订Skill的提交更常改动CLAUDE.md等harness文件。16个开放权重模型单次回答合规率平均+0.41；4个agent所需动作率平均+0.23（+0.16~+0.36），3个agent最终正确率平均+0.10（+0.06~+0.14）。收益主要来自提及旧Skill未有的命令或路径的规则。按需加载场景下，4个agent保留约51%动作增益，3个开放模型约38%。修订使单次回答输入token+18-19%，agent episode无可检测成本；而加载Skill body使episode token平均+50%。
AI.conclusion: Skill修订普遍改变规则且有效提升合规与正确性，收益来自具体命令/路径的引入；但真实按需加载会削弱大部分增益，且加载Skill body带来显著token成本。

title: DePICT: Decision-Preserving Interface for Constrained Downstream Tasks
summary: A constrained optimization problem may involve a parameter in its objective and active constraints, yet the final decision may remain insensitive to small changes in that parameter. This raises a fundamental question: which inputs does a decision making system truly depend on? Building on this question, we introduce DePICT, a procedure for constructing decision preserving interfaces by ranking context directions according to the optimizer's solution sensitivity and aggregating them across an operating regime. We study this problem in a high dimensional setting where primitive context parameterizes a constrained task and the downstream agent observes only a selected subset of context directions. For locally regular constrained programs, we derive a Karush Kuhn Tucker (KKT) based characterization of when a context direction is optimizer relevant. Our analysis shows that appearing in the active optimization problem does not necessarily imply that a variable affects the final decision. Some context directions can alter the KKT conditions while leaving the optimal solution unchanged because their effect is absorbed by the dual variables. DePICT is designed to remove exactly these directions. In a controlled diagnosis, it recovers the decision relevant interface exactly and reduces linear predictor regret to 0.009, compared with 0.475 for the strongest competing baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出DePICT，通过按解灵敏度排序并聚合上下文方向，构造仅保留对决策有影响的接口，滤除被对偶变量吸收的无关方向。
AI.motivation: 约束优化问题的目标与活跃约束虽依赖某参数，但最终决策可能对其微小变化不敏感，需明确决策系统真正依赖哪些输入。
AI.method: 在高维设定下，用KKT条件刻画"优化器相关"的上下文方向，据此设计DePICT：按灵敏度排序方向并在操作区间内聚合，剔除那些只改变KKT条件而不改变最优解的方向。
AI.result: 在受控诊断中精确恢复决策相关接口，将线性预测器后悔降至0.009，而最强基线为0.475。
AI.conclusion: 出现在活跃优化问题中不等于影响最终决策；DePICT能有效识别并移除被对偶变量吸收的方向，构造决策保持接口。

title: Beyond the Parameter Monolith: Reconstructive Memories, Executable Skills, and Residual Assembly for Language Models
summary: Language-model systems can separate contextual computation, persistent storage, and exact execution instead of updating all capabilities through one shared parameter system. We investigate FEM-ASM, a finite-element-method-inspired organization in which independently constructed document states and deterministic executable skills contribute typed proposals to a shared language-model state. An explicit residual operator reconciles proposals attached to common interface nodes. We evaluate this organization through controlled experiments and negative results rather than claiming a physical finite-element formulation of language. An attention-free Multi-Mesh prototype learns causal language modeling but does not establish competitive general capability. A versioned store contains 52,809 reconstructive memory elements near a 1.7-billion-floating-value budget; reconstruction is incomplete, with approximately 75\% token accuracy. Support-aware lexical indices make these elements addressable under provenance-controlled query construction. For executable arithmetic, positional result observations substantially improve neural rendering relative to a repeated global result vector, and output substitutions change the model's preferred answer. A bounded attachment demonstration further measures the effect of making selected evidence available, without establishing the utility of loading an entire multi-billion-value store. The results support a separation of storage, execution, and neural coordination, while identifying unresolved limitations in question-only retrieval, unrestricted answer generation, and end-to-end efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文以受有限元启发的 FEM-ASM 组织方式，探索将语言模型中的上下文计算、持久存储和精确执行分离，而非用单一共享参数系统承担所有能力；通过受控实验和负结果说明存储、执行与神经协调可分离，但存在检索、无约束生成与效率等未解限制。
AI.motivation: 语言模型系统可以让上下文计算、持久存储和精确执行彼此分离，而不必通过一个共享参数系统更新所有能力；作者因此研究一种将独立构建的文档状态、确定性可执行技能与共享语言模型状态相结合的架构，并强调以受控实验和负结果来检验该组织的可行性，而非声称语言具有物理有限元形式。
AI.method: 提出 FEM-ASM 组织：独立构建的文档状态与确定性可执行技能向共享语言模型状态贡献带类型提案，通过显式残差算子在公共接口节点上协调提案。具体包括：无注意力 Multi-Mesh 原型进行因果语言建模；版本化存储包含 52,809 个重构记忆元素，接近 17 亿浮点值预算；支持感知的词汇索引在受控来源查询构造下实现寻址；可执行算术中采用位置化结果观测，并研究输出替换。
AI.result: 无注意力 Multi-Mesh 可学习因果语言建模，但未建立有竞争力的通用能力；记忆重构不完整，token 准确率约 75%；支持感知词汇索引可在来源受控查询下寻址这些元素；可执行算术中，位置化结果观测相比重复的全局结果向量显著改善神经渲染，输出替换会改变模型偏好的答案；有界附着演示测量了使选定证据可用的效果，但未证明加载整个数十亿值存储的效用。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持存储、执行和神经协调的分离，同时指出仅问题检索、无约束答案生成和端到端效率方面仍存在未解决的局限。

title: SCOUT: Supply-Aware Cold-Start Proactive Query Suggestion for Travel Search
comment: Accepted at the CIKM 2026 Workshop on Generative, Retrieval-augmented, and Agentic Intelligence for Personalization
summary:
Generative query suggestion, powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), has become increasingly popular in search and conversational systems to reduce user friction and guide intent formulation. Existing approaches align suggestions with user preferences (e.g., clicks or conversions). This works for open-ended applications like chatbots and personal assistants, where the result space is unconstrained or historical user free-text queries are abundant.
  However, applying these methods to travel search presents two limitations. First, travel search is fundamentally constrained by physical inventory; a query (e.g., "romantic beachfront villa") may yield abundant results in Bali but few in Tokyo, so aligning with user preferences is not by itself grounded in what can be offered. Second, travel platforms traditionally rely on faceted search interfaces with no free-text queries. This creates a cold-start problem: without historical query logs there is no demand-side data for alignment, and without a seed query at request time, suggestions must be generated proactively from structured context alone.
  To address these challenges, we propose SCOUT, a bootstrapping framework for supply-aware proactive query suggestion. SCOUT overcomes the data gap by substituting missing demand-side user feedback with supply-side system feedback. It treats the search engine as a reinforcement learning environment, deriving a dense reward from the production reranker's query-listing match scores, and optimizes the policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). SCOUT improves inventory match rate (IMR@18) by 12.3% while preserving diversity, matching a compute-intensive best-of-8 policy at zero marginal inference cost and making supply-aware suggestion deployable on a real-time travel search path.

AI.tldr: 提出SCOUT框架，用供给侧反馈替代需求侧数据，通过GRPO优化实现实时旅行搜索的主动式查询建议。
AI.motivation: 生成式查询建议依赖LLM并对齐用户偏好，但旅行搜索场景存在两大局限：1）受物理库存约束，对齐偏好不等于可提供的商品（如"浪漫海滩别墅"在巴厘岛多、东京少）；2）旅行平台使用分面搜索界面，无自由文本查询，导致历史查询日志缺失、请求时无种子查询的冷启动问题。
AI.method: SCOUT将搜索引擎视为强化学习环境，用生产级重排器的query-listing匹配分数构造稠密奖励，替代缺失的需求侧用户反馈，并用GRPO优化策略。
AI.result: 库存匹配率IMR@18提升12.3%，同时保持多样性；零边际推理成本即可达到计算密集的best-of-8策略水平，使供给感知建议可部署于实时旅行搜索路径。
AI.conclusion: SCOUT通过供给侧反馈的自举方法，解决了旅行搜索查询建议的数据冷启动与库存约束问题，实现可实时部署的供给感知主动建议。

title: Representation-Aligned Auxiliary Supervision for Language Model Adaptation
summary: Language models exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet adapting them to structured domains remains challenging and can yield inconsistent outcomes. We identify representation compatibility, the extent to which a model effectively processes a representation for a structured task, as a key factor in adaptation. We study this in chess, which provides a controlled testbed with precise semantics, computable optimal actions, and multiple state representations, including a symbolic encoding (FEN) and a spatial format (ASCII). We find that models often process semantically equivalent inputs substantially differently, affecting both learning and generalization. Building on this observation, we propose representation-aligned auxiliary supervision, which uses environment-derived tasks expressed in compatible representations to improve adaptation to structured domains. Across models and representations, auxiliary supervision consistently improves optimal-move prediction relative to target-only training under identical target data. Tasks that expose environment dynamics provide larger and most consistent gains than surface-level or static supervision, while remaining competitive with substantially increasing the amount of target-task data. Moreover, ASCII-trained models transfer more effectively to FEN than FEN-trained models do to ASCII, even surpassing the FEN target-only baseline on FEN evaluation. The gains also extend beyond optimal-move prediction to open-ended, factually grounded commentary generation. Overall, our results show that auxiliary supervision in model-compatible representations can enable effective adaptation in structured domains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型适配结构化领域时的"表征兼容性"问题，以国际象棋为测试平台，提出"表征对齐的辅助监督"方法，通过环境衍生的、与模型兼容表征表达的任务来提升适配效果。
AI.motivation: 语言模型推理能力强，但适配结构化领域仍具挑战且结果不一致。作者认为"表征兼容性"（模型有效处理某结构化任务表征的程度）是适配的关键因素。选择国际象棋作为受控测试平台：语义精确、最优行动可计算、有多种状态表征（符号FEN与空间ASCII）。
AI.method: 发现模型对语义等价输入的处理差异显著后，提出"表征对齐的辅助监督"：使用环境衍生的任务，以兼容表征表达，来提升结构化领域适配。通过多种模型和表征，在相同目标数据下对比辅助监督与仅目标训练。
AI.result: 辅助监督一致提升最优走子预测；暴露环境动态的任务比表层级/静态监督收益更大更稳定，且可与大幅增加目标数据的数据量竞争。ASCII训练的模型向FEN迁移比反向更有效，甚至在FEN评估上超越FEN仅目标基线。收益还扩展到开放式、有事实依据的评论生成。
AI.conclusion: 在模型兼容表征中的辅助监督能实现结构化领域的有效适配。

title: PhysMamba: Selective State Space Models as Learned Articulated Body Simulators
comment: CVPR 2026 Workshop on Physically Grounded Human Perception and Modeling -- 1st PhysHuman
summary: We introduce the first learned articulated body simulator based on a selective state space model (SSM), called PhysMamba. PhysMamba predicts next-frame full-body state from position, rotation, and joint-action history, without velocity inputs. We compare four architectures under partial- and full-observation inputs and three training protocols. The from-scratch rollout training protocol gives Mamba2 strong short- and mid-horizon accuracy under partial observation (s10 = 43 mm, 2/50 diverged), while the two-stage teacher-based rollout protocol stabilizes GRU but fails for Mamba2. With CUDA graph compilation, Mamba2 reaches 0.107 ms per frame (9,334 FPS) on an H100 GPU, within 1.1$\times$ of GRU's un-compiled throughput, adding under 1% latency to a 30 Hz HMR pipeline and enabling integration as a differentiable physics module for video-based mesh recovery.

AI.tldr: PhysMamba是首个基于选择性状态空间模型(SSM)的可学习关节人体模拟器，无需速度输入即可从位置、旋转和关节动作历史预测下一帧全身状态，在精度与速度上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有可学习人体模拟器多依赖RNN等架构且需速度输入。作者希望探索选择性SSM(Mamba2)在关节人体动力学建模中的可行性，并解决部分观测下的姿势预测与实时性问题。
AI.method: 提出PhysMamba，用选择性SSM预测下一帧全身状态，输入仅为位置、旋转与关节动作历史(无速度)。对比四种架构，在部分/全观测输入及三种训练协议下评估；采用CUDA graph编译加速。
AI.result: 从头训练rollout协议下Mamba2在部分观测取得强短期/中期精度(s10=43mm，50次中2次发散)；两阶段教师rollout协议稳定了GRU但对Mamba2失效。CUDA graph编译后Mamba2达0.107ms/帧(9334 FPS)，为GRU未编译吞吐的1.1倍，对30Hz HMR流水线增加不到1%延迟。
AI.conclusion: PhysMamba验证了选择性SSM作为高效可学习关节人体模拟器的潜力，可作为可微物理模块集成到基于视频的网格恢复中，兼顾精度与实时性。

title: Feedback Dominance Analysis for Pursuit-Evasion Games on Graphs
summary: This work identifies the dominance regions for discrete, simultaneous-move pursuit-evasion games on graphs. Existing geometric approaches provide efficient characterizations of winning regions, but typically provide only sufficient conditions and rely on open-loop strategies. To address these challenges, we develop a set-based dynamic programming approach to characterize the pursuer's winning and losing regions, providing necessary and sufficient winning conditions under worst-case behavior. The reachability analysis admits a set-chasing interpretation, allowing translation of dominance sets to feedback strategies that adapt to the players' positions in real time. For states where neither player can guarantee victory, we introduce an instantaneous matrix-game formulation and establish upper and lower bounds on the pursuer's winning probability. Simulation results validate the correctness of the dominance-region characterization and the proposed bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文研究图上离散同步博弈的追逃问题，提出基于集合的动态规划方法刻画追捕者的必胜与必败区域，并针对双方均无法保证胜利的状态建立瞬时矩阵博弈，给出追捕者胜率上下界。
AI.motivation: 现有几何方法虽能高效刻画获胜区域，但通常只给出充分条件且依赖开环策略，无法覆盖最坏情况下的必要充分条件，也难以适应实时位置变化。
AI.method: 采用基于集合的动态规划刻画追捕者的获胜与失败区域，通过可达性分析给出“集合追逐”解释，将支配集合转化为可实时适应玩家位置的反馈策略；对双方均不能确保胜利的状态，引入瞬时矩阵博弈求解胜率上下界。
AI.result: 给出了最坏情况行为下追捕者获胜的必要充分条件，揭示了支配区域与反馈策略的对应关系，并为不确定胜负状态提供了胜率上界与下界；仿真结果验证了支配区域刻画和所提界值的正确性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥补了现有几何方法仅提供充分条件和开环策略的不足，为图上追逃博弈提供了更完整的支配区域刻画与反馈策略设计框架。

title: CARET: Training-Free Test-Time Scaling for Repository-Level Code Completion
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) dominates repository-level code completion: it retrieves cross-file context (R), then decodes one greedy completion (G). Existing work mainly focuses on retrieval and stops there. We argue both stages can be improved together, with generation in particular gaining from test-time scaling. We present CARET, a training-free method. For R, CARET routes among retrieval contexts using the agreement among its own samples, cascading to an alternative context when the samples scatter. For G, it samples candidates over a cached prompt prefix, so the long retrieved context is encoded once rather than once per sample. It then selects the final completion by reverse-context likelihood: a correct completion makes the code after the cursor more probable, so the same model grades its own candidates by reading ahead. Across CrossCodeEval, RepoEval-Line, and RepoEval-API with six code models (1.1B to 7B, four families), CARET improves exact match in all 18 combinations by 10.8 points on average over greedy decoding and 5.3 over self-consistency@10. Token-level compute stays near 1.45 times one generation (measured wall-clock 1.3-2.9 times, growing with generator size). Improving retrieval and generation together yields more accurate code than improving retrieval alone, at a budget that stays close to a single pass.

AI.tldr: CARET是一种免训练方法，同时改进RAG代码补全中的检索(R)与生成(G)阶段，通过自一致性路由检索上下文、缓存前缀采样及反向上下文似然选择候选，在18个组合上平均提升精确匹配10.8个点。
AI.motivation: 现有仓库级代码补全工作主要聚焦于检索阶段，生成阶段被忽视。作者认为检索与生成可以协同改进，尤其生成可从测试时扩展(test-time scaling)中获益。
AI.method: 针对检索(R)：利用模型自身采样间的一致性在多个检索上下文中路由，当样本分散时级联到备选上下文。针对生成(G)：在缓存提示前缀上采样候选，使长检索上下文只编码一次；再用反向上下文似然选优——若补全正确，光标后的代码应更可能，模型通过"前瞻阅读"自评候选。
AI.result: 在CrossCodeEval、RepoEval-Line、RepoEval-API及6个代码模型(1.1B–7B，4个家族)共18个组合上，CARET全部提升精确匹配，相比greedy平均高10.8点，相比self-consistency@10高5.3点。Token级计算约为单次生成的1.45倍(实测墙钟1.3–2.9倍，随模型规模增长)。
AI.conclusion: 同时改进检索与生成比只改进检索能获得更准确的代码，且预算接近单次推理。检索与生成的协同优化是一种高效且有效的代码补全策略。

title: Synthesizing Physics Formulae with Transformers
summary: Finding a compact formula that fits a set of input-output pairs and predicts outputs on unseen inputs is a fundamental problem in science. Symbolic regression automates the search for such formulae: search-based methods explore the space of possible formulae directly, while transformers pre-trained on synthetic data produce formulae of comparable quality substantially faster. Existing transformers, however, are prone to overfitting --- they find formulae that fit the training data well but do not extrapolate to input ranges unseen during training. We address this by shaping the set of formulae used to train a transformer, and show that the resulting formulae extrapolate substantially better. Fine-tuning the transformer on data with noise-corrupted target values further makes the synthesized formulae robust to noise in the observations. On SRBench and LLM-SRBench our transformer synthesizes a formula in about ten seconds and extrapolates better than all evaluated methods at a comparable budget. Search-based methods surpass our accuracy only when given one to three orders of magnitude more time.

AI.tldr: 通过改变训练transformer所用的公式集，使符号回归生成的公式在未见输入范围外推更好，并通过对含噪目标微调增强噪声鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于transformer的符号回归易过拟合，公式能拟合训练数据但无法外推到训练时未见过的输入范围，需要提升外推与噪声鲁棒性。
AI.method: 塑造/筛选用于训练transformer的公式集合，使训练分布更利于外推；并在目标值含噪的数据上对transformer进行微调。
AI.result: 在SRBench和LLM-SRBench上约10秒即可合成公式，在同等预算下外推优于所有评估方法；基于搜索的方法需多1–3个数量级时间才超过其精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过设计训练公式集并做噪声微调，可显著提升transformer符号回归的外推能力与鲁棒性，同时保持高效。

title: A Quantitative Analysis of Graph Representation Strategies for Cyber Attack Detection
summary: Graph based cyber attack detection studies employ various graph construction and representation strategies across different cybersecurity application domains. This diversity motivates a quantitative examination of how representation strategies are distributed across these application domains. This study presents a quantitative analysis of 37 original studies published between 2019 and 2026. Each study was coded according to publication year, application domain, graph representation type, feature extraction strategy, learning paradigm, algorithm, and dataset. Frequency analysis, cross tabulation, and statistical association tests were applied. Automated representation learning was the most frequently employed strategy, accounting for 73.0% of the studies, while handcrafted representation strategies accounted for 27.0%. The Fisher Freeman Halton exact test revealed a statistically significant association between application domain and representation strategy (exact p = 0.008; Cramer's V = 0.540). The findings indicate that automated representation learning predominates within the analyzed corpus and that the distribution of representation strategies differs across cybersecurity application domains.

AI.tldr: 本文对2019-2026年37项基于图的网络攻击检测研究进行定量分析，按年份、应用域、图表示类型等编码，发现自动表示学习占主导（73%），且表示策略在不同应用域间分布差异显著。
AI.motivation: 基于图的网络攻击检测研究采用多样的图构建与表示策略，跨不同网络安全应用域，这种多样性促使人们需要定量考察表示策略在各应用域中的分布情况。
AI.method: 对37项原创研究按发表年份、应用域、图表示类型、特征提取策略、学习范式、算法、数据集进行编码；采用频率分析、交叉制表及统计关联检验。
AI.result: 自动表示学习最常用，占73.0%，手工表示占27.0%；Fisher-Freeman-Halton精确检验显示应用域与表示策略显著关联（精确p=0.008；Cramer's V=0.540）。
AI.conclusion: 在所分析语料中自动表示学习占主导，且表示策略分布在不同网络安全应用域间存在差异。

title: Generate What You Can Trust: Content Credibility in Generative Recommenders
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) represents items with semantic IDs (i.e., discrete token sequences) and generates target item tokens as recommendations. Despite its promising results, existing methods predominantly optimize for accuracy while neglecting the credibility of the recommendations they generate. This oversight inevitably exposes users to uncredible content (e.g., fake news) with serious societal consequences, including user distrust, reputation harm to platforms, and broader social instability. To address this critical yet underexplored challenge, we propose CreGR, the first credible GR model that jointly tackles content credibility across the two core stages of GR: tokenization and generation. In the tokenization stage, we design a new credibility-aware tokenizer that explicitly encourages the model to learn discriminative tokens respectively for credible and uncredible items, thereby disentangling credibility signals at the token level. Building on this, in the generation stage, we propose a novel accuracy-preserving and credibility-oriented generator grounded in discrete diffusion.
