AI.tldr: 单帧JEPA无法编码速度信息（结构盲区），作者提出TI-JEPA将潜变量分为位姿码与显式运动码，显著提升规划性能。
AI.motivation: JEPA世界模型从单帧渲染图训练，而渲染器无运动模糊时单帧不含速度信息，导致编码器（含官方权重）无法捕捉速度。
AI.method: 提出RateIdent三阶段诊断协议验证盲区；TI-JEPA将潜变量拆分为pose code和有限差分motion code联合预测。
AI.result: 四个真实基准上速度探针≤随机而位置探针R²≈0.95；三环境stop-at-goal任务显著提升（Pendulum末端距离降55%，CartPole降64%）；dm_control提升达38倍。
AI.conclusion: 速度重要时单帧预测目标是错误对象，小型可解释的结构改动即可无特权监督地修复。

title: LyapuFlow: Controlling Generative Flows with Lyapunov Feedback for Inverse Problems
summary: Pretrained flow models are now widely used as generative priors in science and vision, where inference-time guidance enables test-time constraints without retraining. Existing methods use projection, posterior sampling, or iterative optimization of the generative trajectory. We propose LyapuFlow, an alternative based on Lyapunov feedback control. At each sampling step, LyapuFlow predicts the terminal sample towards which the current flow is evolving, and evaluates the constraint violation on this prediction. Then, we compute the minimum-norm control that satisfies a prescribed Lyapunov decrease condition. The resulting control remains inactive when the uncontrolled dynamics already reduce the constraint violation at the prescribed rate. Otherwise, it provides a corrective update within a feedback trust region that prevents the control from dominating the pretrained dynamics. We demonstrate LyapuFlow in both data and latent spaces, outperforming alternatives spanning different mechanisms for test-time constraint enforcement in scientific machine learning and image inverse problems.

AI.tldr: 提出LyapuFlow，一种基于Lyapunov反馈控制的流模型推理时引导方法，在采样每步预测终点样本并计算最小范数控制，保持预训练动力学主导，在科学ML与图像逆问题上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 预训练流模型广泛用作生成先验，需在测试时施加约束而无需重训练。现有方法（投影、后验采样、迭代优化）存在局限，故需一种能在不破坏预训练动力学的前提下有效执行约束的新机制。
AI.method: LyapuFlow基于Lyapunov反馈控制：每步采样预测当前流趋向的终点样本，评估其约束违反度；计算满足指定Lyapunov下降条件的最小范数控制。当无控制动力学已按指定速率降低违反度时控制不激活；否则在反馈信赖域内施加修正，防止控制主导预训练动力学。
AI.result: 在数据空间与隐空间中验证，LyapuFlow在科学机器学习与图像逆问题的测试时约束执行上，优于涵盖不同机制的替代方法。
AI.conclusion: LyapuFlow为流模型的推理时约束提供了一种基于Lyapunov控制的有效替代方案，兼顾约束满足与预训练动力学保真，适用于数据与隐空间任务。

title: CRAFT: An Agentic Spreadsheet Form Filling System with Template Awareness
summary: Spreadsheet form filling requires agents to consolidate external evidence, ground values to precise cells, and preserve irregular template structure. Errors in early edits can overwrite labels or misalign fields, undermining later decisions. We propose CRAFT, a template-aware agent framework that connects reflective validation to constrained local repair. Instead of treating reflection as a free-form request to regenerate the workbook, CRAFT grounds detected errors to spreadsheet regions, restores corrupted template state when necessary, and re-grounds plausible writable slots before subsequent edits. A Rectangle-Aware Slot Grounder (RASG) proposes writable cells, while label-slot hints and protected regions constrain subsequent edits. We introduce FormFillBench, with 327 forms across Instruction-Only and Multi-File tracks. Compared with the strongest baselines, CRAFT improves pair accuracy by 8.51 and 23.38 percentage points on these tracks, respectively. Component-removal experiments support structural adjudication and slot re-grounding within the pipeline, and the framework retains its relative advantage among the methods evaluated with a second backbone. The code and benchmark FormFillBench are available at https://github.com/Glllllly/CRAFT.

AI.tldr: 提出CRAFT模板感知智能体框架，通过反思验证与受限局部修复解决表格填写中的错误累积问题，并发布FormFillBench基准。
AI.motivation: 表格填写需要整合外部证据、将值定位到精确单元格，并保持不规则模板结构。早期编辑中的错误可能覆盖标签或错位字段，破坏后续决策。
AI.method: CRAFT将反思验证连接到受限局部修复：将检测到的错误定位到表格区域，必要时恢复损坏的模板状态，并在后续编辑前重新定位可写槽位。矩形感知槽位定位器（RASG）提出可写单元格，标签-槽位提示与保护区域约束后续编辑。
AI.result: 在FormFillBench（327个表单，含Instruction-Only与Multi-File两个赛道）上，相比最强基线，pair准确率分别提升8.51和23.38个百分点。组件移除实验验证了结构裁决与槽位重定位的作用，且更换骨干模型后仍保持相对优势。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT通过将反思与受约束的局部修复结合，有效提升表格填写准确率与鲁棒性，并提供了新的基准。

title: AraYoungVoices: A Diverse L1/L2 Corpus of Arabic Child and Adolescent Speech
summary: State-of-the-art ASR systems primarily target native adult speech, leading to substantial performance gaps for children, adolescents, and L2 speakers. We introduce AraYoungVoices, a 151.72-hour Arabic read-speech corpus from 286 speakers aged 7--18, comprising AraKids (7--12) and AraTeens (13--18). The corpus includes 146 native Arabic (L1) and 140 second-language (L2) speakers, with native speakers spanning Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine, and North African dialectal backgrounds and L2 speakers representing diverse linguistic backgrounds across the Americas, Asia, Africa, and Europe. We benchmark four pretrained ASR models under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings using unseen-speaker-$\&$-unseen-prompt (USUP) and unseen-speaker-$\&$-seen-prompt (USSP) evaluations. Results show that L2 speech remains substantially more challenging than L1 speech, with the largest errors observed mainly for younger L2 speakers. Age-specific fine-tuning improves the matched age group, while joint fine-tuning provides a stronger balance across populations. ASR hypotheses are also consistently closer to the standard reading prompt than to the verbatim transcription, particularly for L2 speech, suggesting partial normalization of reading deviations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AraYoungVoices——一个151.72小时的阿拉伯语青少年朗读语音语料库（286名7–18岁说话者，含L1/L2），并系统评测4个预训练ASR模型，揭示L2及低龄说话者识别难度更大。
AI.motivation: 当前主流ASR系统主要针对母语成人语音，对儿童、青少年及二语（L2）说话者性能存在明显差距，而阿拉伯语青少年及L2语音资源匮乏，亟需相应语料与评测基准。
AI.method: 构建AraYoungVoices语料库：151.72小时阿拉伯语朗读语音，286名7–18岁说话者（AraKids 7–12、AraTeens 13–18），含146名L1（埃及、海湾、黎凡特、北非方言）与140名L2（美洲、亚洲、非洲、欧洲背景）说话者；在零样本与微调设置下，用USUP和USSP两种评测协议基准测试4个预训练ASR模型。
AI.result: L2语音显著比L1更困难，最大错误主要出现在低龄L2说话者；按年龄微调提升对应年龄组表现，联合微调在各人群间取得更佳平衡；ASR假设更接近标准朗读提示而非逐字转写，L2尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 阿拉伯语青少年（尤其L2及低龄者）语音识别仍具挑战，年龄特定与联合微调各有优势，且模型存在对朗读偏差的部分归一化倾向，为包容性ASR研究提供资源与基准。

title: WASP: Weakly Aligned Spatiotemporal Pairs for Fetal Brain MRI-Ultrasound Learning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 21 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/miccunifi/WASP
summary: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is widely regarded as the optimal sensor for fetal brain analysis due to its superior soft-tissue contrast and anatomical detail. However, its high cost and operational burden make it invasive and difficult to obtain at scale. Ultrasound (US), in contrast, is cheap, safe, and routinely acquired, and as a result it has produced substantially larger datasets and a growing ecosystem of pretrained models. This asymmetry raises a natural question: Can we teach a US-only model to understand fetal MRI from only a limited set of examples? The standard recipe, training a foundation model on subject-to-subject paired MRI-US scans, is not viable since no such paired fetal dataset is publicly available. In this paper we address this gap with Weakly Aligned Spatiotemporal Pairs (WASP), a framework that formulates cross-modal correspondence as an entropic Optimal Transport problem driven by clinical metadata, in particular Gestational Age (GA) and diagnostic planes, enabling the fitting of a lightweight alignment module that lifts MRI representations into the US latent space, without fine-tuning the backbone. Empirically, WASP yields its largest gains when MRI is unseen by the model during pretraining (on USFM, GA estimation error drops from 21.9 to 17.4 days and standard plane classification accuracy climbs from 61.9% to 69.0%), while providing smaller, backbone-dependent refinements for backbones pretrained on both modalities (e.g., BioMedParse GA estimation error from 6.5 to 6.0 days and SAM-Med2d plane accuracy from 83.3% to 88.1%). Code is available at https://github.com/miccunifi/WASP.

AI.tldr: WASP框架通过将跨模态对齐建模为基于临床元数据的熵最优传输问题,用轻量对齐模块把MRI表示映射到US潜空间,无需微调主干,实现用少量样本让US模型理解胎儿MRI。
AI.motivation: MRI是胎儿脑分析的最佳传感器,但昂贵且难获取;US便宜安全且数据量大,已形成预训练模型生态。这种不对称引出一个问题:能否用少量样本教会仅用US训练的模型理解胎儿MRI?而标准做法(在成对的MRI-US扫描上训练)因缺乏公开成对的胎儿数据集而不可行。
AI.method: 提出弱对齐时空配对(WASP)框架,将跨模态对应关系建模为由临床元数据(尤其是胎龄GA和诊断切面)驱动的熵最优传输问题,从而拟合一个轻量对齐模块,将MRI表示提升到US潜空间,且不微调主干网络。
AI.result: 当模型预训练时未见过MRI,收益最大:在USFM上GA估计误差从21.9降到17.4天,标准切面分类准确率从61.9%升到69.0%;对于已在两种模态上预训练的主干网络,则提供较小的、依赖主干的改进(如BioMedParse的GA误差从6.5降到6.0天,SAM-Med2d切面准确率从83.3%升到88.1%)。
AI.conclusion: WASP在无需成对MRI-US数据集和无需微调主干的情况下,有效让US模型理解胎儿MRI,尤其在MRI未见场景下增益显著,为跨模态胎儿脑分析提供了可行方案。

title: S$^3$N: A Spherical Spiral Scanning Network for Weather Forecasting
summary: Machine learning-based weather prediction (MLWP) has achieved strong performance in global weather forecasting. Recent Hierarchical Equal Area isoLatitude Pixelation (HEALPix)-based methods use the HEALPix (HP) grid to avoid area distortion near the poles of conventional latitude-longitude (LL) grids. However, existing HP-based approaches often use pointwise mapping methods and process HP pixels within separate base faces or local windows. Consequently, the mapping may introduce reconstruction errors and cross-face communication depends on handcrafted boundary handling or shifted windows. We propose the Spherical Spiral Scanning Network (S$^3$N) to address both limitations. First, L2Proj provides a bidirectional method for mapping atmospheric fields between the LL and HP grids through an $L^2$ projection of their continuous finite-element representations. Second, the Attention-Guided Quad-Spiral State-Space Scanning (AQSS) block uses cross-latitude attention to guide selective state-space updates along four global pole-to-pole spiral paths. This design enables continuous information propagation across HP base-face boundaries without additional boundary-processing mechanisms. Experiments show that S$^3$N achieves better results at 4-, 7-, and 10-day lead times, and exhibits slower error growth in long-range forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出S³N网络解决HEALPix网格下MLWP的点映射重建误差与跨面通信依赖手工边界处理的问题，含L2Proj与AQSS两大模块。
AI.motivation: 现有基于HEALPix的MLWP方法多用逐点映射，且在各基面或局部窗口内独立处理像素，导致映射存在重建误差，跨面通信依赖手工边界处理或移位窗口。
AI.method: 1) L2Proj：通过连续有限元表示的L²投影，实现LL与HP网格间大气场的双向映射；2) AQSS块：用跨纬度注意力引导沿四条全局极到极螺旋路径的选择性状态空间更新，无需额外边界机制即可跨基面连续传播信息。
AI.result: 在4天、7天、10天预报时效上取得更优结果，长程预报中误差增长更慢。
AI.conclusion: S³N同时缓解了映射重建误差与跨面通信问题，验证了L²投影与螺旋状态空间扫描在球面天气预测中的有效性。

title: RAGrasp: Geometry-Semantic Template Retrieval and Grasp Transfer
summary: We present RAGrasp, a retrieval-augmented pipeline for planar parallel-jaw grasping from a compact set of locally collected, grasp-annotated RGB-D (color and depth) templates. Unlike task-specific predictors trained primarily on large public or synthetic grasp datasets, RAGrasp requires no end-to-end retraining for a new deployment.Its template memory is constructed from observations collected with the deployment camera, robot, and gripper in the target workspace, thereby aligning stored examples with the local sensing and embodiment conditions. The system uses self-supervised DINOv2 visual fea- tures together with appearance and depth cues to prompt the Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2), which isolates the query object. A two-stage geometry-semantic retrieval cascade then selects a template, and a confidence gate chooses one of two grasp- transfer estimators. The transferred grasp is refined using mask- support and silhouette-contact constraints before calibrated 2D- to-3D conversion. In real-world trials, RAGrasp achieves 20/20 successful grasps on seen objects and 19/20 on unseen objects. Within the evaluated setting, the results demonstrate deployment- specific grasp adaptation from limited local annotation and tolerance to the tested viewpoint and illumination changes.

AI.tldr: RAGrasp是一个检索增强的平面平行夹爪抓取流水线，仅需少量本地采集的带抓取标注RGB-D模板即可适配新部署，无需端到端重训练。在真实试验中对已见和未见过物体分别达到20/20和19/20抓取成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有任务专用抓取预测器主要依赖大规模公开或合成数据集训练，对于新部署需要端到端重训练，且存储的样本与本地传感及本体条件不一致。作者希望实现针对具体部署环境的抓取自适应，只需有限的本地标注。
AI.method: 1) 用部署相机、机器人和夹爪在目标工作区采集观测，构建与本地感知和本体对齐的模板记忆；2) 用自监督DINOv2视觉特征结合外观与深度线索提示SAM2分割出查询物体；3) 两阶段几何-语义检索级联选择模板；4) 用置信度门控在两种抓取迁移估计器间选择；5) 通过掩码支撑和轮廓接触约束细化迁移抓取，再经标定的2D-to-3D转换得到最终抓取。
AI.result: 真实世界试验中，对已见物体实现20/20成功抓取，对未见过物体达到19/20成功抓取，并在测试视角和光照变化下表现出容忍性。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估的设置中，结果证明仅靠有限的本地标注即可实现部署特定的抓取自适应，并具备对视角和光照变化的容忍能力。

title: Usage-Modulated Sentiment Representations in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (main conference). 18 pages, 3 figures, including appendices
summary: Prior work suggests that sentiment can often be captured by approximately linear directions in LLM activation spaces, but a single direction may not fully capture sentiment representations. In natural communication, sentiment is shaped not only by polarity but also by usage factors, such as tone and audience adaptation. We test whether these factors systematically modulate sentiment representations beyond a shared sentiment direction. We construct a controlled paired dataset that holds event content fixed while varying sentiment polarity and usage factors, and analyze Llama, Mistral, and Gemma. We identify a shared sentiment direction, remove it, and test the residual structure through erasure and generation-time tone steering. Across models, the shared direction is robust (median cosine 0.953-0.975), yet removing it leaves 0.833-0.909 of the original positive-negative representation-difference norm. The residuals contain compact, reproducible usage-conditioned structure. Targeted erasure weakens held-out usage metrics more than random and label-shuffled controls. On Llama, outputs steered along residualized tone components are preferred in 92.8% of blind target-tone comparisons while preserving the requested sentiment polarity in 98.7% of evaluated outputs.

AI.tldr: LLM激活空间中的情感表示不止一个线性方向：去除共享情感方向后，仍有大量残差结构，这些结构编码与语气、受众等使用因素相关的可复现信息。
AI.motivation: 既有工作认为情感可由近似线性方向捕捉，但单一方向可能不足以完整表示情感。自然交流中情感不仅由极性决定，还受语气、受众适应等使用因素影响。本文检验这些因素是否系统性地调制情感表示。
AI.method: 构建受控配对数据集：固定事件内容，变化情感极性与使用因素；分析Llama、Mistral、Gemma。识别共享情感方向并将其去除，通过擦除（erasure）和生成时语气引导（tone steering）检验残差结构。
AI.result: 共享情感方向稳健（余弦中位数0.953-0.975），但去除后仍保留原始正负表示差范数的0.833-0.909。残差包含紧凑可复现的使用条件结构；定向擦除对未见使用指标的削弱大于随机和标签打乱控制。在Llama上，沿残差化语气成分引导的输出在92.8%的盲测目标语气比较中被偏好，同时在98.7%的评估输出中保持所要求的情感极性。
AI.conclusion: 情感表示无法被单一线性方向完全刻画；在共享方向之外，还存在系统性的、与使用因素相关的残差结构，可被定向操控以控制语气而不破坏极性。

title: Organize Primitives into Semantic Parts: Reinforcement Reasoning for 3D Segmentation
summary: Primitive-based 3D segmentation offers a compact and explicit alternative to dense surface prediction, naturally supporting structural abstraction and boundary localization. However, geometric decomposition alone does not determine how primitives should be organized into semantic parts: a single part may span multiple primitives, while geometrically similar or touching primitives may belong to different parts. We therefore introduce RePart (Reinforcement Part Reasoning), which formulates primitive-to-part organization as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and learns semantic organization through trajectory-level reinforcement reasoning. RePart constructs a Composable Primitive Workspace from fine-grained superquadrics and applies a merge-and-stop policy whose decisions are optimized by their downstream effects on the resulting partition rather than local primitive compatibility. The inferred part identities are then mapped back to the original mesh through Boundary-Aware Surface Labeling, preserving accurate surface boundaries beyond the primitive approximation. On PartNet, RePart achieves the strongest results across all four aggregate partition metrics; on 3DCoMPaT++, it obtains the highest RI and SC without target-dataset fine-tuning. These results demonstrate that reinforcement reasoning provides an effective mechanism for organizing geometric primitives into semantic parts while retaining dense segmentation accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/EngineeringAI-LAB/RePart.

AI.tldr: 提出RePart，将基元到语义部件的组织建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，用轨迹级强化学习进行语义组织，并结合边界感知表面标注映射回原网格。
AI.motivation: 基于基元的三维分割紧凑且显式，但几何分解本身无法决定基元如何组织成语义部件：一个部件可能跨越多个基元，几何相似或接触的基元也可能属于不同部件。
AI.method: RePart将基元到部件的组织形式化为有限时域MDP；用细粒度超二次曲面构建可组合基元工作区；采用merge-and-stop策略，依据对最终划分的下游影响而非局部基元兼容性来优化决策；再通过边界感知表面标注将推断的部件身份映射回原网格。
AI.result: 在PartNet上四项聚合分割指标均取得最佳结果；在3DCoMPaT++上无需目标数据集微调即获得最高RI和SC。
AI.conclusion: 强化推理能有效将几何基元组织为语义部件，同时保持稠密分割精度。

title: Hierarchical Credit Assignment for RLVR on Fused Gromov-Wasserstein Geometry
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been shown to improve the reasoning capability of large language models (LLMs) across diverse reasoning tasks. However, group-based RLVR methods, such as GRPO, assign a uniform advantage to all tokens within rollouts of the same outcome. While existing works refine credit assignment of GRPO based on local signals such as token locations or entropy, they often fail to capture the global semantic novelty of a reasoning behavior relative to the current policy. In this work, we propose a hierarchical credit assignment approach for group-based RLVR methods, called HarA, which identifies and encourages semantically novel reasoning behaviors during RLVR. HarA represents each sampled rollout as a distribution over the hidden states and locations of tokens, and computes the Fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) barycenters of all rollouts with the same outcome, capturing the internal reasoning patterns in the latent space under the current policy. The semantic novelty of a reasoning element can then be measured by its contribution to the FGW distance between the current rollout and the barycenter. While solving the FGW formulation is expensive, we introduce an anchor-guided linearization that turns it into a Wasserstein formulation solvable via the Sinkhorn algorithm efficiently. By reweighing token-level advantage of group-based RLVR methods based on the novelty signals, HarA highlights novel reasoning behaviors at flexible granularities to encourage fine-grained LLM exploration. Extensive experiments across three group-based RLVR methods show that our plug-and-play method effectively enhances the exploration of LLMs, outperforming existing methods across diverse reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出HarA方法，通过分层信用分配识别并鼓励语义新颖的推理行为，提升基于组的RLVR方法的LLM探索能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于组的RLVR方法（如GRPO）对同一结果的所有token赋予统一优势，忽略了推理行为相对当前策略的全局语义新颖性。
AI.method: 将每个rollout表示为隐状态与token位置的分布，计算同结果rollout的FGW重心以捕捉推理模式；用对FGW距离的贡献度量语义新颖性；提出锚点引导线性化将其转为Wasserstein问题并用Sinkhorn高效求解；据此重加权token优势。
AI.result: 在三种基于组的RLVR方法及多样推理基准上，该方法作为即插即用模块有效增强LLM探索，超越现有方法。
AI.conclusion: HarA通过分层信用分配诱导细粒度探索，是提升RLVR推理能力的有效通用方案。

title: Causally Fair Generation with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate, complete, and transform information in settings where their outputs can shape consequential decisions, raising concerns about their impact on demographic disparities. In this context, causal inference provides a principled basis for assessing fairness, because it attributes observed disparities to the mechanisms that generated them, which a purely statistical approach cannot do even with infinite data. In LLM generation, a query may request several causally related variables, each of which is both an outcome of interest and a possible cause of other outputs, and the information supplied in the prompt need not follow a topological or a temporal order. This calls for methods that can analyze and selectively remove disparities from such a flexible generation process. In this paper we introduce Causally Fair Generation with LLMs (CFG, for short). CFG extracts relevant concepts, grounds generation in a reference population and causal diagram, and removes user-selected causal effects. CFG also allows pathways deemed justifiable for the task's utility to be retained, which is known in legal literature as business necessity. Further, we provide formal guarantees for our method when eliminating all discriminatory causal effects in the adapted population model, under appropriate causal assumptions. We evaluate CFG with four LLMs in three real-world settings based on population data and on a synthetic dataset with a known causal ground truth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CFG方法，利用因果推断在LLM生成中去除用户指定的因果效应以实现公平生成，并提供理论保证。
AI.motivation: LLM输出会影响重要决策，引发对人口统计差异的担忧。纯统计方法无法归因差异机制，而因果推断能原则性地评估公平。LLM生成中查询涉及多个因果相关变量，信息顺序灵活，需要新方法分析和选择性移除差异。
AI.method: CFG提取相关概念，将生成基于参考人群和因果图，并移除用户选择的因果效应；同时允许保留对任务效用合理的路径（法律上的"业务必要性"）。
AI.result: 在适当因果假设下，CFG在消除适应人群模型中所有歧视性因果效应时提供形式化保证。使用四个LLM在三个真实场景（基于人口数据及已知因果真值的合成数据集）评估CFG。
AI.conclusion: CFG为LLM公平生成提供了因果推断基础的方法，兼顾公平去除与业务必要性，并具备理论保证和实证评估。

title: Self-Generated Feedback Destabilizes Test-Time Training: A Causal Decomposition of Long-Horizon Adaptation
summary: Test-time training (TTT) lets a model store information in its weights during inference. When the model learns from its own output, however, each update also changes the model that generates the next training example. Across 128K-token streams, retaining generated-text updates worsens prediction on independent human-written text with three TTT-E2E model configurations (labeled 125M, 760M, and 3B). The same failure occurs when Adam updates Qwen3-4B's existing weights. The same update mechanisms can improve on real text, so writing itself is not the failure. Three matched comparisons trace the causal pathway. Fixed Generation removes over 98% of the damage at 125M and 760M by using a frozen model to generate training chunks. Recorded Replay separates the loss caused by reading degraded text from the additional loss stored by updating on it. A paired one-update comparison then shows the local conflict: an update predicts its source better but new real text worse. This cost grows after Closed Loop adaptation, with a few trajectories accounting for most large failures. Finally, Settlement evaluates the candidate state on independent real text before commitment. It leaves mean endpoint gaps of 0.07 and -0.02 nats at 125M and 760M while retaining real-text adaptation. These results motivate checking prediction on independent evidence before retaining an update.

AI.tldr: TTT从自身生成文本学习时，更新会改变生成下一训练样本的模型，导致在独立人类文本上预测变差；用冻结模型、回放与独立验证可缓解。
AI.motivation: 测试时训练（TTT）允许模型在推理时把信息存入权重，但若训练数据来自模型自身输出，每次更新都会改变生成下一训练样本的模型，可能造成自污染式退化。
AI.method: 在128K token流上，对三种TTT-E2E配置（125M、760M、3B）保留生成文本更新；并对Qwen3-4B权重做Adam更新。通过三组匹配对照（Fixed Generation冻结模型生成；Recorded Replay分离阅读退化文本的损失与更新存储的额外损失；paired one-update比较）追踪因果路径，并评估Closed Loop适应与Settlement机制。
AI.result: 保留生成文本更新会损害独立人类文本预测；Fixed Generation在125M和760M去除98%以上损害；paired one-update显示更新更好预测来源但更差预测新真实文本；Closed Loop后成本增长且少数轨迹占多数大失败；Settlement在承诺前用独立真实文本评估候选状态，125M和760M端点差距仅0.07和-0.02 nats，同时保留真实文本适应。
AI.conclusion: 写入自身生成文本本身不是失败根源，问题在于更新与生成循环耦合导致局部冲突。保留更新前应在独立证据上检查预测，Settlement等验证机制能有效缓解退化。

title: ConEx: Human-Interpretable Saliency Maps via Concept-Aware Attribution
summary: Many visual explanation methods in computer vision highlight pixel importance but struggle to link these low-level cues to semantically meaningful concepts, limiting their interpretability and trustworthiness. We introduce Concept-based Explanations (ConEx), a novel framework that bridges saliency visualization with concept-based reasoning to provide both faithfulness and interpretability. ConEx automatically discovers class-specific concepts and represents them through concept activation vectors (CAVs), learned without manual supervision using an architecture-specific masking mechanism that reduces noise introduced by the segmentation masks to enhance concept purity. ConEx generates faithful saliency maps that reveal where each concept appears in the image and how it contributes to the prediction. To evaluate the reliability of these learned concepts, we propose two complementary metrics, Vector-Concept Match (VCM) and Concept-Class Match (CCM), that quantify concept alignment and enable direct comparison with existing methods. Extensive experiments across diverse settings demonstrate that ConEx achieves state-of-the-art performance on faithfulness, segmentation, and concept-quality benchmarks. Overall, ConEx advances the field toward truly interpretable and concept-grounded explanations in vision models.

AI.tldr: 提出ConEx框架，将显著性可视化与概念推理结合，自动发现类别特定概念并生成忠实、可解释的显著图。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉解释方法仅突出像素重要性，难以将低层线索关联到语义概念，限制可解释性与可信度。
AI.method: 自动发现类别特定概念，用概念激活向量(CAVs)表示；通过架构特定掩码机制在无人工监督下学习，减少分割掩码噪声以提升概念纯度；生成揭示各概念出现位置及贡献的忠实显著图；提出VCM与CCM两个度量。
AI.result: 在忠实度、分割和概念质量等多个基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: ConEx推动视觉模型朝真正可解释、基于概念的解释方向发展。

title: Checkable NTK Positivity and Finite-Width Gradient Descent for Scalar- and Vector-Valued PINNs with Strong-Form, Weak-Form, and Nonlocal Linear Constraints
summary: We give checkable positive-definiteness criteria for the limiting neural tangent kernel (NTK) and high-probability finite-width gradient-descent guarantees for scalar- or vector-valued physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) with linear constraints. The constraints may be strong-form differential rows of any fixed finite order, including coupled systems, with any linear initial or boundary conditions; weak-form residual and boundary functionals; or finite-measure nonlocal observations such as integral, nonlocal-diffusion, and Dirac-data rows, all in any dimension. For each class, positive definiteness of the limiting NTK is equivalent to a rank condition on a finite coefficient, functional, or moment matrix of the fixed design: a certificate computed before training that detects structural zero modes. The model hypotheses are those of an ordinary two-layer PINN, a smooth nonpolynomial activation with bounded symmetric initialization, and are met by standard choices such as $\tanh$ with uniform initialization. Given a certificate, explicit width and step-size conditions ensure, with high probability, that the empirical NTK retains at least half the limiting gap and that full-batch gradient descent decreases the training loss geometrically at every iteration. Controlled experiments check the certificates and the finite-width mechanism.

AI.tldr: 该论文为带线性约束的PINN建立可检验的NTK正定性判据与有限宽度梯度下降保证，约束涵盖强/弱形式及非局部观测，正定性等价于有限系数/函数/矩矩阵的秩条件。
AI.motivation: PINN训练成功与否依赖NTK是否正定，但对一般线性约束（微分、边界、弱形式、非局部观测）缺乏可先验检验的判据，也缺少有限宽度下的收敛保证。
AI.method: 针对标量或向量PINN，采用两层网络、光滑非多项式激活与有界对称初始化；对各类线性约束，将极限NTK正定性等价为固定设计的有限系数、函数或矩矩阵的秩条件（训练前证书）；再由证书导出宽度与步长的显式条件。
AI.result: 证书可检测结构性零模态；给定证书时，高概率下经验NTK保留至少一半极限间隙，全批量梯度下降每步几何式降低训练损失。受控实验验证了证书与有限宽度机制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为广泛线性约束下的PINN提供了可先验计算的可靠性与收敛性理论保证，将NTK正定性归约为有限维秩检验。

title: Understanding Generative AI Use in Programming MOOCs: The Role of Course Context and Learner Characteristics
summary: The increasing availability of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools, such as ChatGPT and code-completion assistants, raises questions about how learners integrate these tools into learning activities, particularly in MOOCs that attract diverse participant populations. This study examines the use of GenAI in two programming MOOCs taught in Estonian that differ in duration, workload, topic complexity, and assignment volume: About Programming (4 weeks, 26 expected hours, n = 187) and Introduction to Programming (8 weeks, 78 expected hours, n = 182). Post-course questionnaire data were analyzed using non-parametric statistical methods to examine self-reported adoption, usage frequency, and purposes of GenAI use across courses and learner backgrounds. The results show that GenAI adoption was widespread in both MOOCs, with no statistically significant differences by gender, age, education level, or prior programming experience. However, participants in the longer, more extensive MOOC reported significantly higher usage frequency and were more likely to use GenAI for debugging and idea generation. Reported usage frequency for code explanation and debugging was also higher in the longer course. Exploratory analyses found limited relationships between GenAI use and learning-related outcomes. The findings suggest that course context may play a greater role than learner characteristics in shaping how GenAI tools are used. These results provide implications for instructional design and guidance in programming education.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨两个爱沙尼亚编程MOOC中生成式AI的使用情况，发现AI采用广泛且与学习者背景无关，但课程情境（时长、工作量）显著影响使用频率与用途。
AI.motivation: 随着ChatGPT等生成式AI工具的普及，学习者在MOOC等多样化学习场景中如何整合这些工具尚不明确，尤其缺乏对课程情境差异如何影响AI使用的探究。
AI.method: 选取两门爱沙尼亚语编程MOOC（About Programming：4周/26小时/n=187；Introduction to Programming：8周/78小时/n=182），通过课后问卷收集数据，采用非参数统计方法分析AI的采用率、使用频率与用途，比较课程间及不同学习者背景的差异。
AI.result: 两门课程中AI采用率均很高，且不因性别、年龄、教育程度或编程经验而有显著差异；但在更长、更繁重的课程中，使用频率显著更高，且更常用于调试和创意生成，代码解释与调试的使用频率也更高。探索性分析显示AI使用与学习相关结果关系有限。
AI.conclusion: 课程情境比学习者特征更能塑造生成式AI的使用方式，研究结果为编程教育的教学设计与指导提供了启示。

title: Towards cross-cultural study of folksong lyrics with machine translation
summary: Music is universally present in human societies. Ethnomusicologists have long been documenting the diverse expressions of human musicality, and comparative musicology has recently brought several studies of folksong to a more global scale. Such cross-cultural research has not been conducted on lyrics: the language barrier has so far prevented work with multi-lingual data. However, Natural Language Processing (NLP) technologies have reached a stage where this language barrier may no longer be prohibitive. Combining folksong lyrics corpora across five languages, we machine-translate them to a pivot language with a pre-trained neural topic model, and we examine the relationship between content and social function within each language, and across languages for wedding songs. As expected, human evaluation of translation results shows that non-Indo-European languages suffer from overall worse translation quality. Experiments with topic models then indicate that the content of lyrics is at best partially related to the social function of folksongs across all languages. These experiments are just first steps into cross-cultural folk musics lyrics analysis; however, they do indicate that a previously unobserved web of cross-cultural relationships beyond ethnomusicological typologies may be uncovered through the study of what people sing across the world's diverse folk musics.

AI.tldr: 该论文将五种语言的民谣歌词机器翻译到枢轴语言，用预训练神经主题模型进行跨文化分析，发现歌词内容与民谣社会功能仅部分相关。
AI.motivation: 民谣的社会功能与跨文化比较已有研究，但长期受语言障碍限制，歌词的多语言跨文化分析几乎空白。
AI.method: 整合五种语言的民谣歌词语料库，机器翻译为枢轴语言，结合预训练神经主题模型，分析各语言内及跨语言（以婚礼歌曲为例）的歌词内容与社会功能关系，并进行人工翻译质量评估。
AI.result: 人工评估显示非印欧语系语言的翻译质量整体较差；主题模型实验表明，歌词内容与民谣社会功能在所有语言中至多只是部分相关。
AI.conclusion: 这是跨文化民谣歌词分析的初步尝试，但提示通过研究世界各地人们所唱的歌词，可能揭示超越传统民族音乐学类型学的、此前未被观察到的跨文化关系网络。

title: Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting via Spatiotemporal Priors and Generative Assistance
comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Workshops (SA Workshops '26)
summary: We present a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework for the Sparse-View Track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Volumetric Video Challenge, which requires dynamic scene reconstruction from only six cameras with wide baselines. To achieve robust dynamic reconstruction under such sparse views, our framework integrates three components. (1) Region-adaptive spatial priors: We use foreground masks to guide Gaussian initialization and mask voting to control densification separately for the dynamic foreground and static background. Background geometry is regularized using monocular depth aligned to metric scale. (2) Motion-consistent temporal priors: We provide supervision at intermediate times through frame interpolation and constrain projected Gaussian motion with estimated optical flow. (3) Generative assistance: We place virtual cameras in the widest angular gaps and restore their rendered images using a diffusion-based model conditioned on camera poses. The restored images are iteratively incorporated into training as pseudo-supervision. On the validation set, our framework improves full-frame PSNR from 25.60 dB for the baseline to 29.75 dB. On the official test benchmark, it achieves 30.04 dB full-frame PSNR and 27.88 dB foreground PSNR, ranking first overall in the Sparse-View Track.

AI.tldr: 提出4D高斯泼溅框架，用区域自适应空间先验、运动一致时间先验和扩散生成辅助，仅用6个宽基线相机实现稀疏视角动态场景重建，在SIGGRAPH Asia 2026体视频挑战赛稀疏视角赛道排名第一。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角（仅6个宽基线相机）下动态场景重建困难，基线方法性能不足，需要引入多种先验与生成式辅助提升鲁棒性与质量。
AI.method: 三大组件：(1) 区域自适应空间先验：前景掩码引导高斯初始化、掩码投票控制致密化，背景用对齐度量尺度的单目深度正则；(2) 运动一致时间先验：帧插值提供中间时刻监督，光流约束投影高斯运动；(3) 生成辅助：在最宽角度间隙放置虚拟相机，用位姿条件的扩散模型恢复渲染图像并迭代作为伪监督训练。
AI.result: 验证集全帧PSNR从基线25.60 dB提升至29.75 dB；官方测试集达30.04 dB全帧PSNR和27.88 dB前景PSNR，稀疏视角赛道总排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 结合空间/时间先验与扩散生成伪监督，可有效解决宽基线稀疏视角动态重建，显著超越基线并取得赛道最佳成绩。

title: A Bird's-Eye View of Iterative Reward Design
summary: Designing effective reward functions in RL typically requires substantial expertise and trial and error. Recent work automates this process with LLM-based systems that generate and iteratively improve reward code using policy feedback. However, these methods are often hard to compare because they differ in implementation details, feedback assumptions, and evaluation environments. To address this, we introduce a Benchmark for Iterative Reward Design (BIRD) that expresses existing methods in a unified configuration and evaluation space. This lets us compare algorithms directly, ablate individual design choices, and prototype new components under matched feedback conditions and policy-training budgets. Across MuJoCo, Meta-World, Assistax, and HumanoidBench, we identify a small set of simple design choices that consistently improve performance. Combining these choices yields significantly better performance than the evaluated methods from prior work. Our results highlight the strength of simple baselines and motivate further study of when additional algorithmic complexity improves iterative reward design. Code is available at https://github.com/safety-research/bird.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BIRD基准，统一现有基于LLM的迭代奖励设计方法的配置与评估空间，实现公平比较与消融，并发现在多个环境中一组简单设计选择即可超越已有方法。
AI.motivation: RL中设计有效的奖励函数通常需要大量专业知识和试错。近期基于LLM的方法可自动生成并迭代改进奖励代码，但这些方法在实现细节、反馈假设和评估环境上各不相同，难以公平比较。
AI.method: 提出迭代奖励设计基准BIRD，将已有方法表达为统一的配置与评估空间，从而直接比较算法、消融单个设计选择，并在匹配的反馈条件和策略训练预算下原型化新组件。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo、Meta-World、Assistax和HumanoidBench上，识别出一小部分能持续提升性能的简单设计选择。组合这些选择后，性能显著优于先前工作中被评估的方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了简单基线的强大之处，并激励进一步研究何时增加算法复杂度才能真正改进迭代奖励设计。

title: Trinity: Self-Evolving Vision-Language Models with a Self-Verifier
comment: NeurIPS'26 Workshop on Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS)
summary: Self-evolving vision-language models (VLMs), a form of self-improvement in which a model generates its own training data from unlabeled images, are a promising route toward agents that expand their reasoning capability in an unsupervised manner, without relying on ever-larger annotation budgets. Existing methods pair a Questioner that proposes problems with a Solver that answers them, but reward both roles mainly by agreement among sampled answers. Agreement is a weak proxy for truth: it cannot tell whether a question is grounded in the image, whether the proposed reference answer is right, or whether a confident majority is wrong in the same way. We present Trinity, in which one VLM plays three roles, Questioner, Solver, and Verifier, and the Verifier is a self-verifier: an exponential moving average (EMA) of the policy itself, requiring neither labels nor an external judge. The Verifier screens every generated question for image grounding and answer correctness before it becomes supervision, scores Solver reasoning against the image, and adjudicates disputes between the reference answer and a strong Solver consensus, correcting the reference and penalizing the Questioner when the consensus is right. Trained on images alone, Trinity improves Qwen3-VL-8B on mathematical visual reasoning and on science benchmarks with biology content, for example, +8.6 points on the biology split of SciVQR and +12.8 on MathVerse, and its reward dynamics behave as a healthy self-play curriculum should. These results suggest that a self-evolving multimodal agent can strengthen its scientific reasoning from unlabeled scientific images alone, with the model itself serving as the verifier.

AI.tldr: Trinity让单个VLM扮演提问者、求解者、验证者三角色，用策略自身的EMA作为自验证器，无需标签或外部评判，仅用无标注图像训练即可提升视觉数学与科学推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化VLM方法中提问者与求解者主要靠"答案一致性"给奖励，而一致性是真实性的弱代理：无法判断问题是否扎根图像、参考答案是否正确、多数是否同错。因此需要一种不依赖标签的可靠验证机制。
AI.method: 提出Trinity：一个VLM同时充当提问者、求解者与验证者。验证者是策略自身的指数移动平均(EMA)，无需标签或外部评判。它对生成的问题筛查图像扎根性与答案正确性后才作为监督信号，对求解者推理进行打分，并在参考答案与强求解者共识冲突时进行裁决——当共识正确时修正参考答案并惩罚提问者。
AI.result: 仅用图像训练，Qwen3-VL-8B在数学视觉推理与含生物内容的科学基准上提升显著：SciVQR生物分项+8.6分，MathVerse+12.8分；奖励动态呈现健康的自我博弈课程特征。
AI.conclusion: 自进化多模态智能体可仅凭无标注科学图像强化自身科学推理能力，模型本身即可充当验证者。

title: How Much Do LLM-as-a-Judge Design Choices Matter? A Systematic Comparison of Prompt Designs, Rating Scales, and Models
summary: Researchers increasingly use Large Language Models as judges (LLM-as-a-judge) to evaluate model outputs. Yet there are no standards for how to design these judges. Typically, researchers choose the prompt, rating scale, and model intuitively. If these choices change the judge's verdicts, two studies can reach different conclusions about the same facts. To address this risk and to provide an empirical basis for judge designs, we evaluate 10 reasoning models across multiple designs on two tasks: a scalar rating of sentence sentiment and toxicity (over 500 items per category), as well as a binary accuracy classification of question-answer pairs (n=600). For the rating tasks, despite judges showing significant disagreements with the human ground truth, the practical size of differences is small enough to consider most judges reliable (mean absolute deviation of 0.11 points on a 1 - 7 scale); toxicity judges even outperform standard classifiers. Judges are also highly accurate on average (96.5%) for the accuracy classification task. However, design choices can produce shifts: changing the rating scale alone can shift measured bias by up to 0.93 points (rating task), and while accuracy levels are rarely impacted, design choices consistently impact judge leniency (classification task; leniency drop of 28.9 percentage points when using detailed prompts, and up to 56.1 percentage points when switching models). Counterintuitively, lower reasoning effort affects neither accuracy nor leniency. Across both tasks, model identity is the dominant source of variance. These findings suggest that while LLM judges are broadly trustworthy in aggregate, design choices can be meaningful sources of variance. Given the growing reliance on automated evaluation in LLM research, we intend this study as a methodological reference for designing more robust and replicable LLM-as-a-judge pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了LLM-as-a-judge的设计选择对评判结果的影响，发现尽管LLM评判者总体上可靠（评分任务平均绝对偏差小、准确率高），但设计选择（如评分量表、提示详细度、模型选择）能显著改变测得的偏置与宽松度，其中模型身份是方差的主要来源。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-judge日益流行，但缺乏设计标准，研究者通常凭直觉选择提示、评分量表与模型。若这些选择改变评判结论，不同研究可能对同一事实得出不同结论，因此需要为评判设计提供实证基础。
AI.method: 跨10个推理模型、多种评判设计，在两个任务上评估：(1) 句子情感与毒性的标量评分（每类500+条目）；(2) 问答对的二元准确性分类（n=600）。
AI.result: 评分任务中虽与人类真值有显著分歧，但实用差异小（1-7量表上平均绝对偏差0.11），多数评判者可被视为可靠，毒性评判甚至优于标准分类器；准确性分类平均准确率96.5%。但设计选择会产生偏移：仅改变评分量表可使测得偏置变动达0.93分；分类任务中准确率很少受影响，但宽松度受设计影响显著（详细提示下降28.9个百分点，换模型下降最多56.1个百分点）；反直觉的是，降低推理努力不影响准确率或宽松度。模型身份是两任务方差的主导来源。
AI.conclusion: LLM评判者总体值得信赖，但设计选择是重要的方差来源。鉴于自动化评估在LLM研究中日益重要，该研究旨在作为方法学参考，用于设计更稳健、可复现的LLM-as-a-judge流程。

title: Task-Sensitive Geometry of Representation Transfer for Object Detection under Image Degradation
summary: Object detection under image degradation can benefit from clean-image supervision, but aggregate gains do not imply that transferred representation changes are uniformly useful. We study how clean task knowledge affects degraded-image representations and whether local responses to structured representation directions can be characterized geometrically. Using paired clean and Gaussian-degraded BDD100K images, we show that clean-teacher distillation improves observed detection accuracy while producing heterogeneous object-level transfer. We isolate a representation component complementary to direct clean-teacher alignment and map it into the distilled student space through an orthogonal bridge. Controlled interventions rescue 13.22% of objects lost under the distilled representation, versus 4.30% under norm-matched random perturbations, with very low harm on preserved objects. We introduce task-sensitive geometry, a gradient-derived channel-space geometry constructed from normalized detection-loss gradients. On a reserved cohort, mapped-complement orientation within this frozen geometry is positively associated with local intervention-response magnitude after controlling for intervention magnitude (partial Spearman $ρ$ = 0.242, 95% CI [0.108, 0.359]). The relationship eplicates on independent data ($ρ$ = 0.180) and with RT-DETR-L ($ρ$ = 0.227), but not for the direct clean-teacher residual family, and it weakens for large interventions. Routing rules and specialized distillation objectives based on these signals do not yield statistically reliable gains over CLEANKD. These results support a local, direction-family-dependent task-sensitive geometry while showing that converting such structure into improved global training remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: 研究清洁图像监督对退化图像检测表示的影响，发现清洁教师蒸馏产生异质的目标级迁移；通过正交桥映射互补表示分量可挽救13.22%丢失目标，并引入"任务敏感几何"刻画表示方向与干预响应的局部关系。
AI.motivation: 清洁图像监督虽能提升退化图像检测的整体精度，但聚合增益不代表迁移的表示变化均匀有用；作者想探究清洁任务知识如何影响退化图像表示，以及结构化表示方向的局部响应能否用几何刻画。
AI.method: 使用配对清洁与高斯退化BDD100K图像，分析清洁教师蒸馏的目标级迁移异质性；分离出与直接清洁教师对齐互补的表示分量，经正交桥映射到蒸馏学生空间；用归一化检测损失梯度构建通道空间"任务敏感几何"，并在保留队列上检验映射互补方向与干预响应幅度的关系（控制干预幅度）；在独立数据和RT-DETR-L上复现。
AI.result: 控制干预挽救13.22%在蒸馏表示下丢失的目标，随机扰动仅4.30%，对保留目标危害很低；映射互补方向在冻结几何中的取向与干预响应幅度正相关（partial Spearman ρ=0.242，95% CI [0.108, 0.359]），独立数据ρ=0.180、RT-DETR-L ρ=0.227，但直接清洁教师残差族不显著，大干预下关系减弱；基于这些信号的路由规则和专门蒸馏目标未获得统计可靠增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种局部的、依赖方向族的任务敏感几何，但将此类结构转化为全局训练改进仍是未解问题。

title: A multi-stage probabilistic framework to estimate gas-fired generator performance during extreme winter weather
summary: Extreme winter weather has repeatedly disrupted gas-fired power generation in the United States, yet the plant-level data needed to systematically quantify outage risk remain proprietary. Using publicly available weather and electricity demand data together with anonymized generator contingency records from the North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC), we develop a three-stage Bayesian probabilistic framework for estimating winter-driven generator performance. Applied to New York State (2013--2022), the framework sequentially estimates: the hourly probability of a generator contingency event, the expected net available capacity conditioned on an event occurring, and the event duration. Colder conditions and higher electricity demand are associated with higher failure probability, lower retained capacity, and longer event duration. Under the most severe observed stress conditions, estimated mean hourly event probability reaches 24\% , while expected mean net available capacity falls to 13\% of nameplate rating. Full outage events have a median duration of 12.7 hours, while partial derating event duration increases from 2.4 to 7.1 hours with capacity loss severity. The proposed framework establishes a transferable baseline that utilities with access to plant-level records can directly extend to obtain more precise reliability estimates for operational planning and resource adequacy assessment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个三阶段贝叶斯概率框架，利用公开天气与电力需求数据及NERC匿名发电机停运记录，估计冬季极端天气下发电机的停运风险与性能，并应用于纽约州（2013–2022）。
AI.motivation: 极端冬季天气反复中断美国燃气发电，但系统量化停运风险的厂级数据多为专有，难以获取，因此需要一种可迁移的估计方法。
AI.method: 三阶段贝叶斯概率框架，依次估计：发电机停运事件的逐小时概率、事件发生条件下预期净可用容量、以及事件持续时间；输入为公开天气和电力需求数据，结合NERC匿名发电机应急记录。
AI.result: 更冷条件与更高电力需求对应更高故障概率、更低保留容量和更长持续时间。最严重观测压力下，平均逐小时事件概率达24%，预期平均净可用容量降至铭牌容量的13%。完全停运事件中位持续12.7小时；部分降额事件持续时间随容量损失严重程度从2.4小时增至7.1小时。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一个可迁移的基线，拥有厂级记录的公用事业公司可直接扩展以获得更精确的可靠性估计，用于运行规划和资源充足性评估。

title: Reactivating Alignment: Defending LLMs from Jailbreaks via Intention-Aware Input-Output Matching
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that conceal harmful intent within complex adversarial prompts. Existing defenses primarily rely on input perturbation or harmful-output suppression, but they rarely model where malicious intent resides, resulting in brittle protection and excessive over-refusal.
  We propose SENTINEL, a plug-and-play, generation-time jailbreak defense that reframes mitigation as an intent extraction problem. Our key insight is that instruction-tuned LLMs exhibit strong input--output semantic consistency: regardless of jailbreak complexity, generated outputs tend to align with the attacker's true intent. SENTINEL exploits this property by matching semantically aligned input--output regions to extract intention-revealing subsequences, scores these subsequences using refusal-direction projections to estimate harmfulness, and halts generation when necessary. Experiments on HarmBench across multiple LLMs show that SENTINEL reduces jailbreak success rates to close to 5\% while maintaining low over-refusal. We further demonstrate robustness to adaptive attacks and provide a mechanistic interpretation: SENTINEL re-distributes jailbreak features from alignment blind spots to aligned regions.

AI.tldr: SENTINEL：一种即插即用的生成时越狱防御，通过提取意图揭示子序列并基于拒绝方向投影评分来阻止有害生成。
AI.motivation: 现有防御依赖输入扰动或有害输出抑制，未建模恶意意图所在位置，导致防护脆弱且过度拒答。
AI.method: 将防御重构为意图抽取问题。利用指令微调LLM的输入-输出语义一致性，匹配语义对齐的输入-输出区域提取意图揭示子序列，用拒绝方向投影评估危害性，必要时中止生成。
AI.result: 在HarmBench多个LLM上，越狱成功率降至约5%，同时保持低过度拒答；对自适应攻击具有鲁棒性；机制解释表明其将越狱特征从对齐盲区重新分配到对齐区域。
AI.conclusion: SENTINEL提供了一种有效、低过度拒答且具可解释性的生成时越狱防御方案。

title: vMF Sentence LDA: A Spherical Topic Model over Sentence Embeddings
summary: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and models derived from it remain widely used topic models. LDA observes each document as a bag-of-words and models each topic by a categorical distribution over the vocabulary, so that it uses neither the internal structure of the document nor the similarity in meaning between words. Earlier work has responded to this limitation in two ways: many models have introduced embeddings, and some have assigned topics to sentences rather than to words. Their combination, a topic model that observes sentence embeddings, remains little explored. We propose vMF Sentence LDA (vSLDA), which keeps the admixture structure of LDA, observes each sentence as its L2-normalized embedding and models each topic by a von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distribution, which matches the cosine geometry of sentence embeddings. Its per-topic parameter count and per-iteration cost are linear in the embedding dimension, versus quadratic for the full-covariance Gaussian distribution in the existing model over sentence embeddings. We evaluate vSLDA where the limitation is expected to matter most, among topics that share much of their vocabulary: the topics that subdivide the one subject of a collection, and the narrow topics that result when a corpus is divided into a large number of topics. On two corpora, vSLDA attains the best mean rank against eight baselines when the fine categories within each coarse category are classified from the document-topic distributions. On the whole corpus, its advantage appears or widens as the number of topics grows. Weighting the word frequencies of each sentence by its topic posterior yields expected topic-word counts of the same form as those of LDA, so that the standard topic coherence and diversity measures apply to models that assign topics to sentences. On their product, topic quality, vSLDA leads in most within-category conditions of both corpora.

AI.tldr: 提出 vMF Sentence LDA (vSLDA)，将 LDA 的混合结构与句嵌入的 von Mises-Fisher 分布结合，建模句子级主题，在细粒度主题分类与主题质量上优于八个基线。
AI.motivation: 传统 LDA 仅用词袋，忽略文档内部结构和词义相似性；已有工作分别引入嵌入或句子级主题，但"句子嵌入+主题模型"的组合探索不足，尤其在词汇高度重叠的细粒度主题上表现受限。
AI.method: vSLDA 保留 LDA 的混合（admixture）结构，将每个句子视为 L2 归一化嵌入并作为观测单位，用 von Mises-Fisher (vMF) 分布建模每个主题，契合余弦几何；每主题参数量和每轮迭代成本随嵌入维度线性增长（对比全协方差高斯模型的二次成本）。
AI.result: 在两个语料上，从文档-主题分布进行细类分类时，vSLDA 对八个基线取得最佳平均排名；全语料上主题数越多优势越明显。通过句主题后验加权词频得到与 LDA 同形的期望主题-词计数，使标准主题一致性与多样性度量可用；在主题质量乘积指标上，在两语料多数类内条件下领先。
AI.conclusion: vSLDA 有效结合句子嵌入与混合主题建模，在词汇重叠严重的细粒度场景中优于现有方法，计算开销更低，并兼容标准主题评估指标。

title: FLASHSWIN: Unlocking Large Windows and Dense Tokens in Swin Vision Transformers with Memory Efficient Attention
summary: High-resolution vision backbones have long been forced to trade away local token density to afford larger receptive fields. Hierarchical Swin transformers impose this compromise because standard windowed attention materializes an $M^2\times M^2$ score matrix per window, incurring $O(M^4)$ memory as windows or token grids grow. Furthermore, Swin adds a learned relative-position bias elementwise to attention scores, requiring full materialization of the score matrix and its gradient. This keeps Swin and SwinV2 trapped in a small-window($M=8,16$), coarse-token regime with patch size $4\times4$ ($p=4$), limiting performance for fine-grained tasks. We introduce FLASHSWIN, which replaces standard windowed attention with a FlashAttention implementation that computes exact softmax attention without materializing the score matrix, reducing per-window memory from $O(M^4)$ to $O(M^2)$. This enables higher token density and larger receptive fields without inflating memory overhead. Training memory is flat across window sizes: at a $32\times32$ window, FLASHSWIN-T requires only $12.4$\,GB, unchanged from $8\times8$, compared to $70/90$\,GB for SwinV2/V1-T. However, applying FlashAttention directly to Swin creates a trade-off: bypassing the score matrix precludes Swin's additive relative-position bias, forfeiting spatial information in exchange for memory efficiency. FLASHSWIN restores position information as window-local learnable 2D RoPE, making large windows and dense token grids both affordable and accurate. At matched scale, FLASHSWIN-T outperforms Swin variants. With dense tokens and wide windows ($p=2,M=32$), the same Tiny model reaches $84.1\%$ ImageNet-1K, $44.1$ COCO box AP, and $47.28$ ADE20K mIoU---gains of $+1.3$, $+5.1$, and $+1.82$ over SwinV2-T at $M=16$, respectively. At fixed $M=32$, halving the patch size yields roughly $3\times$ larger gains in boundary quality than in mIoU.

AI.tldr: FLASHSWIN 用 FlashAttention 替代标准窗口注意力，将每窗口内存从 O(M^4) 降至 O(M^2)，并以窗口局部 2D RoPE 恢复位置信息，从而支持大窗口与密集 token，在分类、检测、分割上超越 Swin/SwinV2。
AI.motivation: Swin 类层次化 Transformer 为获得大感受野不得不牺牲局部 token 密度：标准窗口注意力显式物化 M^2×M^2 注意力分数矩阵，内存为 O(M^4)；再加相对位置偏置需完整物化分数及梯度，导致只能用小窗口(M=8,16)和粗 token(p=4)，限制细粒度任务性能。
AI.method: 用 FlashAttention 实现精确 softmax 窗口注意力，不物化分数矩阵，内存降至 O(M^2)；用窗口内可学习 2D RoPE 替代加性相对位置偏置，使大窗口和密集 token 均可行且准确。
AI.result: 训练内存不随窗口增大而增：32×32 窗口下 FLASHSWIN-T 仅 12.4GB（与 8×8 相同），而 SwinV2/V1-T 为 70/90GB。p=2,M=32 时 Tiny 模型达 ImageNet-1K 84.1%、COCO box AP 44.1、ADE20K mIoU 47.28，较 M=16 的 SwinV2-T 分别 +1.3/+5.1/+1.82。固定 M=32 时 patch 减半带来的边界质量提升约为 mIoU 提升的 3 倍。
AI.conclusion: FLASHSWIN 解除了 Swin 的内存瓶颈，使高分辨率骨干可同时拥有大窗口与密集 token，在多项细粒度视觉任务上一致优于 Swin/SwinV2。

title: CEENs: Causality-enforced evolutional networks for solving time-dependent partial differential equations
summary: Despite the growing popularity of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), their applicability in the long-time integration of partial differential equations (PDEs) remains constrained. We argue that this problem stems from the lack of consideration of temporal causality in the original PINN formulation, resulting in a bias towards satisfying governing equations at later times before learning the initial condition and hence leading to erroneous solutions. To this end, we propose a novel method that seamlessly integrates temporal causality into the training process. Drawing inspiration from classical numerical methods where the temporal causality is reflected, we divide the time domain into nonoverlapping subintervals, assign a unique neural network to each subinterval, and construct a loss function founded on the integral form of PDEs within these subintervals. The proposed networks undergo sequential training, beginning with the initial time step. Our method demonstrates significant improvement in accuracy for long-time simulations of various PDE problems where the original PINN method fails while it requires less computational cost and memory compared to the PINN method. A parallelization algorithm is provided to further enhance the computational efficiency, showing a significant speedup for solving time-dependent PDEs.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出物理信息神经网络(PINN)在多方程长时间积分中受限，根源在于原公式未考虑时间因果性。作者提出将时间域划分为不重叠子区间，每个子区间用独立网络并在积分形式上构建损失，按时间顺序训练，从而显著提升长时间求解精度并降低计算成本与内存。
AI.motivation: PINN在PDE长时间积分中适用性受限。作者认为原因是原始PINN公式未考虑时间因果性，导致训练偏向先满足较晚时刻的控制方程而忽视初始条件，产生错误解。
AI.method: 受经典数值方法中体现时间因果性的启发，将时间域划分为互不重叠的子区间，为每个子区间分配独立神经网络，并基于子区间内PDE的积分形式构造损失函数；网络从初始时间步开始按顺序训练。此外提供并行化算法以提升计算效率。
AI.result: 在多个PINN失效的PDE长时间模拟问题中，所提方法显著提高了精度，且相比PINN方法需要更少的计算成本和内存；并行算法进一步加速了时间相关PDE求解。
AI.conclusion: 将时间因果性融入训练（子区间分解+积分形式损失+顺序训练）能有效解决PINN长时间积分问题，兼具精度、效率和内存优势，并通过并行化进一步提升求解效率。

title: Semantic Causal-Factor Inference from Aviation Incident Narratives Using A Variational Autoencoder with Cosine-Similarity-Based Reconstruction
summary: Aviation accident and incident investigations generate extensive unstructured textual information containing evidence relevant to the causes and contributing factors of safety occurrences. Automatically extracting such information is challenging because causal evidence may be distributed across long and complex investigation narratives. This study proposes a semantic causal-factor inference framework combining natural language processing with a variational autoencoder (VAE) to learn the relationship between aviation investigation narratives and expert-reported probable causes. Investigation narratives and their corresponding probable causes are transformed into numerical representations, after which the encoder maps narrative representations to a probabilistic latent space. The decoder estimates representations of the corresponding probable causes and is trained using an objective that combines Kullback-Leibler divergence with cosine-similarity-based semantic reconstruction. The framework was evaluated using 20,919 finalized U.S. National Transportation Safety Board investigation reports from 2005 to 2020. On the held-out test set, the predicted and expert-reported probable-cause representations achieved a mean cosine similarity of 0.786 (SD = 0.120). The predicted representations also yielded interpretable terms associated with causal information in the reports. The results demonstrate the potential of probabilistic latent representation learning for AI-assisted extraction of causal information from aviation safety narratives while retaining expert investigation as the basis for formal causal determination.

AI.tldr: 提出结合NLP与变分自编码器(VAE)的语义因果因子推断框架，从航空事故调查叙事中自动提取与专家报告的可能原因相关的因果信息。
AI.motivation: 航空事故调查产生大量非结构化文本，其中因果证据分散于冗长复杂的叙事中，自动提取困难。目标是自动学习调查叙事与专家报告的可能原因之间的关系。
AI.method: 将调查叙事及其对应的可能原因转化为数值表示；编码器将叙事表示映射到概率潜在空间；解码器估计对应可能原因的表示。训练目标结合KL散度与基于余弦相似度的语义重构。数据为2005–2020年美国NTSB的20,919份最终调查报告。
AI.result: 在留出测试集上，预测的与专家报告的可能原因表示的余弦相似度均值为0.786（SD=0.120）；预测表示还能给出与报告因果信息相关的可解释词项。
AI.conclusion: 概率潜在表示学习在AI辅助从航空安全叙事中提取因果信息方面具有潜力，同时保留专家调查作为正式因果判定的基础。

title: Small Agents with Semantic Search: Efficient Multilingual Code Localization
summary: Locating relevant files from natural-language requests is a core subtask for agents operating over code repositories. We investigate whether this task can be delegated to compact, specialized models to enable on-device search while reducing the token usage, latency, and inference cost of larger agents. We show that semantic search improves file localization, with gains in accuracy, cross-language transfer, and inference efficiency. To study this setting, we introduce a training framework for file-localization agents built around ColGREP, a local semantic search tool based on late-interaction retrieval models. Our recipe combines weighted supervised fine-tuning on teacher trajectories, assigning turn-level credit based on retrieval outcomes, with reinforcement learning on localization quality. We train three model families with fewer than two billion parameters to formulate search queries, inspect retrieved content, and identify relevant files. On localization tasks derived from SWE-bench Lite and Multi-SWE-bench Flash, ColGREP-equipped agents substantially improve over their base models and outperform corresponding GREP-based agents. In addition to improving localization accuracy, ColGREP reduces mean end-to-end trajectory latency by 44.1\% on CPU while using 29.1\% fewer tokens, and enables better generalization to programming languages unseen during fine-tuning. These results suggest that compact, tool-specialized localization agents can provide an efficient interface between natural-language requests and large codebases.

AI.tldr: 论文研究将代码仓库中的自然语言文件定位任务委派给紧凑专业模型，提出基于ColGREP（晚期交互检索的本地语义搜索工具）的训练框架，训练<2B参数模型，显著提升定位精度、效率与跨语言泛化。
AI.motivation: 大型智能体在代码仓库中定位相关文件时token消耗、延迟与推理成本高；希望用紧凑专业模型实现设备端搜索，降低成本。
AI.method: 引入围绕ColGREP（基于晚期交互检索模型的本地语义搜索工具）的文件定位智能体训练框架；结合加权监督微调（基于教师轨迹，按检索结果分配轮次级信用）与面向定位质量的强化学习；训练三个<2B参数模型族，用于构建查询、检查检索内容并识别相关文件。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Lite与Multi-SWE-bench Flash任务上，配备ColGREP的智能体显著优于基座模型，并超过基于GREP的智能体；平均端到端轨迹延迟在CPU上降低44.1%，token使用减少29.1%，且对微调未见编程语言泛化更好。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑、工具专业化的定位智能体可作为自然语言请求与大型代码库之间的高效接口。

title: COMPASS: Comet Object Measurement Pipeline with Automated Selection and Scoring
summary:
Summary: The single-cell gel electrophoresis ('comet') assay is a widely used technique for quantifying DNA damage at the individual cell level. However, image analysis often relies on manual inspection or semi-automated software, which can be labor-intensive, difficult to reproduce, and sensitive to image quality and comet morphology. COMPASS automates comet assay image analysis by combining deep learning-based comet segmentation with damage measurement and automated comet selection. The pipeline produces standardized DNA damage measurements while offering robust detection, reducing manual effort and improving reproducibility through transparent selection and optional manual review.
  Availability and implementation: COMPASS is implemented in Python and is freely available at https://github.com/ rsinghlab/COMPASS. Installation instructions, pretrained weights, and example usage are provided in the repository.
  Contact: jack_roberts2@brown.edu, ritsingh@illinois.edu
  Supplementary information: Available onlime upon publication.

AI.tldr: COMPASS是一个用Python实现的开源工具，结合深度学习彗星分割、损伤测量与自动彗星筛选，实现彗星电泳图像分析自动化，提升可重复性并减少人工。
AI.motivation: 单细胞凝胶电泳（彗星实验）图像分析多依赖人工检查或半自动软件，耗时、难以复现，且对图像质量和彗星形态敏感。
AI.method: 将基于深度学习的彗星分割与损伤测量、自动彗星筛选相结合的流水线，并提供透明筛选及可选人工复核。
AI.result: 产出标准化的DNA损伤测量结果，具备稳健检测能力，减少人工投入并提升可重复性。
AI.conclusion: COMPASS为彗星实验图像分析提供了自动化、开源且可复现的解决方案；代码及预训练权重在GitHub公开。

title: Specific Algorithmic Interpretability of Neural Networks: A Case Study on Textures
summary: We develop a principled framework for constructing neural networks whose specific parameter realizations admit an explicit algorithmic interpretation. Existing algorithm-inspired architectures can explain the computational structure of a network, yet after standard training the learned parameters need not retain a clear relation to the motivating algorithm. We address this gap as follows. First, we model each data point as a sample of a class-dependent stochastic process and assume that statistics of this process can be estimated from a single sample and these statistics are sufficient to distinguish the classes. We then construct a neural network whose initial parameters exactly implement an algorithm for estimating these statistics, making the network fully interpretable. To account for mismatch between the idealized model and real data, we fine-tune this network while controlling its deviation from the algorithmic initialization. The trained network hence roughly retains the interpretation of the initial network. A PAC-Bayesian analysis yields a uniform generalization bound whose complexity term scales with the fine-tuning radius, providing a statistical motivation for our approach. We instantiate the framework for texture classification using the scattering transform to estimate the discriminative statistics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种框架：构建初始参数精确实现显式算法的神经网络，并通过受限微调在保留算法可解释性的同时适应真实数据。
AI.motivation: 现有算法启发式架构虽能解释计算结构，但标准训练后学到的参数与原始算法失去明确关系，可解释性丢失。
AI.method: 将数据建模为类别相关随机过程的样本，假设单样本可估计充分统计量；构造初始参数实现该统计估计算法的网络，再在控制偏离初始化的约束下微调；用PAC-Bayes分析给出一致泛化界。
AI.result: PAC-Bayes泛化界的复杂度项随微调半径增长，为方法提供统计依据；以散射变换估计判别统计量，实例化于纹理分类。
AI.conclusion: 通过受限微调可在适应真实数据失配的同时大致保留算法式可解释性，并由泛化界支持该策略。

title: InferOpt: Constrained Multi-Objective Search for LLM Inference Configurations
summary: Serving an LLM means setting dozens of inference-time knobs, from per-layer KV retention to per-layer expert counts. Practice sets them with mechanism-specific heuristics that return a single operating point and do not scale to layer-wise search spaces. We recast inference configuration as constrained multi-objective black-box optimization and build InferOpt, a reusable search framework that requires only variable bounds, a deterministic resource cost, and an evaluation hook. InferOpt searches on a frozen sampled proxy set, rejects over-budget candidates before any model call, tightens the budget adaptively, and re-validates Pareto representatives on full-scale dataset. One pipeline covers a 28-dimensional continuous KV space (Qwen2.5-7B) and a 26-dimensional discrete MoE space (DeepSeek-V2-Lite). On KV, post-prefill pruning cuts the 16K cache by 64.4% and TPOT by 22.9--48.5%, and the searched layer-wise budget by InferOpt beats a matched uniform budget by 7.3% and 14.0% of the Full KV reference points. On MoE, a searched top-k schedule by InferOpt removes 43.0% of routed token--expert pairs while staying within 0.59 points of the default, closer than the matched-budget baselines. Against Random Search, NSGA-II, and MOTPE, InferOpt leads on both spaces, taking the best proxy hypervolume and the lowest retention on KV and staying closest to the uncompressed reference at the lowest experts on MoE.

AI.tldr: InferOpt 将 LLM 推理配置重构成约束多目标黑盒优化问题，用统一搜索框架处理 KV 与 MoE 的层级配置，并以代理集搜索+自适应预算+全量再验证获得帕累托最优。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时参数（如逐层 KV 保留、逐层专家数）依赖机制专用启发式，只能给出单一工作点，无法应对层级高维搜索空间。
AI.method: 将推理配置视为约束多目标黑盒优化，构建 InferOpt：仅需变量边界、确定性资源代价与评估钩子；在冻结采样代理集上搜索，调用模型前剔除超预算候选，自适应收紧预算，并在全量数据集上再验证帕累托代表。
AI.result: 覆盖 28 维连续 KV 空间（Qwen2.5-7B）与 26 维离散 MoE 空间（DeepSeek-V2-Lite）。KV：prefill 后剪枝使 16K 缓存降 64.4%、TPOT 降 22.9–48.5%，逐层预算优于均匀预算 7.3% 和 14.0%。MoE：搜索的 top-k 调度减少 43.0% token–expert 对，仅差默认 0.59 分。对 Random Search、NSGA-II、MOTPE 均领先。
AI.conclusion: InferOpt 是通用可复用的推理配置搜索框架，在 KV 与 MoE 两类空间均取得更优帕累托前沿与更低资源占用。

title: InstMoE: Adaptive Multimodal Routing with Specialized Experts
summary: Multimodal inputs are inherently heterogeneous, not only across modalities but also in the information pathways required for effective prediction. To address this limitation, we propose InstMoE, an adaptive expert routing framework for multimodal learning. InstMoE dynamically routes each input to specialized unimodal and cross-modal experts, allowing the model to adapt its information pathways to the characteristics of the input. However, routing can be misled when modality-specific variations obscure task-relevant semantics. Such irrelevant variations may distort routing decisions, causing inputs to be assigned to inappropriate experts. We therefore introduce a Contrastive Semantic Alignment module, which encourages semantically similar inputs to share task-relevant representations while suppressing irrelevant modality-specific variations. Experiments on multimodal sentiment analysis benchmarks demonstrate that InstMoE achieves state-of-the-art performance on CMU-MOSEI and CH-SIMS v2 while using substantially fewer parameters than competitive baselines. Further analysis shows that different inputs exhibit distinct expert preferences, demonstrating that InstMoE moves beyond fixed fusion toward adaptive multimodal computation.

AI.tldr: 提出InstMoE，一个面向多模态学习的自适应专家路由框架，通过动态路由到单模态与跨模态专家，并引入对比语义对齐模块抑制模态特异噪声干扰，在多模态情感分析任务上以更少参数达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多模态输入本质上是异质的，不仅体现在模态之间，还体现在有效预测所需的信息通路上。传统固定融合方式无法根据输入特性调整信息路径。同时，模态特异的变化可能掩盖任务相关语义，从而误导路由决策，使输入被分配到不合适的专家。
AI.method: InstMoE的核心是自适应专家路由框架，将每个输入动态路由到专门的单模态专家和跨模态专家，使模型能根据输入特征调整信息通路。为应对路由被误导的问题，引入对比语义对齐模块（Contrastive Semantic Alignment），促使语义相似的输入共享任务相关表示，同时抑制无关的模态特异变化。
AI.result: 在多模态情感分析基准测试中，InstMoE在CMU-MOSEI和CH-SIMS v2数据集上取得SOTA性能，且参数量显著少于竞争基线。进一步分析显示不同输入表现出不同的专家偏好。
AI.conclusion: InstMoE突破了固定融合范式，实现了自适应的多模态计算，验证了动态路由结合语义对齐在多模态学习中的有效性。

title: Decouple, Purify and Unite: Semantic-Structural Prototype Learning for Federated Medical Segmentation
summary: Federated learning enables medical institutions to train a global model without sharing data, yet feature heterogeneity from diverse scanners or protocols remains challenging. Existing representation-based methods face two limitations: 1) Incomplete Contextual Representation Learning: single-layer or coupled representations overlook multi-level structural cues and entangle regional semantics with boundary details. 2) Layerwise Style and Aggregation Biases: domain-specific style discrepancies across intermediate layers degrade prototypes, while aggregation that overlooks client distribution shifts can further amplify bias. We propose FedBCS+, federated decoupled contextual alignment with style-purified aggregation. We employ Frequency-domain Style Recalibration (FSR) in prototype construction to decouple content-style representations and extract style-purified prototypes. Built upon these purified features, Decoupled Contextual Prototype Alignment (DCPA) explicitly decouples multi-level features into semantic and structural prototypes and aligns regional semantics and fine-grained anatomical structures separately. Style-purified Semantic Prototype Aggregation (S2PA) measures each client's purified prototype divergence from the global consensus and adaptively reweights aggregation toward under-represented clients to reduce consensus bias. On five heterogeneous medical segmentation benchmarks spanning histopathology, MRI, ultrasound, and colonoscopy, FedBCS+ achieves the highest mean Dice among the compared methods. A convergence analysis further characterizes how aggregation and alignment affect the optimization bound.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedBCS+，一种联邦解耦上下文对齐与风格纯化聚合方法，解决医学图像分割中特征异质性问题。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可在不共享数据下训练全局模型，但来自不同扫描仪或协议的医学特征异质性仍是挑战。现有基于表示的方法存在两个局限：1）不完整的上下文表示学习：单层或耦合表示忽略多层级结构线索，并将区域语义与边界细节纠缠；2）层级风格与聚合偏差：中间层域特定风格差异会劣化原型，而忽略客户端分布偏移的聚合会进一步放大偏差。
AI.method: 提出FedBCS+，包含三个组件：频率域风格重校准（FSR）用于原型构建，解耦内容-风格表示并提取风格纯化原型；解耦上下文原型对齐（DCPA）将多层特征显式解耦为语义和结构原型，分别对齐区域语义与细粒度解剖结构；风格纯化语义原型聚合（S2PA）度量各客户端纯化原型与全局共识的偏差，并将聚合自适应重加权至欠代表客户端以减少共识偏差。
AI.result: 在涵盖组织病理学、MRI、超声和结肠镜的五种异质医学分割基准上，FedBCS+取得最高平均Dice；收敛分析刻画了聚合与对齐如何影响优化边界。
AI.conclusion: FedBCS+通过风格纯化解耦表示与偏差感知聚合，有效缓解联邦医学图像分割中的特征异质性，并在多个基准上表现优异。

title: MaDeL: Manifold-Decomposed Feature Losses for Generative Modeling
summary: Generative models are often trained with isotropic objectives such as mean-squared error. For data concentrated near a low-dimensional manifold, however, such losses conflate displacement along the manifold, which may represent valid variation, with displacement away from it, which produces invalid samples. This mismatch is especially problematic in sparse, highly constrained domains, where ambient-space regression can encourage off-manifold interpolation. We ask whether a generative objective can distinguish manifold-parallel variation from manifold-orthogonal deviation directly from data, without explicitly estimating the manifold. We introduce a manifold-decomposed feature loss (MaDeL) that learns complementary representations from corrupted observations: one is trained to recover the clean sample, while the other is trained to recover the corruption. We show that, under a feature bottleneck, their Jacobians align with the tangent and normal spaces, exactly for linear manifolds and locally for smooth manifolds. Together, these representations define an anisotropic objective that separately measures intrinsic variation and off-manifold deviation. Across synthetic, Earth and climate science, and torsion-angle benchmarks, MaDeL improves support recovery and average angular $W_1$ under single-step sampling; on protein backbones, it reduces steric clashes across one- and few-step sampling budgets.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MaDeL（流形分解特征损失），通过从含噪观测中学习互补表示（一个恢复干净样本、一个恢复损坏），在特征瓶颈下使其Jacobian分别对齐切空间与法空间，从而构建区分流形内在变化与偏离的异向损失。
AI.motivation: 生成模型常用MSE等各向同性损失，但数据集中于低维流形时，这类损失混淆了沿流形位移（有效变化）与离开流形位移（产生无效样本）。在稀疏、强约束领域尤为严重，环境空间回归会促使非流形插值。
AI.method: 引入流形分解特征损失（MaDeL）：从损坏观测学习两个互补表示，一个恢复干净样本，一个恢复损坏；在特征瓶颈下证明其Jacobian分别对齐切空间与法空间（线性流形精确成立，光滑流形局部成立），进而定义分别度量内在变化与离流形偏离的异向目标。
AI.result: 在合成、地球与气候科学以及扭转角基准上，单步采样下改善支持恢复与平均角度W1；在蛋白质骨架上，跨单步与少步采样预算减少空间位阻冲突。
AI.conclusion: 无需显式估计流形，即可直接从数据区分流形平行变化与正交偏离，为强约束域生成建模提供有效目标，提升采样质量与结构有效性。

title: VCLMU: Mechanism-Centric Virtual Cell World Modeling for Perturbation Response
comment: This paper was accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 workshop on AI for drug discovery
summary: Predicting cellular responses to genetic perturbations is a central capability for virtual cells and a key step toward computational modeling of biological interventions. Most existing models directly map an unperturbed molecular profile and perturba- tion to the resulting observation without explicitly representing the latent cellular transition induced by the intervention. We introduce a mechanism-centric virtual cell world model that represents cellular state as a set of Latent Mechanism Units (LMUs) and treats genetic perturbations as actions on these latent states. Each LMU combines a reusable identity grounded in multimodal biological evidence with an observation-specific state, allowing a perturbation to induce mechanism- specific stochastic transitions before decoding the resulting transcriptional response. We train VCLMU through two-stage pretraining, first on around 200K pseudo-bulk perturbation profiles and then on gene-aligned single-cell perturbation data. Across six perturbation-disjoint benchmarks, VCLMU consistently improves perturbation- specific response recovery over strong baselines while maintaining competitive global response accuracy. We further analyze learned LMUs through enrichment between perturbation responses and LMU gene sets and show that they capture structured biological response programs. These results support mechanism-level latent state transition as a useful formulation for virtual cell models that aim to predict and interpret cellular responses to biological interventions.

AI.tldr: 提出机制中心的虚拟细胞世界模型VCLMU，将细胞状态表示为潜在机制单元(LMU)，把遗传扰动视为对潜在状态的动作，通过两阶段预训练显著提升扰动特异性响应预测并具备可解释性。
AI.motivation: 预测细胞对遗传扰动的响应是虚拟细胞的核心能力。现有模型大多直接将未扰动分子profile与扰动映射到观测结果，未显式建模干预诱导的潜在细胞状态转变，缺乏机制层面的可解释性。
AI.method: 将细胞状态表示为Latent Mechanism Units(LMU)集合，每个LMU结合基于多模态生物证据的可复用身份与观测特定状态；扰动作为动作诱导机制特异的随机状态转移，再解码转录响应。采用两阶段预训练：先在约20万伪bulk扰动profile上，再在基因对齐的单细胞扰动数据上训练。
AI.result: 在六个扰动不相交(perturbation-disjoint)基准上，VCLMU在扰动特异性响应恢复上稳定优于强基线，同时保持有竞争力的全局响应准确率；通过扰动响应与LMU基因集的富集分析，显示LMU捕获了结构化的生物响应程序。
AI.conclusion: 机制层面的潜在状态转移是虚拟细胞模型的有效建模范式，可同时实现细胞响应的预测与可解释性。

title: Belief-Trajectory Energy: Measuring the Path to a Prediction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) progressively revise their predictions across Transformer layers, yet we typically observe only the final output, discarding the trajectory through which it is formed. We introduce Belief-Trajectory Energy(BTE), a model-grounded measure that characterizes an input through the layerwise predictive revisions it induces in a model. By mapping intermediate states into a shared predictive space, BTE provides a principled measure of belief change that can be summarized as either a scalar or a structured depth profile. Theoretically, we show that local BTE corresponds to predictive revision under the Fisher-Rao geometry, while the sequence of revisions captures information beyond the initial-to-final belief change. Empirically, scalar BTE provides a model-relative signal of difficulty across diverse reasoning tasks, while richer BTE representations support human-LLM review detection and fine-grained generator attribution, reaching up to $0.998$ macro-AUROC and $95.6\%$ eight-way attribution accuracy. Further analysis shows that BTE develops throughout pretraining and is selectively reshaped by targeted training, demonstrating that the resulting measurement reflects what the scoring model has learned. Together, our results establish belief trajectories as a principled model-grounded signal and suggest a broader perspective in which learned models can themselves serve as instruments for characterizing the data they process. More demonstrations can be found at https://yingjiahao14.github.io/BTE-web/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Belief-Trajectory Energy (BTE)，一种基于模型内部层级预测修正轨迹的度量，将中间状态映射到共享预测空间，可用于难度度量、人机审阅检测与生成器归因。
AI.motivation: LLM逐层修正预测，但通常只观察最终输出，丢弃了预测形成的轨迹信息；作者希望利用这些层级修正轨迹作为刻划输入信号的原则性度量。
AI.method: BTE将Transformer中间层状态映射到共享预测空间，度量层级预测修正，可表示为标量或结构化深度剖面；理论上证明局部BTE对应Fisher-Rao几何下的预测修正，且修正序列包含超出初始到最终信念变化的信息。
AI.result: 标量BTE在多种推理任务上提供模型相关的难度信号；更丰富的BTE表示支持人机审阅检测与细粒度生成器归因，达到最高0.998 macro-AUROC和95.6%八路归因准确率。BTE在预训练中逐渐形成，并被针对性训练选择性重塑。
AI.conclusion: 信念轨迹是一种原则性的、模型根基的信号，表明学习模型本身可作为刻划其所处理数据的工具。

title: Knossos and Ariadne: Benchmarking and Learning Complete Diagram Topology Extraction with Vision-Language Models
summary: Structural diagrams are widely used to represent complex systems and relational information across scientific, engineering, procedural, and spatial domains. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have become increasingly capable of recognizing diagram elements and reasoning about their content, while complete diagram topology extraction remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we study diagram-to-graph topology extraction: extracting all diagram entities and the complete relations among them. To enable large-scale supervised training and systematic evaluation of this task, we introduce Knossos, a benchmark of 19,200 diagrams across six diverse domains, with 245,179 nodes and 439,740 edges. Its symbolic generation process provides exact alignment between rendered diagrams and annotations of complete topology, relation types, and connector geometry. To address the modeling challenge of complete topology extraction, we also present Ariadne, a structured framework that decomposes the task into node inventory extraction and source-conditioned edge prediction. Extensive experiments show that training on Knossos substantially improves complete topology extraction in smaller open-source VLMs. Ariadne further improves over one-step extraction under matched supervision, demonstrating the additional benefit of structured decomposition. It achieves the highest average Edge F1 among the evaluated methods on Knossos, while both backbone variants also improve over their unadapted counterparts on the real-world external benchmark. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/bangwayne/knossos_Ariadne_Public.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究“图到图（diagram-to-graph）拓扑抽取”任务，即从结构图中提取全部实体及完整关系。为此提出大规模基准Knossos与结构化框架Ariadne（节点清单抽取+边预测分解），实验表明二者显著提升完整拓扑抽取性能。
AI.motivation: 结构图广泛用于表示复杂系统与关系信息，现有视觉语言模型虽在识别元素和内容推理上进步明显，但对完整图拓扑的抽取研究仍不足，缺乏大规模监督数据与系统评估基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建Knossos基准：19,200张图，涵盖6个领域，245,179个节点与439,740条边，通过符号化生成实现渲染图与完整拓扑、关系类型、连接器几何的精确对齐；2) 提出Ariadne框架，将任务分解为节点清单抽取与源条件边预测两阶段。
AI.result: 在Knossos上训练显著提升小型开源VLM的完整拓扑抽取能力；Ariadne在同等监督下优于一步式抽取，在Knossos上取得最高平均Edge F1，且两种骨干变体在真实世界外部基准上也优于未适配版本。
AI.conclusion: 大规模合成基准训练与结构化任务分解可有效提升VLM的完整图拓扑抽取能力，并具备向真实场景迁移的潜力。

title: Measuring Effective Data Resolution in Guided Diffusion Posteriors
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics
summary: Guided diffusion samplers are increasingly used to reconstruct physical fields from sparse observations, but standard diagnostics do not say how much of the reconstruction was actually determined by the data. We introduce effective data resolution for black-box generative posteriors: a comparison between the resolution warranted by the inverse problem, $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{ref}}$, and the resolution realised by the sampler, $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{samp}}$. A perturbation estimator measures $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{samp}}$ and the spatial map $R(x,x)$ from sampler queries alone. We validate the estimator against exact references and use it to study guided diffusion. The resulting measurements show that guidance weight can strongly alter apparent information transfer, that mean, spread and resolution are not jointly corrected by one weight even with an exact prior and score, and that resolution fidelity does not follow reliably from the apparent principledness of a guidance rule.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"有效数据分辨率"指标，用扰动估计器从采样器查询中度量引导扩散重建中实际实现的分辨率，并检验其与逆问题所要求分辨率的差距。
AI.motivation: 引导扩散采样器广泛用于从稀疏观测重建物理场，但标准诊断无法说明重建结果中有多少信息真正由数据决定。
AI.method: 引入"有效数据分辨率"概念，比较逆问题所要求的分辨率 dof_ref 与采样器实现的分辨率 dof_samp；用扰动估计器仅依赖采样器查询来度量 dof_samp 及空间图 R(x,x)，并用精确参考验证估计器。
AI.result: 测量表明：引导权重会强烈改变表观信息传递；即使先验与分数精确，均值、离散度与分辨率也无法由单一权重联合校正；分辨率保真度并不总能从引导规则的表观合理性中可靠推出。
AI.conclusion: 所提有效数据分辨率可诊断生成式后验中真正由数据决定的信息量，揭示引导扩散在信息传递与分辨率保真度方面的局限。

title: ManifoldCache: Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration via Constraint Manifold Caching
summary: Diffusion models for structured scientific generation must produce samples satisfying hard geometric constraints imposed by physics, chemistry, or biology, yet inference in these settings is prohibitively slow, demanding hundreds to thousands of neural-function evaluations per sample. We unify eight state-of-the-art models spanning medical volumetrics, molecular conformations, protein backbone design, crystal structure prediction, and multi-view 3D scenes under a single abstraction, Constraint-Manifold Diffusion Models (CMDMs), in which the target distribution is supported on a manifold defined by an externally specified constraint map. All existing acceleration families fail on this class: quantization exhausts memory on high-dimensional volumetric operators; pruning breaks constraint fidelity; fast ODE solvers allow trajectories to drift off the constraint manifold; and feature-caching heuristics are blind to constraint geometry, inducing mode confusion in the high-noise regime. We introduce ManifoldCache, the first training-free, data-free accelerator designed from first principles for CMDMs. The key insight is that the conditional score decomposes orthogonally into a normal component, which enforces constraint satisfaction, and a tangential component, which navigates within the manifold. Exploiting this structure, we prove that the noise-schedule midpoint is a sharp safe-caching boundary: caching before it incurs provably bounded error, while caching after it guarantees a strictly positive fraction of trajectories suffer mode confusion, a gap that persists up to the boundary. We further prove that deeper network blocks admit provably larger certified cache strides within the safe phase, as a consequence of the score decomposition propagating through block Jacobians. The resulting schedule requires no calibration data, along with zero training overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Constraint-Manifold Diffusion Models (CMDMs) 统一框架，并设计首个免训练、免数据加速器 ManifoldCache，利用分数正交分解与噪声调度中点作为安全缓存边界，显著加速受硬几何约束的扩散生成。
AI.motivation: 结构化科学生成（医学体数据、分子构象、蛋白质骨架、晶体结构、多视角3D场景）需满足物理/化学/生物硬几何约束，但扩散推理极慢（每样本数百至数千次网络评估）。现有加速方法均失效：量化内存爆炸、剪枝破坏约束保真、快速ODE求解器漂移离开约束流形、特征缓存对约束几何无感知并引发模式混淆。
AI.method: 将八种SOTA模型统一为CMDMs，目标分布支撑于由外部约束映射定义的流形上。提出ManifoldCache：基于条件分数正交分解为法向分量（强制约束满足）与切向分量（流形内导航）。理论上证明噪声调度中点为安全缓存边界，并证明更深网络块在安全阶段内可实现更大的认证缓存步长（分数分解通过块雅可比传播）。方法免校准数据、零训练开销。
AI.result: 证明中点前缓存误差有界，中点后缓存则保证严格正比例的轨迹出现模式混淆，且该间隙持续至边界；更深块可获更大认证缓存步长。
AI.conclusion: ManifoldCache为CMDMs提供首个从第一性原理设计的免训练、免数据加速方案，通过分数分解与中点安全边界实现有保证的加速，且无校准与训练开销。

title: Selecting Repetition Counts Across Model Scales in Data-Constrained Pretraining
summary: The repetition count that works best for a small language model may not remain best at a larger scale. We study this effect in pretraining with a finite target corpus mixed with generic data at a fixed target fraction.
