One of promising way is to decouple three distinct responsibilities of proposing retrieval actions, updating persistent state, and deciding when to stop rather than concentrating them within a single policy. Targeted at it, we introduce Harness-Search, a multi-agent search harness to reduce the local errors propagating across subsequent exploration, evidence curation, and termination decisions. In particular, Harness-Search assigns these responsibilities to three permission-bounded authorities: a Retrieval Policy that proposes search operations, a Memory Operator that validates and commits persistent-state updates, and a Summary Auditor that accepts or rejects termination based on the sufficiency of the curated evidence. Together, these roles form a Propose-Commit-Audit loop in which actions are proposed, persistent evidence is selectively committed, and stopping decisions are subjected to an explicit sufficiency check. Across seven long-horizon search benchmarks, Harness-Search improves both retrieval and answer generation under the same policy backbone, increasing Recall by 4.60-27.92 points and Final-Answer Recall by 12.34-30.13 points over the strongest harness-based baseline on each evidence-retrieval benchmark. Moreover, trajectory-level analyses show that Harness-Search continues to accumulate useful evidence and expand evidence coverage with less redundant retrieval as the search history grows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Harness-Search，一种多智能体搜索框架，将检索、记忆更新和终止决策解耦为三个受限权限角色，形成 Propose-Commit-Audit 循环，在七个长程搜索基准上显著提升检索与答案生成表现。
AI.motivation: 长程搜索中交互历史不断增长，单一智能体容易迷失、忽略有用证据或在证据不足时过早终止，因此需要将检索动作提出、状态更新和终止判断这三项职责解耦。
AI.method: Harness-Search 将职责分配给三个权限受限角色：Retrieval Policy 负责提出搜索操作，Memory Operator 负责验证并提交持久状态更新，Summary Auditor 负责根据证据充分性接受或拒绝终止，三者构成 Propose-Commit-Audit 循环。
AI.result: 在七个长程搜索基准上，相同策略骨干下，相比最强 harness 基线，检索证据基准的 Recall 提升 4.60–27.92 分，Final-Answer Recall 提升 12.34–30.13 分；轨迹分析显示随历史增长能持续积累有用证据、扩大证据覆盖并减少冗余检索。
AI.conclusion: 通过多智能体角色解耦，Harness-Search 有效抑制局部错误在探索、证据整理和终止决策间的传播，提升长程搜索的检索与答案质量。

title: RSure-Agent: Reliable Use of Tool Observations for Remote Sensing Agents
comment: The demo is available at https://github.com/airs101/RSure-Agent (code will be released for further research)
summary: Remote sensing agents rely on perception, measurement, and raster analysis tools to solve Earth observation tasks. We refer to their judgments and quantitative results about ground objects as tool observations. However, these observations are subject to substantial uncertainty and may be incorrect even when the tools execute successfully. When agents accept incorrect observations, the errors can propagate through subsequent reasoning and cause task failure. We analyze 1,229 execution trajectories across three remote sensing agent benchmarks. On each benchmark, at least 88.1% of tasks depend on tool observations. Among these tasks, at least 22.7% contain incorrect observations despite successful tool execution. These errors propagate to the final answer in at least 82.0% of affected tasks on each benchmark. To address this problem, we propose RSure-Agent, a framework for verifying tool observations and limiting error propagation. We introduce a verifiable observation protocol that requires tools to return process evidence for the agent to verify their observations. We also construct a task-tool reliability prior from offline task feedback. The prior summarizes each tool configuration's past performance across task types and provides a task-specific reference for verification. Using process evidence and this prior, RSure-Agent decides whether to accept an observation, request additional evidence, or reject it. We evaluate RSure-Agent on EarthBench, ThinkGeo, TerraLogic, and CHOICE-420. Across the three agent benchmarks, RSure-Agent reduces the error propagation rate by 21.3 to 25.9 percentage points relative to the base configuration with verification and the prior disabled. On CHOICE-420, it improves overall accuracy over direct answering by 5.71 percentage points on average across 11 backbone models. On EarthBench, it reduces the tool-call ratio by 25.9% relative to Earth-Agent.

AI.tldr: 论文发现遥感智能体的工具观测即使执行成功也常含错误，且错误会传播导致任务失败；提出RSure-Agent框架，通过可验证观测协议与任务-工具可靠性先验来校验观测、抑制错误传播。
AI.motivation: 遥感智能体依赖感知、测量与栅格分析工具，其对地物的判断与定量结果（工具观测）存在显著不确定性，即便工具成功执行也可能错误。若智能体接受错误观测，错误会沿推理链传播并导致任务失败，因此需要校验工具观测并限制错误传播。
AI.method: 提出RSure-Agent框架：1) 可验证观测协议，要求工具返回过程证据供智能体核验观测；2) 基于离线任务反馈构建任务-工具可靠性先验，汇总各工具配置在不同任务类型上的历史表现，提供任务特定参考。结合过程证据与先验，智能体决定接受观测、请求更多证据或拒绝。
AI.result: 分析三个遥感智能体基准共1,229条执行轨迹：每个基准至少88.1%任务依赖工具观测，其中至少22.7%存在错误观测（工具执行成功），受影响任务中至少82.0%错误传播到最终答案。RSure-Agent在三个基准上将错误传播率降低21.3–25.9个百分点；在CHOICE-420上，11个骨干模型平均准确率较直接回答提升5.71个百分点；在EarthBench上，工具调用率较Earth-Agent降低25.9%。
AI.conclusion: 工具观测错误在遥感智能体中普遍且易传播，是任务失败的重要来源；通过过程证据与可靠性先验的校验机制，RSure-Agent能有效抑制错误传播、提升准确率并减少不必要的工具调用。

title: Proximal Causal Learning under Unmeasured Confounding
summary: Estimating treatment effects from observational data typically relies on the No Unmeasured Confounding Assumption (NUCA), which rarely holds in practice. Proximal causal learning (PCL) addresses unmeasured confounding via proxy variables, yet existing methods require the proxy variables to be pre-specified. Thus, we propose PCL-U, a framework that learns proxy variables directly from observed covariates. PCL-U uses neural encoders to decompose covariates into treatment-inducing, outcome-inducing, and shared proxies, guided by minimax mutual information objectives, and obtains causal estimates through a practical moment-based risk function. Experiments on benchmarks show that PCL-U matches or outperforms existing baselines. Besides, there are two types of synthetic datasets with varying dimensions and confounding strengths that illustrate that our method maintains stable estimation accuracy.

AI.tldr: PCL-U直接从观测协变量中学习代理变量，通过神经编码器分解出处理诱导、结果诱导和共享代理，并在基准上达到或超越现有方法且估计更稳定。
AI.motivation: 从观测数据估计处理效应通常依赖"无未测量混杂"假设，但现实中很少成立。近端因果学习(PCL)可通过代理变量处理未测量混杂，但现有方法要求代理变量预先指定，限制了实用性。
AI.method: 提出PCL-U框架：用神经编码器将观测协变量分解为处理诱导、结果诱导和共享代理三类，并由极小极大互信息目标引导；通过实用的基于矩的风险函数获得因果估计。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上，PCL-U匹配或超越现有基线；在两类维度与混杂强度不同的合成数据集上，方法保持稳定的估计精度。
AI.conclusion: PCL-U无需预先指定代理变量，能够自动从观测协变量中学习代理并稳健地估计处理效应，拓展了近端因果学习的适用范围。

title: LatentIndex: Cross-Layer Sharing with Layer-Specific Selection for Sparse Attention
summary: Sparse attention reduces core-attention computation, but its indexers still incur repeated selection work and per-layer key-cache storage. Reusing selected indices across layers reduces this overhead but constrains multiple layers to the same token set. We introduce LatentIndex, which extends the latent-sharing principle of Multi-head Latent Attention across indexer layers. Each layer group constructs a shared latent cache from its first layer's hidden states, while layer-specific scoring enables independent token selection. Absorbing key decoders into queries enables direct scoring of the shared cache without reconstructing historical per-layer keys. We develop training-free calibration and investigate a training-aware instantiation of this principle. To balance quality and computation, a hierarchical selection (HS) variant lets followers independently refine a shared candidate set proposed by the anchor. With four-layer sharing, LatentIndex reduces logical indexer-cache storage by 61.1% on DeepSeek-V3.2. Across DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5, training-free LatentIndex improves head-wise attention-mass recall over IndexCache by up to 3.28 percentage points while maintaining RULER and LongBench performance close to native DSA. HS further achieves 2.30-2.72 times decode indexer speedups over DSA across 8K-128K contexts, retaining most of LatentIndex's recall. LatentIndex offers a new perspective on cross-layer indexing: sharing continuous representations rather than discrete selections enables efficient reuse while preserving layer-specific token selection.

AI.tldr: LatentIndex 通过跨索引器层共享连续隐状态而非离散 token 选择，在降低缓存与计算开销的同时保持每层独立选 token。
AI.motivation: 稀疏注意力虽减少了核心注意力计算，但其索引器仍存在重复选择工作和逐层 key-cache 存储开销。跨层复用已选索引可降低开销，但会强制多层使用相同 token 集合，限制灵活性。
AI.method: 借鉴 MLA 的隐层共享思想，扩展到索引器层：每个层组从其首层隐状态构建共享 latent cache，各层用独立打分实现 token 选择；将 key decoder 吸收进 query，直接对共享缓存打分而无需重建历史逐层 key。提出无需训练的校准方法，并探索训练感知实例，以及分层选择（HS）变体——由锚层提出候选集，后续层独立精炼。
AI.result: 四层共享下，LatentIndex 在 DeepSeek-V3.2 上将逻辑索引器缓存存储降低 61.1%。在 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5 上，免训练版本相较 IndexCache 将 head-wise attention-mass recall 最多提升 3.28 个百分点，RULER 与 LongBench 性能接近原生 DSA。HS 在 8K–128K 上下文上实现 2.30–2.72 倍解码索引器加速，并保留大部分 recall。
AI.conclusion: LatentIndex 提出跨层索引新视角：共享连续表示而非离散选择，可在保留层特定 token 选择的同时实现高效复用。

title: The Hidden States Cookbook: A Large-Scale Ablation Study for Noise-Robust Conversational Intent Classification in Industry
summary: Conversational database interfaces face a critical challenge: users naturally embed queries in conversational noise (greetings, politeness, off-topic remarks), which degrades intent classification accuracy and wastes computational resources. Despite advances in orchestration and retrieval strategies, a fundamental question remains unanswered: which pooling strategy maximizes intent classification accuracy under realistic conversational noise in production language models? This work addresses this gap through 360 controlled experiments spanning four pooling configurations (mean, max, last-token, attention, and FFT-augmented variants) using Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct on BANKING77 and CLINC150 datasets under clean/noisy conditions with ten random seeds. Key findings reveal that attention pooling consistently outperforms alternative strategies under noisy conditions (~+2.6-2.8 F1 over the default), while mean pooling degrades performance by up to ~5 F1 points. Frequency-domain filtering does not produce consistent accuracy improvements and functions primarily as a structural variation rather than an accuracy-enhancing component. These results provide concrete, evidence-based guidance for building noise-robust conversational classifiers: attention pooling is recommended for noisy interfaces, mean pooling should be avoided, and last-token pooling is appropriate for clean-query scenarios.

AI.tldr: 通过360次控制实验，发现attention pooling在噪声对话下最优，mean pooling最差。
AI.motivation: 对话式数据库接口中，用户查询常夹杂问候、礼貌语等噪声，导致意图分类精度下降并浪费算力，但哪种pooling策略在真实噪声下最优仍无定论。
AI.method: 360次控制实验，覆盖五种pooling配置（mean、max、last-token、attention及FFT增强变体），使用Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct，在BANKING77与CLINC150上，于clean/noisy条件及十个随机种子下评测。
AI.result: 噪声条件下attention pooling稳定优于其他策略（较默认约+2.6-2.8 F1）；mean pooling最多下降约5 F1；频域滤波无一致提升，仅作为结构性变体。
AI.conclusion: 噪声接口推荐attention pooling，应避免mean pooling，clean场景适用last-token pooling。

title: One Tile, Multiple Instances: Rethinking MIL for Sparse Diagnostic Evidence
summary: In weakly supervised Whole Slide Image (WSI) classification, feature extractors typically compress each image tile into a single global embedding. Consequently, slide-level aggregators are restricted to this coarse tile scale, concealing fine-grained sub-tile evidence from the attention mechanism. We introduce DI-MIL, a framework that decouples encoding context from instance granularity through decomposed instances. By clustering dense spatial tokens from a frozen foundation model within each tile, DI-MIL converts a single tile into multiple independently weighted instance embeddings. As a training-free post-encoding module, DI-MIL integrates seamlessly into existing pipelines without requiring re-encoding or downstream architectural modifications. We evaluate DI-MIL on cytopathology, a challenging testbed where sparse diagnostic signals are easily diluted within standard tiles. Across four datasets, three frozen foundation models, and two attention-based aggregators, DI-MIL demonstrates consistent efficacy, improving 67 of 72 metric-level comparisons, with the largest mean gains reaching 3.64 points under cytopathology-specific backbones. In a broader comparison against seven representative MIL baselines, DI-MIL paired with ACMIL achieves highest mean performance in 33 of 36 backbone-dataset-metric comparisons. Ablations show that direct smaller tiling inflates the extracted tile count by up to 43.3$\times$ with non-monotonic performance, whereas DI-MIL incurs zero additional image-extraction overhead while achieving the strongest overall results. These results establish instance construction as an orthogonal design dimension in MIL, supporting DI-MIL as a cost-efficient solution under sparse diagnostic evidence.

AI.tldr: DI-MIL通过聚类每个tile内的密集空间token，将单tile分解为多个可独立加权实例，无需重新编码即可提升弱监督WSI分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有WSI分类中特征提取器将每个tile压缩为单一全局embedding，导致聚合器只能在粗粒度tile级别工作，细粒度sub-tile证据被注意力机制忽略，尤其稀疏诊断信号（如细胞病理）容易被稀释。
AI.method: DI-MIL将冻结基础模型在每个tile产生的密集空间token进行聚类，把一个tile转换为多个可独立加权的实例embedding；作为无需训练的后编码模块，可无缝接入现有pipeline，无需重编码或架构修改。
AI.result: 在4个数据集、3个冻结基础模型、2个注意力聚合器上，72个指标比较中67个提升，最大平均增益3.64点（细胞病理专用backbone）。对比7个MIL基线，DI-MIL+ACMIL在36个比较中33个取得最高平均性能。消融显示更小tiling使tile数膨胀43.3倍且性能非单调，而DI-MIL无额外图像提取开销。
AI.conclusion: 实例构建是MIL中一个正交的设计维度，DI-MIL在稀疏诊断证据下是成本高效的解决方案。

title: Weight Decay and Neuron Condensation: A Three-Stage Analysis of Two-Layer ReLU Networks
summary: Weight decay is widely used as a regularization technique in neural network training, yet its role in neuron condensation (parameter direction alignment) remains unclear. Starting from a parameter initialization in the neural tangent kernel regime, we characterize training dynamics under weight decay through three stages: rapid fitting, amplitude compression, and neuron condensation. Using a two-layer ReLU network, we analyze a residual correlation field that governs both neuron amplitudes and directions. During rapid fitting, the residual approaches a quasi-static equilibrium maintained by weight decay while the tangent kernel remains nearly unchanged. In the early stage of amplitude compression, kernel decay amplifies the residual correlation field, whose isolated attracting extrema provide candidates for condensation directions. As neuron amplitudes stabilize, we bound the drift of attracting extrema and demonstrate contraction of neuron directions around them, leading to neuron condensation. This staged analysis provides a dynamical understanding of how weight decay promotes a condensed representation, beyond reducing parameter norms.

AI.tldr: 本文从NTK初始化出发，刻画权重衰减下训练的三阶段动态：快速拟合、幅度压缩和神经元凝聚，解释权重衰减如何促成参数方向对齐的凝聚表征。
AI.motivation: 权重衰减广泛用作正则化，但其对神经元凝聚（参数方向对齐）的作用机制尚不清楚。作者希望从动力学角度理解权重衰减如何促成凝聚表征，而非仅停留在减小参数范数。
AI.method: 以两层ReLU网络为对象，从NTK区域初始化出发，通过分析一个同时控制神经元幅度与方向的残差相关场，将训练动态划分为三阶段：快速拟合、幅度压缩和神经元凝聚。
AI.result: 快速拟合阶段：残差趋于由权重衰减维持的准静态平衡，切核近似不变。幅度压缩早期：核衰减放大残差相关场，其孤立吸引极值提供凝聚方向候选。随神经元幅度稳定，作者界定吸引极值的漂移并证明神经元方向向其收缩，导致神经元凝聚。
AI.conclusion: 该分阶段分析给出了权重衰减促进凝聚表征的动力学理解，超越“仅减小参数范数”的传统解释。

title: SEIS: Self-Evolving Inference Systems
summary: Inference systems determine how fast and how cheaply language models can be served, so making them faster has direct practical value. However, prior work focuses mostly on optimizing certain parts such as kernels or memory within the large system. In this work, we take a holistic approach and apply agentic self-evolution to optimize the whole system end-to-end. Our SEIS (Self-Evolving Inference Systems) autonomously optimizes the entire mini-sglang engine without human intervention through iterative sessions with inherited experiences and code changes. Serving Qwen3-0.6B on H100, the resulting engine reaches 3.27X the throughput of the original mini-sglang implementation and beats SOTA engines like vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, and SGLang in the single-request workload. The correctness of the optimized inference engine by SEIS is tested in terms of numerical difference and downstream accuracy on math and long-context retrieval tasks. The code and session histories show that the speedup comes from redesigning the whole engine and that building on earlier sessions beats independent attempts. These results suggest that agentic self-evolution can optimize a complex system end-to-end. The evaluation also has to evolve with the engine, and letting agents evolve it is a natural next step.

AI.tldr: 提出 SEIS，用智能体自我进化端到端地自动优化整个推理引擎（mini-sglang），无需人工干预，在 H100 上服务 Qwen3-0.6B 时吞吐达原实现 3.27X。
AI.motivation: 推理系统的速度与成本直接决定语言模型的实用价值，但以往工作多只优化系统内的局部组件（如 kernel、内存），缺乏对整个系统的端到端优化视角。
AI.method: 采用整体（holistic）方法，将智能体自我进化（agentic self-evolution）应用于推理系统的全流程优化：SEIS 通过迭代会话进行代码修改并继承先前经验，自主优化整个 mini-sglang 引擎。
AI.result: 在 H100 上服务 Qwen3-0.6B，优化后引擎吞吐达原始 mini-sglang 的 3.27X，单请求负载下超过 vLLM、TensorRT-LLM、SGLang 等 SOTA 引擎；正确性经数值差异及数学、长上下文检索下游准确率验证。
AI.conclusion: 代码与会话历史表明加速来自对整个引擎的重新设计，且基于早期会话的迭代优于独立尝试，说明智能体自我进化可端到端优化复杂系统；评估方法也需随引擎共同进化，让智能体自动进化评估是自然的下一步。

title: Writing as a Self-Organized Critical Process
summary: We explain autocorrelation decay power laws omnipresent in texts by self-organized criticality. Specifically, we analyze the recently released KLiCKe keystroke dataset and show that not only the final texts' autocorrelations form a manifold that adheres to a power law with a finite-size scaling, but also the text revisions generate revision-size-dependent restoring dynamics toward that manifold. Thus, human writing appears to dynamically regulate semantic correlations in a text toward a critical state.

AI.tldr: 本文用自组织临界性解释文本中普遍存在的自相关幂律衰减现象。
AI.motivation: 文本中普遍存在自相关幂律衰减，但其成因尚不明确，作者希望从自组织临界性角度给出统一解释。
AI.method: 分析新发布的KLiCKe击键数据集，考察最终文本的自相关结构以及修订过程中的动态行为。
AI.result: 最终文本的自相关构成一个满足有限尺寸标度幂律的流形；文本修订产生依赖于修订规模的回复动力学，使文本趋向该流形。
AI.conclusion: 人类写作似乎通过动态调节文本中的语义相关性，使其趋近临界状态。

title: Enhancing Long-Video VLM Embeddings with Query-Aware Streaming Latent Reasoning
summary: Long-video embedding requires capturing sparse query-relevant evidence under a limited visual-token budget. Uniform sampling can miss brief events in videos spanning minutes or hours, whereas encoding more frames in a single context increases memory and computation. We introduce \textbf{Query-Aware Streaming Latent Reasoning} (QASLR), a post-training framework that accumulates evidence across clips while keeping the embedding size fixed. QASLR selects a bounded set of frames, restores their temporal order, and processes them clip by clip with a vision-language backbone. A compact set of persistent think tokens cross-attends to each clip's features, while an embed token reads out a normalized representation after every update. This design integrates evidence across multiple backbone calls without requiring all selected frames to share a single context. Training combines final contrastive learning, step-wise contrastive supervision, and final-embedding self-distillation. Intermediate supervision trains partial-video readouts for retrieval, while self-distillation regularizes them toward the final representation. Query-aware selection produces query-conditioned representations for candidate-set scoring and reranking, whereas query-independent selection enables reusable corpus indexing. Under the full training recipe, HourVideo retrieval Hit@1 increases from 54.2 to 70.7 and from 57.4 to 72.8 for 2B and 8B Qwen3-VL-Embedding backbones, respectively. Gains extend to the evaluated moment-retrieval and video-QA tasks, and the streaming head transfers to a second Qwen-family embedding backbone. These results support streaming latent aggregation as an effective approach to integrating long-video evidence into fixed-dimensional representations.

AI.tldr: QASLR：查询感知流式隐推理框架，在固定嵌入维度下逐片段累积长视频证据，显著提升长视频检索性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频嵌入需在有限视觉token预算下捕获稀疏的查询相关证据。均匀采样会漏掉数分钟至数小时视频中的短暂事件，而在单一上下文编码更多帧会大幅增加内存与计算开销。
AI.method: QASLR为后训练框架：选取有限帧并恢复时序，逐片段用视觉-语言骨干处理；持久think token跨片段cross-attend，embed token每次更新后读出归一化表示。训练结合最终对比学习、逐步对比监督与最终嵌入自蒸馏。查询感知选择产生查询条件表示用于候选打分与重排，查询无关选择支持可复用索引。
AI.result: 完整训练下，HourVideo检索Hit@1在2B和8B Qwen3-VL-Embedding骨干上分别从54.2升至70.7、57.4升至72.8。增益延伸至moment-retrieval与video-QA任务，流式头可迁移至另一Qwen族嵌入骨干。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，流式隐聚合是将长视频证据整合进固定维度表示的有效方法，无需所有帧共享单一上下文。

title: PhaseGate: Phase-Aware CPU Retrieval Scheduling for On-Device LLMs on Unified Memory
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints
summary: On-device assistants run GPU-based LLM inference alongside CPU retrieval on unified-memory systems. Under a saturated local-retrieval workload, four concurrent retrieval workers raise 95th-percentile (p95) decode latency by 60-61% on two M4 systems, whereas prefill latency rises by only 5.7-6.9%. We study LLM phase as an admission signal for independent CPU retrieval under controlled LLM workloads. PHASEGATE calibrates separate concurrency limits for prefill and decode, selecting four and one on our base-M4 configuration. Under a backlogged queue, it achieves 2.0 times the aggregate retrieval throughput of the best tested feasible fixed policy, with both p95 LLM latency metrics within 1.25 times their no-retrieval baselines in all seven held-out runs. A phase-blind control, TimeGate, uses the same two limits on a calibration-derived schedule without observing LLM phase. It achieves similar retrieval throughput but violates the output-token latency limit in every run. M2 and M2 Pro Mac minis reproduce the policy ordering, while output-length sweeps show that the advantage narrows as decode occupies more of each request.

AI.tldr: PHASEGATE利用LLM的prefill/decode阶段作为CPU检索的准入信号，为两阶段分别设定并发上限，在保证延迟的前提下大幅提升检索吞吐。
AI.motivation: 设备端助手在统一内存系统上同时运行GPU LLM推理与CPU检索，饱和的本地检索负载（4个并发worker）会使p95解码延迟升高60-61%，远高于prefill的5.7-6.9%，说明解码阶段对CPU检索竞争更敏感，需要阶段感知的准入控制。
AI.method: PHASEGATE在受控LLM负载下，为prefill和decode分别标定独立的并发上限（在base-M4上分别为4和1），并根据LLM当前阶段动态准入CPU检索。对照组TimeGate使用相同的两个上限与标定时间表但不感知LLM阶段。在M2与M2 Pro Mac mini上复现策略排序，并进行输出长度扫描。
AI.result: 在积压队列下，PHASEGATE达到最佳可行固定策略聚合检索吞吐的2.0倍，且七次留出运行中两项p95 LLM延迟指标均在无检索基线的1.25倍以内。TimeGate吞吐相近但在每次运行中都违反输出token延迟限制。输出长度扫描显示，当解码占比增大时优势收窄。
AI.conclusion: 以LLM阶段作为准入信号可在不牺牲延迟SLA的前提下显著提升共置检索吞吐，阶段感知是有效且可迁移的策略；但其收益随解码占比上升而下降。

title: PermVLA: Factorization Order as a Regularizer for VLA Learning
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly learn action chunks through a fixed left-to-right (LTR) factorization, although the same expert trajectory distribution admits many valid chain-rule factorizations. We identify factorization order as an overlooked regularization choice and introduce causally anchored permutation (CAP), which samples action reveal orders with a tunable chronological prefix. Its auxiliary objective trains one shared policy to predict actions from different known subsets of the same expert chunk, while deployment retains deterministic LTR control. We call this conditional-set augmentation: it creates multiple conditional prediction problems from one expert chunk without adding demonstrations. This discourages reliance on the single chronological prefix used by ordinary teacher forcing. Controlled experiments show that CAP consistently outperforms standard LTR training on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, with the same advantage appearing in cross-dataset CALVIN evaluation. A diagnostic that measures the expected squared difference between a chunk's joint log likelihood under two reveal orders verifies that CAP training internalizes agreement across reveal orders. These findings position sampled subset-conditioned auxiliary objectives as a general recipe for constructing VLA regularizers, illustrated by an extension to diffusion action generators.

AI.tldr: 论文提出因果锚定置换（CAP），将动作块的分解顺序视为正则化选择，通过抽样的动作揭示顺序训练共享策略，在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和CALVIN上优于标准从左到右训练。
AI.motivation: VLA策略通常采用固定的从左到右因式分解学习动作块，但同一专家轨迹分布存在多种有效的链式法则因式分解，固定顺序会过度依赖单一时间前缀。
AI.method: CAP采样带有可调时间前缀的动作揭示顺序，用辅助目标训练一个共享策略从同一专家块的不同已知子集预测动作，部署时仍用确定的LTR控制，实现条件集增强。
AI.result: 在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上CAP持续优于标准LTR训练；跨数据集CALVIN评估中也有同样优势。诊断指标（同一块在两种揭示顺序下联合对数似然的期望平方差）验证CAP内化了不同揭示顺序间的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 采样子集条件的辅助目标可作为构建VLA正则化器的一般方法，并已扩展到扩散动作生成器。

title: Dataset Signatures in Human-LLM Interactions and User Modeling
summary: Human--LLM interaction datasets shape our understanding of AI use and provide a foundation for downstream research, including training and evaluation of user models. In recent years, a growing number of datasets have sought to capture a representative picture of human--LLM interactions. But how different are the pictures these datasets provide, and what do those differences mean for research built on them? We study these questions across seven conversation datasets, spanning in-the-wild chat logs and human preference data. We begin by revisiting the dataset classification experiment of Torralba & Efros and find that neural network classifiers identify the source of a conversation from user messages alone well above chance, indicating distinctive dataset signatures. This separability persists after matching datasets on the dimensions of human-designed taxonomies, implying subtle differences that these taxonomies do not capture. We then examine the implications for user modeling: how dataset signatures propagate to the outputs of user models trained on these datasets; how dataset choice influences evaluations of user model quality and subsequent evaluations of LLM assistants paired with these user models; and how dataset classifiers can guide data selection for training user models. While each dataset is meant to capture a slice of 'real-world' interactions, our findings reveal the extent to which these slices diverge, and the consequences of those differences for research built on these foundations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究七个人类-LLM对话数据集之间的差异（"数据集签名"），发现神经网络分类器仅凭用户消息即可高准确率识别来源，且这种可分性在人造分类维度匹配后仍然存在，并探讨这些差异对用户建模和评估的影响。
AI.motivation: 越来越多数据集声称能代表人类-LLM交互的真实图景，但不同数据集提供的"切片"可能存在显著差异，而这些差异对基于这些数据集的下游研究（如训练和评估用户模型）的含义尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在七个对话数据集（含真实聊天日志和人类偏好数据）上重访Torralba & Efros的数据集分类实验，用神经网络分类器仅基于用户消息识别对话来源；在人工设计分类维度上对数据集进行匹配后再测可分性；进而分析数据集签名如何传播到用户模型输出、数据集选择如何影响用户模型及LLM助手评估，以及如何用分类器引导数据选择。
AI.result: 分类器识别来源的准确率显著高于随机水平，表明存在独特的数据集签名；这种可分性在分类维度匹配后依然存在，说明存在分类法未捕捉的细微差异；数据集签名会传播到用户模型输出，数据集选择会影响用户模型质量评估及后续LLM助手评估。
AI.conclusion: 尽管每个数据集都意在捕捉"真实世界"交互的一个切片，但这些切片之间存在显著分歧，这对建立在其之上的研究产生了重要后果。

title: Reflection-Robust 6DoF Object Tracking with Light Fields
summary: Tracking the 6DoF pose of a moving rigid object is fundamental to robotics and autonomous driving, but existing trackers assume that object appearance is stable across a sequence, an assumption that breaks down on reflective surfaces whose appearance changes as they mirror the environment. We introduce a light field based reflection-robust 6DoF tracker that turns this apparent nuisance into a pose cue. Per frame, our method recovers depth robustly against reflections, back-projects it into a point cloud, and estimates surface normals. It then decomposes the object's view-dependent appearance into a diffuse albedo and the environment map it reflects, resulting in a relightable surface light field. Starting from a coarse initialization, we relight it by the recovered environment map and optimize the pose on the photometric loss. Because a moving object mirrors new parts of the scene, the environment map fills in as the sequence proceeds, sharpening this signal over time. To evaluate this approach, we introduce a light field tracking dataset re-rendered from a robotic manipulation benchmark at four controlled reflectivity levels, each paired with simulated depth that reproduces how consumer RGB-D sensors fail on shiny surfaces. Additionally, we evaluate on two captured light field sequences. Our method trails the strongest baselines on diffuse objects and is the only one that holds its accuracy on fully reflective objects, where every baseline degrades.

AI.tldr: 提出基于光场的反射鲁棒6DoF追踪器，将反射外观变化转为位姿线索，实现全反射物体追踪。
AI.motivation: 现有6DoF追踪器假设物体外观在序列中稳定，但反射表面的外观会随镜像环境变化而改变，导致假设失效。作者将反射这一"干扰"转化为位姿线索。
AI.method: 逐帧鲁棒估计深度（抗反射），反投影为点云并估计表面法线；将视角相关外观分解为漫反射反照率与所反射的环境贴图，得到可重光照的表面光场；从粗初始化开始，用恢复的环境图重光照并通过光度损失优化位姿。物体运动时镜像新场景区域，环境图随序列逐步补全，信号随时间增强。
AI.result: 在从机器人操作基准重渲染、含四个受控反射率水平并配对模拟深度的光场追踪数据集上评估，另在两个实拍光场序列上评估。方法在漫反射物体上略逊于最强基线，但在全反射物体上是唯一保持精度的，所有基线均退化。
AI.conclusion: 通过光场建模将反射外观变化作为位姿线索，实现了对全反射物体的鲁棒6DoF追踪，超越现有基线的适用边界。

title: TMAML: Temporal Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Cold-Start Time Series Forecasting
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, Accepted at Neurips 2026 TS-LIMITS Workshop
summary: Cold-start forecasting, the task of forecasting a time series with little to no historical data, is a common challenge. Addressing it requires approaches that learn quickly from few datapoints and leverage information from related series, typically through static covariates, to generalize well to unseen series. While some global forecasting models can generate cold-start predictions by leveraging information shared across multiple series, they are not optimized for out-of-train-set generalization or adaptation from short histories. In this work, we formulate cold-start forecasting as a few-window learning problem and introduce Temporal Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (TMAML), which tailors the model-agnostic meta-learning algorithm, originally developed for few-shot adaptation of neural networks, to deep time series forecasting. TMAML constructs meta-tasks as temporally consistent support-query windows and pairs them with a temporal meta-training and meta-testing procedure, yielding forecasting models that are explicitly optimized for cold-start forecasting. We instantiate TMAML on the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and present an initial empirical analysis of forecast accuracy and calibration across three cold-start scenarios: TMAML consistently outperforms or matches a standard ERM-trained TFT, yields better-calibrated forecasts than naive on two of the three scenarios, but does not consistently outperform naive on probabilistic forecast accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文将冷启动预测形式化为少窗口学习问题，提出时间模型无关元学习（TMAML），通过在TFT上实现并实验，显示其在点预测上优于或持平ERM，但概率预测上未稳定超越朴素基线。
AI.motivation: 冷启动预测（历史数据极少或无）是常见难题，需要能从少量数据快速学习并借助相关序列（如静态协变量）泛化的方法。现有全局模型虽能跨序列共享信息，但未针对训练集外泛化或短历史适应进行优化。
AI.method: 将冷启动预测建模为少窗口学习问题，提出TMAML：把元学习算法（原用于神经网络少样本适应）改造到深度时间序列预测中。TMAML以时间一致的支撑-查询窗口构造元任务，配合时间元训练与元测试流程，显式优化冷启动预测。在Temporal Fusion Transformer（TFT）上实例化TMAML。
AI.result: 在三种冷启动场景下，TMAML持续优于或持平标准ERM训练的TFT；在三个场景中的两个上预测校准优于朴素方法；但在概率预测准确率上未能稳定超越朴素基线。
AI.conclusion: TMAML为冷启动时间序列预测提供了显式优化的元学习框架，在点预测与校准上有初步优势，但概率预测准确率仍待改进。

title: Efficient Neural Surrogates for Linear Radiation Transport on the Lattice and Hohlraum benchmarks
summary: Linear radiation transport equations (RTEs) form the simulation foundations underpinning design and analysis tasks in nuclear engineering, inertial confinement fusion, medical imaging, and astrophysics, but resolving the high-dimensional phase space at engineering fidelity remains expensive enough that outer-loop workflows, such as design optimization, uncertainty quantification, and parameter sweeps, are routinely budget-bound on traditional solvers. Neural surrogates promise to relax this bottleneck by amortizing simulation cost across thousands of downstream queries, but the architectural choices and engineered inductive biases that make a surrogate accurate on one transport problem do not transfer straightforwardly across model families. We benchmark two parameter-matched neural surrogate architectures, the physics-attention Transolver and the multi-scale graph network Bi-Stride Multi-Scale MeshGraphNet (BSMS-MGN), as end-to-end approximations of the final-time particle concentration for the two-dimensional linear RTE on the canonical Lattice and Hohlraum benchmarks. An ablation across Fourier features and region-weighted training loss exposes strongly architecture-dependent inductive-bias preferences, indicating that design choices common to physics-informed surrogate workflows must be revisited per architecture rather than imported across model families, and that downstream utility depends on per-QoI sensitivity rather than a single field-level score. The model training recipe, training data, and evaluation pipeline are released alongside this paper to support reproduction, transfer to related transport problems, and evaluation as amortized forward-model components in larger outer-loop simulation workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文对两种参数量匹配的神经代理架构（物理注意力Transolver与多尺度图网络BSMS-MGN）在二维线性辐射输运方程（RTE）的Lattice与Hohlraum基准上进行端到端基准测试，发现归纳偏置偏好强烈依赖于架构，需按架构重新审视设计选择。
AI.motivation: 线性辐射输运方程是核工程、惯性约束聚变、医学成像与天体物理中仿真设计的基础，但高维相空间的高保真求解代价高昂，使得设计优化、不确定性量化等外层循环工作流受限于传统求解器预算。神经代理可摊销仿真成本，但使代理在某一输运问题上准确的架构选择与归纳偏置难以跨模型族迁移。
AI.method: 以二维线性RTE为对象，在典型Lattice与Hohlraum基准上，对两种参数量匹配的神经代理架构（物理注意力的Transolver与多尺度图网络BSMS-MGN）进行基准测试，作为最终时刻粒子浓度的端到端近似。开展关于傅里叶特征与区域加权训练损失的消融实验。同时发布训练配方、训练数据与评估流程。
AI.result: 消融实验显示，对傅里叶特征与区域加权损失的偏好强烈依赖于架构，表明物理信息代理工作流中常见的设计选择必须按架构分别重新评估，而不能跨模型族直接套用；下游效用取决于逐QoI（关注量）敏感性，而非单一场级评分。
AI.conclusion: 归纳偏置需按架构定制，通用设计不宜跨模型族迁移；代理的下游价值应由逐QoI敏感性衡量。所发布的训练配方、数据与评估流程有助于复现、迁移到相关输运问题，并作为大型外层循环仿真工作流中的摊销前向模型组件进行评估。

title: Lend Me Your Eyes: Instruction-Aware Text Embeddings via Attention Relay
summary: Text embedding models trained with contrastive learning learn to follow task instructions from instruction-paired data, while instruction-tuned LLMs already know how to follow them. We show that this instruction-following ability can carry over from an LLM to a Transformer-based embedder without any training. We propose Attention Relay, which passes the attention weights an LLM produces to the embedder's own attention. Across six instruction-tuned LLMs from the Qwen3, Llama 3.1 and OLMo 3 families and ten widely used embedding models that differ in tokenizer, size and pooling type, Attention Relay makes nearly every combination instruction-aware. Experiments that break the method down into its parts show that the LLM's attention weights track the instruction in its later layers and come largely from instruction tuning. They also show that relaying these weights selects which content in the text matters: it makes the aspect of the text that the instruction asks about dominant in the embedding, or restores that aspect where averaging had diluted it.

AI.tldr: 提出 Attention Relay，无需训练即可将指令跟随能力从 LLM 迁移到文本嵌入模型，通过将 LLM 的注意力权重传给嵌入器的注意力，使几乎任意 LLM-嵌入器组合具备指令感知能力。
AI.motivation: 指令感知的文本嵌入通常依赖指令配对数据对比训练。而指令微调的 LLM 本身已具备指令跟随能力，作者希望验证这种能力能否无需训练直接迁移到 Transformer 嵌入器。
AI.method: Attention Relay：把某个 LLM 生成的注意力权重传递给嵌入器自身的注意力机制，从而在无需训练的情况下将 LLM 的指令跟随能力注入嵌入器。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3、Llama 3.1、OLMo 3 三个家族的 6 个指令微调 LLM 与 10 个不同分词器、规模和池化方式的嵌入模型上，几乎每种组合都变为指令感知。消融实验表明，LLM 注意力在较深层跟踪指令，且主要来自指令微调。
AI.conclusion: 传递 LLM 注意力权重能选择文本中重要内容：使指令所问方面的内容在嵌入中占主导，或恢复被平均池化稀释的方面。指令跟随能力可从 LLM 无训练迁移至嵌入器。

title: PWM: Personalized World Models with Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Pretrained world models can generate diverse environments, yet users often want to explore a particular scene specified by their own video. This requires learning the scene's visual identity while retaining the quality of action-conditioned generation. We introduce Personalized World Models (PWM), a framework for customizing interactive world models from short scene videos through online reinforcement learning. In PWM, the support trajectory and its associated controls provide reward feedback on continuations sampled from the current policy. In the GRPO instantiation, group-relative optimization updates a compact LoRA adapter using a unified reward for scene appearance, visual continuity, and motion, while base-policy anchoring regularizes changes to the pretrained generation prior of a frozen Yume-5B backbone. The same adaptation procedure is applied across real and rendered environments. We also instantiate PWM with DiffusionNFT as an alternative reward-guided optimization method for learning the scene-specific adapter. We also introduce PWM-Bench, comprising 150 customization tasks across Indoor, Outdoor, and Gaming, with paired evaluation on held-out continuations. The GRPO and DiffusionNFT instantiations of PWM improve customization over native Yume in 71.3% and 65.3% of the evaluated scenes, respectively, with positive mean gains across all three domains. For the GRPO instantiation, matched SFT comparisons further demonstrate higher mean customization gains and better mean image-quality scores in every domain, while retaining frame-level visual quality close to the pretrained model.

AI.tldr: 提出PWM框架，通过在线强化学习将预训练世界模型定制到用户指定场景视频。
AI.motivation: 预训练世界模型能生成多样环境，但用户常想探索自己视频指定的特定场景，需学习场景视觉身份同时保持动作条件生成质量。
AI.method: PWM利用支持轨迹及控制作为奖励反馈，GRPO实例用统一奖励（场景外观、视觉连续性、运动）更新紧凑LoRA适配器，并以基策略锚定正则化冻结的Yume-5B先验；另用DiffusionNFT实例化；引入PWM-Bench基准（150任务，Indoor/Outdoor/Gaming）。
AI.result: GRPO与DiffusionNFT分别使71.3%和65.3%评估场景提升定制效果，三个域均有正向平均增益；GRPO相比匹配SFT在各域定制增益更高、图像质量更好，且保持接近预训练模型的帧级视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: PWM能有效从短视频定制交互式世界模型，兼顾场景个性化与生成质量。

title: Coupling Noisy Pairwise Knowledge to the DAG Posterior for Causal Discovery
summary: External causal reports can improve structure learning from limited observations, but their reliability varies across sources and variable pairs. We introduce HB-NoisyKG, a Bayesian framework that combines observational data with repeated causal reports from sources such as large language models. Each report is a noisy observation of a direct pair state implied by one DAG. A feature-conditioned Beta prior pools information about pair reliability, and a shared error matrix captures systematic mistakes. Alternating inference uses the graph posterior to refine reliability estimates, which determine how reports influence subsequent graph updates. The report likelihood uses only graph pair-state marginals, so the same observation layer supports discrete and continuous likelihoods in graph-only and joint inference. Against an 80-restart no-KG baseline, HB uses at most 80 total restarts and lowers mean SHD from 22.39 to 16.06 on five discrete benchmarks. On a physical light tunnel with random variable IDs and retained descriptions, HB lowers SHD from 39.00 for no-KG to 27.30. On continuous Sachs, graph-only BGe raises AUROC by 0.121 over no-KG Top-K. In a controlled synthetic study, continued updating also reduces mean reliability estimation error and held-out report log loss compared with one-time estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出HB-NoisyKG贝叶斯框架，融合观测数据与来自LLM等源头的重复因果报告（含噪声），通过特征条件Beta先验与共享误差矩阵建模可靠性，交替推断使图后验与可靠性估计互相修正，在多基准上显著降低SHD并提升AUROC。
AI.motivation: 外部因果报告（如LLM给出）能在观测受限时改进结构学习，但不同来源和变量对的可靠性差异大，需要一种能显式建模并纠正噪声报告可靠性的框架。
AI.method: 将每条报告视为某DAG所隐含的成对直接状态的噪声观测；用特征条件Beta先验汇总成对可靠性信息，用共享误差矩阵刻画系统性错误；采用交替推断，用图后验更新可靠性估计，再据此调节报告对图更新的影响；报告似然仅依赖图的成对状态边缘，从而统一支持离散/连续似然及图-only与联合推断。
AI.result: 五个离散基准上，相比80重启的no-KG基线（SHD 22.39），HB最多用80总重启将均值SHD降至16.06；物理light tunnel（随机变量ID、保留描述）SHD从39.00降至27.30；连续Sachs上graph-only BGe使AUROC比no-KG Top-K提高0.121；合成研究中持续更新降低可靠性估计误差与留出报告的对数损失。
AI.conclusion: HB-NoisyKG表明显式建模报告可靠性并交替推断，可有效利用噪声外部因果报告改进结构学习，且在离散/连续、图-only/联合设定下均有效。

title: A Tropical Geometry View of Forgetting: A Per-Unit Projector for Knowledge-Preserving Fine-Tuning
summary: Fine-tuning a language model on new text degrades what it already does. Replay-free projectors such as Adam-NSCL and GPM forbid one shared subspace of a layer's inputs in every row of the update. The tropical geometry of a ReLU layer shows why this is too coarse. In data space, the units' walls are tropical hypersurfaces whose cells are dual to the upper vertices of a zonotope; in weight space, each old token is a hyperplane, and the tokens cut out a polyhedron, the closure of the weights that keep every token on its side. An exact identity joins the two pictures: the squared change of the layer's output under any weight change splits into in-cell, open-to-closed and closed-to-open terms, and the first two live on the tokens each unit fires on. The identity names a gate-aware per-unit projector, and a budget-separation theorem prices exact protection: it costs a unit the rank of its own open tokens, while a shared subspace pays at least the rank of their union in every row. On OPT-1.3b, where 96% of (token, unit) pairs are closed, the projector forgets less than Adam-NSCL at all six matched budgets from 9 to 60 constrained directions per row, the gap widening from $1.1\times$ to $4.3\times$; with 1/5.5 of the directions it halves the forgetting of Adam-NSCL at GPM's energy threshold. On OPT-6.7b, it matches Adam-NSCL's forgetting at matched budget while learning more. As the theory predicts, the open/closed partition is the operative variable: open tokens beat random, sign-blind and anti-gate token sets on 18 of 18 seed-pairs. In pruning repair, every derivative-based local model of the output error at the dense weights is blind to pairs that open: the minimisers of the gate-weighted objective can leave the polyhedron, the objective's closed-form solution is 1.94 nats worse than no repair on OPT-1.3b, and a convex one-sided penalty bounds the escape.

AI.tldr: 提出基于ReLU热带几何的门感知逐单元投影器，实现无回放持续学习，在OPT模型上以更少方向显著降低遗忘。
AI.motivation: 微调语言模型会损害已有能力；现有无回放投影方法（如Adam-NSCL、GPM）为每行更新强加单一共享子空间，约束过粗，未考虑ReLU单元的激活结构。
AI.method: 利用ReLU层热带几何：数据空间中的墙壁对应zonotope上顶点，权重空间中旧token形成多面体约束。推导输出平方变化的精确恒等式，分解为in-cell、open-to-closed、closed-to-open项，据此设计门感知的逐单元投影器，并给出预算分离定理量化保护代价。
AI.result: OPT-1.3b上96%的(token,unit)对为closed，该投影器在每行9–60个约束方向的六个预算下遗忘均少于Adam-NSCL，差距从1.1×增至4.3×；方向数为1/5.5时在GPM能量阈值下将遗忘减半。OPT-6.7b上匹配预算下遗忘相当但学得更多；开放/封闭划分是关键变量，开放token在18/18种子对上优于随机、符号盲和反门控集合。剪枝修复中，基于导数的局部模型对open对有盲区，闭式解比不修复差1.94 nats，凸单边惩罚可限制逃逸。
AI.conclusion: ReLU的热带几何揭示共享子空间投影过粗，开放/封闭划分是持续学习与剪枝修复中的核心变量；门感知逐单元投影器在更少约束下实现更优的遗忘-学习权衡。

title: Can Prosodic Style Be Inferred from Text Alone? Evidence from Unsupervised Acoustic Clusters
summary: Much of expressive text-to-speech research rests on an untested assumption that written text carries enough information to select an appropriate prosodic style for its delivery. Text-predicted style models improve listener preference, and expressive-appropriateness evaluation presupposes that context constrains style, yet neither measures the assumption itself. This paper tests it as a falsifiable hypothesis against style labels derived from acoustics alone. For each of six speakers in a 1,200-hour conversational corpus, utterances are clustered in the spaces of five speech models, including a prosody-only control, and the cluster of held-out utterances is predicted from twelve text embedding models. Three controls are applied: utterance length is erased from the speech embeddings; accuracy is scored against the majority-class floor of unbalanced clusters rather than uniform chance; and a bag-of-words baseline measures word identity alone. Text predicts the cluster above that floor for all six speakers (+0.111 top-3 accuracy), but bag-of-words achieves three quarters of this. Sentence embeddings add only +0.026, largest for encoders not trained for sentence semantics and reversed by tree-based probes for all others. Acoustic clusters are not compact in text embedding space in any of 360 configurations. The prosody-only space weakens the association for five speakers, but not for the speaker showing it most strongly. Text thus informs these delivery clusters mainly through word choice, whether as a cue to prosody or as a marker of topic and recording situation, and reference-free style selection cannot assume more.

AI.tldr: 本文通过可证伪实验检验"书面文本能预测韵律风格"这一假设，发现文本主要靠词选择传递信息，而非句子语义，参考无关的风格选择不能依赖更多。
AI.motivation: 表达性TTS研究普遍假设书面文本包含足够信息来选择恰当的韵律风格，但该假设从未被直接检验。现有风格预测模型虽提升偏好，且风格适配评价预设了情境约束风格，但都未测量该假设本身。
AI.method: 在1200小时对话语料上对6位说话者，用5种语音模型（含纯韵律对照）对语句聚类，用12种文本嵌入模型预测留出语句的聚类。三重控制：从语音嵌入中消除语句长度、以多数类下限而非均匀概率评分、用词袋基线衡量词身份效应。
AI.result: 文本在6位说话者上都超过多数类下限（top-3准确率+0.111），但词袋已达四分之三。句子嵌入仅增+0.026，且最大增益出现在非句子语义训练的编码器上。360种配置中声学聚类在文本空间均不紧凑。纯韵律空间对5位说话者削弱关联，但对关联最强者无效。
AI.conclusion: 文本主要通过词选择（作为韵律线索或话题与录音场景标记）影响这些交付聚类风格，参考无关的风格选择不能做更多假设。

title: TRACE: Time-Adaptive Residual Attention Control with Content-Style Decomposition for Training-Free Diffusion Style Transfer
summary: Reference-guided style transfer aims to preserve the semantic structure of a content image while transferring the visual appearance of a style reference. Recent diffusion-based methods achieve impressive stylization quality by exploiting strong pretrained generative priors. However, training-free approaches still face a difficult trade-off among style fidelity, content preservation, and content leakage. Direct style injection may unintentionally transfer semantic content from the style image, while fixed guidance schedules often ignore the time- and state-dependent nature of diffusion sampling. To address these limitations, we propose TRACE, a training-free diffusion style transfer framework with Time-adaptive Residual Attention Control and Content-Style Decomposition. TRACE first performs offline CLIP-based subspace analysis to separate content and style directions from paired data. During inference, it removes content-related components from the style reference and style-related components from the content reference to reduce leakage. It then injects style information through residual cross-attention and applies uncertainty-aware guidance to adapt the guidance signal at each denoising step. Experiments show that TRACE achieves a favorable trade-off between stylization and preservation. Compared with optimal-control-based baselines, TRACE substantially improves style fidelity (+17.28 CSD and +34.10 SRA). While, compared with stylization methods, it better preserves content structure (+12.80 DINO, +5.52 CLIP-I, and -8.19 LPIPS) and reduces directional semantic leakage by 29.5% in DCL. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/pixelchemy-research/TRACE.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一个免训练扩散风格迁移框架，通过时间自适应残差注意力控制和内容-风格分解，缓解风格注入中的内容泄漏并动态调整引导，实现风格保真与内容保留的更好平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练扩散风格迁移方法难以权衡风格保真、内容保留与内容泄漏：直接注入风格会无意迁移风格图的语义内容，固定引导策略忽视了扩散采样过程时间与状态相关的特性。
AI.method: TRACE先用CLIP做离线子空间分析，从配对数据中分离内容与风格方向；推理时从风格参考中去除内容成分、从内容参考中去除风格成分以减少泄漏；再通过残差交叉注意力注入风格，并采用不确定性感知引导在每步去噪中自适应调整引导信号。
AI.result: 实验表明TRACE在风格化与保留间取得良好权衡：相比最优控制基线，风格保真显著提升（+17.28 CSD，+34.10 SRA）；相比风格化方法，内容结构保留更好（+12.80 DINO，+5.52 CLIP-I，-8.19 LPIPS），DCL方向性语义泄漏减少29.5%。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过时间自适应与内容-风格分解，有效缓解内容泄漏并提升风格迁移质量，代码已开源。

title: Only Project Once: Projection-Adaptive Loss for Exact Constraint Satisfaction
summary: Precise constraint satisfaction is a prerequisite to deploying learned models in many areas, motivating methods that repair raw neural predictions with a repair procedure. Current methods unroll multiple repair steps in training and softly penalize constraint violations that remain after the unroll. This is compute- and memory-intensive, lacks robustness when the repair fails to converge, and surrenders most of the constraint satisfaction work to the repair. Our central finding is that, contrary to common practice, a single detached projection step suffices in training. We accomplish this with a Projection-Adaptive Loss (PAL), which uses the constraint residual after this single step to adaptively weigh constraint penalties on the raw prediction. In experiments, PAL is the only method that retains virtually perfect feasibility on extremely nonlinear constraints, and matches or outperforms current methods on synthetic and engineering benchmarks. Because it only requires a single detached projection step, PAL trains 2.5x faster than the canonical repair-based method (DC3) on its own ACOPF benchmark. PAL can also be trained when constraints are expensive to evaluate (e.g., via neural surrogates), a setting where current unrolled methods are memory-intractable.

AI.tldr: 提出Projection-Adaptive Loss (PAL)，证明训练中只需单步detached投影即可实现精确约束满足，训练更快且可行性更好。
AI.motivation: 许多领域部署学习模型需精确满足约束，现有修复方法训练时展开多步修复并软惩罚残余违反，计算与内存开销大、修复不收敛时鲁棒性差、且把约束满足任务几乎全交给修复过程。
AI.method: PAL使用单步detached投影后的约束残差来自适应地加权原始预测上的约束惩罚项，仅需一步投影，无需多步展开。
AI.result: 在极端非线性约束上PAL是唯一保持几乎完美可行性的方法；在合成与工程基准上匹配或超越现有方法；在其ACOPF基准上比DC3训练快2.5倍；在约束评估昂贵（如神经代理）场景中可训练，而现有展开方法内存不可行。
AI.conclusion: 与常见做法相反，训练中单步detached投影已足够，PAL在可行性、效率和可扩展性上优于现有修复式方法。

title: MASBench: Benchmarking LLM-based Multi-Agent Collaboration under Partial Observability
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have progressively evolved into the core of autonomous agents. Building on this progress, LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) coordinate multiple agents into a synergistic team to accomplish complex tasks that exceed the capabilities of individual agents. The effectiveness of such systems depends not only on the agents themselves, but also on how collaboration mechanisms are designed and organized. Note that real-world collaboration is typically partially observable, where each agent can only access partial information about the environment due to physical or privacy-related constraints. However, many existing multi-agent benchmarks assume global observability, and leave limited support for systematically evaluating collaboration mechanisms. To bridge this gap, we introduce MASBench, a multi-agent collaboration benchmark designed under partially observable constraints. It is organized into three progressive task categories: Reasoning, Scheduling, and Game. Through this structure, we progressively evaluate three representative collaboration mechanisms: Protocol, Memory, and Routing. MASBench further provides deterministic evaluation metrics, including performance score, communication cost, and cost effectiveness, to characterize both collaboration outcomes and communication overhead. Experiments across diverse LLM backbones and mechanism configurations offer empirical guidance for effective MAS design. Code is available at: https://github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/MASBench

AI.tldr: 本文提出MASBench，一个在部分可观测约束下评估LLM多智能体协作机制的基准，涵盖推理、调度、博弈三类任务，并支持对协议、记忆、路由三种机制的系统评估。
AI.motivation: 真实世界协作通常是部分可观测的，但现有多智能体基准多假设全局可观测性，缺乏对协作机制的系统评估支持。
AI.method: 设计MASBench基准，组织为推理、调度、博弈三类渐进任务，用于评估协议、记忆、路由三种代表性协作机制，并提供确定性评价指标。
AI.result: 在多种LLM骨干与机制配置下的实验为有效MAS设计提供了经验性指导。
AI.conclusion: MASBench弥补了部分可观测多智能体协作评估的空白，提供性能分数、通信成本与成本效益等指标，助力MAS设计研究。

title: What Is a Repeated Token Worth? The Scaling Geometry of Multi-Epoch Pretraining
summary: As pretraining increasingly repeats data, every run faces three questions: how many epochs to take, how that number should change with model size, and whether anything besides the epoch count matters. We answer them by pricing a repeated token against two references: one epoch on the same data, which gives its value, and fresh data at equal compute, which gives its cost. Against fresh data, the cost of repetition follows a single variable, the number of extra epochs divided by the unique tokens per parameter. Against the same data, a second epoch is worth nearly as much as a fresh one, and repeated tokens fall to half the value of fresh ones after a critical epoch count that grows with the training budget per parameter but hardly with model size. With unique data fixed, the predicted compute-optimal run grows model size and epochs together until loss stops improving, near the critical epoch count. The same variable accounts for the direction of size trends that appear to conflict: larger models tolerate fewer epochs when the corpus is fixed, from about 15 at 127M to 4 at 2B parameters, but not when unique data grow with the model. Counts alone do not determine loss: at identical counts, replaying shards consecutively raises loss by up to 0.46~bits per byte, concentrating repeats on fewer samples also raises it, lower-entropy sources degrade faster with repetition, and re-tokenizing repeats helps only under heavy repetition. These results offer an empirical guide to pretraining when unique data, rather than compute, are the binding constraint.

AI.tldr: 论文研究预训练数据重复问题，提出用"每参数额外epoch数除以唯token数"这一变量描述重复代价，并给出最优epoch数、模型规模与重复价值的经验规律。
AI.motivation: 预训练数据被反复使用，需回答训练多少epoch、epoch数如何随模型规模变化，以及除epoch数外还有什么因素影响重复效果，尤其当唯一数据成为瓶颈时。
AI.method: 将重复token的代价与两种参考对比：同数据一个epoch（定义其价值）和等算力下的新数据（定义其代价）；用实验分析代价随额外epoch与每参数唯token数之比的变化，并考察shard重放顺序、重复集中度、数据熵和重新分词等影响。
AI.result: 针对新数据，重复代价由唯一变量决定；针对同数据，第二个epoch价值接近新数据，超过随每参数训练预算增长（但几乎不随模型规模增长）的临界epoch数后，重复token价值降至新数据的一半。固定唯一数据时，预测的算力最优运行会同时增大模型规模和epoch数，直至损失不再改善，接近临界epoch数。同一变量还解释看似矛盾的大小趋势：语料固定时大模型耐受更少epoch（127M约15次至2B约4次），但唯一数据随模型增长时并非如此。相同计数下，连续重放shard最多使损失上升0.46 bpb，集中重复于更少样本也会升高损失，低熵源随重复退化更快，重新分词仅在重度重复时有益。
AI.conclusion: 研究为唯一数据而非算力成为约束条件时的预训练提供经验指导，强调重复代价可由单一变量刻画，且计数之外的重复方式与数据特性同样影响损失。

title: Robust Tensor Completion via Reflective Convolution Nuclear Norm Minimization
summary: Robust tensor completion recovers multidimensional data from partial observations corrupted by sparse gross errors. Existing convolutional low-rank models typically construct translated copies using circular continuation, which introduces artificial wrap-around neighborhoods for finite nonperiodic data. We propose reflective convolution nuclear norm minimization (RCNNM), which replaces circular shifts with endpoint-nonrepeating reflection. The resulting lifting has nonuniform entry multiplicities and satisfies a weighted Gram identity that supports both the recovery analysis and the optimization method. Under random sampling and sparse corruption, we establish high-probability exact recovery of the underlying tensor and sparse errors, together with stability under bounded dense perturbations. We further develop a two-block ADMM with a closed-form entrywise tensor update, while singular-value thresholding is implemented through the smaller right Gram matrix. Experiments on synthetic tensors, BSDS color images, and CAVE multispectral images show that RCNNM consistently improves over its circular-lifting counterpart, with the clearest gains near image boundaries. In particular, average boundary-PSNR improvements reach 3.26 dB while global reconstruction quality remains competitive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反射卷积核范数最小化（RCNNM），用端点不重复反射替代循环平移构建卷积低秩模型，实现鲁棒张量补全，并给出理论恢复保证与高效优化算法。
AI.motivation: 现有卷积低秩模型通常用循环延拓构造平移副本，对有限非周期数据会引入人为的环绕邻域，导致边界处建模失真、性能下降。
AI.method: 将循环平移替换为端点不重复反射，得到非均匀条目重数的lifting，并满足加权Gram恒等式以支撑恢复分析与优化；设计两块ADMM，逐元素张量更新有闭式解，奇异值阈值通过较小的右Gram矩阵实现。
AI.result: 在随机采样与稀疏污染下证明高概率精确恢复张量与稀疏误差，并具对有界稠密扰动的稳定性；合成张量、BSDS彩色图像与CAVE多光谱图像实验显示RCNNM一致优于循环lifting，边界处增益最明显，边界PSNR平均提升达3.26 dB，全局质量仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 反射卷积核范数最小化有效缓解循环延拓的边界伪影，兼顾理论恢复保证与数值效率，在边界区域带来显著重建提升。

title: DiffGate: Difficulty-Gated Teacher Guidance for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a widely used paradigm for post-training large language models, reducing the train--test mismatch of conventional distillation by supervising the student on its own generated trajectories. However, existing OPD objectives remain largely token-local and outcome-agnostic, optimizing teacher--student agreement at each prefix despite reasoning quality being determined at the trajectory level. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), provides complementary outcome-level supervision but suffers from sparse rewards and coarse credit assignment. We show that OPD and RLVR exhibit complementary blind spots: teacher signals provide dense local guidance but are weakly aligned with rollout correctness, whereas group-relative rewards capture task success but provide coarse token-level credit and vanish on all-failure groups. We introduce DiffGate, an outcome-gated objective that combines GRPO with selective, bounded teacher guidance. Teacher supervision is applied only to failed trajectories, scaled by group difficulty, and smoothly bounded to prevent extreme teacher--student discrepancies from dominating optimization. The verifier therefore determines \emph{which trajectories} receive teacher guidance, while the teacher provides dense token-level update directions within those trajectories. Across Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B students, DiffGate improves code avg@8 over matched GRPO by $+1.7$ and $+1.8$ points and pass@8 by $+1.6$ and $+5.7$ points, respectively. On mathematics, avg@8 remains within $0.5$ points of GRPO while pass@8 improves by $+1.1$ and $+3.9$ points. Overall, DiffGate improves pass@8 across all four model--domain settings, demonstrating improved solution coverage under our evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: DiffGate结合GRPO与选择性、有界的教师指导，用于LLM后训练，仅在失败轨迹上应用教师监督并按组难度缩放，提升pass@8等指标。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy distillation(OPD)目标多为token局部且与结果无关，而RLVR(如GRPO)提供结果级监督但奖励稀疏、信用分配粗。二者存在互补盲区，需结合二者优势。
AI.method: 提出DiffGate：结果门控目标函数，将GRPO与选择性、有界教师指导结合。仅对失败轨迹施加教师监督，按组难度缩放，并平滑界定以防止极端教师-学生差异主导优化。验证器决定哪些轨迹接受指导，教师在轨迹内提供密集token级更新方向。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-0.6B与1.7B上，代码avg@8较GRPO分别+1.7、+1.8分，pass@8分别+1.6、+5.7分；数学avg@8与GRPO相差0.5分内，pass@8分别+1.1、+3.9分。四个模型-领域设置pass@8均提升。
AI.conclusion: DiffGate在保持GRPO数学性能的同时提升解的覆盖率，验证了结果门控的选择性教师指导能有效弥补OPD与RLVR的盲区。

title: When Debate Helps: Proposal Supply and Verification-Aware Readout in Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Multi-agent debate can improve reasoning, yet often fails to beat simple majority voting. We argue that successful debate requires two distinct mechanisms: proposal supply must surface a correct answer, and readout must identify that answer when voting misses it. We formalize the first requirement through recoverable headroom, which measures cases where a correct proposal is available but the majority answer is wrong. For the second, we develop Latent Verification Debate (LVD), an accounting model in which candidate proposals receive answer-specific verification evidence before final generation. Controlled fixed-proposal interventions estimate this latent effect in equivalent peer-support units and show that correct evidence changes answer probabilities and generated decisions while proposal supply remains fixed. To improve proposal supply, we construct societies from neural-thicket agents using labeled and label-free coverage objectives. Across two backbones and matched-budget reasoning benchmarks, coverage-selected societies increase complementary proposal supply and improve aggregate accuracy in repeated stochastic evaluations. Round-level controls further show that interaction provides gains beyond applying the same finalizer directly to the initial proposals. These results identify proposal coverage and truth-sensitive evidence use as complementary conditions for debate to outperform voting. Code is available at https://github.com/Wang-ML-Lab/when-debate-helps.

AI.tldr: 多智能体辩论常不如简单多数投票。作者提出辩论成功需两个机制：提案供给要能浮现正确答案（可恢复余量），读出机制要能在投票失败时识别正答（Latent Verification Debate）。实验表明覆盖率选出的群体提升提案供给与准确率，且交互优于对初始提案直接读评。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论虽能提升推理，但常无法击败简单多数投票，作者想厘清辩论何时才有效。
AI.method: 提出可恢复余量来衡量正确答案已存在但多数投票错误的情形；构建Latent Verification Debate（LVD）会计模型，使候选提案在最终生成前获得针对答案的验证证据；用固定提案干预估计潜效应；用神经thicket智能体及有/无标签覆盖率目标构造社会群体。
AI.result: 固定提案干预显示正确证据能改变答案概率与生成决策；覆盖率选择的群体增加互补提案供给，在两个骨干网络和同等预算的推理基准上提升重复随机评估的总体准确率；轮级控制表明交互增益超过直接对初始提案做最终读评。
AI.conclusion: 提案覆盖率与真值敏感的证据使用是辩论超越投票的两个互补条件。

title: More Than Words: Compositional Tokenization for Efficient Language Models
summary: Language models process and generate text sequentially in token units, and the tokenizer determines how much text each inference step covers. Under standard tokenization, a short English phrase such as "On the table." is usually produced as four separate predictions for the preposition (On), article (the), noun (table), and punctuation (.), where each consumes a sequence position and adds inference cost. We introduce CoBPE, a compositional tokenization approach that represents such phrases as a lexical base token (table) attached with a small set of reusable surface modifiers, composed in embedding space at input and predicted jointly at output. In controlled pretraining from scratch at 780M and 1.3B scales, CoBPE shortens sequences by 30% and improves average downstream performance by 1.2 points relative to standard BPE under matched training compute. Our results suggest that part of what is now expressed through token sequences can instead be modeled through structured representations, opening a broad design space for more token-efficient and capable language models.

AI.tldr: 提出CoBPE组合式分词方法：将短语表示为词根token加可复用表层修饰符，在嵌入空间组合，减少序列长度并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 标准BPE分词将短语拆为多个token（如介词、冠词、名词、标点各占一个位置），增加推理成本。作者想探索用结构化表示替代部分token序列。
AI.method: CoBPE把短语表示为词根基础token加一组可复用的表层修饰符，输入时在嵌入空间组合，输出时联合预测。
AI.result: 在780M和1.3B规模从零预训练，相比标准BPE训练计算量匹配下，序列缩短30%，下游平均性能提升1.2分。
AI.conclusion: 部分现有由token序列表达的内容可用结构化表示建模，为更token高效、更强的语言模型开辟设计空间。

title: Geometry-Aware Preference Optimization for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Preference alignment has become a standard practice for text-to-image diffusion models. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) simplifies this process by eliminating explicit reward modeling. Its diffusion variant, Diffusion-DPO, has become a widely adopted baseline. Diffusion-DPO essentially encourages the likelihood of preferred samples while suppressing dispreferred ones. In this paper, we revisit DPO-style alignment methods for diffusion models from the perspective of the manifold hypothesis. Under this view, natural images concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold embedded in the high-dimensional ambient space, whereas DPO directly optimizes preference distributions in the full space without accounting for this geometric structure. This creates a mismatch in the optimization dynamics: it suppresses geometry-preserving tangential updates, while insufficiently restricting hazardous normal-direction updates. This mismatch gradually degrades image quality and diversity. To address this issue, we propose Anisotropic Geometry-Aware Preference Optimization (APO), which replaces the uniform Euclidean treatment of prediction errors with a geometry-aware anisotropic metric derived from the reference model. Concretely, APO adaptively strengthens regularization in directions where the reference denoising function is highly sensitive, while relaxing constraints in directions that permit safe semantic adjustment. This recalibrates preference optimization according to the local manifold geometry, and maintains the original manifold structure. Experiments show that APO achieves strong performance and an average win rate exceeding 60\% against various existing alignment methods across diverse benchmarks. It requires significantly fewer training steps than prior methods, and preserves generation diversity throughout training.

AI.tldr: 本文从流形假设视角重新审视扩散模型的DPO式偏好对齐，指出其全空间优化忽略图像的低维流形结构，导致质量与多样性下降，并提出几何感知的APO方法。
AI.motivation: Diffusion-DPO直接在全空间优化偏好分布，未考虑自然图像集中于低维流形的几何结构，造成切向更新被抑制、法向危险更新约束不足，从而逐渐损害图像质量与多样性。
AI.method: 提出Anisotropic Geometry-Aware Preference Optimization (APO)，用参考模型导出的几何感知各向异性度量替代预测误差的均匀欧氏处理：在参考去噪函数敏感方向增强正则化，在允许安全语义调整的方向放松约束，按局部流形几何重新校准偏好优化并保持流形结构。
AI.result: 在多样基准上APO取得强劲表现，对多种现有对齐方法平均胜率超60%，训练步数显著少于先前方法，并在整个训练过程中保持生成多样性。
AI.conclusion: 从流形几何角度重思扩散偏好对齐是有效方向，APO通过各向异性度量实现了更高效且保持多样性的对齐。

title: Asymptotically Optimal Best Arm Identification with Fixed-Budget under Differential Privacy
summary: Best arm identification under differential privacy is a pure-exploration problem in which both statistical efficiency and privacy protection must be achieved simultaneously. We study fixed-budget best arm identification for bandits under pure $ε$-differential privacy, where the learner must recommend an arm after a prescribed sampling budget while protecting the full transcript. We prove that the optimal exponential decay rate of the error probability is upper bounded by an instance-dependent privacy-aware transportation exponent that differs from the analogous quantity used to characterize the stopping time in fixed-confidence analysis by Jourdan and Azize [2025]. Guided by this exponent, we propose AO-Pri-BAI, an adaptive algorithm that maintains private running estimates through Laplace-tree mechanisms and learns a sampling design through a min--max interaction between hard alternatives and arm allocations. We prove that AO-Pri-BAI satisfies pure $ε$-differential privacy. We also establish that the exponent of the failure probability of AO-Pri-BAI matches the privacy-aware benchmark. Numerical studies show that even in the non-asymptotic setting, AO-Pri-BAI outperforms benchmark algorithms on various instances, complementing the theoretical analyses.

AI.tldr: 研究纯ε-差分隐私下固定预算最佳臂识别问题的理论最优错误率，并提出匹配该基准的算法AO-Pri-BAI。
AI.motivation: 在固定预算最佳臂识别中需同时兼顾统计效率与隐私保护，而差分隐私约束下的最优错误率指数尚缺乏刻画。
AI.method: 证明错误概率最优指数受隐私感知传输指数上界约束，提出AO-Pri-BAI：用Laplace树机制维护私有运行估计，通过困难替代与臂分配的min-max交互学习采样设计。
AI.result: AO-Pri-BAI满足纯ε-差分隐私，其失败概率指数达到隐私感知基准；数值实验显示非渐近情形下优于基准算法。
AI.conclusion: 给出固定预算隐私最佳臂识别的隐私感知最优指数基准，并提出可达该基准的实用算法。

title: RAGStress: A controlled benchmark for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation under knowledge-base degradation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is typically evaluated under the implicit assumption that the underlying knowledge base (KB) is clean, leaving the behaviour of RAG systems under realistic KB degradation poorly characterised. We introduce RAGStress, a controlled evaluation benchmark for stress-testing RAG systems under systematic KB corruption. The benchmark pairs four naturalistic corruption types (factual corruption, numeric typo, relevance poisoning, and contradiction injection) with three severity levels (subtle, moderate, and obvious) over a single-KB, metadata-filtered experimental design built from 57 MMLU subjects and 182,546 documents. Across 52,500 model-question-condition evaluations, RAGStress reveals that clean retrieval can mask robustness differences, semantic-fidelity corruptions are substantially more harmful than signal-utility perturbations, no-retrieval accuracy does not predict corrupted-retrieval robustness, and mixed-KB accuracy should not be treated as worst-case robustness. We document the benchmark's intended use, supported claims, and limitations, and provide an artifact bundle including generation scripts, corruption prompts, metadata schema, and evaluation code. RAGStress is intended as a controlled stress test for RAG robustness under KB corruption, not as a general model leaderboard.

AI.tldr: RAGStress是一个受控评测基准，系统性地在知识库损坏条件下压力测试RAG系统，揭示干净检索会掩盖鲁棒性差异、语义保真度损坏危害更大等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG评测默认知识库是干净的，缺乏对现实知识库退化情景下的行为刻画。
AI.method: 构建RAGStress基准：四种自然损坏类型（事实损坏、数字错字、相关性投毒、矛盾注入）×三种严重程度（细微、中等、明显），基于57个MMLU科目、182,546篇文档的单KB、元数据过滤设计，进行了52,500次模型-问题-条件评测。
AI.result: 干净检索会掩盖鲁棒性差异；语义保真度损坏比信号效用扰动危害更大；无检索准确率无法预测损坏检索的鲁棒性；混合KB准确率不应被视为最坏情况鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RAGStress是面向知识库损坏下RAG鲁棒性的受控压力测试，而非通用模型排行榜；提供生成脚本、损坏提示、元数据模式和评测代码等artifact。

title: Atomic Visual Entailment: Enhancing Zero-Shot Vision-Language Reasoning through Atomic Fact Decomposition and Learned Selection
summary: Visual entailment (VE) asks whether an image supports, contradicts, or leaves undecided a textual hypothesis. Strong results come from fine-tuning large vision-language models on labelled data, while zero-shot and hybrid approaches remain far behind. A VE hypothesis often bundles several visual claims, yet existing zero-shot methods reason over it as a single unit. We propose Atomic Visual Entailment (AVE), which decomposes the hypothesis into atomic facts, produces candidate predictions from both the full hypothesis and its facts using frozen vision-language models, and predicts the final label with a lightweight classifier trained only on how those candidates behave. We find that decomposition helps only when the hypothesis context is preserved: judging facts in isolation is worse than not decomposing at all. Full-hypothesis and atomic prediction make complementary errors, and learning which to trust recovers far more of that complementarity than majority voting, reaching 0.803 test accuracy on SNLI-VE without fine-tuning any vision-language model. AVE also localises the visual evidence behind its prediction without region-level supervision. These results suggest that learning which candidate prediction to trust can close much of the gap to fine-tuned systems, offering a practical alternative where fine-tuning a vision-language model directly would need more labelled data or compute than is available.

AI.tldr: 提出Atomic Visual Entailment (AVE)，将VE假设分解为原子事实，结合全假设与事实的候选预测，用轻量分类器在冻结VLM上实现0.803 SNLI-VE准确率，无需微调。
AI.motivation: 现有VE强结果依赖微调大型视觉语言模型，而零样本与混合方法差距大。已有零样本方法将包含多个视觉断言的假设作为单一单元推理，未利用其组合结构。
AI.method: AVE将假设分解为原子事实，用冻结的VLM分别对完整假设和原子事实产生候选预测，并训练一个仅观察这些候选行为的轻量分类器来预测最终标签。关键发现是分解必须保留假设上下文，孤立判断事实反而更差；全假设与原子预测错误互补，学习信任哪个候选优于多数投票。
AI.result: 在SNLI-VE上达到0.803测试准确率，且未微调任何视觉语言模型；AVE还能在无区域级监督下定位预测所依据的视觉证据。
AI.conclusion: 学习信任哪个候选预测可大幅缩小与微调系统的差距，为微调VLM需要更多标注数据或算力的场景提供实用替代方案。

title: VisualErase: Dual-Branch Visual Trajectory Redirection for Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Concept erasure is essential for the safe deployment of text-to-image diffusion models, as they may reproduce harmful, copyrighted, or privacy-sensitive content learned from unconstrained large-scale data. Existing methods typically erase unwanted concepts while preserving general generation capability by redirecting target-related text-to-image mappings. However, recent studies show that erased models may still retain visual generative trajectories of target concepts, leaving them vulnerable to adversarial recovery attacks and revealing a fundamental gap between redirecting text-to-image mappings and truly removing visual knowledge. To bridge this gap, we propose VisualErase, a new paradigm that redirects concept-bearing visual generative trajectories toward explicitly defined concept-removed outcomes. To enable this redirection, we use structure-preserving image editing to construct content-aligned, concept-removed counterparts for source images, providing explicit visual endpoints that retain non-target content. We then derive a denoising target from each source-to-counterpart pair and use a dual-branch redirection loss to align both text-conditioned and unconditional predictions with this target, since conditional supervision alone does not explicitly constrain generation without textual guidance. To mitigate the adverse effects of concept erasure on non-target generation, we jointly optimize the redirection loss with a counterpart retention loss that matches denoising predictions from the frozen pretrained model. Across style, celebrity, and nudity erasure, VisualErase limits the maximum attack success rate over seven attacks to 0%, 8%, and 0.1%, respectively, while retaining general generation quality. These results highlight the importance of visual trajectory redirection for robust concept erasure beyond text-to-image mappings alone.

AI.tldr: VisualErase：将概念相关的视觉生成轨迹重定向到明确“去概念”的目标，实现更鲁棒的概念擦除。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除方法仅重定向文本到图像映射，模型仍保留目标概念的视觉生成轨迹，易受对抗恢复攻击，说明重定向映射并不等于真正移除视觉知识。
AI.method: 用结构保持的图像编辑为源图构造内容对齐、去概念的对偶图，得到显式视觉终点；从源-对偶对推导去噪目标，并用双分支重定向损失同时对齐文本条件与无条件预测；联合优化对偶保留损失（匹配冻结预训练模型）以保护非目标生成。
AI.result: 在风格、名人、裸露擦除任务上，对七种攻击的最大攻击成功率分别降至0%、8%、0.1%，同时保持通用生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 视觉轨迹重定向对实现超越文本到图像映射的鲁棒概念擦除至关重要。

title: Anticipating the Consequences of Curriculum Decisions with Large Language Models
summary: Automatic curriculum learning can improve the effectiveness of reinforcement learning by selecting the training experiences presented to the agent over time. Predicting the consequences of such decisions can, however, be difficult. We analyze automatic curriculum learning as a sequential decision-making problem, highlighting a gap between the quantities that determine the value of curriculum decisions and the information captured by local learning signals commonly used to guide them. We then investigate whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can exploit richer information about the learning problem to better anticipate the consequences of curriculum decisions. We introduce a method that combines online learning-progress estimates with LLM-informed estimates of (i) the potential downstream benefits of learning on each task and (ii) whether direct training on a task is currently likely to produce progress. We evaluate the approach on a custom benchmark of 256 textual goals in Craftax under different curriculum objectives. We observe the strongest gains when optimizing for individual target tasks. When optimizing across the full task set, the benefits vary across learners with different mechanisms for cross-task transfer, ranging from modest improvements in learning speed to larger gains that persist through the end of training.

AI.tldr: 本文将自动课程学习视为序贯决策问题，指出常用局部学习信号与决定课程价值的信息之间存在差距，并提出结合在线学习进度估计与LLM对任务下游收益及当前可学习性的估计的方法。
AI.motivation: 自动课程学习能提升强化学习效果，但预测课程决策的后果很困难。现有局部学习信号所捕捉的信息，不足以反映决定课程决策价值的关键量，因此需要更丰富的学习问题信息。
AI.method: 将自动课程学习建模为序贯决策问题；使用LLM估计每个任务潜在的下游收益，以及直接训练该任务当前是否可能产生进展；再将这些LLM信号与在线学习进度估计相结合来指导课程决策。
AI.result: 在Craftax的256个文本目标基准上、不同课程目标下评估。面向单个目标任务优化时收益最强；面向完整任务集优化时，效果因学习者跨任务迁移机制而异，从学习速度的适度提升，到训练结束仍保持的较大收益不等。
AI.conclusion: LLM能利用更丰富的学习问题信息来更好预测课程决策后果，但收益取决于优化目标和学习者的迁移机制，并非在所有设定下都一致显著。

title: Penumbra: Sample-Efficient Adversarial Search for Regulatory Obligations
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust) at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 12 pages (4 content pages plus references and appendices)
summary: Agents are entering finance, healthcare and law, sectors where a violation leaves no lexical signature and carries real penalties. Whether an omission is material, or a disclosure sufficient, depends on what the response left out. Probing such an obligation means finding responses one minimal edit from flipping compliance, and every probe costs a generation and two adjudications, so the binding constraint on regulatory red-teaming is sample efficiency, not volume. We introduce Penumbra, an adversarial search that walks from a verified anchor under an expanding edit budget until a two-evaluator committee changes its verdict, and emits the two adjacent responses that straddle the change. Allocation is adaptive, and the objective is coverage of the defeat surface: distinct (obligation x defeat mode) cells resolved per candidate. At matched budget, adaptive allocation reaches uniform allocation's full-budget coverage on 59% of the candidates; at equal records it covers 1.43x the defeat modes of naive enumeration, and the gain is confined to the axis it targets. On 60 screened obligations of a financial advisory constitution, Penumbra returns 144 pairs, each a compliant and a violating response that the committee places on opposite sides of the boundary, differing by a handful of words where a model asked for both directly produces texts sharing almost nothing. A second constitution, for clinical triage, reproduces this on 18 obligations: 49 pairs at the same tightness, with the same modes hardest. Pairs like these show where an obligation's own terms stop deciding, which is what an agent deployed under it must be tested against, and the search finds them at a cost that scales with the boundary, not the text.

AI.tldr: 提出 Penumbra，一种高样本效率的对抗搜索方法，用于生成恰好跨越合规边界的对抗性响应对。
AI.motivation: 金融、医疗、法律等领域的智能体违规不体现在词汇特征上，是否合规取决于响应遗漏了什么；对这类义务的探测需要找到距合规翻转只有一次最小编辑的响应，而每次探测都消耗一次生成和两次判定，因此约束瓶颈是样本效率而非数量。
AI.method: Penumbra 从已验证的锚点出发，在逐步扩大的编辑预算下进行对抗搜索，直到由双评估者组成的委员会改变判定，并输出跨越该变化的两条相邻响应；分配策略自适应，目标为“击败表面”的覆盖，即在每个候选上解析出不同的（义务×失败模式）单元数。
AI.result: 在匹配预算下，自适应分配在59%的候选上达到均匀分配全预算的覆盖；在相同记录数下覆盖的失败模式是朴素枚举的1.43倍且增益局限于目标轴。在金融咨询宪法的60条筛查义务上返回144对，每对为委员会判为边界两侧的合规与违规响应，仅差几个词，而直接要求模型同时生成两种文本则几乎无共享内容。医疗分诊宪法的18条义务上复现：49对，同样紧密，最难模式一致。
AI.conclusion: 这类响应对揭示了义务自身条款停止起作用的位置，正是部署于该义务下的智能体必须被测试的点，且搜索成本随边界而非文本规模增长。

title: Automatic Speech Recognition for Low-Resource Sinhala: A Critical Review of Methods, Challenges, and Future Directions
comment: 29 pages, 1 table. Submitted to Computer Speech & Language
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) for low-resource languages remains a major challenge. Sinhala, the primary language of Sri Lanka with about 16 million speakers, illustrates the difficulty: agglutinative morphology, a 54-phoneme inventory, subject-object-verb (SOV) syntax and scarce annotated speech data limit both conventional and modern ASR systems. This paper presents the first critical review of Sinhala ASR research, tracing its development from Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) through deep neural networks to self-supervised pre-trained models such as wav2vec 2.0, XLS-R, Whisper and Massively Multilingual Speech (MMS). We compare existing Sinhala systems with related low-resource ASR work on Tamil, Malayalam and Hindi in terms of architecture, training data, word error rate (WER) and robustness to real-world acoustic conditions, and we assess self-supervised and transfer learning as responses to scarce labeled data. We show that most reported WERs are not directly comparable because they differ in corpus, data split and scoring, and that the only controlled comparison in the literature attributes an 18.1% relative WER reduction to corpus correction alone. We also discuss context-aware ASR that draws on phonological, syntactic and semantic knowledge. We identify six research gaps: (1) the lack of large annotated corpora covering multiple dialects and acoustic conditions; (2) weak contextual modeling of Sinhala morphosyntax; (3) high WER in real-world conditions; (4) the absence of standardized benchmarks; (5) the lack of parameter-efficient fine-tuning studies; and (6) the absence of annotated code-switched Sinhala-English speech resources. We outline a research agenda to address these gaps, intended as a roadmap for researchers working on Sinhala and other morphologically rich languages.

AI.tldr: 本文是首篇僧伽罗语ASR研究综述，梳理从HMM到自监督预训练模型的发展，指出WER不可直接比较等关键问题，并提出六大研究空白与议程。
AI.motivation: 僧伽罗语作为低资源语言，因黏着形态、54音素、SOV语序及标注语音稀缺，使传统与现代ASR均受限，亟需系统梳理研究现状并指明方向。
AI.method: 对僧伽罗语ASR研究进行批判性综述，从HMM、深度神经网络到wav2vec 2.0、XLS-R、Whisper、MMS等自监督模型，并与泰米尔语、马拉雅拉姆语、印地语的同类低资源工作进行架构、数据、WER及鲁棒性对比。
AI.result: 多数报告的WER因语料、数据划分和评分不同而不可直接比较；文献中唯一受控比较显示，仅语料校正即带来18.1%的相对WER降低。
AI.conclusion: 识别出六大研究空白：缺乏多方言多声学条件的标注语料、僧伽罗语形态句法上下文建模薄弱、真实环境WER高、缺少标准化基准、缺乏参数高效微调研究、缺少僧伽罗语-英语语码转换标注资源，并提出研究路线图。

title: PortraitAes: Intent-Conditioned Structured Portrait Aesthetics Assessment
summary: Portrait aesthetic assessment assigns comparable scores according to how effectively human-centered images fulfill their photographic intent. These scores support data filtering, candidate selection, and preference modeling in image-generation pipelines. Existing methods typically predict a single aesthetic score or use general-purpose MLLMs without conditioning on photographic intent. This omission matters because the same blur, pose, lighting, or framing choice may serve one photographic intent but undermine another. These models thus learn context-agnostic aesthetic priors and yield inconsistent, inaccurate, misleading judgments for portraits with distinct photographic objectives. We introduce PortraitAes-Bench, an 11K-scale benchmark that decomposes this task into intent-conditioned subjudgments. Expert-authored rubrics define nine photographic intents, six first-level dimensions, and 22 secondary criteria. They support a structured pipeline for intent routing, specialist assessment, verification, and score fusion. Following this structure, we train PortraitAes with multi-task supervision. We then improve score comparability through Gaussian score calibration and within-dimension cross-image ranking. On the standard benchmark, PortraitAes achieves a Pearson correlation of 0.924 and a Spearman rank correlation of 0.934. On the hard-case set, its Pearson correlation is 0.829 and its Spearman rank correlation is 0.795. Across both sets, PortraitAes outperforms the evaluated general-purpose MLLMs and specialized aesthetic baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出意图条件化的人像美学评估基准与模型PortraitAes，在标准与困难集上均超越通用MLLM和专用美学基线。
AI.motivation: 现有人像美学评估通常预测单一分数或直接使用通用MLLM，未考虑摄影意图。相同的模糊、姿态、光照或构图在不同意图下可能增益或损害美感，导致模型学到与语境无关的审美先验，对具有不同摄影目标的人像给出不一致、不准确甚至有误导性的判断。
AI.method: 构建11K规模基准PortraitAes-Bench，将任务分解为意图条件化的子判断：由专家撰写评分细则定义9种摄影意图、6个一级维度和22项二级标准，并据此设计意图路由、专家评估、验证与分数融合的结构化流程。按此结构以多任务监督训练PortraitAes，再通过高斯分数校准和维度内跨图像排序提升分数可比性。
AI.result: 标准基准上Pearson相关0.924、Spearman秩相关0.934；困难集上Pearson相关0.829、Spearman秩相关0.795；两个集合上均优于所评估的通用MLLM和专用美学基线。
AI.conclusion: 将人像美学评估显式条件化于摄影意图，并结合专家细则、多任务监督与分数校准，可显著提升评估的准确性与可比性，优于通用MLLM及现有专用基线。

title: Backward-Consistent Diffusion Sampling for Sparsely Observed PDE Inverse Problems
summary: Recovering Partial Differential Equation (PDE) coefficient fields from extremely sparse observations is a severely ill-posed inverse problem for which generative machine learning methods (e.g., diffusion models) have become a leading way to encode the prior.
