Recent state-of-the-art diffusion solvers lift these priors to function spaces, finding a physics-consistent reconstruction in the output space of the diffusion denoiser. We prove that, in a discontinuous PDE setting, output space methods can result in failure to appropriately minimize the unobserved error with the correct coefficient field. Consequently, we propose Function space Backward-Consistent Sampling (FunBCS), an input space optimization approach for solving PDE problems which aims to find the best input such that the denoiser reconstruction is physics-consistent. We then prove that FunBCS appropriately minimizes the unobserved error, unlike output space optimization methods. Per our theoretical analysis, we also provide insights on how to dynamically allocate the number of input space optimization steps used throughout the sampling process. Our evaluations, across four PDE inverse problems (including the discontinuous Darcy flow), demonstrate that FunBCS reduces the reconstruction error by $27$-$64\%$ while running $1.4$-$2.1\times$ faster when compared to the current state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FunBCS，一种输入空间优化方法，用于从极稀疏观测中恢复PDE系数场，证明输出空间方法在间断PDE设定下失效，而FunBCS能正确最小化未观测误差，误差降低27-64%且快1.4-2.1倍。
AI.motivation: 从极稀疏观测恢复PDE系数场是严重病态逆问题，需生成模型编码先验。现有SOTA扩散求解器将先验提升到函数空间，在去噪器输出空间中寻找物理一致重建，但在间断PDE设定下可能无法正确最小化未观测误差。
AI.method: 提出Function space Backward-Consistent Sampling (FunBCS)，一种输入空间优化方法，寻找最佳输入使去噪器重建物理一致。理论上证明FunBCS能正确最小化未观测误差（不同于输出空间方法），并给出采样过程中输入空间优化步数的动态分配策略。
AI.result: 在四个PDE逆问题（含间断Darcy流）上评估，相比当前SOTA，重建误差降低27-64%，运行速度快1.4-2.1倍。
AI.conclusion: FunBCS通过输入空间优化克服输出空间方法在间断设定下的缺陷，在准确性和效率上均优于现有方法。

title: Not Self-Decidable: LLMs Cannot Draw the Boundary of What an Agent Verifier Can Check
comment: Accepted at the Who Verifies the Agents? Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 21 pages (9 content pages plus references and appendices)
summary: A verifier for an agent faces rules of two kinds: the ones a fixed check can settle and the ones that require a judge. A team that derives its own checks fixes that split up front. Where the requirements come from outside, as in finance, healthcare and law, the agent enforces rules it did not write, so the split falls to runtime, recurring for every predicate of every rule on every action at a rate no reviewer can audit. Every escalation scheme assumes a model can make that decision itself, that it is self-decidable. Across six corpora, including the EU AI Act, FINRA guidance and a deployed credit agent, we collect roughly 22,000 labels from four models built by three labs. They agree almost perfectly where the answer is obvious and collapse on regulatory text; their errors run in opposite directions, so no model can be trusted as the conservative choice; and on the deployed agent's own rule-set they err together, over-claiming that a fixed check will do, the direction that never gets escalated. We introduce CoVer (corroborate-then-verify), which treats unanimity as a nomination, admitting a predicate only when the check synthesized for it survives intervention, reading fields the agent cannot write and holding under deterministic rewording. That gate rejects most of what corroboration wrongly admits, at a cost in coverage we report rather than tune away. The obvious alternative, agreement with a reference judge, certifies nothing: it climbs from 30% to 77% across calibration bands while the genuinely decidable share does not move, because a judge drawn from the population under indictment ratifies the blind spot it shares. Self-decidability is not a capability to elicit from a model but a boundary the verifier must construct.

AI.tldr: 论文挑战"规则可自判定"假设：在外部规则场景下，模型无法可靠区分"固定检查可判定"与"需裁判"的谓词；作者提出CoVer，将模型共识视为提名，仅当合成检查通过干预、读取不可写字段并抗确定性改写时才采纳，从而构造出可判定边界。
AI.motivation: 验证器面临两类规则：固定检查可判定与需裁判。当需求来自外部（金融、医疗、法律）时，代理执行非自写规则，这一划分只能在运行时逐谓词、逐动作反复进行，速度无人可审。现有升级方案都假设"自判定性"可由模型自身决定，本文质疑该假设并检验其是否成立。
AI.method: 在六个语料（含EU AI Act、FINRA指引及一个已部署信贷代理）上，收集来自三个实验室四个模型约22,000条标注；分析模型一致性与错误方向；提出CoVer（corroborate-then-verify）：把模型一致性当作提名，仅当为该谓词合成的检查通过干预测试、读取代理无法写入的字段、并在确定性改写下保持稳定时才纳入；对照方法为与参考裁判一致性校准。
AI.result: 模型在显而易见处几乎完全一致，但在监管文本上崩溃；错误方向相反，故无一模型可作保守选择；在已部署代理的规则集上错误同向，过度声称"固定检查足够"（正是永不被升级的方向）。CoVer门控拒绝大部分corroboration错误纳入的谓词，代价是覆盖下降（如实报告而非调参消除）。与参考裁判一致性从30%升至77%却无法认证任何东西：真正可判定比例不变，因为裁判来自被质疑总体，会认可共享盲区。
AI.conclusion: 自判定性不是可从模型激发的固有能力，而是验证器必须主动构造的边界。一致性/裁判一致性无法替代构造性验证。

title: Knowing the Rules, Applying the Rules: Evaluating Language Models on Traditional Chinese Bazi
comment: 16 pages, including references and appendices. Project page: https://monsterpppp.github.io/bazi-qa-benchmark/
summary: Knowing domain rules does not guarantee applying them to a case. We study this distinction in traditional Chinese Bazi through 3,000 Chinese multiple-choice questions spanning 14 Theory and 11 Case categories. Six endpoint systems are evaluated, with primary results reported on a 2,492-item model-informed refinement. Theory accuracy exceeds Case accuracy for every system, and gaps of 16.60-29.56 percentage points remain when invalid responses are excluded. The contrast is more specific than a general case-reasoning deficit. Across six systems, Twelve Stages and Nayin reach mean accuracies of 89.10% and 88.62%, while Shensha Basics reaches 75.96%. Within Case, Luck Pillars averages 84.62%, but Career and Family Relations average only 36.98% and 38.19%. Overall rankings also conceal different category strengths. On the original 3,000 items, paired DeepSeek native/disabled comparisons associate native configurations with Theory gains of 6.53 and 12.20 points for Flash and Pro, respectively; Case changes are -3.67 and +1.27 points. These are provider-configuration associations, not isolated causal effects of reasoning. The results motivate task-specific evaluation of cultural-domain applications rather than reliance on aggregate knowledge scores. The benchmark measures agreement with a model-generated, model-verified answer key, not real-world predictive validity. Final-set results are post-selection descriptions, and incomplete provenance and expert validation constrain their interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过3000道中文选择题（14个理论类、11个案例类）研究八字中"懂规则"与"会应用"的差距，评测六个系统，发现理论准确率普遍高于案例准确率。
AI.motivation: 掌握领域规则不等于能将其应用到具体案例，论文试图在传统中国八字领域验证这一"知识-应用"鸿沟，并检验其是否比一般性案例推理缺陷更具特异性。
AI.method: 构建含14个理论类与11个案例类的3000道中文选择题基准，评测六个终端系统，主结果基于2492项模型辅助精炼集；并做DeepSeek原生/禁用配置的配对比较。
AI.result: 所有系统理论准确率均高于案例，剔除无效回答后差距达16.60–29.56个百分点；十二长生、纳音平均准确率约89.10%、88.62%，神煞基础75.96%；案例中运势平均84.62%，而事业、家庭关系仅36.98%、38.19%。原生配置在理论上有+6.53/+12.20点提升，案例变化为-3.67/+1.27点。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对文化领域应用进行任务特异性评测，而非依赖聚合知识分数；但基准衡量的是与模型生成并验证的答案键的一致性，非现实预测效度，且最终结果属于事后筛选描述，受溯源不完整与专家验证不足限制。

title: EMBER-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-Event Causal Memory in Long-Horizon Embodied Tasks
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. The first two authors contributed equally. Project page: https://zhaoalexgoat.github.io/EMBER-Bench/
summary: Lifelong physical agents must reason over extended interactions where past events continue to shape the world long after they disappear from view. Beyond recalling what happened, agents must infer how history changes the current state and constrains future actions. Yet existing embodied and video-memory benchmarks largely focus on historical retrieval and summary, leaving such history-dependent causal reasoning underexplored. We introduce EMBER-Bench, an egocentric benchmark for cross-event causal reasoning in long-horizon embodied tasks, for which we newly created the task design, video recording, and data annotation. It contains 189 household tasks and 699 QA pairs, spanning task progress, failure recovery, external interventions, and compound long-horizon tasks with distant dependencies and prerequisites, with fine-grained event and causal-chain annotations. EMBER-Bench evaluates reasoning in both directions: next-action prediction selects the next action from history, and causal traceback, given that action, identifies the historical event that makes it necessary. Input ablations that add action logs or privileged cause-and-consequence annotations to the video indicate which kind of historical information models fail to use. Among the 16 evaluated models, the highest overall accuracy is 61.2%, compared with a mean of 98.3% across two human evaluators. At paired decision points, correct traceback is not associated with correct next-action prediction. Adding action logs yields a gain of 1.6 points, whereas cause-and-consequence annotations yield an additional gain of 13.0 points on top of that. These results suggest that extracting causal information from past events and converting it into constraints on current actions remains a key difficulty for long-horizon embodied agents. Project Page: https://zhaoalexgoat.github.io/EMBER-Bench/

AI.tldr: 提出EMBER-Bench，首个面向长时程具身任务中跨事件因果推理的自我中心基准，含189任务/699 QA对；16个模型最高仅61.2%，远低于人类98.3%，揭示模型难以将过去事件的因果信息转化为对当前动作的约束。
AI.motivation: 终身具身智能体需在长时间交互中推理历史如何改变当前状态并约束未来动作，但现有具身与视频记忆基准多聚焦历史检索与总结，忽视依赖历史的因果推理。
AI.method: 构建EMBER-Bench基准：新设计任务、录制视频、标注数据，含189个家庭任务与699个QA对，覆盖任务进展、失败恢复、外部干预及带远距离依赖与前置条件的复合长时程任务，并提供细粒度事件与因果链标注。评估双向推理：下一动作预测与因果回溯；并通过输入消融（加入动作日志、因果标注）分析模型缺乏哪类历史信息。
AI.result: 16个模型中最高总体准确率61.2%，两名人类评估者平均98.3%。配对决策点上，正确回溯与正确下一动作预测不相关。加入动作日志提升1.6点，再加因果标注额外提升13.0点。
AI.conclusion: 从过去事件中提取因果信息并将其转化为对当前动作的约束，仍是长时程具身智能体的关键难点。

title: The Numerical Linear Algebra of Large Language Models
summary:
Numerical Linear Algebra (NLA) has consistently played a vital role in advancing science by providing tools to solve fundamental problems encountered in scientific and engineering applications. Over the decades, it has continually evolved to meet the demands driven by successive waves of scientific discovery. For instance, during the 1950s and 1960s, substantial efforts were devoted to developing methods for solving eigenvalue problems that emerged from the rapidly growing field of aerodynamics. This led to the discovery of the LR and QR algorithms. Later the attention turned to the solution of sparse linear systems that were common in applications like computational aerodynamics. Today we are experiencing yet another wave of major scientific advancement and NLA is once more at the heart of its development. This Machine Learning (ML) wave is proving to be utterly disruptive in science and engineering. Many tools in ML particularly Large Language Models (LLMs) are grounded in matrix and tensor methods. As we are approaching Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), it is clear that matrix methods will be called to play an even more significant role. For the numerical linear practitioner the speed of the current change makes it particularly challenging to adapt.
  This is a survey article that centers on machine learning techniques, with a particular focus on large language models. It has two main objectives. The first is to clarify the core concepts behind Large Language Models in a manner accessible to specialists in numerical methods. The second is to examine the key Numerical Linear Algebra concepts employed by LLM techniques, while also highlighting several significant recent contributions of NLA to the field.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，旨在向数值线性代数专家介绍大语言模型的核心概念，并探讨NLA与LLM技术的相互关联。
AI.motivation: 数值线性代数（NLA）历来推动科学发展，从气动学的特征值问题（LR/QR算法）到稀疏线性系统。当前机器学习浪潮（尤其是LLM）同样由矩阵/张量方法支撑，逼近AGI时矩阵方法将更重要，但变化速度对NLA研究者构成挑战。
AI.method: 综述性文章，聚焦机器学习技术特别是大语言模型。目标一：以NLA专家可理解的方式阐明LLM核心概念；目标二：审视LLM技术所采用的关键NLA概念，并突出NLA在该领域的近期贡献。
AI.result: 论文为综述，未提出新实验结果，而是梳理LLM概念与NLA方法的对应关系，并总结NLA近期的若干重要贡献。
AI.conclusion: NLA与LLM紧密交织，NLA研究者需适应这一快速变革；该综述为NLA专家进入LLM领域提供了桥梁。

title: Learning to Clarify Underspecified Intents Under Limited Interaction
summary: AI assistants receive requests that leave out information needed for a good outcome, for example about users' preferences or goals. They must then either speculate or ask for more information before proceeding. We reconceptualize this as a value-of-information problem: the assistant should acquire information whose absence causes the greatest avoidable loss in user utility. This is rarely known ex ante; rather, assistants must predict it in order to optimally allocate limited user interactions. We instantiate this problem in image generation and derive a reinforcement learning framework using multi-turn simulated users to maximize utility recovery under uncertainty. In a preregistered study with 456 interactive sessions across 76 human participants, this helped users significantly better match reference images with significantly fewer questions, less total interaction time, and lower cost. This points toward a simple and scalable framework for training language model assistants to better disambiguate user intent by asking more informative questions.

AI.tldr: 将AI助手的追问重构成"信息价值"问题，用强化学习+多轮模拟用户训练助手问最关键的问题。在图像生成任务、456次交互实验中发现：能更准确匹配参考图，且提问更少、耗时更短、成本更低。
AI.motivation: 用户请求常缺失偏好、目标等关键信息，助手只能猜测或追问。而"哪些信息的缺失造成最大效用损失"往往事先未知，因此需要预测信息价值，以最优分配有限的用户交互次数。
AI.method: 在图像生成任务中实例化该问题，构建强化学习框架，使用多轮模拟用户，在不确定性下最大化效用恢复（utility recovery）。
AI.result: 预注册研究，涵盖76名被试、456次交互会话。相比基线，助手帮助用户显著更好地匹配参考图像，同时提问数显著更少、总交互时间更短、成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 提出一个简单且可扩展的框架，用于训练语言模型助手通过提出更有信息量的提问来更好地澄清用户意图。

title: Spend Bytes on Breadth: Precision-Count Trade-offs for Decode-Time KV Compression in Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Reasoning models write most of their KV cache while decoding long chains of thought (CoT), so the cache has to be compressed online under a fixed memory budget. Decode-time methods mostly decide which tokens to evict. We ask how a fixed byte budget should be split between the number of cached tokens and their precision. BreadthKV spends the bytes on more tokens at low precision, combining quantization with eviction, and picks the bit-width for each model and budget with a 60-problem end-to-end calibration, since offline attention error does not predict it reliably. On three reasoning models and four math and science benchmarks, it scores above eviction alone in 17 of 18 settings and produces shorter outputs. Much of what eviction loses comes from derailed runs, which keep reasoning until the length cap without reaching an answer. On Qwen3-8B at our tightest budget, eviction sends 91% of AIME samples to the cap and BreadthKV 40%. Under the same protocol, BreadthKV is statistically indistinguishable from a joint rate-distortion allocator (RDKV) that uses 27% more KV memory-time, and it outperforms our re-implementation of ThinKV.

AI.tldr: BreadthKV在固定字节预算下将KV缓存字节更多分配给token数量（低精度），结合量化与驱逐，通过端到端校准选择比特宽度，在推理任务中优于仅驱逐方法。
AI.motivation: 推理模型在解码长思维链时产生大量KV缓存，需在固定内存预算下在线压缩。现有解码时方法主要决定驱逐哪些token，但未探究固定字节预算应如何在缓存token数量与其精度之间分配。
AI.method: 提出BreadthKV：将字节预算花在更多低精度token上，结合量化与驱逐；针对每个模型和预算，用60问题端到端校准选择比特宽度（因离线注意力误差无法可靠预测）。
AI.result: 在3个推理模型和4个数学/科学基准上，18个设置中17个优于仅驱逐，且输出更短。最紧预算下Qwen3-8B上AIME样本达长度上限比例：驱逐91% vs BreadthKV 40%。与使用多27% KV内存时间的联合率失真分配器RDKV统计不可区分，并优于其ThinKV复现。
AI.conclusion: 固定字节预算应优先用于更多低精度token而非高精度少token；BreadthKV有效减少脱轨运行，在同等或更少内存下达到接近最优分配器的性能。

title: Look Where You Say You're Looking: Self-Grounded Attention for Visual Reasoning
summary: We introduce Self-Saliency, a method for training Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to increase the alignment between their visual attention and the image regions mentioned in their reasoning. Self-Saliency uses a grounding model to localize the objects mentioned in each reasoning step and treats the resulting areas as supervision for the model's visual attention. Previous work on steering visual attention determines target image regions based solely on the image and question. In contrast, we show that conditioning the target regions on the model's generated reasoning improves downstream performance. For proper evaluation, we build a unified, broad suite of 25 visual reasoning benchmarks, where we reproduce the results of previous methods. We find that Self-Saliency significantly outperforms both prior attention-steering methods and baselines that ground image-level text, achieving both a better average rank and a better mean score. Post-training analysis shows that the model primarily adapts its reasoning text to existing attention patterns, producing shorter steps that refer to larger regions. Nevertheless, when controlling for generated text, attention to grounded regions increases significantly across the relevant layer. Finally, we identify a consistent geometric bias in VLM visual attention toward the image border. However, our ablations show that Self-Saliency's gains cannot be explained by simply aligning attention with the center of the image, highlighting the importance of aligning visual attention with the regions mentioned in the model's reasoning.

AI.tldr: Self-Saliency：用 grounding 模型定位推理步骤提到的区域作为视觉注意力监督，训练 VLM 提升视觉-语言对齐，在 25 个基准上优于既有注意力引导方法和基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉注意力引导方法仅基于图像与问题确定目标区域，忽略了模型生成推理中的文本信息；本文想让注意力目标区域以模型自身推理为条件。
AI.method: 用 grounding 模型对每个推理步骤中提到的物体进行定位，将定位区域作为模型视觉注意力的监督信号训练 VLM；并构建包含 25 个视觉推理基准的统一评测套件，复现前人方法结果。
AI.result: Self-Saliency 显著优于先前注意力引导方法及图像级文本 grounding 基线，平均排名与平均分均更好；训练后模型主要让推理文本适应已有注意力模式（步骤更短、指向区域更大），但在控制生成文本后，相关层对 grounded 区域的注意力显著提升；还发现 VLM 注意力存在朝图像边缘的几何偏置，消融表明收益不能仅由对齐图像中心解释。
AI.conclusion: 以模型推理为条件对齐视觉注意力确实有效，收益源于对齐推理中提到的区域而非简单的注意力中心化或边缘偏置修正。

title: Policy as Data: Replay-Based Policy Dual Averaging via Advantage Regression
summary: Actor-critic methods reuse past experience to improve sample efficiency. However, historical data are typically regarded as off-policy samples for the current policy-improvement update. This work introduces Regularized Dual Averaging Actor Critic (RDA2C), which assigns a distinct role to replay. In regularized dual averaging, the subsequent policy is determined by accumulated policy-improvement feedback, so historical advantage estimates contribute directly to the actor objective rather than solely to the most recent update. RDA2C stores state-action samples with critic-estimated advantage labels, fits a dual score model $Z_θ$ to the aggregated dataset, and derives the current policy from the accumulated score model using the entropy mirror map. In this way, replay defines an empirical dual objective from which the policy is computed. To analyze RDA2C, we establish a finite-time value-gap decomposition, separating the regularized dual-averaging term from errors due to stale-replay supervised fitting, critic bias, finite-buffer variance, and replay coverage, and stating the assumptions under which each error is bounded. RDA2C accepts advantage labels from any critic. With GAE labels, RDA2C outperforms PPO on six of eight MuJoCo tasks and eight of twelve Atari games. RDA2C also outperforms AAPDA, the closest dual-averaging baseline, on six of eight MuJoCo tasks. With twin-$Q$ labels, RDA2C matches SAC at matched batch size and update frequency.

AI.tldr: 提出 RDA2C，将回放缓冲视为经验对偶目标，用正则化对偶平均让历史优势估计直接累积到 actor 目标中，理论上有有限时间价值差分解，实验在 MuJoCo/Atari 上超越 PPO、AAPDA，与 SAC 持平。
AI.motivation: Actor-critic 复用历史经验提升样本效率，但现有方法通常把历史数据当作当前策略改进的 off-policy 样本，只服务于最近一次更新，未充分利用历史优势信息。
AI.method: RDA2C：用正则化对偶平均，使策略由累积的策略改进反馈决定；存储带 critic 估计优势标签的 state-action 样本，拟合对偶得分模型 Z_θ 到聚合数据集，再通过熵镜像映射导出当前策略。回放定义了经验对偶目标，接受任意 critic 的优势标签（如 GAE、twin-Q）。
AI.result: 建立有限时间价值差分解，将正则化对偶平均项与陈旧回放监督拟合、critic 偏差、有限缓冲方差、回放覆盖等误差分离，并给出各项有界的假设。GAE 标签下在 8 个 MuJoCo 中 6 个、12 个 Atari 中 8 个超过 PPO；在 6/8 MuJoCo 上超过 AAPDA；twin-Q 标签下在匹配 batch size 和更新频率时与 SAC 持平。
AI.conclusion: RDA2C 通过把回放重新定义为对偶目标的经验来源，使历史优势直接贡献于 actor 目标，兼顾样本效率与理论可分析性，并在连续与离散控制任务上取得有竞争力的性能。

title: PyINE: A Framework for Scalable Elicitation and Oversight via Code Execution
summary: Reasoning models can remain capable of solving a task while still defaulting to cheaper but misleading shortcuts. This creates a central oversight problem: when a model gives an answer with plausible but incomplete reasoning, can an overseer determine whether that output should be trusted? To study this problem, we introduce PyINE, a framework for scalable elicitation and oversight using instrumented Python programs as a verifiable execution substrate. In PyINE, programs define task environments, execution traces provide authoritative labels for outcomes and intermediate facts, and task variants can be generated mechanically rather than through static human annotation. We instantiate the framework in PyINE-v1, a first release built from nearly one million deterministic execution traces and over 500,000 matched LLM-generated code variants used for counterfactual evaluation. Using standard RL with verifiable rewards on cue-varied tasks, we train a shortcut-following model that improves substantially at predicting execution outcomes while still making systematic errors when misleading human-facing cues conflict with the program's realized behavior. We then evaluate activation probes, trained text classifiers, prompted judges, and a lightweight debate protocol as overseers of this model. We find that performance pooled at the dataset level can hide weak coverage of the failures that matter most: cheap learned overseers often miss rare shortcut-driven errors, while stronger model-based checks are more balanced but substantially costlier and harder to turn into reliable thresholded decisions. PyINE-v1 turns this failure-mode coverage problem into a reusable experimental setting for developing oversight methods that are verifiable, failure-mode-aware, and cost-sensitive.

AI.tldr: 提出 PyINE 框架，利用可执行 Python 程序作为可验证的执行基座，通过近百万条执行迹和50万+代码变体评测监督方法，揭示数据集级聚合性能会掩盖监督者对关键shortcut错误的覆盖不足。
AI.motivation: 推理模型可能仍具解题能力，却默认采用更廉价但具误导性的shortcut；当答案看似合理但推理不完整时，监督者难以判断该输出是否可信。
AI.method: PyINE 用 instrumented Python 程序定义任务环境，执行迹提供权威标签，任务变体机械生成而非静态人工标注。实例化 PyINE-v1（约100万确定性执行迹、50万+匹配的 LLM 生成代码变体）做反事实评估；用标准 RL 与可验证奖励在带线索任务上训练一个 shortcut-following 模型，再以激活探针、文本分类器、提示式裁判和轻量辩论协议作为监督者进行评测。
AI.result: 训练模型在预测执行结果上有显著提升，但当误导性人类线索与程序实际行为冲突时仍犯系统性错误。廉价学习型监督者常漏掉罕见的 shortcut 驱动错误；更强的模型化检查更平衡但成本高、且难以转化为可靠阈值决策。
AI.conclusion: PyINE-v1 将失效模式覆盖问题转化为可复用实验环境，支持开发可验证、感知失效模式且成本敏感的监督方法。

title: MedicalHarness: A Controlled Evaluation of LLMs and Agent Harnesses on Medical Tasks
summary: LLM agents are increasingly built for medical work and scored on clinical benchmarks. Each such score, however, comes from a model running inside an agent harness, the system that controls the loop between the model and its environment. An agent's score is therefore a property of a model--harness pair. For medical agents, how much outcomes change with the harness has rarely been measured. Measuring this change, and explaining it, raises two challenges. First, a harness comparison must change nothing but the harness and be repeated across models and kinds of task. Second, comparing whole harnesses leaves their mechanisms bundled together, so it cannot show when an individual mechanism helps. To address these challenges, we present MedicalHarness, a controlled study of models and agent harnesses on medical tasks. We first build MedicalHarnessBench to evaluate agents on $107$ tasks across four domains that each test a different harness capability. Using this benchmark, we run five open-weight models under five agent harnesses, changing only the harness within a comparison, and analyze both outcomes and execution traces. To study individual mechanisms, we build MH-Lab, a controlled harness that switches off context management, planning or tool exposure one at a time within a shared execution loop. We find that the harness and its interaction with the model account for about a quarter of the outcome variance, and that no single harness is best across models and tasks. Code and data are available at https://github.com/REAL-Lab-NU/MedicalHarness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedicalHarness，通过构建基准MedicalHarnessBench和受控harness MH-Lab，系统研究agent harness对医疗LLM agent表现的影响，发现harness及其与模型的交互约占结果方差的四分之一，且无单一最优harness。
AI.motivation: 医疗LLM agent的评分实际上来自"模型+harness"组合，但harness对结果的影响在医疗领域很少被量化；同时比较整个harness无法揭示单个机制的作用，因此需要一个只改变harness、跨模型跨任务且能拆解机制的受控研究。
AI.method: 构建MedicalHarnessBench（107个任务，覆盖四个测不同harness能力的领域）；在5个开源权重模型×5个agent harness下运行，仅改变harness并分析结果与执行轨迹；另构建MH-Lab受控harness，在共享执行循环中逐一关闭上下文管理、规划或工具暴露机制。
AI.result: harness及其与模型的交互约占结果方差的四分之一；没有任何单一harness在所有模型和任务上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 医疗agent的表现是模型与harness的共同属性，harness选择及机制设计对结果有实质影响，需针对性选择而非依赖单一最优方案；代码与数据已开源。

title: LightVLN: Efficient Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation with Compact Memory and History-Guided Local Aggregation
summary: Aerial vision-and-language navigation (VLN) enables unmanned aerial vehicles to execute long-horizon natural-language instructions from visual observations in complex three-dimensional environments. However, recent aerial VLN models often rely on large-scale vision-language backbones and dense visual histories, imposing substantial computation and memory costs that hinder onboard deployment. We propose LightVLN, a lightweight history-aware aerial VLN framework that combines a compact 0.5B language backbone with compact representations of both historical and current observations. LightVLN compresses each historical frame into a single token using visual features already computed by the policy. It further introduces history- and instruction-conditioned local aggregation to reduce the current observation from 256 to 32 visual tokens while preserving navigation-relevant spatial information. With up to 16 historical frames, the policy uses at most 48 observation-derived tokens. On the public OpenFly dataset, LightVLN achieves 50.93% Test-Seen and 36.14% Test-Unseen success rates (SR), outperforming the evaluated 7B language-backbone baselines on most reported metrics. It also achieves 25.83% SR on AerialVLN-S Val-Seen. In a reconstructed unseen campus, we deploy LightVLN on a DJI M350 RTK with an external Jetson Orin NX 16 GB for closed-loop onboard-compute real-to-sim hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) evaluation, achieving 14.61 Hz model inference and 11.13 Hz end-to-end decision updates. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of LightVLN for aerial navigation.

AI.tldr: LightVLN 是一个轻量级、历史感知的空中视觉-语言导航框架，用 0.5B 语言骨干和紧凑的观测表示，在保证性能的同时显著降低计算与显存开销。
AI.motivation: 现有空中 VLN 模型依赖大规模视觉-语言骨干和密集的视觉历史，计算与内存开销大，难以在无人机等设备上部署。
AI.method: 采用紧凑的 0.5B 语言骨干；将每帧历史压缩为单个 token（复用策略已计算的视觉特征）；引入历史与指令条件下的局部聚合，将当前观测从 256 个视觉 token 降到 32 个；最多 16 帧历史时，观测相关 token 不超过 48 个。
AI.result: 在 OpenFly 数据集上取得 50.93% Test-Seen 和 36.14% Test-Unseen 成功率，多数指标超过所评估的 7B 骨干基线；AerialVLN-S Val-Seen 上 SR 为 25.83%。在重建的未见校园中，部署于 DJI M350 RTK + Jetson Orin NX 16 GB，实现 14.61 Hz 模型推理和 11.13 Hz 端到端决策更新。
AI.conclusion: LightVLN 在空中导航中兼顾了有效性与效率，验证了其面向机载部署的可行性和实用性。

title: Revisiting the Generalization of Neural Graph Edit Distance Models
summary: Neural approaches to Graph Edit Distance (GED) have achieved strong results under standard within-dataset evaluation, but much less is known about how well these models transfer across graph collections. We conduct a systematic study of this problem using exact GED supervision across diverse graph datasets and a broad set of representative learning-based methods. Our results reveal a pronounced gap between within-collection performance and cross-collection transfer. Models that perform well on their training collections often lose this advantage when evaluated on structurally different data. Training on multiple source collections substantially improves zero-shot transfer and provides a better starting point when limited supervision is available for a new target collection. Further analysis shows that transfer behavior varies with the source--target direction and the structural characteristics of the collections involved. These findings suggest that conventional within-collection evaluation provides only a partial view of the generalization behavior of neural GED models and motivate broader evaluation across heterogeneous graph collections.

AI.tldr: 本论文系统研究了神经图编辑距离(GED)模型在跨图集合上的迁移能力，发现其同分布性能与跨集合迁移性能存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 神经GED方法在同数据集评估下表现优异，但其跨图集合的迁移能力研究不足，需系统评估其泛化性。
AI.method: 使用精确GED监督，在多个多样化图数据集上，对代表性学习方法进行系统性的跨集合迁移研究。
AI.result: 发现同集合性能与跨集合迁移之间存在明显鸿沟；多源训练能显著提升零样本迁移，并为新目标集合的少样本学习提供更好起点；迁移行为随源-目标方向和结构特征而变。
AI.conclusion: 传统同集合评估仅提供神经GED模型泛化性的局部视角，需在异构图集合上进行更广泛的评估。

title: Toward a Locally Deployable Agentic Co-Scientist: Small-Model Planning for Early-Stage Drug Discovery
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the AI for Drug Discovery Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Early-stage computational drug discovery requires coordinating heterogeneous scientific tools across multi-step workflows. We present a lightweight, tool-augmented framework in which a locally deployable compact language model plans calls to 18 modular tools. A Unified Molecular Schema maintains shared molecular records, while a plug-in interface supports tool replacement and extension. We construct 1,263 manually refined query-plan pairs through workflow-graph path coverage and apply LoRA fine-tuning to three compact model families. Under the query-level split, all fine-tuned models generate fully parseable and schema-compliant plans on 47 held-out cross-group queries. Llama 3.2-3B achieves a tool-selection F1 of 0.998, sequence exact match of 0.979, and argument F1 of 0.960. Under the stricter workflow-grouped split, which excludes identical ordered tool sequences across partitions, sequence exact match reaches 0.452 to 0.548, highlighting the remaining difficulty for compact models in generating complete workflow paths unseen during training. These results demonstrate the feasibility of compact, locally deployable planning while identifying compositional generalization as an important direction for further improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量工具增强框架，用本地小模型规划18个模块化药物发现工具的调用，LoRA微调后在小样本上规划几乎完美，但组合泛化仍困难。
AI.motivation: 早期计算药物发现需协调异构工具完成多步工作流，需一个轻量、可本地部署的规划框架。
AI.method: 构建统一分子Schema与插件式接口，含18个工具；通过工作流图路径覆盖构造1,263条人工精炼查询-计划对；对三个小模型家族进行LoRA微调。
AI.result: 查询级划分下，微调模型在47条跨组查询上均生成可解析且符合Schema的计划；Llama 3.2-3B工具选择F1 0.998、序列精确匹配0.979、参数F1 0.960。更严格的工作流分组划分下，序列精确匹配降至0.452–0.548。
AI.conclusion: 验证了紧凑本地部署规划的可行性，组合泛化（生成训练中未见完整工作流路径）是重要改进方向。

title: CLARA: Can AI Assess Developmental Appropriateness in Children's Stories?
summary: Assessing the developmental suitability of children's narratives is important for educational recommendation and developmental literacy research, yet such assessment typically relies on subjective and difficult-to-scale human judgment. This raises an important question: Can AI systems approximate human developmental judgments of children's stories? To study this problem, we introduce CLARA, a cognitively grounded framework for developmental narrative understanding through structured annotation across cognitive (COG), language (LAN), and social-emotional (SEL) dimensions, together with a bilingual benchmark resource containing 1107 Chinese--English children's stories with normalized silver developmental references and structured developmental annotations. We evaluate CLARA through benchmark comparison, component analysis, translated bilingual consistency analysis, and blinded human evaluation with educators. Experimental results show that structured developmental annotation achieves substantially stronger alignment with developmental references and human judgments than readability-based methods and direct prompting baselines. Overall, our findings suggest that AI systems can approximate certain aspects of human developmental judgment when guided by structured developmental annotation, while also highlighting the importance of interpretability and human oversight in educational NLP.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CLARA框架，通过结构化标注（认知、语言、社会情感三维度）评估儿童叙事发展适宜性，并构建1107篇中英双语故事基准，实验表明结构化标注比可读性方法和直接提示更贴近人类发展判断。
AI.motivation: 儿童叙事的发展适宜性评估对教育推荐和读写发展研究很重要，但传统评估依赖主观且难以规模化的人类判断。核心问题是：AI系统能否近似人类对儿童故事的发展性判断？
AI.method: 提出CLARA——一个认知基础的发展性叙事理解框架，基于认知（COG）、语言（LAN）、社会情感（SEL）三维度进行结构化标注；并构建含1107篇中英儿童故事的双语基准资源，含标准化银标注发展参考和结构化发展标注。通过基准比较、组件分析、翻译双语一致性分析和教育者盲评进行评估。
AI.result: 结构化发展标注在与发展参考和人类判断的对齐上，显著优于基于可读性的方法和直接提示基线。
AI.conclusion: 在结构化发展标注引导下，AI系统可近似人类发展判断的某些方面，同时凸显教育NLP中可解释性与人类监督的重要性。

title: Triggering Generalist Reasoning via Predictive Uncertainty for Dual-System VLA
summary: Dual-system Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models improve real-time robotic control by pairing a slow, reasoning-capable generalist with a fast specialist action expert. However, existing methods invoke the generalist at a fixed frequency, ignoring the fact that decision-making complexity varies throughout a rollout. This static strategy wastes computation in easy phases and can delay renewed reasoning when the scene changes unexpectedly. We propose TUD (Triggering generalist reasoning via predictive Uncertainty for Dual-system VLA), an adaptive inference framework that selectively skips unnecessary generalist calls. TUD measures the cross-step dispersion of action re-predictions at the upcoming chunk slot under the cached generalist context, as a predictive uncertainty signal. This signal captures how much the future action plan shifts as new observations arrive and is computed from forwards the architecture already runs, requiring neither manual phase labels nor an auxiliary uncertainty model. On VLA-Arena, it achieves a higher success rate at matched call budgets than alternative uncertainty baselines while maintaining low wall-clock overhead, and more consistently separates successful from failed rollouts. Also, TUD finds a more favorable cost-success trade-off than non-adaptive baselines, tracing an entire operating curve as a single threshold is varied, and substantially reduces VLM calls at matched success rate. The same trade-off appears in our real-robot experiments, where TUD cuts generalist calls by 75% relative to the strongest fixed-interval baseline while achieving an even higher success rate. Our results suggest that predictive uncertainty provides a practical criterion for adaptive reasoning in efficient VLA control.

AI.tldr: 提出TUD框架，通过预测不确定性自适应触发双系统VLA中的通才推理，减少不必要调用。
AI.motivation: 现有双系统VLA以固定频率调用通才，忽视了决策复杂度随时间变化，造成简单阶段算力浪费、场景突变时推理延迟。
AI.method: 用缓存通才上下文下即将到来的chunk位置的行动重预测跨步离散度作为预测不确定性信号，自适应跳过不必要的通才调用；无需人工阶段标签或额外不确定性模型。
AI.result: VLA-Arena上在相同调用预算下成功率更高、墙钟开销低；更好区分成功与失败rollout；在成本-成功率权衡上优于非自适应基线；相同成功率下显著减少VLM调用；真机实验减少75%通才调用且成功率更高。
AI.conclusion: 预测不确定性为高效VLA控制中的自适应推理提供了实用准则。

title: Gated Target Propagation for Compositional Generalization in Continual Learning
summary: Continual learning is typically framed as acquiring new knowledge without catastrophically forgetting previous tasks. However, a flexible continual learner should also be able to reuse and recombine previously acquired knowledge to rapidly solve novel task compositions. We introduce Gated Target Propagation (GaTaP), a continual learning algorithm in which task-specific gating variables---learned through a closed-form inner loop update---selectively suppress or enhance network modules. Network parameters are learned in a slower timescale outer loop, using the same local difference target propagation error signal as is used for adapting gating variables. We provide tractable experiments on class-incremental learning scenarios for both multilayer perceptron and convolutional network architectures. We show strong performance retention on previously learned tasks, as well as compositional generalization to unseen tasks, achieved through few-shot gain adaptation at inference. We analyze learned gating patterns and find that related tasks exhibit similar gating patterns, suggesting that inferred gates capture meaningful, reusable task structure. Overall, GaTaP provides a powerful framework for jointly ameliorating catastrophic forgetting and enabling few-shot compositional generalization in neural network models.

AI.tldr: GaTaP：通过门控变量选择性调制网络模块的持续学习方法，兼顾抗灾难性遗忘和组合泛化。
AI.motivation: 灵活持续学习器不仅需避免遗忘旧任务，还应能复用重组已学知识以快速解决新任务组合。
AI.method: 引入任务特定的门控变量，通过闭式内循环更新选择性抑制或增强网络模块；网络参数在外循环以较慢时间尺度学习，内外循环共用局部差分目标传播误差信号。
AI.result: 在MLP和CNN的类增量学习实验中，旧任务保持性强，且通过推理时少样本门控自适应实现对新任务组合的组合泛化；相似任务的显著门控模式相似。
AI.conclusion: GaTaP能同时缓解灾难性遗忘并实现少样本组合泛化，门控捕捉了可复用的任务结构。

title: Formalizing the Moral Evaluation of Speech Acts: Truthfulness, Lies and Ethical Dilemmas
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 27th International Conference on Principles and Practice of Multi-Agent Systems (PRIMA 2026). Kumamoto, Japan
summary: In life-or-death situations, a benevolent lie may appear more moral than telling the truth. Yet such lies can backfire, producing unintended and sometimes fatal consequences. This tension, famously disputed by Kant and Constant in 1797, applies not only to lying but to assertive speech acts in general, raising the question of which utterance should be chosen when moral stakes are high. We present a logical framework for the ethical evaluation of speech-act utterances based on agents' beliefs. Implemented in Answer Set Programming (ASP), the framework assesses utterances under deontologism, consequentialism, and principialism, and is illustrated on Sartre's The Wall (1939), a reworking of that controversy in which lying leads alternately to rescue and to death. Our setting is general by design: as two variants show, accommodating a new moral situation amounts to adjusting parameters, not rules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于行动者信念的言语行为伦理评估逻辑框架，用ASP实现，在义务论、后果论和原则主义下评估话语，并以萨特《墙》为例展示。
AI.motivation: 在生死情境中，善意谎言可能显得更道德，但也可能带来致命后果。这一康德与康斯坦的争论不仅关乎说谎，也关乎所有断言性言语行为，因此需要回答：道德代价高昂时应选择哪句话。
AI.method: 构建基于行动者信念的言语行为伦理论逻辑框架，并在Answer Set Programming中实现；框架可在义务论、后果论和原则主义三种伦理立场下评估言语行为；以萨特《墙》为案例进行说明，并通过两个变体检验其一般性。
AI.result: 框架成功评估了《墙》中谎言分别导致救援与死亡的情境；两个变体表明，适配新的道德情境只需调整参数，而无需修改规则。
AI.conclusion: 该设定具有通用性：言语行为的伦理评估可以形式化，并且在新增道德情境中仅需参数调整即可扩展。

title: Adaptive Utilization of Low-Rank Adaptation via Conditioned Gating
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) achieves parameter-efficient fine-tuning by constraining model updates to a low-rank subspace and has been widely used in practice. However, LoRA typically employs a shared low-rank update across tokens, which limits its ability to fully exploit the adaptation subspace for tokens from different sequences. To address this issue, we propose an adaptive utilization of Low-Rank Adaptation (U-LoRA), which employs conditioned gating to explicitly learn effective token-level utilization of the limited low-rank adaptation subspace. Specifically, U-LoRA generates utilization coefficients along low-rank directions for each token and jointly coordinates and constrains them using sequence-level contextual information, thereby inducing more consistent adaptive patterns within a sentence. To further enhance training stability, we introduce a bias-corrected exponential moving average (EMA) historical prior that calibrates utilization signals across optimization steps, suppressing noise caused by batch-to-batch fluctuations. The effectiveness of our method arises from a better utilization of the existing low-rank subspace via input-conditioned strategies, rather than from expanding the subspace. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and natural language understanding benchmarks demonstrate that U-LoRA achieves competitive performance under comparable parameter budgets when with strong LoRA baselines and recent variants.

AI.tldr: 提出U-LoRA，通过条件门控为每个token生成沿低秩方向的利用系数，并结合序列级上下文与EMA历史先验，实现对LoRA低秩子空间的自适应token级利用，在数学推理和自然语言理解任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: LoRA在token间共享同一个低秩更新，限制了针对不同序列中不同token充分利用适应子空间的能力。
AI.method: U-LoRA使用条件门控为每个token生成沿低秩方向的利用系数，并用序列级上下文信息联合协调与约束这些系数，使句内模式更一致；同时引入偏差校正的EMA历史先验，跨优化步校准利用信号以抑制批间波动噪声。核心在于通过输入条件策略更好地利用已有低秩子空间，而非扩展子空间。
AI.result: 在数学推理与自然语言理解基准上，U-LoRA在可比参数预算下与强LoRA基线及近期变体相比取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过输入条件的token级自适应利用策略，可更充分地挖掘现有低秩子空间潜力，从而在不增加子空间规模的前提下提升LoRA微调效果。

title: GeoBridge-VLA: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models encode semantic information from vision-language pretraining, but manipulation also requires precise spatial reasoning. We present GeoBridge-VLA, a two-stage method for learning geometric features from a pretrained VLA's frozen visual encoder and using them for action prediction. Stage I trains a feature bridge and geometry decoder with depth supervision. Stage II freezes these modules and trains a gated residual interface together with the action-side projections and action expert. The residual augments the existing visual tokens without adding a second image encoder or increasing the token count. Deployment requires RGB, robot state, and language, but no depth observations. Under matched evaluation conditions, GeoBridge-VLA achieves 70.9% success on LIBERO, compared with 60.0% for SmolVLA. Disabling the residual in the same trained checkpoint reduces success from 70.90% to 69.85%, with mixed effects across suites. On a physical ROBOTIS OMY robot, GeoBridge-VLA succeeds in 148 of 200 trials (74.0%) across four tasks, compared with 108 of 200 (54.0%) for SmolVLA.

AI.tldr: GeoBridge-VLA通过两阶段方法从冻结的VLA视觉编码器中学习几何特征用于动作预测，在LIBERO和真实机器人上均超越SmolVLA。
AI.motivation: VLA模型具备视觉-语言预训练的语义能力，但操作任务还需要精确的空间推理，现有方法在几何特征利用上不足。
AI.method: 两阶段方法：Stage I用深度监督训练特征桥接与几何解码器；Stage II冻结这些模块，训练门控残差接口及动作侧投影与动作专家。残差增强视觉token，不增加第二编码器或token数量；部署仅需RGB、机器人状态和语言，无需深度。
AI.result: LIBERO成功率70.9%（SmolVLA为60.0%）；禁用残差后同检查点从70.90%降至69.85%，各套件效果不一。真实ROBOTIS OMY机器人四任务200次试验成功148次（74.0%），SmolVLA为108/200（54.0%）。
AI.conclusion: 从冻结视觉编码器提取几何特征并注入动作侧，可显著提升VLA操作性能且无需部署时深度输入。

title: Pareto-Improving Adversarial Attacks with Primal-Dual Regularization
summary: Transferable adversarial attacks are arguably the most practical black-box threat model. Under the same perturbation budget, stronger transfer attacks attain higher attack success rate (ASR), yet their imperceptibility also tends to degrade. Under such a fixed-budget protocol, transferability and imperceptibility therefore appear to trade off against each other. We argue that this conflict is an artifact of fixed-budget evaluation, not an intrinsic trade-off. When attacks are compared on the ASR--imperceptibility Pareto frontier obtained by sweeping $ε$, stronger transfer attacks already attain better imperceptibility at matched ASR than weaker ones. To exploit this latent advantage, we introduce the stealthy transfer attack ST, a plug-in primal-dual wrapper that adds an $L_\infty$ saturation regularizer to the standard constrained objective and resolves it through a two-step primal-dual update: a projected primal step on the perturbation coupled with an $L_1$-ball projection on a dual variable that absorbs the regularizer through Fenchel duality, requiring no auxiliary models or handcrafted perceptual priors. Empirically, ST extends the Pareto frontier across different base attacks and additional surrogate architectures. At $ε{=}16/255$, average imperceptibility gains over each base attack are $17\%$ on LPIPS and $14\%$ on NIQE while ASR is preserved or improved. At matched high-ASR levels, the strongest ST variants further Pareto-dominate dedicated stealth-oriented transfer attacks, confirming that the latent imperceptibility advantage of strong transfer attacks can be unlocked by a primal-dual optimization wrapper without sacrificing transferability. Code will be made available at \url{https://github.com/AndssY/ST}.

AI.tldr: 提出ST，一种即插即用的原对偶包装器，通过L∞饱和正则化解锁强迁移攻击的潜在隐蔽性，在保持迁移性的同时扩展ASR-不可感知性帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 固定扰动预算下，迁移性与不可感知性看似存在权衡：强迁移攻击ASR更高但隐蔽性更差。作者认为此冲突是固定预算评估造成的假象，而非本质权衡。
AI.method: ST在标准约束目标上加入L∞饱和正则项，用两步原对偶更新求解：扰动上的投影原步，配合对偶变量的L1球投影，通过Fenchel对偶吸收正则项，无需辅助模型或手工感知先验。
AI.result: 在ε=16/255时，相比各基础攻击LPIPS平均提升17%、NIQ​E提升14%，ASR保持或提升；在高ASR匹配水平下，最强ST变体进一步帕累托支配专用隐蔽迁移攻击。
AI.conclusion: 强迁移攻击的潜在不可感知性优势可通过原对偶优化包装器在不牺牲迁移性的前提下被释放。

title: Agentic discovery of blood biomarker from distilled private health records
summary: Routine complete blood counts (CBCs) could yield new biomarkers, but the private records needed to evaluate candidates cannot be shared with frontier language model agents that excel at discovery. We distilled the evidence held in the Clalit Health Services panel of over 5.4 million patients into a released scoring tool: for each of 13 immune-mediated diseases, a graph attention network was trained inside the data boundary to predict the case-control AUC of candidate CBC expressions, and only the trained weights were released. The tool grounds an agent's propose-score-refine loop in real-world data without exposing any patient data. In external validation, agent-discovered expressions improved on their literature-seeded starting points by a median of 4.18 AUC percentage points, and across three independent cohorts, reranking the candidates of three frontier research tools improved on their first choices in most comparisons, with gains that varied by cohort. The released scorer supports privacy-preserving biomarker hypothesis generation.

AI.tldr: 该研究将Clalit超540万患者的CBC证据蒸馏为可发布的评分工具（13种免疫介导疾病各一个图注意力网络），在不泄露原始数据的前提下让语言模型智能体在真实世界数据上做"提议-评分-优化"循环，智能体发现的CBC表达优于文献起点（AUC中位数提升4.18个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 常规全血细胞计数（CBC）可能蕴含新生物标志物，但评估候选指标所需的私人病历无法共享给擅长发现的前沿语言模型智能体，形成数据可用性与隐私保护之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 在数据边界内部训练图注意力网络，针对13种免疫介导疾病，预测候选CBC表达式的病例-对照AUC；仅发布训练好的权重作为评分工具，用于支撑智能体的"提议-评分-优化"循环。
AI.result: 外部验证中，智能体发现的表达式较文献启发的起点AUC中位数提升4.18个百分点；在三个独立队列中，对其候选重新排序多数比较优于三个前沿研究工具的初始选择，提升幅度因队列而异。
AI.conclusion: 发布的评分器支持隐私保护的生物标志物假设生成，实现了真实数据下的模型发现而不暴露任何患者数据。

title: Plan Canvas: Fixed Reasoning Regions for Continuous Language Flows
summary: Continuous language flows generate text by denoising all positions of a target canvas together. The natural way to add reasoning to such a model is to write a trace ahead of the answer, but the trace length changes from question to question. The answer start is therefore unknown during denoising, and the model has to decide the trace length, the place of every trace token, and the answer at the same time. We propose Plan Canvas to fix the boundary between the trace and the answer. A plan region of fixed capacity holds a compact trace, supervised padding fills its unused positions, and the answer starts at a fixed position. The fixed regions also allow separate denoising clocks for the plan and for the answer. With the trace text, backbone, and canvas length of the free-trace baseline held fixed, Plan Canvas improves accuracy on ProsQA and on Deep ProsQA, a graph benchmark with longer proofs. On Deep ProsQA, accuracy rises from 73.0\% to 87.0\%, the share of questions answered with a valid path rises from 30.8\% to 59.1\%, and the gain is largest on the longest proofs.

AI.tldr: 提出 Plan Canvas，通过固定 trace 与 answer 边界，解决连续语言流模型中 trace 长度可变导致答案起始位置未知的问题。
AI.motivation: 连续语言流模型同时去噪整个目标画布，若在答案前写推理 trace，trace 长度因问题而异，导致答案起始位置未知，模型需同时决定 trace 长度、每个 trace token 位置和答案，难度大。
AI.method: Plan Canvas 设置固定容量的 plan 区域存放紧凑 trace，用带监督的 padding 填充未用位置，答案从固定位置开始；固定区域还允许 plan 和 answer 使用独立的去噪时钟。实验中保持 trace 文本、backbone 和画布长度与 free-trace 基线一致。
AI.result: 在 ProsQA 上提升准确率；在 Deep ProsQA 上准确率从 73.0% 升至 87.0%，有效路径答题比例从 30.8% 升至 59.1%，且在最长证明上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 固定 trace 与答案边界能有效提升连续语言流模型的推理能力，尤其在长证明任务上效果显著。

title: SPACE-CLIPv2: Decoding Local Geometry from Frozen CLIP for Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Vision-language foundation models such as CLIP provide strong semantic representations, but their patch tokens are not directly optimized for dense metric geometry. SPACE-CLIP showed that frozen CLIP features can support monocular depth estimation through layer-group feature fusion, yet it leaves open how neighboring CLIP tokens should be combined to recover fine local structure. We present SPACE-CLIPv2, a frozen-backbone depth decoder that aggregates fixed local neighborhoods in CLIP token space. At selected decoder stages, the model samples a fixed token stencil, predicts aggregation weights, and injects the resulting response through a gated residual update. A token-space high-pass branch further preserves shallow local contrast. On NYU Depth V2, SPACE-CLIPv2 improves over a matched SPACE-CLIP baseline, while five-seed experiments consistently favor fixed over learned-offset sampling. Zero-shot iBims-1 evaluation further improves boundary and planar-geometry measures. These results support constrained local token aggregation as a practical mechanism for decoding geometry from frozen CLIP representations.

AI.tldr: 提出SPACE-CLIPv2，一种冻结CLIP骨干的深度解码器，通过在token空间聚合固定局部邻域来估计单目深度，并优于SPACE-CLIP基线。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉语言基础模型语义强，但其patch token未针对稠密度量几何优化；SPACE-CLIP虽证明冻结特征可支持深度估计，但未说明相邻token应如何组合以恢复细局部结构。
AI.method: 在选定解码阶段采样固定token模板（stencil），预测聚合权重，通过门控残差更新注入响应；并加入token空间高通分支保留浅层局部对比度。采用冻结骨干，对比固定与学习偏移采样。
AI.result: 在NYU Depth V2上优于匹配的SPACE-CLIP基线；五种子实验一致支持固定采样优于学习偏移采样；零样本iBims-1评测在边界与平面几何指标上进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 受限的局部token聚合是从冻结CLIP表示中解码几何的实用机制。

title: Path Laplacian Encodings for Directed Graphs
summary: Directed graphs naturally model many real-world systems in which interactions are asymmetric, such as citation networks, web graphs, and information-flow networks. However, graph learning methods commonly rely on message passing with symmetrized graph representations or positional encodings that only partially exploit edge directionality. We introduce PathLapPE, a novel spectral positional encoding (PE) derived from the path Laplacian on directed graphs. PathLapPE provides node- and edge-level features that encode directional higher-order structure and can be incorporated into standard graph learning architectures. Empirical results on node- and graph-level benchmark tasks show that PathLapPE yields consistent improvements across several architectures, especially when combined with direction-aware message passing. Compared with magnetic Laplacian positional encodings, a widely studied spectral positional encoding for directed graphs, PathLapPE does not require additional fine-tuning of directionality hyperparameters while offering competitive runtime and performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PathLapPE，一种基于有向图路径拉普拉斯算子（path Laplacian）的谱位置编码，可编码方向性高阶结构并融入标准图学习架构。
AI.motivation: 有向图广泛存在于引用网络、网页图和信息流网络中，但现有图学习方法多依赖对称化表示的消息传递或仅部分利用边方向的位置编码，方向信息利用不充分。
AI.method: 从有向图的路径拉普拉斯算子导出谱位置编码 PathLapPE，提供节点级和边级特征，编码方向性高阶结构，可插入标准图学习架构，尤其与方向感知消息传递结合。
AI.result: 在节点级和图级基准任务上，多种架构均获得一致提升，尤其与方向感知消息传递结合时更明显。相比 magnetic Laplacian 位置编码，PathLapPE 无需额外微调方向性超参数，且运行时间和性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: PathLapPE 是一种有效且易用的有向图谱位置编码，能充分挖掘方向性高阶结构，在性能与效率上相比现有方法具有优势。

title: Dynamic Routing as a New Dimension for Test-time Versatility of LLMs
summary: Beyond scaling their parameters and data, large language models currently gain versatility on new problems along a single axis: the tokens they spend on chain-of-thought (CoT). We investigate whether dynamic routing programs, which execute a subset of the model's layers or iterate some of them, can open a second axis of test-time adaptation, complementary to CoT and free of any gradient update. Prior work showed that such programs exist and bring accuracy and efficiency gains on problems similar to those they were trained on; we ask whether they can also be identified rapidly, from a handful of demonstrations (3 or 10), by a strategy that transfers across models and tasks without training. First, we find that strategies that select programs by the probability they assign to the demonstrations' labels, arbitrated by the model's own confidence, bring consistent gains: on average over the 49 tasks of MMLU and substantially on four of seven models, and most of all on far out-of-distribution tasks such as ARC-AGI, where programs double the accuracy of a 7B model whose CoT fails. Second, on MMLU across the seven post-trained models, routing complements CoT in practice: the two succeed on different queries, and their composition exceeds CoT alone. Despite these gains, our analyses show that confidence-based selection leaves much of the potential untapped, in two places in particular: (1) in surfacing the routing potential that is already present early in pre-training but becomes harder to select after post-training, and (2) in making models robust to the refinements routing introduces, since unsuccessful routes tend to drive the residual stream out of the distribution that the following layers expect. Together, our results point to dynamic routing as a paradigm for extending the plasticity of existing and future LLMs in rapid test-time adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文探究动态路由程序（执行或迭代部分层）能否作为CoT之外的第二条测试时自适应轴，无需梯度更新，仅用少量示例即可识别，并跨模型跨任务迁移。
AI.motivation: LLM目前仅通过CoT在token轴上获得新问题上的通用性；作者希望找到一种互补的、无需梯度更新的测试时自适应方式，探索动态路由是否能拓展模型可塑性。
AI.method: 研究基于少量演示（3或10个）快速识别路由程序的策略，采用按演示标签概率选择程序、并用模型自身置信度仲裁的无训练策略；在MMLU的49个任务及7个模型、ARC-AGI等分布外任务上评估，并分析路由与CoT的互补性及局限。
AI.result: 置信度仲裁的程序选择策略带来一致增益：MMLU上7个模型中有4个显著提升，ARC-AGI等OOD任务上程序使7B模型准确率翻倍（其CoT失败）；路由与CoT成功于不同查询，二者组合优于单独CoT。但分析显示，基于置信度的选择仍浪费大量潜力，尤其在后训练后难以选出早期预训练中的路由潜力，以及难以应对路由带来的残差流分布偏移导致的不成功路由。
AI.conclusion: 动态路由可作为扩展现有及未来LLM快速测试时自适应可塑性的新范式，与CoT互补，但需改进选择策略以充分释放潜力。

title: HLA: Expressive Hybrid Linear Attention via Chunk-Wise Dynamic Mixing
summary: Linear attention enables efficient long-context autoregressive decoding by compressing history into recurrent states, but this compression can make selective access to sparse and distant information difficult. Existing chunk-based extensions increase memory capacity, yet learned chunk-mixing coefficients may remain fixed with respect to input content and therefore cannot adapt historical access to each query. We introduce \emph{Hybrid Linear Attention} (HLA), a query-dependent chunk-level attention mechanism for Gated DeltaNet (GDN). HLA represents each completed chunk as an exact affine state transition and computes content-dependent routing gates from compact, self-attentively pooled representatives. Each gate interpolates the corresponding historical transition with the identity map, controlling both the chunk's additive memory and its transformation of earlier states. Effective-support regularization further encourages concentrated routing for sparse inference. We evaluate HLA under both pretrained adaptation and from-scratch training. Across Qwen3.5 models from 0.8B to 9B, HLA consistently improves over native GDN and fixed chunk mixing, with gains of up to 5.57 percentage points on LongBench-V2 and 3.97 points on RULER. In a controlled from-scratch 1.3B setting trained for 100B tokens with a 4K context, HLA also improves RULER performance from 4K to 32K, with gains increasing from 0.83 points at 4K to 4.22 points at 32K. These results demonstrate that query-dependent composition of recurrent memory improves long-context modeling and remains effective beyond the training context while using compact per-chunk affine summaries. Project page: https://caesarhhh.github.io/hla/

AI.tldr: 提出 Hybrid Linear Attention (HLA)，一种针对 Gated DeltaNet 的查询依赖型 chunk 级注意力机制，通过内容相关路由门控实现对历史信息的自适应访问，显著提升长上下文建模能力。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力将历史压缩为递归状态，但难以选择性访问稀疏且久远的信息。现有 chunk 方法虽提升记忆容量，但其 chunk 混合系数往往固定、不随输入内容变化，无法针对每个查询自适应访问历史。
AI.method: HLA 将每个完成的 chunk 表示为精确的仿射状态转移，并利用紧凑的自注意力池化代表计算内容相关的路由门。每个门在对应历史转移与恒等映射间插值，同时控制该 chunk 的加性记忆及其对更早状态的变换。此外引入有效支撑正则化，促进稀疏推理时的集中路由。
AI.result: 在预训练适配与从头训练两种设置下评估。Qwen3.5 模型（0.8B 至 9B）上，HLA 持续优于原生 GDN 和固定 chunk 混合，LongBench-V2 最高提升 5.57 个百分点，RULER 提升 3.97 点。在 1.3B 模型、100B token、4K 上下文的从头训练中，RULER 在 4K 至 32K 均提升，增益从 4K 的 0.83 点增至 32K 的 4.22 点。
AI.conclusion: 查询依赖的递归记忆组合能有效改善长上下文建模，且在使用紧凑的逐 chunk 仿射摘要时，其效果可超越训练上下文范围。

title: Code2Games: Enabling Coding Agents for Gaming World Generation
summary: Generating a high-quality gaming world from a natural-language game intent requires joint reasoning about scene structure, spatial layout, gameplay objectives, interactive entities, and executable gameplay logic. Existing coding agents can generate individual assets, scenes, or scripts, but often struggle to maintain consistency across these components. We propose Code2Games, an agentic framework that builds a structured gaming world upon a base Blender world generated from the same game intent. Code2Games coordinates scene analysis, gameplay planning, constrained gaming-world generation, and gaming-engine customization through a shared scene-gameplay representation with persistent element correspondence. After world generation, Code2Games adapts the generated world to Unreal Engine 5 and employs an execution-guided reconstruction process that uses compilation diagnostics, runtime feedback, and gameplay test results to resolve inconsistencies arising during engine adaptation. To systematically evaluate gaming-world generation, we introduce the GameCode4D benchmark, which comprises ten fixed game prompts spanning different levels of scene and gameplay complexity. We evaluate the generated results across four dimensions: visual quality, interactive fidelity, multimodal artifact quality, and playable-game quality. Experiments demonstrate that, compared with direct gaming-world generation by coding agents and existing baseline methods, Code2Games consistently improves the visual quality and interactive fidelity of generated gaming worlds, as well as the quality of the resulting games after engine adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Code2Games 框架，从自然语言游戏意图生成一致的完整游戏世界，并引入 GameCode4D 基准进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体只能生成单独资产、场景或脚本，难以在场景结构、空间布局、玩法目标、交互实体与可执行逻辑间保持一致性。
AI.method: 基于同一游戏意图生成基础 Blender 世界，通过共享的场景-玩法表示与持久元素对应关系协调场景分析、玩法规划、受限世界生成和引擎定制；随后适配 UE5，并采用编译诊断、运行时反馈和玩法测试驱动的执行引导重建。
AI.result: 在 GameCode4D（十个固定游戏提示，覆盖不同复杂度）上，从视觉质量、交互保真度、多模态产物质量和可玩游戏质量四个维度评估，Code2Games 相较直接生成与基线方法持续提升。
AI.conclusion: Code2Games 能有效提升生成游戏世界的视觉质量、交互保真度及引擎适配后的游戏质量。

title: Low-Fidelity FDM Spectral Guidance for Neural Eigenvalue Solvers
summary: Operator eigenvalue problems appear throughout science. Classical methods usually discretize the operator into a matrix and then solve the resulting matrix eigenvalue problem. This works well in low dimensions, but fine grids quickly become expensive in both memory and computation as the dimension grows. Neural network based solvers avoid storing these large grids, but recent state of the art neural methods can require hundreds of thousands of training steps and may struggle to find the desired eigenvalues. We show that the two approaches can help each other. A coarse finite difference method (FDM) calculation acts as a cheap numerical model of the operator spectrum. We use the approximate eigenvalues as fixed shifts during the training of the neural solver, as they only need to locate the relevant part of the spectrum. We also introduce Stabilized Inverse Power Method Neural Network (SIPMNN), a more stable training procedure for higher-dimensional problems. Across five test problems at $d=10$, the combined approach is more accurate overall than the tested fully neural alternatives while using eight to ten times fewer iterations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将粗网格有限差分法(FDM)与神经网络求解器结合，利用FDM近似特征值作为神经网络训练中的固定位移，并引入SIPMNN稳定训练过程，在d=10的五个测试问题上比纯神经网络方法更准确且迭代次数减少8-10倍。
AI.motivation: 算子特征值问题在科学中普遍存在。经典方法需将算子离散化为矩阵，维度高时网格过细导致内存和计算开销剧增；而现有最先进的神经网络方法虽避免存储大网格，却需要数十万次训练步，且难以找到所需特征值。
AI.method: 作者让两种方法互补：用粗网格有限差分法(FDM)计算作为算子谱的廉价数值模型，将得到的近似特征值作为固定位移(shift)用于神经网络求解器训练，因其只需定位谱的相关部分。同时提出稳定逆幂法神经网络(SIPMNN)，一种针对高维问题更稳定的训练流程。
AI.result: 在d=10的五个测试问题上，所提组合方法总体上比测试的纯神经网络替代方案更准确，且迭代次数减少8到10倍。
AI.conclusion: 粗数值方法与神经网络求解器可相互促进：廉价FDM提供的近似特征值可有效指导神经网络训练，结合SIPMNN的稳定性，显著提升高维算子特征值问题的求解效率与精度。

title: When Is Enough Enough in Self-Evolving LLM Systems?
summary: Self-evolving large language model (LLM) systems repeatedly propose, evaluate, and incorporate updates to prompts, skills, or other persistent artifacts. Despite their growing effectiveness, these systems typically operate under a predetermined iteration or compute budget, without a principled criterion to determine when further evolution is no longer worthwhile. This can lead to two undesirable consequences: unnecessary computation after performance has saturated and the risk of returning late updates that overfit or exploit the evaluation signal. These issues motivate us to study two fundamental questions: when should a self-evolving system stop, and what should it output once it stops? We address the first by formulating an online sequential testing problem and constructing an anytime-valid restart detector using the per-item paired evaluation outcomes already produced by self-evolving LLM systems. We address the second by formulating a change-point estimation problem and using the estimated transition to select an earlier artifact for output. The resulting procedure is plug-and-play and requires no modification of the underlying self-evolving algorithms. Across two self-evolving frameworks, three LLM model families, and five benchmarks, our method substantially reduces computation costs while maintaining comparable unseen-test performance. For example, on SearchQA with SkillOpt and DeepSeek V4 Flash, our method stops at round 4 rather than the full budget of 40, reducing token usage by 91.6% while achieving 82.43% unseen-test accuracy versus 82.00% under the full-budget run.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自演化LLM系统何时停止演化及停止后输出什么的问题，提出随时有效的重启检测器与变点估计方法，在保持性能的同时大幅降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 自演化LLM系统通常在预设的迭代或计算预算下运行，缺乏判断演化何时不再有价值的准则，导致性能饱和后的无效计算以及返回过拟合或利用评估信号的晚期更新。
AI.method: 将停止问题建模为在线序列检验问题，利用自演化系统已产生的逐项配对评估结果构造随时有效的重启检测器；将输出问题建模为变点估计问题，利用估计的转变点选择较早的artifact进行输出。方法即插即用，无需修改底层自演化算法。
AI.result: 在两个自演化框架、三个LLM模型家族和五个基准上，方法大幅降低计算成本并保持可比的未见测试性能。例如在SearchQA上使用SkillOpt和DeepSeek V4 Flash时，在第4轮停止（而非完整预算40轮），token使用减少91.6%，未见测试准确率82.43%对比全预算运行的82.00%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的即插即用停止与输出选择流程能有效判断自演化系统何时终止并选择合适artifact，在保持性能的同时显著节省计算资源。

title: Learning to Learn a Language
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables, Code: https://github.com/cbl/prior-fitted-language-model, weights: https://huggingface.co/lennartcb/pflm1
summary: We present the Prior-Fitted Language Model (PFLM), a 300M-parameter byte-level transformer pretrained only on samples from a synthetic non-linguistic prior. Given a prefix of real text, it learns to predict the language in context with frozen weights, having never seen a word of any real language. Every training sequence is generated by a recurrent structural causal model drawn fresh from a distribution over such models. The model never sees the same language twice during training, so the only way to predict the continuation is to infer the language from the prefix. Samples from this prior share the statistical signatures of natural text: Zipfian frequencies, slow entropy-rate convergence, and long-range dependence. On Wikipedia in six languages, bits per byte fall from the uniform eight to between 0.9 and 2.4 at one million bytes of context. Given numerals instead of text, PFLM learns to count, to compare magnitudes, and to add approximately. It predicts deterministic sequences like Rudin-Shapiro or the prime indicator, and it compresses six non-text domains, from source code to speech, below gzip and PPMd. The model has not learned a language. It has learned to learn one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PFLM（先验拟合语言模型），一个仅用合成非语言先验样本预训练的300M字节级Transformer。在冻结权重下，给定真实文本前缀，它能在上下文中推断语言并预测后续，在六种语言维基百科上把每字节比特从8降至0.9-2.4，还能计数、比较、近似加法与压缩多种非文本领域。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型能否在从未见过任何真实语言的情况下，仅凭合成结构先验学会"在上下文中学习语言"这一能力，从而分离"学到某种语言"与"学会学习语言"两种机制。
AI.method: 使用递归结构因果模型从先验分布中新鲜采样生成每条训练序列，训练一个300M参数、字节级的Transformer；训练中从不重复见到同一语言，迫使模型必须从前缀推断语言。先验样本具备Zipf频率、慢熵率收敛、长程依赖等自然文本统计特征。推理时权重冻结，仅凭上下文适应。
AI.result: 在六种语言维基百科上，100万字节上下文时每字节比特从均匀的8降至0.9-2.4；给定数字能学会计数、比较大小和近似加法；能预测Rudin-Shapiro序列、素数指示序列等确定性序列；在从源代码到语音的六个非文本领域压缩效果优于gzip和PPMd。
AI.conclusion: 该模型并未学会某一种语言，而是学会了"学习语言"本身，表明上下文学习能力可源自对具有通用统计结构先验的拟合。

title: CoDG-Net: Structure-Guided Style Diffusion and Collaborative Learning to Mitigate Catastrophic Forgetting in Medical Image Domain Generalization
comment: Proceedings of the Thirty-Fifth International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence Main Track. Pages 1622-1630. https://doi.org/10.24963/ijcai.2026/181
summary: Domain Generalization (DG) for medical image segmentation is both highly challenging and critically important. However, existing medical DG methods largely overlook the issue of Catastrophic Forgetting (CF): \textbf{Models often sacrifice their ability to retain source-domain knowledge while pursuing cross-domain robustness.} This can directly threaten diagnostic safety in already-deployed clinical scenarios. To address this, we investigate data augmentation strategies and catastrophic forgetting for medical image DG segmentation. First, we propose a structure-guided style diffusion augmentation method. Constrained by anatomical structure consistency in the frequency domain, this method performs cross-domain diffusion on the amplitude spectrum, generating samples with more diverse and broader style coverage to better support domain generalization. Then, we design a collaborative learning network with a dual-branch interactive architecture (CoDG-Net), together with a novel learning bias-guided strategy that adaptively regulates knowledge transfer at both the layer level and the task level, thereby effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting on the source domain. Experiments and ablation studies on single-source and multi-source medical DG benchmark datasets demonstrate that CoDG-Net not only outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in target-domain segmentation performance, but also achieves a lower forgetting rate on the source-domain data. The code is available at: https://github.com/wangprocess/CoDG-Net.

AI.tldr: 本文针对医学图像分割的域泛化(DG)中忽视的灾难性遗忘(CF)问题，提出结构引导的风格扩散数据增强方法和双分支交互协作学习网络CoDG-Net，在保持目标域分割性能的同时降低源域遗忘率。
AI.motivation: 现有医学域泛化方法大多忽视灾难性遗忘问题：模型在追求跨域鲁棒性时会牺牲对源域知识的保留能力，这在已部署的临床场景中会直接威胁诊断安全。
AI.method: 1) 提出结构引导的风格扩散增强方法，在频域中以解剖结构一致性为约束，对振幅谱进行跨域扩散，生成风格覆盖更广的样本；2) 设计双分支交互架构的协作学习网络CoDG-Net，并提出学习偏置引导策略，在层级和任务级自适应调节知识迁移。
AI.result: 在单源和多源医学DG基准数据集上的实验与消融表明，CoDG-Net在目标域分割性能上优于现有SOTA方法，同时在源域数据上取得更低的遗忘率。
AI.conclusion: 结合结构引导扩散增强与学习偏置引导的协作学习，可同时提升域泛化性能并缓解灾难性遗忘，保障临床部署安全。代码已开源。

title: Score-Calibrated Flow for Sampling from Unnormalized Densities with Applications to Generative Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for online reinforcement learning (RL), enabling multimodal behaviors and improved performance. However, training these policies remains challenging: the critic specifies the desired policy as an unnormalized Boltzmann density but does not provide direct samples from it. Many existing methods rely on importance sampling to construct training signals, which can suffer from high variance, increasing computational cost and destabilizing training. We propose Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF), a simple and efficient algorithm for training generative models to sample from unnormalized densities without importance sampling or backpropagation through the sampling trajectory. We learn the desired flow by enforcing self-consistency, bypassing target posterior mean estimation. By jointly exploiting the prescribed target score and the structure of flow matching, we establish these self-consistency requirements as score-calibrated optimality conditions, first for the terminal density and then for the trainable velocity field. We prove that their unique solutions are, respectively, the target density and the ideal flow model that conditional flow matching (CFM) would recover if target samples were available. We formulate the velocity condition as a fixed-point equation and exploit its conditional-expectation structure to construct a stop-gradient objective for enforcing it. The resulting training procedure retains the scalable sample-interpolate-regress structure of CFM despite the absence of target samples, using endpoints generated by the current flow. For online RL, the critic gradient supplies the target score at the generated actions, yielding a direct approach to actor training. Experiments on RL benchmarks demonstrate that SCF matches or improves upon state-of-the-art generative-policy baselines, while substantially reducing training time.

AI.tldr: 提出 Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF)，一种无需重要性采样或轨迹反向传播、可高效从非归一化密度中训练的生成式策略算法，在在线 RL 中匹配或超越现有方法并显著降低训练时间。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流模型虽为在线 RL 提供表达力强的策略类，但训练困难：critic 给出的期望策略是非归一化 Boltzmann 密度，无法直接采样，现有方法依赖高方差的重要性采样，导致计算昂贵且训练不稳定。
AI.method: SCF 通过自一致性学习目标流，绕过目标后验均值估计；联合利用目标 score 与流匹配结构，建立 score-calibrated 最优性条件——分别针对终端密度与可训练速度场，并证明其唯一解即为目标密度和若存在目标样本时 CFM 会恢复的理想流。将速度条件表述为不动点方程，利用条件期望结构构造 stop-gradient 目标，保持 CFM 的 sample-interpolate-regress 结构，用当前流生成端点。在线 RL 中，critic 梯度在生成动作处提供目标 score。
AI.result: RL 基准实验表明，SCF 匹配或改进了最先进的生成式策略基线，同时大幅减少训练时间。
AI.conclusion: SCF 为从非归一化密度训练生成式策略提供了一种简单、高效且理论保证的方法，避免重要性采样和轨迹反向传播，可直接用于 actor 训练。

title: Not All Answers Are Contextually Persuadable: Inference Dynamics in Large Language Models under Contextual Influence
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: At the core of modern prompting techniques is contextual sensitivity, the ability of large language models to adapt their predictions based on inference-time context. Despite its central role, inference behavior under strong contextual influence remains poorly understood, particularly at the level of internal inference dynamics. We introduce a theoretical framework for analyzing contextual influence through inference dynamics, enabling quantitative characterization of inference behavior beyond output-level answer changes. Our analysis shows that inference dynamics do not exhibit unbounded drift under repeated contextual assertions. Instead, predictive representations converge to stable, query-dependent regimes that fundamentally constrain whether contextual signals can alter a model's prediction. This leads to a surprising finding: Repeated contextual assertions do not act as accumulating evidence during inference and may therefore fail to alter a model's prediction even under unbounded repetition, while in other cases a prediction change becomes inevitable. We empirically validate our theoretical predictions, demonstrating strong alignment between theory and observed inference behavior. These contributions offer a principled pathway toward characterizing the limits of contextual influence during inference, providing practical implications for model development.

AI.tldr: 论文提出分析上下文影响推理动态的理论框架，揭示推理动态不会无限漂移，而是收敛到稳定的查询相关区域，从而限制上下文信号能否改变模型预测。
AI.motivation: 现代提示技术核心在于上下文敏感性，但强上下文影响下的推理行为（尤其内部推理动态）仍理解不足；需要超越输出层答案变化的定量刻画方法。
AI.method: 建立通过推理动态分析上下文影响的理论框架，定量刻画推理行为，并分析重复上下文断言下的动态演化。
AI.result: 推理动态不会无界漂移，预测表示收敛到稳定的查询依赖区域；重复上下文断言不累积为证据，可能无法改变预测，但在某些情况下预测改变不可避免；实证与理论高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 提供了刻画推理中上下文影响极限的原则性路径，并对模型开发具有实践意义。

title: Noise Out, Bias In: Targeted Bias Injection in Diffusion Language Models via Closed-Loop Activation Steering
summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked positions, re-predicting each token multiple times before it is committed. An autoregressive decoder exposes an answer's distribution once, at the step that commits it; a dLLM exposes it at every denoising step before commitment, and we show that an adversary can exploit this. Since an answer remains open to revision over many denoising steps, an adversary with access to internal activations can watch how likely the model is to produce a chosen answer and adjust the intervention accordingly. Building on this observation, we study targeted bias injection, an attack that steers a frozen dLLM toward a demographic answer selected by the adversary. The attack uses a simple proportional-integral (PI) controller that tracks the target-answer probability during denoising and adapts the strength of a steering vector on the fly. On ambiguous BBQ questions where the correct answer is abstention, our attack raises LLaDA-8B-Instruct's preference for the targeted group from 1.8 to 16.7 percentage points, more than three times the strongest fixed-strength steering baseline, and on SocialStigmaQA it raises the selection of stigmatizing answers from 17.6% to 58.1%. Fitted to other demographic targets, the same attack shifts answers by up to 37 percentage points, and each attack takes about 40 minutes on one GPU. On the primary target, feedback is what makes the attack work: constant steering at the same average strength over the token-committing steps produces a far smaller shift while corrupting nearly three times as many outputs, and a constant strength set separately for each example still falls well short. Our findings identify the denoising trajectory as a new control channel in dLLMs and call for bias audits that examine the serving stack rather than the frozen model alone.

AI.tldr: 提出针对掩码扩散语言模型(dLLM)的定向偏见注入攻击,利用去噪轨迹中答案概率持续暴露的特点,用PI控制器动态调节引导向量强度,显著提高模型对特定人口群体答案的偏好。
AI.motivation: 自回归解码器只在提交token的步骤暴露答案分布一次,而dLLM在每个去噪步骤都暴露答案分布,且答案在多个去噪步骤中保持可修改。这种特性可能被对手利用:对手可观察模型产生特定答案的概率并实时调整干预。现有研究尚未探讨这一新的控制通道。
AI.method: 提出定向偏见注入攻击。用一个简单的比例-积分(PI)控制器,在去噪过程中跟踪目标答案概率,并实时自适应调整引导向量(steering vector)的强度,将冻结的dLLM引向对手选定的人口群体答案。
AI.result: 在正确答案应为弃权的模糊BBQ问题上,攻击将LLaDA-8B-Instruct对目标群体的偏好从1.8提升到16.7个百分点,是固定强度引导基线最强的三倍以上;在SocialStigmaQA上,污名化答案的选择率从17.6%升至58.1%。针对其他人口目标,同一攻击可产生最高37个百分点的偏移,每次攻击约需单GPU 40分钟。反馈机制是关键:相同平均强度的恒定引导效果远小,且破坏近三倍的输出;即使逐样本设定恒定强度也仍不及PI控制器。
AI.conclusion: 去噪轨迹是dLLM中一个新的控制通道。呼吁偏见审计应审查整个服务栈,而非仅关注冻结的模型本身。

title: Salvation Lies Within: Eliciting Inherent Style Transfer in Step-Distilled Diffusion Models
summary: Adapting step-distilled text-to-image (T2I) models through post-training incurs additional computational costs and affects native few-step generation behavior. This motivates a complementary route beyond style-specific adaptation: drawing on the visual knowledge already encoded in step-distilled T2I models to elicit stylistic capabilities through language. Pursuing this direction requires textual guidance that captures how visual attributes jointly define a style and remain applicable as the depicted content changes. To explore this approach, we introduce StyleForge, a fully automatic, training-free framework that expresses reference styles as reusable rendering instructions. By integrating overall rendering characteristics with local color and lighting behavior, StyleForge organizes visual evidence from reference images into a coherent specification of how the target style should be expressed. The specification is then compiled into textual guidance that can be reused across content prompts, enabling frozen step-distilled T2I models to render different subjects and scenes in the reference style while retaining native few-step generation. Extensive experiments show relative gains of up to 29.47\% in generation quality scores over the strongest baseline, while Pareto analysis indicates that improved stylization is accompanied by strong adherence to the requested content.

AI.tldr: StyleForge：一种免训练框架，通过语言指令让冻结的步蒸馏文生图模型复用参考风格，无需微调即可保持原生少步生成能力。
AI.motivation: 对步蒸馏T2I模型进行后训练式风格适配会带来额外计算成本，并破坏其原生少步生成行为，因此需要探索超越风格特定适配的互补路径——利用模型已有的视觉知识通过语言激发风格能力。实现此方向需要能捕捉视觉属性如何共同定义风格、且随内容变化仍适用的文本引导。
AI.method: 提出StyleForge，全自动、免训练框架：将参考风格表达为可复用的渲染指令。整合整体渲染特征与局部颜色、光照行为，把参考图像的视觉证据组织成连贯的风格规格，再编译为可跨内容提示复用的文本引导，使冻结的步蒸馏T2I模型能渲染不同主体与场景。
AI.result: 大量实验显示，生成质量分数相对最强基线最高提升29.47%；Pareto分析表明风格化提升的同时对请求内容保持强遵循度。
AI.conclusion: 通过语言引导可有效激发步蒸馏T2I模型的风格化能力，在免训练条件下兼顾生成质量、内容一致性并保留原生少步生成行为。

title: Learning Discriminative Geometry for Drifting Models
summary: Recently proposed Drifting Models shift iterative distribution refinement from inference to training, enabling effective one-step generation. However, their performance on complex image datasets depends strongly on the representation used to construct the drifting field: pixel-space drifting performs poorly, whereas pretrained feature spaces substantially improve sample quality for reasons that remain unclear. We trace this gap to the discriminative geometry of the representation, which determines sample weighting in kernel density estimation (KDE) and, consequently drift. We introduce persistent representation learning, which continuously learns a more discriminative representation geometry as the generator evolves across batches. We further establish a current-step gradient equivalence between the KDE ratio loss and drift regression loss under matched conditions, connecting density-ratio-based generator optimization to empirical drifting and motivating direct control of the drifting velocity. Across multiple datasets, our method learns effective discriminative representations directly from pixels and reduces FID by approximately $82-95\%$ over the original pixel-space Drifting Models, without pretrained encoders. Adapting pretrained representations and applying velocity clipping provide further gains.

AI.tldr: Drifting Models（漂移模型）在复杂图像上依赖预训练特征空间，本文提出持续表示学习以从像素出发学习判别性几何，使FID降低约82-95%。
AI.motivation: 漂移模型将迭代分布精炼从推理转移到训练，实现高效单步生成，但其在复杂图像数据集上的性能强烈依赖表示：像素空间漂移效果差，而预训练特征空间能显著提升样本质量，原因尚不清楚。作者将这一差距归因于表示的判别性几何，该几何决定核密度估计（KDE）中的样本加权，进而影响漂移。
AI.method: 提出持续表示学习（persistent representation learning），随生成器跨批次演化，不断学习更具判别性的表示几何。同时建立KDE比值损失与漂移回归损失在匹配条件下的当前步梯度等价性，将基于密度比的生成器优化与经验漂移联系起来，并据此直接控制漂移速度。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，方法无需预训练编码器即可直接从像素学得有效的判别性表示，相比原始像素空间漂移模型FID降低约82-95%。适配预训练表示并施加速度裁剪可带来进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 表示几何的判别性是漂移模型性能的关键，持续表示学习与漂移速度控制为无需预训练编码器的高质量单步生成提供了有效途径。

title: Do More Modalities Always Help? A Geometric Perspective on Missing-Modality Robustness
summary: Missing modality remains a longstanding challenge in multimodal learning. Existing methods typically address this issue through modality recovery or adaptive strategies. However, they overlook models' internal cross-modal dependencies formed during multimodal training, which later impair robustness. We systematically characterize a counterintuitive deployment-time failure mode: models trained on full modalities can underperform unimodal models when one modality is missing at inference time. This pattern appears across diverse architectures, such as fusion models, CLIP-style two-tower models, and vision-language models. We show that such degradation is closely associated with learned cross-modal dependencies in the principal parameter subspaces. Multimodal training induces structured rotations of these subspaces, particularly in cross-modal interaction layers. These rotations are associated with reduced task-aligned margins and larger task-aware representation harm under missing-modality inputs. We propose Geodesic Unlearning (GU), a lightweight parameter-editing method that leverages Grassmannian subspace geometry for structured subspace correction to improve missing-modality robustness. It rotates the principal input subspace toward a unimodal reference along a geodesic path. We prove that this correction minimizes the distance to the reference within a fixed subspace-distance budget. Experiments across architectures and datasets show that GU improves performance under missing-modality inference while preserving full-modality accuracy, outperforming strong missing-modality robustness baselines. These findings support a geometric view of deployment-time missing-modality degradation and suggest localized subspace editing as a practical route for robustness correction.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了多模态模型在推理时缺失一个模态反而弱于单模态模型的失效现象，并提出基于Grassmann流形几何的轻量参数编辑方法Geodesic Unlearning (GU)来修复该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态缺失模态方法主要依赖模态恢复或自适应策略，但忽略了多模态训练过程中形成的内部跨模态依赖，这种依赖会损害缺失模态时的鲁棒性。作者刻画了一种反直觉的部署时失效模式：全模态训练的模型在推理缺失一个模态时可能不如单模态模型。
AI.method: 作者将退化归因于主参数子空间中学习到的跨模态依赖：多模态训练导致跨模态交互层的主子空间发生结构化旋转。为此提出Geodesic Unlearning (GU)，一种轻量参数编辑方法，利用Grassmannian子空间几何，将主输入子空间沿测地路径旋转朝向单模态参考方向，并证明在固定子空间距离预算下该校正最小化到参考的距离。
AI.result: 在多种架构（融合模型、CLIP式双塔模型、视觉语言模型）和数据集上验证了失效模式；GU在缺失模态推理下提升性能，同时保持全模态准确率，优于强缺失模态鲁棒性基线。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持从几何视角理解部署时缺失模态退化，并表明局部子空间编辑是修复鲁棒性的实用途径。

title: HuatuoGPT-3: RL-Only Domain Adaptation from Base Models
comment: Extended version of "OnePO: Direct One-stage Policy Optimization for SFT-free Domain Adaptation", accepted at ICML 2026, with additional analysis and scaling to HuatuoGPT-3
summary: Domain adaptation aims to turn a general-purpose large language model (LLM) into an expert for a target domain. While the dominant SFT+RL pipeline offers a convenient cold start, it may reduce exploration diversity and introduces additional complexity through multi-stage optimization. These limitations motivate RL-only adaptation. However, pure on-policy RL suffers from a cold-start problem, while mixed-policy RL still falls short: informative tokens in teacher outputs are learned too slowly in early training, and stale teacher outputs can hinder later improvement. We identify these two failure modes as Gradient Starvation and Teacher-Distribution Anchoring.
