Tick conversion predicts almost no loss for a learned decider whose hit accuracy falls by 14.8 percentage points (pp) on the same games in asynchronous play. We instead split the decider's gap to a zero-latency teacher into time and quality components. In ViZDoom, we train a small decider by imitating a scripted teacher, run the game on wall-clock time, and add a control in which the teacher waits for a call to the decider's server before deciding. On a Windows host, three preregistered studies put the time component at 6.5-8.7 pp and the quality component at 6.3-8.6 pp. On a Linux host that skips 0.08-0.09% of ticks, the time component disappeared (-0.1 pp; paired 95% bootstrap interval [-0.4, 0.0]) while the quality component remained (5.6 pp [3.7, 7.5]). Retraining on teacher-labelled states from the decider's own play (DAgger) improved it on new games on both hosts (2.6 pp [0.4, 4.9] and 3.1 pp [1.1, 5.2]), a preregistered partial success. Imposing one delay schedule on every arm in live play left a quality component of 5.8 pp [4.0, 7.5] on 100 new games, and retraining cut the decider's disagreement with the teacher on its own states from 22.7% to 14.9%. In a conveyor simulator with a 400 ms deadline, delay past it erased the quality component. A latency-matched control whose delays match the decider's shows which remedy to try.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将实时智能体相对于零延迟教师的性能差距分解为"时间成分"与"质量成分"，并以ViZDoom实验验证：Windows上时间成分6.5–8.7pp、质量成分6.3–8.6pp；Linux上时间成分消失而质量成分仍在；DAgger重训练显著改善，属预注册的部分成功。
AI.motivation: 实时智能体的评估常在暂停世界或把决策时间取整到整tick（tick conversion）下进行，而tick conversion几乎预测不出损失——同一游戏在异步实时对战中命中率却下降14.8个百分点。因此需要区分"因延迟导致的损失"与"因决策质量导致的损失"，以正确评估实时性影响并指导补救措施。
AI.method: 在ViZDoom中以模仿脚本教师的方式训练小型决策器，游戏按墙钟时间运行，并加入让教师等待决策器服务器调用的对照。在Windows与Linux主机上开展三项预注册研究，将差距拆分为时间成分与质量成分；使用来自决策器自身状态的教师标注数据做DAgger重训练；在实时对局中对所有分支施加统一延迟调度，并在400ms截止的传送带模拟器中检验超时效应，另设延迟匹配对照。
AI.result: Windows主机上时间成分为6.5–8.7pp，质量成分为6.3–8.6pp；Linux主机（跳过0.08–0.09% tick）时间成分消失（-0.1pp，配对95% bootstrap区间[-0.4, 0.0]），质量成分仍在（5.6pp [3.7, 7.5]）。DAgger重训练在两主机的新游戏上均有改善（2.6pp [0.4, 4.9] 与 3.1pp [1.1, 5.2]）。在100个新游戏中统一延迟调度下质量成分仍有5.8pp [4.0, 7.5]，重训练将决策器在自身状态上与教师的分歧从22.7%降至14.9%。传送带模拟器中超过400ms截止的延迟会消除质量成分。
AI.conclusion: 实时智能体的性能损失可分解为可分离的时间与质量成分，二者在不同平台上表现不同：延迟可被精确计时系统消除，而质量成分需通过DAgger等重训练手段缓解。延迟匹配对照可帮助判断应采用哪种补救措施，为实时智能体的评估与改进提供了诊断框架。

title: ForkPilot: Self-Evolving Policy for Retrospective Search in Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Interactive language-model agents increasingly solve complex tasks through long-horizon, multi-call reasoning, where errors in beliefs or actions can compound across tool interactions. Retrospective search can recover from such failures but is prone to misallocation. Delayed outcomes obscure the contribution of intermediate search decisions, leading to Attribution Complexity, while evolving execution evidence leads to Adaptation Complexity, where previously learned estimates become stale. To address these challenges, we first introduce Search Value Dynamics (SVD), which characterizes the evolving trade-off between the gain and cost of retrospective search. Building on SVD, we propose ForkPilot, a self-evolving two-stage policy-learning framework. In the first stage, ForkPilot learns a search-value policy offline from completed trajectories through automatically constructed outcome comparisons. In the second stage, it makes search decisions based on current observations and then self-evolves by incorporating newly completed trajectories into subsequent policy updates. We evaluate ForkPilot across 6 diverse benchmarks and 7 widely used LLM backbone families, including four open-source families, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Opus 4.8 in a production agentic system, against 9 competitive baselines, including a real-world harness deployment used by hundreds of thousands of paid users. ForkPilot achieves comparable state-of-the-art performance while reducing token usage by up to 59.2%, demonstrating its efficacy.

AI.tldr: 提出Search Value Dynamics (SVD)刻画回溯搜索的收益-成本权衡，并基于此设计自进化两阶段策略学习框架ForkPilot，在6个基准、多个LLM主干上达到SOTA性能并减少最多59.2% token消耗。
AI.motivation: 交互式语言模型智能体在长时程多步推理中，信念或动作错误会跨工具交互累积。回溯搜索虽能纠错，但存在误分配问题：延迟结果模糊了中间搜索决策的贡献（归因复杂度），演化中的执行证据使已有估计过时（适应复杂度）。
AI.method: 1) 提出Search Value Dynamics (SVD)，刻画回溯搜索增益与成本随时间的动态权衡；2) 基于SVD提出ForkPilot两阶段自进化策略学习框架：第一阶段通过自动构造的结果比较，从已完成轨迹中离线学习搜索价值策略；第二阶段基于当前观测做搜索决策，并将新完成的轨迹纳入后续策略更新实现自进化。
AI.result: 在6个多样化基准、7个主流LLM主干家族（含4个开源家族、GPT-5.6 Sol、Opus 4.8）及生产级智能体系统中评估，对比9个竞争基线（含服务数十万付费用户的真实系统部署），ForkPilot达到可比的SOTA性能，同时token使用量最多减少59.2%。
AI.conclusion: ForkPilot通过SVD引导的自进化两阶段策略学习，有效缓解回溯搜索中的归因与适应复杂度，在保持SOTA性能的同时显著降低token开销，验证了其有效性。

title: Introducing Code-Switched Contexts to Cognitively-Inspired Bilingual Model Training
summary: During language acquisition, bilingual children are regularly exposed to code-switched input and use it as a cognitive scaffold to accelerate vocabulary growth and cross-linguistic syntactic mapping. In contrast, computational bilingual models are conventionally pretrained on interleaved monolingual corpora. While introducing synthetic code-switching during pretraining has become a promising strategy to enhance cross-lingual alignment and downstream performance, the structural and developmental parameters governing the success remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate the efficiency of training with synthetic code-switched data across two typologically distinct language pairs by controlling two key variables: the structural location of code-switches and the dynamic switching rate across training stages. Our results show that training with code-switched data improves cross-lingual alignment for typologically close languages.

AI.tldr: 本文研究合成语码转换预训练对双语模型跨语言对齐的影响，重点考察语码转换的结构位置与动态切换率两个变量。
AI.motivation: 双语儿童通过语码转换输入加速词汇增长与跨语言句法映射，而计算双语模型通常仅用交错单语语料预训练；尽管合成语码转换是提升跨语言对齐的潜在策略，其结构与训练动态参数的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 在两个类型学差异显著的语言对上，通过控制语码转换的结构位置和跨训练阶段的动态切换率，考察合成语码转换数据训练的效率和效果。
AI.result: 使用语码转换数据训练能提升类型学相近语言之间的跨语言对齐。
AI.conclusion: 合成语码转换预训练的收益与语言类型学距离相关，对类型学相近语言更为有效。

title: Order Matters: Competition-Guided Query Ordering for RNN-Based Object Detection
summary: DETR-style detectors use one-to-one bipartite matching during training to assign object queries to ground-truth objects, enabling end-to-end set prediction without non-maximum suppression (NMS). However, without an explicit de-duplication procedure, multiple queries can still produce highly similar hypotheses for the same object, making training unstable and predictions less decisive. Inspired by the sequential ordering of NMS, we propose DETRNN, a plug-and-play module that turns unordered object queries into a competition-aware sequence for recurrent refinement. DETRNN builds an explicit confidence-and-similarity based order from prior predictions, then refines queries with an RNN along this order to model competition inside the decoder. This ordered recurrent refinement reduces redundant predictions, stabilizes optimization, and improves final detection accuracy. Experiments on multiple DETR-style detectors show consistent gains with comparable efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出DETRNN插件模块，将无序object queries转为竞争感知序列，用RNN沿序精炼，减少冗余预测、稳定训练并提升DETR类检测器精度。
AI.motivation: DETR类检测器用一对一二分匹配训练，但仍会有多个查询对同一目标产生高度相似假设，缺乏显式去重导致训练不稳定、预测不够果断。
AI.method: 受NMS顺序排序启发，DETRNN根据先验预测构建基于置信度与相似度的显式顺序，将object queries转为顺序序列，用RNN沿该顺序进行循环精炼，在decoder内建模查询间竞争。
AI.result: 在多个DETR类检测器上实验，效率相当的情况下取得一致精度提升。
AI.conclusion: 有序循环精炼可减少冗余预测、稳定优化并提升检测精度，是即插即用的通用改进模块。

title: GRAM: Correcting Frozen Time-Series Foundation Models via Graph-Retrieved Amplitude Memory
summary: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) enable zero-shot forecasting through large-scale cross-domain pretraining, while retrieval augmentation further improves their performance by leveraging historical information. However, existing methods typically correct TSFM forecasts using the ground-truth futures of similar historical windows, which contain both predictive components already captured by the foundation model and sample-specific random fluctuation that is difficult to transfer. In contrast, recurring systematic model bias within prediction errors more directly characterizes the failure modes of a frozen TSFM and therefore provides more valuable correction signals. Effectively exploiting such model bias, however, poses two challenges: prediction errors at different numerical levels are difficult to compare due to scale differences, and the recurring bias must be extracted from prediction errors contaminated by random fluctuation. To address these challenges, we propose GRAM, a general retrieval-augmented framework for frozen TSFMs. GRAM first introduces an Amplitude Memory Module (AMM) that scales prediction errors by amplitude and aggregates them into retrievable prototypes. It then employs a Prototype Graph Module (PGM) to model relations among prototypes to aggregate consistent bias information while suppressing random fluctuation. During online forecasting, GRAM retrieves and expands prototypes relevant to the current query and generates per-horizon corrections to refine the original TSFM forecast. Experiments across multiple datasets and foundation models demonstrate consistent forecasting improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAM，一种面向冻结时序基础模型的检索增强框架，通过提取预测误差中重复出现的系统性模型偏差（而非直接使用历史真值）来修正零样本预测，并利用幅度归一化和原型图建模解决尺度差异与随机波动问题，在多个数据集和基础模型上取得一致的预测提升。
AI.motivation: 现有时序基础模型（TSFM）结合检索增强虽能提升零样本预测，但通常用相似历史窗口的真实未来来修正预测。这些真实未来既包含模型已捕捉的预测成分，又包含难以迁移的样本特定随机波动。相比之下，预测误差中反复出现的系统性模型偏差更能直接刻画冻结TSFM的失效模式，是更有价值的修正信号。但利用该偏差面临两挑战：不同数值水平的预测误差因尺度差异难以比较；需从被随机波动污染的误差中提取重复偏差。
AI.method: GRAM包含两个模块：1）幅度记忆模块（AMM），按幅度对预测误差进行缩放并聚合为可检索的原型；2）原型图模块（PGM），建模原型间关系，聚合一致的偏差信息并抑制随机波动。在线预测时，GRAM检索并扩展与当前查询相关的原型，生成逐预测步（per-horizon）的修正量以精炼原始TSFM预测。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种基础模型上的实验表明，GRAM带来一致的预测性能提升。
AI.conclusion: GRAM通过挖掘并利用冻结TSFM预测误差中的重复系统性偏差，为检索增强时序预测提供了一种通用且有效的框架。

title: Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents
summary: Recursive language-model agents decompose tasks and delegate subtasks to child instances of the same policy, forming a tree of work. Training them, however, is hard: the final outcome is verifiable, but the self-invented intermediate subtasks are numerous and carry no ground truth. Existing methods score each node with a verifier or judge, which is costly at scale and blind to decomposition quality. We argue that a recursive agent must learn three coupled capabilities within one set of weights: decomposing problems into subtasks, solving them, and evaluating the outcomes, each requiring its own training signal. SERA (Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents) turns evaluation into a learned capability of the policy itself. Before delegating, the parent writes a rubric of weighted success criteria for each child subtask; a ranking objective against verified outcomes then trains rubric generation so that the criteria track genuine subtask success. In addition, a complementary leaf-coverage signal provides direct credit for task decomposition. Our central finding is that \emph{training} the policy to generate aligned rubrics is what drives the gains: because the same weights both evaluate and execute, learning to judge subtasks sharpens the agent's ability to solve them. Notably, external supervision is also reduced: the judge is consulted only to train the rubric generator, while solving is trained against the agent's own rubric scores, which outperform direct use of the judge. Beyond training, the learned rubric doubles as an inference-time selector for tree search. On TextCraft-Synth and TextWorld-Sync, SERA improves over strong recursive-agent baselines by 5.38 and 13.14 points on average, and rubric-guided tree search at inference adds a further 2.43 points on TextWorld-Sync.

AI.tldr: SERA将评估能力内化为递归智能体策略的一部分，通过训练策略生成对齐的评分标准（rubric）来驱动分解、求解与评估三种能力的联合学习。
AI.motivation: 递归语言模型智能体通过分解任务并委托子任务形成工作树，但训练困难：最终结果可验证，而自创的中间子任务繁多且没有真实标注。现有方法用验证器或评判器为每个节点打分，成本高昂且无法感知分解质量。作者认为递归智能体需在同一套权重中学习三种耦合能力：分解、求解和评估，且各需独立训练信号。
AI.method: SERA将评估变为策略自身可学习的能力。父节点在委托前为每个子任务编写带权成功标准的评分表（rubric）；利用针对已验证结果的排序目标训练评分表生成，使标准能追踪真实子任务成功。另设叶子覆盖信号，为任务分解提供直接信用分配。由于同一权重既评估又执行，学会评判子任务会提升求解能力。
AI.result: 外部监督减少：评判器仅用于训练评分表生成器，求解则针对智能体自身评分表分数训练，且优于直接使用评判器。在TextCraft-Synth和TextWorld-Sync上，SERA平均超越强递归智能体基线5.38和13.14分，推理时评分表引导的树搜索在TextWorld-Sync上再提升2.43分。
AI.conclusion: 训练策略生成对齐的评分表是增益的核心来源，证明内化评估能力可同时提升求解与分解表现，并可作为推理时的树搜索选择器，减少对外部监督的依赖。

title: Cross-lingual Calibration of Pre-Generation Success Probes for Multilingual LLM Routing
summary: Pre-generation success probes estimate response correctness from a language model's hidden activations before decoding, enabling cost-aware routing. While prior work has demonstrated their utility primarily on English inputs, we study their reliability across languages along three dimensions: (1) whether they preserve the ranking of likely successes and failures (DISCRIMINATION); (2) whether they retain probabilities that match observed success frequencies (CALIBRATION); and (3) whether they produce scores comparable enough across candidate models for cost-aware multilingual routing (UTILITY). Using 3,000 MATH problems in 10 languages and 8 open-weight model configurations, we compare cross-lingual transfer from English-trained probes and equal-budget pooled multilingual probes. English-trained probes retain useful cross-lingual discrimination but become less well calibrated after transfer. Pooled multilingual supervision improves both properties and yields more reliable estimates of success. In routing experiments, the pooled router achieves a 0.7% higher test success rate while reducing modeled cost by 13.0% relative to always selecting the model with the highest average success. These results show that multilingual routing requires success estimates that remain well calibrated and comparable across languages and models.

AI.tldr: 研究多语言预生成成功探针的可靠性，发现英语训练的探针跨语言迁移后校准变差，而多语言混合监督能改善判别与校准，并提升路由效用。
AI.motivation: 预生成成功探针此前主要在英语上验证，其在多语言场景下是否仍可靠、能否支撑成本感知的多语言路由尚不清楚。
AI.method: 使用10种语言的3000道MATH题目和8个开放权重模型配置，从判别力、校准度、效用三个维度，比较英语训练探针的跨语言迁移与等预算的多语言混合探针。
AI.result: 英语探针保留有效的跨语言判别力但迁移后校准下降；混合多语言监督同时改善判别与校准。路由实验中，混合路由器的测试成功率提高0.7%，同时将建模成本相对"始终选择平均成功率最高模型"降低13.0%。
AI.conclusion: 多语言路由需要跨语言、跨模型都保持良好校准且可比的成功估计，多语言混合监督是实现这一目标的有效途径。

title: Long-MDR: Long-Context Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Deep-Research Agents
summary: The next generation of multimodal research agents must reason over long-lived research histories rather than short model completions. During a single task, an agent may repeatedly search the web, inspect visual evidence, revisit earlier hypotheses, and accumulate tens of thousands of tokens of multimodal context. Despite this trend, online RL for multimodal research agents remains largely confined to shorter contexts and interaction horizons. We push online RL training to 128k context and 75+ tool-interaction turns. To our knowledge, this is the first online multimodal deep-research RL study trained at 128k context, and the first trained with a 75 tool-turn horizon. Scaling to this regime exposes several practical limitations of conventional RL training. Early in training, weak policies make poor use of large interaction budgets, causing expensive rollouts with little reward improvement. Later, policy entropy can collapse before performance has saturated, prematurely ending useful learning. We introduce Long-MDR, a three-component training recipe designed specifically for this setting: On-Policy Distillation Warmup, Progressive Horizon Expansion, and Entropy-Triggered Rescue. Together, these techniques improve both the learning efficiency and stability of long-horizon RL, enabling continued gains in a regime where direct training is slow and costly. At a 50-turn evaluation budget, our RL-trained Long-MDR-9B ranks first on five of six benchmarks among the compared 7B-9B agents.

AI.tldr: Long-MDR 通过三组件训练配方（同策略蒸馏预热、渐进式视界扩展、熵触发救援），实现了 128k 上下文、75+ 工具交互轮次的多模态深度研究智能体在线强化学习训练。
AI.motivation: 多模态研究智能体需在长历史、长上下文场景下推理，但现有在线 RL 多局限于短上下文和短交互视界，长视界训练中早期 rollout 低效、后期策略熵崩塌，导致学习慢且不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 Long-MDR 三组件训练配方：(1) On-Policy Distillation Warmup 同策略蒸馏预热；(2) Progressive Horizon Expansion 渐进式视界扩展；(3) Entropy-Triggered Rescue 熵触发救援。
AI.result: 在 50 轮评估预算下，RL 训练的 Long-MDR-9B 在六个基准中的五个上，于 7B-9B 智能体对比中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次实现 128k 上下文与 75 工具轮次的多模态深度研究在线 RL 训练，显著提升长视界 RL 的学习效率与稳定性，并在长视界训练中持续获得收益。

title: Which Preferences to Train On? End-to-End Multi-Objective Alignment with an Adversarial Preference Distribution
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values is important for safe, efficient, and beneficial AI deployment. However, human values are multifaceted: helpfulness, harmlessness and humor trade off against one another, and different users want different trade-offs. Multi-objective alignment (MOA) addresses this by training a policy that can provide any point of the Pareto front, but existing methods either train one model per preference, interpolate a few separately aligned experts post hoc, or train a single conditioned model without considering which preferences it should be trained on. Since the hard regions of the preference simplex depend on the objectives at hand, existing methods leave them under-trained and do not get the most out of a single model. Therefore, we propose MAESTRO (Multi-objective Alignment via End-to-end STeering and Robust Optimization), which formulates MOA as a minimax problem over preference distributions and trains a single prompt-conditioned policy end-to-end with RL against an adversarial preference distribution: a Dirichlet distribution updated by online mirror descent toward the preferences the current policy serves worst, rather than on a fixed one. On HH-RLHF, BeaverTails and a summarization task, with up to three objectives, MAESTRO attains the best Pareto front on most tasks in a single training run, at the lowest training cost among the compared methods. The largest margins appear in the hard regions that a fixed preference distribution leaves under-trained, confirming that a single prompt-conditioned model is capable of covering the objective trade-offs on its own.

AI.tldr: MAESTRO将多目标对齐(MOA)形式化为偏好分布上的极小极大问题，用对抗性Dirichlet分布(通过在线镜像下降更新)端到端RL训练单一prompt条件策略，在单次训练中于多数任务取得最佳Pareto前沿。
AI.motivation: 人类价值是多面的(有用性、无害性、幽默性相互权衡)，且不同用户需要不同权衡。现有多目标对齐方法要么每个偏好训练一个模型、要么事后插值少数专家模型、要么训练单一条件模型但不考虑应训练哪些偏好，导致偏好单纯形中的困难区域训练不足，无法充分发挥单一模型潜力。
AI.method: 提出MAESTRO，将MOA表述为偏好分布上的极小极大问题，端到端地用RL训练单一prompt条件策略，对抗一个由在线镜像下降更新的Dirichlet偏好分布——该分布动态指向当前策略服务最差的偏好，而非固定分布。
AI.result: 在HH-RLHF、BeaverTails及一个摘要任务上(最多三个目标)，MAESTRO在多数任务单次训练即取得最佳Pareto前沿，且训练成本在对比方法中最低。最大优势出现在固定偏好分布训练不足的困难区域。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明单一prompt条件模型能够自行覆盖各目标间的权衡，验证了通过对抗偏好分布和端到端引导训练MOA的有效性。

title: VideoResearchAgent: Grounded Task Synthesis and Sim-to-Real RL for Open-Web Video Research
summary: Existing deep research agents are designed primarily for text- and image-based web sources, while video reasoning systems typically assume that relevant videos are provided in advance. We study open-web video research, where an agent must autonomously discover relevant videos, navigate their temporal content, and ground answers in visual evidence. Training such agents at scale is challenging as live video interaction is slow and unreliable, whereas fixed local simulation can induce retrieval-specific shortcuts that fail to transfer to the open web. We introduce VideoResearchAgent, a scalable training framework to address these challenges. First, we introduce controllable task synthesis pipeline to synthesize multi-hop research tasks from timestamped visual evidence while filtering text-only shortcuts. Second, we build a field-aligned local video simulator that preserves deployment-facing search and watch interactions while accelerating video search by a factor of 34.5-64.6. Third, we introduce Retrieval-Domain-Randomized GRPO (RDR-GRPO), which diversifies candidate rankings, distractors, metadata, and result structure during training to reduce overfitting to simulated retrieval. On Video-BrowseComp, the VideoResearchAgent trained using Qwen3.5-4B achieves 40.48% accuracy, comparable to Gemini-3-Flash-Preview, while reducing cumulative API-token consumption by 74.9% relative to the untrained model. Together, these results establish an accurate and efficient training recipe for open-web video research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VideoResearchAgent，一个面向开放网络视频研究任务的可扩展训练框架，自主发现视频、定位时间段并基于视觉证据作答。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究智能体主要面向文本/图像来源，视频推理系统则假设视频已给定；开放网络视频研究训练面临实时交互慢且不可靠、本地模拟易产生检索捷径难以迁移的问题。
AI.method: 包含三部分：可控任务合成流水线（从带时间戳视觉证据合成多跳研究任务并过滤纯文本捷径）；字段对齐的本地视频模拟器（保留部署时的搜索与观看交互，搜索加速34.5-64.6倍）；检索域随机化 GRPO（RDR-GRPO），在训练中多样化候选排序、干扰项、元数据和结果结构以减少对模拟检索的过拟合。
AI.result: 在 Video-BrowseComp 上，用 Qwen3.5-4B 训练的 VideoResearchAgent 达到40.48%准确率，与 Gemini-3-Flash-Preview 相当，同时相比未训练模型减少74.9%的累计 API token 消耗。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了开放网络视频研究的准确且高效的训练方案。

title: Shared Stopping Decisions Change Answers in HQQ Cache Quantization
summary: Language-model systems batch questions for throughput, but unrelated questions should not change a target's answer when its input and numerical execution are fixed. We study compression of the key and value cache, which stores attention representations reused during generation. With request-local groups, Transformers' Half-Quadratic Quantization (HQQ) backend updates compression parameters separately but uses a shared average error to decide when all updates stop. Replacing only the question batched with the target changes four-bit HQQ answers in 170/384 test comparisons across two models. Replaying the other execution's update counts reproduces its complete answer and cache fingerprints in every changed pair, in both directions. Computing the stopping mean in FP32 reduces cache differences but leaves answer changes. Native HQQ also changes confirmed numerical correctness in eight arithmetic pairs. Fixed iterations and request-local stopping remove observed companion dependence under matched controls. Request-local stopping remains sensitive to synthetic padding changes at the tensor level. Fixing the original iteration budget removes this decision path without tuning. Neither repair has an established quality advantage, and natural rebatching still changes answers. Request-independence audits must cover stopping decisions as well as quantization groups.

AI.tldr: 该文研究KV缓存压缩(HQQ)中的"请求独立性"问题：批处理中不相关的问题会通过共享的停止决策改变目标问题的答案。作者通过实验证明四种修复方案各有局限，呼吁审计需覆盖停止决策。
AI.motivation: 语言模型系统为提高吞吐量会批处理问题，但当输入和数值执行固定时，不相关的问题不应改变目标答案。作者质疑现有KV缓存压缩(尤其HQQ)在批处理下是否真的满足这一独立性，发现共享的停止误差平均会引入伴生依赖。
AI.method: 以请求局部组下的HQQ为对象，将目标问题与不同问题配对批处理。通过替换同批问题、跨执行重放更新计数、将停止均值计算改为FP32、固定迭代预算、请求局部停止等多种控制实验，检验答案与缓存指纹是否改变。
AI.result: 在两次模型、384次比较中，170次4比特HQQ答案发生变化；重放更新计数能100%复现改变后的答案与缓存指纹，双向成立。FP32计算停止均值减少缓存差异但仍改变答案；原生HQQ在8个算术配对中改变数值正确性。固定迭代与请求局部停止可消除伴生依赖，但前者对合成填充仍敏感，且两者均无质量优势，自然重批处理仍改变答案。
AI.conclusion: HQQ的共享停止决策破坏了请求独立性。修复方案(固定迭代、请求局部停止、FP32)各有残余问题，且无明确质量优势。因此请求独立性审计不仅要检查量化分组，还必须覆盖停止决策路径。

title: F$^2$ SLAM: Turning Feed-Forward Geometry into Persistent Factors for SLAM
summary: Feed-forward 3D models provide strong multi-view geometric priors, while on- line simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) relies mainly on local mea- surements and can accumulate drift over long sequences. Existing attempts to combine the two typically treat feed-forward predictions as an external geomet- ric state that is aligned or fused with the online estimate after the fact, which keeps broader multi-view evidence outside the optimizer that refines the SLAM state. We present F2SLAM, which instead converts feed-forward geometry di- rectly into optimization-native target-weight measurements attached to a persis- tent dense factor graph. A high-frequency stream maintains local tracking con- straints and graph connectivity, while a low-frequency stream uses wider multi- view context to selectively refresh existing measurements after a state-consistency check. Both streams constrain the same poses, inverse depths, and optional cam- era intrinsics through a single dense bundle adjustment. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate consistently strong trajectory estimation and improved dense reconstruction in both calibrated and uncalibrated settings. Notably, the uncalibrated configuration reduces the average ATE RMSE from 0.030 m for the strongest feed-forward baseline to 0.002 m on the Replica dataset.

AI.tldr: F2SLAM将前馈3D几何直接转化为优化原生的目标权重测量，融入持续密集因子图，实现高频局部跟踪与低频多视图刷新，提升轨迹估计与稠密重建。
AI.motivation: 在线SLAM依赖局部测量，长序列易累积漂移；现有方法仅将前馈预测作为外部几何状态事后对齐/融合，多视图证据未进入优化器。
AI.method: 将前馈几何转为优化原生目标权重测量，附加到持续密集因子图；高频流维持局部跟踪约束与图连通性，低频流利用更广多视图上下文，经状态一致性检查后选择性刷新已有测量；两流共同约束位姿、逆深度及可选相机内参，通过单一密集BA优化。
AI.result: 多基准实验显示稳定强轨迹估计，标定与非标定设置下稠密重建改善；非标定配置在Replica上平均ATE RMSE从最强前馈基线的0.030 m降至0.002 m。
AI.conclusion: 将前馈几何直接纳入SLAM优化过程（而非事后融合）可显著提升轨迹精度与重建质量。

title: PIT-GCL: Protein Interaction using Topological Graph Contrastive Learning
summary: Protein binding prediction is central to target identification, therapeutic binder design, and large scale screening, yet remains challenging because binding depends on sequence, three dimensional geometry, and global structural organization. Recent folding models such as AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2 have substantially improved structure prediction, but their confidence outputs (pLDDT, pTM, ipTM) are not specifically designed for binary binding prediction, and dedicated structure aware predictors often require bound complex structures that are unavailable at screening scale. We introduce PIT-GCL, a dual tower structure aware framework that encodes each protein independently from its amino acid sequence, Cα point cloud, and a global persistent homology descriptor. Each tower combines residue ESM-2 embeddings with a topological summary computed from the H0 and H1 persistence landscapes of a Vietoris-Rips filtration, and processes the resulting tokens with a structure aware Transformer in which pairwise Cα distances enter as a learned attention bias. A bidirectional cross attention module then performs latent space soft docking between the two per-protein representations, and the model is trained with a combined binary cross entropy and NT-Xent contrastive objective. On three binary interaction prediction benchmarks, general PPI on PPIRef, TCRpMHC binding on STAG, and whole chain pairs on PPB-Affinity, PIT-GCL outperforms representative sequence based, structure aware, and task specific baselines on general PPI under our evaluation, and is the only method above chance on PPB-Affinity; on TCR-pMHC it leads at a fixed decision threshold but is outranked by a task specific sequence model. Because each protein is encoded independently in the first phase, its representation can be precomputed and reused across candidate pairs, which is convenient for large scale screening.

AI.tldr: PIT-GCL是一个双塔结构感知框架，仅用序列、Cα点云和持久同调描述子独立编码蛋白，通过交叉注意力做软对接，实现无需复合物结构的蛋白结合预测。
AI.motivation: 现有折叠模型（AlphaFold3、Boltz-2）的置信度输出并非为二分类结合预测设计，而专用结构感知预测器往往需要筛选规模下无法获得的复合物结构。
AI.method: 双塔独立编码：ESM-2残基嵌入+Vietoris-Rips过滤的H0/H1持久景观拓扑摘要，结构感知Transformer以Cα距离作注意力偏置；双向交叉注意力做潜空间软对接；以BCE+NT-Xent对比损失训练。
AI.result: 在PPIRef、STAG、PPB-Affinity三个基准上，PIT-GCL在通用PPI上超越序列/结构/任务专用基线；在PPB-Affinity上是唯一超过随机水平的方法；TCR-pMHC固定阈值下领先，但被任务专用序列模型超越。
AI.conclusion: 独立编码使蛋白表示可预计算并跨候选对复用，利于大规模筛选。

title: Monitorability Disposition in Large Reasoning Models
summary: Monitoring the chain-of-thought (CoT) of large reasoning models (LRMs) is a common way to detect misbehavior in real-world practice. However, current monitoring is passive: a separate model inspects the session only after execution. This means harm may already have occurred before it is caught. An active alternative is to have the model self-report its misbehavior as it happens. Whether models are willing to do this, however, is unknown. We introduce "monitorability disposition": a model's willingness to make itself monitorable and stay monitored throughout inference when warranted. We measure it as the fraction of warranted cases in which a model self-reports its own misbehavior via tool calls to available monitoring channels. We evaluate four LRMs on three misbehaviors (sycophancy, reward hacking, and bias) while varying the available monitors (AI and human) and the pressure to use the monitoring tools. We find that when tool use is optional, models self-report in only about 16% of warranted cases on average. Increasing tool-use pressure does not improve reporting where it matters: high-severity misbehavior is never self-reported. Models also systematically select the monitor they perceive as least strict. Overall, we identify monitorability disposition as a new contributing factor to model monitorability: when sufficiently strong, it keeps models seeking monitorability throughout inference.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"可监控性倾向"(monitorability disposition)概念,衡量模型在推理过程中主动上报自身不当行为的意愿,发现现有LRM普遍不愿自我上报。
AI.motivation: 当前对大型推理模型的监控是被动的:仅在执行后才由独立模型检查,危害可能已发生。主动方案是让模型在不当行为发生时自我上报,但模型是否愿意这样做尚不清楚。
AI.method: 定义可监控性倾向为模型在"应上报"情况下通过工具调用自我上报的比例。在四种LRM、三种不当行为(谄媚、奖励黑客、偏见)上评估,并变化可用监控者(AI与人类)及使用监控工具的压力。
AI.result: 工具使用可选时,模型平均仅在约16%的应上报情况中自我上报;增加压力无助于关键场景,高严重度不当行为从不被自我上报;模型系统性地选择其认为最宽松的监控者。
AI.conclusion: 可监控性倾向是影响模型可监控性的新因素:当足够强时,它能促使模型在整个推理过程中主动寻求被监控。

title: Probabilistic Race and Ethnicity Prediction Using Group-Specific Name Lists
summary: Statistically valid estimation of racial and ethnic disparities often requires inferring the probability that an individual belongs to a particular racial or ethnic group given only their name and geographic location. The standard approach, Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG), relies on group population frequencies for each name. Although the U.S. Census Bureau provides such information for common names and a limited set of racial categories, comparable data do not exist for many racial and ethnic groups and are rarely available outside the U.S. We propose the list-powered BISG ($\ell$BISG) method, which can be used to derive calibrated group probabilities from group-specific name lists. These lists may be compiled based on expert knowledge or generated synthetically using large language models (LLMs), and thus may be subject to unknown biases. Representing names as embeddings, we treat list membership as a proxy prediction task and apply a correction based on proximal inference to recover the target group probabilities. We validate the method on U.S. voter files with self-reported race, on the full-count 1900 U.S. Census, and on the Lebanese voter registry. We find that LLM-generated name lists yield accurate and well-calibrated probabilities as well as precise disparity estimates comparable to those obtained using methods that require name-race data. Thus, $\ell$BISG substantially broadens the applicability of probabilistic race and ethnicity prediction to settings where name-race data are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 提出ℓBISG方法，用群体特定姓名列表（可由专家或LLM生成）推导校准的种族概率，通过嵌入和近端推断纠偏，在无姓名-种族数据场景下实现准确的种族推断与差异估计。
AI.motivation: 标准BISG依赖美国人口普查的姓名-种族频率数据，但许多种族群体及美国以外地区缺乏此类数据，限制了种族差异统计推断的适用范围。
AI.method: 将姓名表示为嵌入，把列表成员资格视为代理预测任务，基于近端推断（proximal inference）进行校正，从群体特定姓名列表中恢复目标群体概率。姓名列表可由专家知识或LLM生成。
AI.result: 在美国带自我报告种族的选民文件、1900年全量人口普查及黎巴嫩选民登记册上验证：LLM生成的姓名列表能产生准确且良好校准的概率，差异估计精度与需姓名-种族数据的方法相当。
AI.conclusion: ℓBISG显著扩展了概率性种族推断的适用性，使其可用于缺乏姓名-种族数据的场景。

title: PixReenact: Pixel-Conditioned Causal Video Diffusion for Streaming Head-Avatar Reenactment
summary: Streaming head-avatar reenactment aims to animate a reference image according to a live driving video, requiring robust motion transfer, long-term identity stability, and low latency. Existing methods often rely on specialized identity or motion representations, which can discard useful visual information and inherit failure modes from external extractors. In addition, many recent diffusion-based reenactment methods use offline, clip-based generation, jointly processing and denoising an entire video clip before producing its output, making continuous low-latency streaming difficult. We introduce PixReenact, a pixel-conditioned streaming reenactment framework built on causal video diffusion. PixReenact conditions directly on VAE-encoded reference and driving frames, without specialized identity or motion representations. To separate reference identity from driver motion, we train with cross-identity pseudo supervision together with corrective objectives anchored to the original reference and driving inputs. Long self-rollouts reduce autoregressive drift, while state-aware dual-teacher distillation separately addresses cold-start and steady-state generation. Across three cross-identity benchmarks and a long-horizon streaming benchmark, PixReenact demonstrates robust cross-identity reenactment, particularly under challenging conditions such as extreme viewpoints, occlusions, and pronounced facial expressions, while maintaining the reference identity over long streams. A 4-NFE rolling student continuously emits four frames per update with a mean emission latency of 239 ms.

AI.tldr: PixReenact：基于因果视频扩散的像素条件流式头部化身重演框架，直接以VAE编码的参考帧和驱动帧为条件，实现长时身份稳定与低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖专门的identity/motion表示，会丢失视觉信息并继承外部提取器的失败模式；许多扩散方法采用离线、基于片段的生成，难以连续低延迟流式输出。
AI.method: 基于因果视频扩散，直接条件于VAE编码的参考和驱动帧，无需专门表示。用跨身份伪监督加锚定原始输入的修正目标分离身份与动作；长自rollout减少自回归漂移；状态感知双教师蒸馏分别处理冷启动与稳态；4-NFE滚动学生每次更新输出4帧。
AI.result: 在三个跨身份基准和长时流式基准上表现稳健，尤擅极端视角、遮挡、夸张表情；长流中保持参考身份；平均发射延迟239 ms。
AI.conclusion: PixReenact通过像素条件因果扩散与蒸馏策略，实现鲁棒的跨身份、长时稳定、低延迟流式重演。

title: CURIO: Curiosity-Driven Test-Time Learning for Open-Ended Discovery
summary: Open-ended discovery requires learning from repeated attempts while continuing to explore directions whose value is not yet apparent. Search with a frozen large language model (LLM) can reuse previous solutions in context, but cannot update the model from its successes and failures on the test problem. Reinforcement learning (RL) enables such adaptation; however, strongly favoring high-reward trajectories may suppress low-reward yet potentially promising directions too early. We introduce CURIO, a curiosity-driven test-time learning framework that complements task feedback with an Intrinsic Curiosity World Model (ICWM). The ICWM learns transitions in the policy's hidden-state representation and supplies prediction-error bonuses at sampled tokens outside the policy's top-k choices. Epoch normalization and an annealed weight regulate their contribution to the policy update. On six mathematical discovery tasks and single-cell denoising with Qwen3 backbones from 8B to 235B, three-run means improve over a matched task-only RL control on five mathematical objectives, match the best reported performance on Circle Packing, and improve denoising Score and mean squared error (MSE) on both held-out corpora at every tested scale. Relative gains reach 18.3% on Hadamard and 10.8% on denoising Score. Code-diversity measurements show greater structural variation among generated programs, supporting curiosity as a complementary exploration signal for learning in open-ended discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出CURIO，一种好奇心驱动的测试时学习框架，通过内在好奇心世界模型补充任务反馈，在开放发现任务上提升性能。
AI.motivation: 开放式发现需要从反复尝试中学习，同时继续探索价值尚未显现的方向。冻结LLM的搜索可复用上下文中的解，但无法从成功与失败中更新模型；而RL虽可适应，却因过度偏好高奖励轨迹而过早抑制低奖励但有潜力的方向。
AI.method: CURIO引入内在好奇心世界模型（ICWM），学习策略隐状态表示的转移，并在策略top-k选择之外的采样token上提供预测误差奖励。通过epoch归一化和退火权重调节其对策略更新的贡献。
AI.result: 在六个数学发现任务和单细胞去噪任务上，使用8B至235B的Qwen3骨干，三次运行均值在五个数学目标上优于仅任务RL控制，Circle Packing上匹配最佳报告性能；去噪Score和MSE在两个留出语料及所有尺度上均改善。Hadamard相对增益18.3%，去噪Score提升10.8%。代码多样性测量显示生成程序结构变化更大。
AI.conclusion: 好奇心作为互补的探索信号，支持开放发现中的学习。

title: Are We Measuring Scientific Intelligence? Rethinking the Evaluation of AI Scientists
comment: [Oral] NeurIPS 2026 Agentic AI for Biological Discovery Workshop
summary: AI agents can now carry out data-driven scientific analyses end to end, and benchmarks assess them by giving an agent a question and a dataset and scoring its final answer against a fixed key. These benchmarks assume that a correct answer was derived from the supplied data, a property we call evidence grounding. However, an agent can also reach the key from prior knowledge or by ruling out the other options, and a score based on a single run cannot tell these cases apart. We show how to test this assumption and find that it often fails. For each question, we build versions of its data files in which the evidence for the answer is left intact, withdrawn or reversed, check each edit with a pre-registered reference statistic, and run the same agent on every version. We then measure evidence-grounded accuracy, which credits a correct answer only if the agent also responds when the evidence is withdrawn and follows it when it is reversed. We evaluate three agent scaffolds and five models on 18 single-cell questions from BAISBench and four synthetic problems from GeneBench-Pro. On the single-cell questions, the Claude agents are 95% accurate and answer 83% correctly without any data, but their evidence-grounded accuracy is only 41%. Hiding gene names raises the share of runs that follow reversed evidence from 58% to 93% on ten gene tasks, suggesting that prior knowledge competes with the supplied data. The benchmark score and LLM judges can also reward answers that ignore the changed evidence. Measuring scientific intelligence rather than recall therefore requires checking whether answers follow the evidence and whether scores reward them for it.

AI.tldr: 论文指出AI智能体在数据驱动科学分析基准中可能不依赖提供的数据(证据)而靠先验知识或排除法答对,提出检验"证据接地"的方法并发现基准假设常常不成立。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准只给一个问题加数据集,再用固定答案键给最终答案打分,默认正确答案来自所给数据。但智能体也可能靠先验知识或排除其他选项得到答案,单次运行分数无法区分这些情况,因此需检验证据接地假设是否成立。
AI.method: 为每个问题构造数据文件的三个版本(residual证据保留、撤回、反转),用预注册的参考统计量校验每次编辑,并在每个版本上运行同一智能体;由此定义"证据接地准确率"——只有当证据撤回时智能体不给出答案、证据反转时其答案随之改变,才算正确。在BAISBench 18个单细胞问题和GeneBench-Pro 4个合成问题上评估3种智能体框架和5个模型。
AI.result: 单细胞问题上,Claude智能体准确率95%,但在无任何数据时仍有83%答对,而证据接地准确率仅41%。在10个基因任务中隐藏基因名后,跟随反转证据的运行比例从58%升至93%,说明先验知识与所给数据存在竞争。基准分数和LLM评判也可能奖励忽视变化证据的答案。
AI.conclusion: 衡量科学智能而非记忆,必须检验答案是否真正遵循证据,以及评分是否奖励这种遵循。

title: DeferKV: Rethinking Eviction Timing for One-Shot KV Cache Compression
summary: Long-context large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of tasks, but the growing KV cache introduces substantial memory and inference overhead. Existing one-shot KV cache compression methods typically commit to irreversible eviction immediately after prefill, before any signal from actual generation becomes available. Our quantitative analysis shows that early queries from the actual generation stage provide attention signals that are more consistent with subsequent decode attention, with the largest single-step gain occurring at the prefill-decode boundary. Based on this observation, we propose DeferKV, which moves the eviction decision from the end of prefill to the first real decoding step and temporally combines prompt-side and decode-side observations, thereby better aligning KV importance estimation with subsequent generation requirements. DeferKV requires no additional training, draft model, or future-query prediction module, making it simple and easy to deploy. Experiments on LongBench, RULER, and Needle-in-a-Haystack demonstrate that DeferKV consistently improves model performance under KV cache compression while maintaining low inference latency.

AI.tldr: 提出DeferKV，将KV缓存淘汰决策从prefill末尾推迟到首个真实解码步，融合prompt侧与decode侧观测以更准确估计KV重要性，无需额外训练。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM的KV缓存带来显著内存与推理开销；现有一次性压缩方法在prefill结束即做不可逆淘汰，此时尚无真实生成信号，导致重要性估计与实际解码需求不一致。
AI.method: 基于定量分析（prefill-decode边界处单步增益最大，早期生成query的注意力信号更接近后续解码注意力），将淘汰决策推迟到第一个真实解码步，并时序融合prompt侧与decode侧观测，无需训练、草稿模型或未来query预测模块。
AI.result: 在LongBench、RULER和Needle-in-a-Haystack上，KV缓存压缩下模型性能持续提升，同时保持低推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 延迟淘汰决策并融合双阶段注意力信号是简单有效、易部署的KV缓存压缩思路，可在压缩同时兼顾性能与效率。

title: ArticuTable: Generating Instance-Level Interactive Rigid-Articulated 3D Tabletop Scenes from a Single Image
summary: Embodied agents benefit from 3D environments that combine visual fidelity to real-world observations with physical interactivity. Existing single-image tabletop reconstruction methods recover plausible scene geometry but typically represent objects as monolithic rigid bodies, limiting interaction to whole-object rigid motion and precluding executable part-level articulation. Meanwhile, recovering a scene layout consistent with the input view remains challenging because a single observation may admit multiple plausible pose-scale configurations. We present ArticuTable, a single-image 3D tabletop reconstruction framework that recovers both executable part-level articulation and an input-view-consistent scene layout. For object modeling, we introduce generation-robust articulation modeling (GRAM), which combines joint fitting guided by a multimodal large language model with semantic state reasoning to recover reliable joint parameters and valid motion ranges from imperfect monolithic proxy meshes, thereby converting them into executable articulated assets. For scene layout, we introduce progressive semantic-geometric scene registration (PSGSR), which progressively narrows the pose-scale search space under complementary metric, planar, and input-view constraints and resolves orientation ambiguity through structure-aware semantic correspondences, yielding a scene layout consistent with the input view. We further contribute ArticuTable-100, a curated collection of 100 simulation-ready tabletop scenes. Extensive evaluation, including a user study, demonstrates strong performance across visual fidelity, input-view consistency, articulation quality, physical plausibility, and simulation readiness.

AI.tldr: 提出ArticuTable，一种单图桌面3D重建框架，同时恢复可执行的部件级铰接和与输入视角一致的场景布局，并贡献ArticuTable-100数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有单图桌面重建方法通常将物体表示为整体刚体，仅支持整体刚性运动，无法实现部件级铰接；同时单一观测可能存在多种合理的位姿-尺度配置，难以恢复与输入视角一致的场景布局。
AI.method: 包含两个核心模块：1）生成鲁棒铰接建模（GRAM），结合多模态大语言模型引导的关节拟合与语义状态推理，从有缺陷的整体代理网格中恢复可靠关节参数与有效运动范围，转化为可执行铰接资产；2）渐进式语义-几何场景配准（PSGSR），在度量、平面和输入视角约束下逐步缩小位姿-尺度搜索空间，通过结构感知语义对应解决朝向歧义。
AI.result: 构建了ArticuTable-100（100个可仿真桌面场景集合），并通过大量评估及用户研究，在视觉保真度、输入视角一致性、铰接质量、物理合理性和仿真就绪度方面均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: ArticuTable实现了单图桌面场景的部件级铰接重建与视角一致布局，验证了其在仿真就绪场景生成方面的有效性。

title: Greedy Local Learning for Language Model Pretraining: Gaps and Objective Design
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Collaborative, Open, and Decentralized Training of Foundation Models (CODEC-FM). 13 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables
summary: Greedy block-wise local learning splits a network into gradient-isolated blocks trained by local auxiliary losses, deleting the backward pass between blocks: inter-stage communication becomes forward-only and every block can step its optimizer independently, properties directly relevant to decentralized model-parallel training. Local learning is competitive with end-to-end backpropagation on image classification, and on small Transformers it is known to trade a worse best loss for parallel speedup. How this loss gap behaves in autoregressive language model (LM) pretraining at larger scale, and which auxiliary designs reduce it, has not been measured. We present a token-budget-matched empirical study at 125M and 400M parameters with $K \in \{1,2,4\}$ blocks at Chinchilla-optimal budgets, factorizing the auxiliary design into network architecture and training objective. We observe: (i) the gap to end-to-end training more than doubles from $K=2$ to $K=4$, but at $K=4$ shrinks from 125M to 400M; (ii) replacing an MLP auxiliary with a Transformer-based one is a strong network-side intervention, recovering 22-41% of the gap; (iii) a multi-token-prediction (MTP) auxiliary objective helps at the first block boundary, whereas adding it at deeper boundaries hurts, and restricting it to the first block yields the best $K=4$ configuration ($+0.062$ vs. $+0.075$ nats at 400M); and (iv) deployment-style per-block execution reduces activation memory by up to $2.2\times$. We frame these results as an empirically grounded method direction rather than a finalized method: local objectives should apply future-predictive pressure selectively across boundaries while resisting shortcuts that bypass predictive content.

AI.tldr: 本文对125M与400M参数的GPT类模型进行token预算匹配的贪心分块局部学习实验，因子化辅助设计的网络架构与训练目标，测量自回归LM预训练中的损失差距并探索缩小该差距的设计方向。
AI.motivation: 局部学习在图像分类上可与端到端反向传播竞争，在小Transformer上有并行加速但损失更差。该损失差距在更大规模自回归语言模型预训练中的表现，以及哪些辅助设计能缩小差距，尚未被测量。
AI.method: 在125M和400M参数、Chinchilla最优化token预算下，用K∈{1,2,4}个梯度隔离块开展token预算匹配的实证研究，将辅助设计分解为：(1)网络架构(MLP vs. Transformer辅助块)；(2)训练目标(多token预测MTP辅助目标)；并测量部署式逐块执行的内存收益。
AI.result: (i) 与端到端训练的差距从K=2到K=4增加一倍以上，但K=4时从125M到400M缩小；(ii) 将MLP辅助替换为Transformer辅助可恢复22-41%的差距；(iii) MTP辅助目标在首个块边界有益，在更深边界有害，仅限首块时K=4配置最佳(400M下+0.062 vs. +0.075 nats)；(iv) 逐块执行将激活内存降低最多2.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 本文结果被视为一种有实证依据的方法方向而非定型方法：局部目标应有选择地在各边界施加未来预测压力，同时抵抗绕过预测内容的捷径。

title: Zero-Shot Time-Series Question Answering via Decoupled Perception and Reasoning
summary: Time-series question answering (TSQA) requires grounding linguistic queries and diverse answer formats in complex numerical observations. However, existing methods heavily overfit to specific datasets and struggle to generalize when input series, question contexts, and answer requirements shift simultaneously. To address this challenge, we propose TSHarness, an agentic framework that establishes a decoupled workflow for cross-dataset zero-shot TSQA. At its core, TSHarness divides and conquers numerical perception and contextual reasoning via a structured Time-Series Perception State (TPS). Guided by a reusable memory of analytical knowledge, a learned Tool Selector adaptively invokes numerical tools to extract salient statistical and temporal features into the TPS. The answering agent then performs semantic reasoning over the TPS to generate target outputs, triggering iterative re-perception through the feedback loop when evidence is deemed insufficient. By separating numerical feature extraction from question-specific reasoning, TSHarness eliminates the need for target-side training or answer feedback, providing a generalizable, cost-efficient foundation for zero-shot TSQA.

AI.tldr: 提出TSHarness，一种解耦数值感知与上下文推理的agentic框架，实现跨数据集零样本时序问答。
AI.motivation: 现有时序问答方法过度拟合特定数据集，当输入序列、问题上下文和答案要求同时变化时难以泛化。
AI.method: 通过结构化Time-Series Perception State (TPS)解耦数值感知与推理；可复用分析知识记忆引导学习的Tool Selector自适应调用数值工具提取统计与时间特征到TPS；回答agent基于TPS语义推理生成输出，证据不足时通过反馈循环触发迭代再感知。
AI.result: 消除目标侧训练或答案反馈需求，为跨数据集零样本TSQA提供可泛化、成本高效的基础。
AI.conclusion: TSHarness通过分离数值特征提取与问题特定推理，有效应对跨数据集零样本时序问答的泛化挑战。

title: From Abusive Language Classification to Sequence Labeling Identification
summary: Industrial content moderation must process massive message streams under tight latency constraints, yet most abusive language (AL) detection systems rely on sentence-level classification (ALC), which neither localizes abusive spans nor identifies who is targeted. We define Abusive Language Identification (ALI) as a sequence-labeling task that jointly extracts AL spans and target mentions, and assess whether this approach can be used for text moderation. On a pilot corpus drawn from a production moderation pipeline, we compare ALI with ALC on cross-domain generalization and implicit abuse, and we also evaluate AL and target span detection. ALI remains competitive with ALC while providing localized outputs for moderators, with a modest and configuration-sensitive advantage on implicit abuse. Exact AL boundaries and target spans remain difficult to recover. We complement this comparison with a qualitative analysis and discuss perspectives on complete target--span linking and on structured benchmarks for ALI.

AI.tldr: 该论文定义"辱骂语言识别"(ALI)为序列标注任务，联合抽取辱骂片段与目标指称，并在生产审核语料上证明其性能与句子级分类(ALC)相当，同时能定位片段，但边界与目标跨度仍难精确恢复。
AI.motivation: 工业内容审核需在严格延迟下处理海量消息，但主流辱骂语言检测依赖句子级分类(ALC)，既不能定位辱骂片段，也无法识别被攻击对象，难以满足审核员需求。
AI.method: 将ALI定义为序列标注任务，联合抽取辱骂跨度与目标指称；在来自生产审核流程的试点语料上，对比ALI与ALC在跨域泛化和隐式辱骂上的表现，并评估辱骂与目标跨度检测，辅以定性分析。
AI.result: ALI与ALC竞争性相当，同时为审核员提供定位输出；在隐式辱骂上具有小幅且对配置敏感的优势；精确的辱骂边界与目标跨度仍难以恢复。
AI.conclusion: ALI可作为文本审核的可行方案，但完整的目标—跨度链接与结构化基准仍有待进一步研究。

title: MGPO: Manifold-Guided Diffusion Alignment for Task-Aware Dataset Distillation
summary: Diffusion-based dataset distillation (DD) suffers from a fundamental objective mismatch: likelihood-driven diffusion models prioritize density approximation over the discriminative decision boundaries required for downstream tasks. Beyond semantic mismatch, relying solely on density also leads to geometric coverage loss, where generated samples collapse into a few high-density modes and fail to cover the manifold's structural diversity. We propose Manifold-Guided Policy Optimization (MGPO), which reformulates DD as a multi-objective reinforcement learning problem and achieves Dual-Space Alignment via a pixel-space discriminative reward and a latent-space geometric reward guided by a class-wise Minimum Spanning Tree (MST). The discriminative reward enforces class separability, while the MST-based geometric reward encourages generated latents to cover a sparse geometric skeleton of each class, jointly addressing both failure modes. We further provide an idealized analysis that motivates the MST-based reward, including a Hausdorff approximation bound and a subsampling bound independent of the dataset size. The reward-modular design extends to structured tasks such as object detection and segmentation by substituting the frozen task reward model. Extensive experiments show MGPO consistently outperforms existing methods, including a +8.0% mIoU gain on segmentation under low-budget settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MGPO，将扩散数据集蒸馏重构为多目标强化学习问题，通过像素级判别奖励与基于类别MST潜空间几何奖励实现双空间对齐，缓解密度近似与几何覆盖缺失两大问题，在多任务上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的数据集蒸馏存在目标错配：似然驱动的扩散模型侧重密度近似，忽视下游任务所需的判别决策边界；仅依赖密度还导致几何覆盖损失，生成样本塌缩到少数高密度模态，无法覆盖流形结构多样性。
AI.method: 提出Manifold-Guided Policy Optimization (MGPO)，将数据集蒸馏重构为多目标强化学习问题。通过像素空间判别奖励增强类可分性，通过类别级最小生成树(MST)引导的潜空间几何奖励促使生成潜变量覆盖每类的稀疏几何骨架。奖励模块化设计可替换冻结任务奖励模型，扩展到目标检测与分割等结构化任务。并提供MST奖励的理论分析，包括Hausdorff近似界与与数据集规模无关的子采样界。
AI.result: 大量实验表明MGPO持续优于现有方法，在低预算设置下分割任务取得+8.0% mIoU提升。
AI.conclusion: MGPO通过双空间对齐与MST几何先验，同时解决判别性不足和几何覆盖塌缩问题，并能推广到结构化下游任务，验证了其有效性与通用性。

title: Your Temporal Link Predictor Is Blind to Who Is Active: A Missing Factor That Transfers Across Models
summary: An interaction has two parts: someone decides to act, and then chooses whom to act on. Temporal link prediction has concentrated on the second, and we show that it is blind to the first by construction: a standard negative keeps the real source and swaps the destination, and we prove that this cancels the source's activity exactly from the optimal score, so no model trained and evaluated this way is ever rewarded for learning it. Under the harder historical and inductive negatives, whose sources differ, the same factor becomes the dominant signal. We model it with Source Node Activity Modeling (SNAM), a self-exciting event intensity fitted by an exact point-process likelihood to decayed interaction counts the history states already contain; it has fewer than 20 parameters. On their own, never looking at the destination, these parameters beat DyGFormer and TPNet on four of five datasets under historical negatives. Added to the frozen scores of TPNet, TGN, DyGFormer and DSRD, four models of different design, without retraining anything, they raise AP on almost every backbone-dataset pair in both settings, by up to 25 points. Our full model ranks first overall against eleven baselines on 13 datasets and three protocols, and on million-event streams trains an epoch 9-100x faster than TPNet and DyGFormer. We conclude that source activity is a blind spot of temporal link prediction, and a cheap, transferable one to close. Code is available at https://github.com/Erutaner/Your-Temporal-Link-Predictor-Is-Blind-to-Who-Is-Active.

AI.tldr: 本文指出时序链接预测忽视交互中的"谁发起"（源活跃度）信号，提出源节点活跃度建模(SNAM)，用小参数模型显著提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 交互包含两部分：谁决定行动、以及选择作用对象。时序链接预测主要研究后者，而作者证明标准的负采样（保留真实源、替换目标）在设计上会让源活跃度从最优评分中被精确抵消，导致模型无法学到该信号。在历史与归纳式负采样下，源活跃度反而成为主导信号，却被现有方法忽视。
AI.method: 提出源节点活跃度建模(SNAM)，一种自激发事件强度模型，通过精确的点过程似然拟合历史状态中已包含的衰减交互计数，参数少于20个。
AI.result: 单独使用SNAM（不看目标）在历史负采样下于5个数据集中的4个上超过DyGFormer和TPNet。将其加入TPNet、TGN、DyGFormer、DSRD的冻结评分后，无需重训练即可在几乎每个主干-数据集组合上提升AP，最高提升25点。完整模型在13个数据集、3种协议下对抗11个基线排名第一，在百万级事件流上训练每轮比TPNet和DyGFormer快9-100倍。
AI.conclusion: 源活跃度是时序链接预测的盲区，而SNAM是一种廉价且可迁移的解决方案，可有效弥补该盲区。

title: BACAM: Behavior-Aware Continual Agent Merging for Multi-Turn Interaction
summary: Model merging offers a way to integrate the capabilities of specialized experts, but existing agent merging methods typically require all of them to be available at once. We study continual agent merging, which integrates incoming experts sequentially without retaining previously merged experts. Yet merging in parameter space or feature subspaces does not ensure that the merged model acquires an incoming expert's behavior on interaction trajectories. Moreover, updates toward a new expert can disrupt the merged model's previously integrated interactive behavior. Therefore, we propose Behavior-Aware Continual Agent Merging (BACAM), which learns parameter-wise merging gates from candidate-generated trajectories using expert-guided behavioral supervision. Task-level stability-plasticity control and tensor-level conflict-aware update budgets limit interference with existing capabilities while allowing new ones to be acquired. The learned gates are folded into the model weights without additional inference-time parameters. Across four interactive tasks - web shopping, tool use, information retrieval, and embodied interaction - BACAM achieves an average success rate of 62.82%, exceeding the strongest evaluated merging baseline by 21.69 percentage points. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/shuaitongli/BACAM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BACAM，一种行为感知的持续智能体合并方法，通过专家引导的行为监督学习参数级合并门控，在四个交互任务上平均成功率达62.82%，超过最强基线21.69个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体合并方法要求所有专家同时可用，无法逐个整合专家；且参数空间或特征子空间合并无法保证合并模型在交互轨迹上学到新专家行为，同时新专家更新会破坏已整合的交互能力。
AI.method: 提出行为感知持续智能体合并（BACAM）：从候选轨迹中利用专家引导的行为监督学习参数级合并门控；采用任务级稳定性-可塑性控制与张量级冲突感知更新预算来限制对已有能力的干扰；学习到的门控折叠进模型权重，不增加推理参数。
AI.result: 在四个交互任务（网络购物、工具使用、信息检索、具身交互）上平均成功率达62.82%，超过最强评估基线21.69个百分点。
AI.conclusion: BACAM有效解决了持续智能体合并中的行为获取与灾难性遗忘问题，在不增加推理开销的前提下显著优于现有合并方法，代码已公开。

title: DialectSentEval 2026: Arabic Dialect Sentiment Analysis and Swapping Shared Task
summary: Sentiment analysis is a fundamental problem in Natural Language Processing (NLP). Standard sentiment classification for the Arabic language remains challenging due to the high volume of dialectal Arabic. To advance research in this area, this paper proposes the Shared Task on Sentiment Analysis and Swapping in Arabic Dialects (DialectSentEval), hosted with the Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference (ArabicNLP 2026). This shared task consists of two subtasks: Subtask 1 focuses on multi-class and multi-dialect sentiment analysis, requiring models to identify sentiment polarity across various Arabic dialects. Subtask 2 introduces a generative task for Arabic sentiment swap, challenging models to invert sentiment polarity while preserving core semantics. In this overview paper, we present the motivation, dataset creation, and summarize the main findings from participating models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 DialectSentEval 阿拉伯方言情感分析与情感交换共享任务的概览，包含两个子任务：多类别多方言情感分类，以及保持语义的情感极性反转生成任务。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语方言数量庞大，标准情感分类困难，亟需推动该领域研究。
AI.method: 在 ArabicNLP 2026 举办共享任务，设计两个子任务：子任务1为多类别多方言情感极性识别；子任务2为生成式情感交换，要求反转情感极性同时保持核心语义。论文介绍动机、数据集构建并总结参赛模型结果。
AI.result: 论文总结了参赛模型的主要发现（摘要中未给出具体数据指标）。
AI.conclusion: 该共享任务旨在推动阿拉伯方言情感分析及情感交换生成研究的发展。

title: Hybrid-Basis Feature Forecasting for Diffusion Sampling Acceleration
summary: We propose Hybrid-Basis Feature Forecasting (HybridFF), a training-free, plug-and-play framework for accelerating diffusion sampling. To capture local smoothness, long-range trends, and complex non-monotonic variations when modeling feature evolution, HybridFF first estimates coefficients using moving least squares (MLS) for each of multiple complementary basis families and then combines the corresponding predictors using fusion weights. In addition to the choice of basis functions, the fusion weights also play a critical role. We introduce two strategies to balance quality and speedup. HybridFF (Fixed) prioritizes efficiency with model-specific fusion weights calibrated on a small set and held constant during inference. HybridFF (Adaptive) updates the fusion weights online using branch reliability scores computed from an exponential moving average of full-step prediction errors, improving prediction fidelity and generation quality under aggressive caching while retaining substantial acceleration. Experiments across DiT-XL/2, FLUX.1-dev, SD3.5-Large, and HunyuanVideo demonstrate a favorable speedup--quality trade-off over representative single-basis forecasters and caching baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出HybridFF，一种免训练、即插即用的扩散采样加速框架，通过多基函数预测器融合实现更优的加速-质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散采样推理成本高，现有单基函数预测器难以同时捕捉特征演化中的局部平滑、长期趋势和复杂非单调变化。
AI.method: 对多个互补基函数族分别用移动最小二乘(MLS)估计系数，再通过融合权重组合预测器；分固定(Fixed，小样本校准权重)与自适应(Adaptive，基于全步预测误差EMA的分支可靠性在线更新权重)两种策略。
AI.result: 在DiT-XL/2、FLUX.1-dev、SD3.5-Large和HunyuanVideo上，相比代表性单基函数预测器和缓存基线取得更优的加速-质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: 多基函数融合及融合权重设计能有效平衡扩散采样加速与生成质量，为免训练加速提供实用方案。

title: ResOPD: Tail Residualization for Sparse On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on self-generated trajectories, but transmitting dense teacher distributions across long reasoning traces creates prohibitive communication and memory bottlenecks. Practical systems therefore rely on sparse teacher interfaces, typically transmitting either the sampled-token score or a small Top-$k$ distribution. However, this sparse setting faces a fundamental dilemma: sampled-token estimators are unbiased but suffer from severe gradient variance, whereas directly optimizing Top-$k$ objectives introduces systematic bias. To improve this trade-off, we propose ResOPD (On-Policy Distillation with Tail Residualization), which provides unbiased full-vocabulary reverse KL gradient estimation under on-policy sampling, with substantial variance reduction under the same sparse payload in the evaluated settings. ResOPD aggregates the unobserved vocabulary into an observable coarse tail event, computes its exact aggregate gradient, and samples only the fine-grained within-tail residual, which requires no additional teacher queries or forward passes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ResOPD substantially reduces gradient variance, stabilizes online training dynamics, and improves downstream performance across the evaluated settings. These results establish ResOPD as an efficient, plug-and-play variance reduction primitive for sparse on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出ResOPD,在稀疏教师接口下实现无偏且低方差的on-policy蒸馏反向KL梯度估计。
AI.motivation: On-policy蒸馏需传输密集教师分布,带来通信与内存瓶颈;实际系统用稀疏接口(采样token分数或Top-k),但采样token估计无偏却方差大,Top-k目标有系统偏差,存在基本权衡困境。
AI.method: ResOPD将未观测词表聚合成可观测的粗粒度尾部事件,计算其精确聚合梯度,仅采样细粒度尾部内残差,无需额外教师查询或前向传播,提供无偏的全词表反向KL梯度估计。
AI.result: 在相同稀疏载荷下显著降低梯度方差,稳定在线训练动态,并在多项评估设置中提升下游性能。
AI.conclusion: ResOPD是一种高效、即插即用的稀疏on-policy蒸馏方差缩减原语。

title: Runtime Authorization of Self-Generated Subgoals in Long-Horizon Tool-Using AI Agents
summary:
Long-horizon tool-using AI agents create subgoals, replan, delegate work, and compose sibling results. Per-tool permission checks cannot establish that a changing goal graph remains within the principal-approved task. We address this authorization gap in a finite structured domain with one principal and one authorization root. Each proposed goal-graph mutation carries a version-bound witness that its continuation traces, resources, obligations, invariants, and closing condition refine the active root contract; every protected effect is rechecked at an atomic commit boundary. Free-form goal text supplies no authority.
  We prove trace-policy and modeled forbidden-state preservation under explicit mediation, abstraction, freshness, and atomicity assumptions, plus conditional root-success preservation, a separation result for memoryless allowlists, exact finite-domain decidability, and universal-safety monotonicity under sound abstraction refinement. An executable model explores 340 states and 419 transitions. Across 96 matched cases covering 25 structural schemas, the complete mechanism commits zero forbidden states in 48 drifted cases and completes all 48 benign counterparts. Two public upstream runtime paths execute 258 native dispatches across 32 cases, with every case-level decision and receipt chain matching. A frozen host-local study covers 129 synthetic one-factor-at-a-time cells, all matching fixed decisions and reasons. A history-aware continuation comparator blocks every modeled bad trace prefix but commits all operations in 11 cases whose violations lie in typed resources, freshness, or explicit-join evidence outside its trace projection. Within the registered structured domains, runtime authorization preserves useful replanning while preventing self-generated subgoals from becoming a source of new authority.

AI.tldr: 提出运行时授权机制，为长时程工具型AI代理的目标图变更提供版本绑定的见证与原子提交校验，防止自生成子目标成为新授权来源，并给出理论证明与多组实验验证。
AI.motivation: 长时程工具型代理会创建子目标、重规划、委派任务并组合结果，逐工具权限检查无法保证不断变化的目标图仍处于委托方批准的任务范围内，存在授权缺口。
AI.method: 在有限结构化域、单委托方与单授权根下，要求每个目标图变更携带版本绑定见证，证明其延续轨迹、资源、义务、不变量与关闭条件精化当前根契约；每个受保护效应在原子提交边界重检。自由文本目标不提供授权。
AI.result: 证明轨迹策略与被建模禁止状态保持、条件性根成功保持、无记忆白名单分离结果、有限域可判定性及健全抽象精化下的通用安全单调性。可执行模型含340状态419转移；96组匹配案例中48个漂移案例零禁止提交、48个良性案例全部完成；两条公共运行时路径258次派发全部匹配；129个合成单元全部匹配；历史感知比较器阻断所有坏轨迹前缀但提交11个超出其投影的案例。
AI.conclusion: 在已注册结构化域内，运行时授权既保留有用的重规划能力，又阻止自生成子目标成为新授权来源。

title: Agentic schema-guided extraction of materials process knowledge from scientific literature
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, submitted for review to Nature Communications Materials
summary: Materials literature contains detailed experimental knowledge, but procedures, chemical entities and measurements remain difficult to aggregate because they are reported in heterogeneous forms and depend on process-specific context. We present SciKGExtract, a schema-guided framework that combines large-language-model extraction with chemical normalization and agent-based evaluation and refinement before knowledge-graph integration. We evaluate the framework on 176 atomic-layer-deposition papers describing zinc oxide (ZnO) and indium--gallium--zinc oxide (IGZO), together with an expert-annotated full-schema subset. PubChem normalization improves exact-match extraction F1 for every tested model. For ZnO, the best F1 increases from 0.591 for direct normalized extraction to 0.805 with agentic refinement, whereas the best IGZO result is 0.344, revealing the greater difficulty of multicomponent supercycle processes. Evaluation against a deeply nested schema containing 65 experimental properties and 155 quantitative measurement nodes further exposes errors in process segmentation and numerical assignment. These results show that chemical canonicalization and targeted agentic verification provide complementary controls for converting complex materials literature into reusable, machine-actionable experimental knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SciKGExtract框架，结合大语言模型抽取、化学标准化与智能体评估修正，将材料文献转化为知识图谱，并在ZnO/IGZO的ALD论文上验证。
AI.motivation: 材料文献含丰富实验知识，但程序、化学实体和测量数据形式异构、依赖过程语境，难以聚合。
AI.method: SciKGExtract：模式引导框架，融合LLM抽取、PubChem化学标准化，以及基于智能体的评估与修正，再进行知识图谱集成。在176篇ZnO和IGZO的原子层沉积论文及专家标注全模式子集上评测。
AI.result: PubChem标准化提升了所有模型的精确匹配抽取F1。ZnO最佳F1由直接标准化抽取的0.591提升至智能体修正后的0.805；IGZO最佳仅0.344，反映多组分超循环工艺更难。含65个实验属性、155个定量测量节点的深层嵌套模式评测进一步暴露了过程分割与数值归属错误。
AI.conclusion: 化学规范化与针对性智能体验证为将复杂材料文献转化为可复用、机器可操作的实验知识提供了互补的控制手段。

title: When and What to Prune? Stage-Aware Visual Token Pruning for Efficient VLA
summary: Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate vision-language models and is especially useful for vision-language-action (VLA) inference, where many visual tokens must be processed before predicting robot actions. Existing pruning methods usually estimate which tokens can be pruned based on attention scores or feature diversity, retaining tokens that are either highly attended or visually different from others. However, most of them use fixed pruning schedules, such as pruning once at a preset layer or pruning at uniformly spaced layers. Such schedules can be risky for VLA models, because the model may not know which visual regions matter for the action in early layers. Tokens that look unimportant at first may become useful after the model combines visual observations with the language instruction. In this work, we propose SAPrune, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient VLA inference. Instead of pruning at fixed layers, SAPrune uses a small calibration set to observe how action-to-visual attention changes across layers, and chooses pruning layers only after the attention pattern becomes more reliable. At each selected layer, SAPrune applies a dual-path pruning rule: one path protects strongly attended visual tokens from pruning, while the other prevents useful surrounding context from being discarded. Experiments on LIBERO, SIMPLER, and real-world robotic tasks show that SAPrune prunes 87.5% of visual tokens and achieves up to 1.718x inference speedup while maintaining competitive task success rates.

AI.tldr: SAPrune：一种免训练的视觉token剪枝框架，通过校准集动态选择剪枝层，实现VLA推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有剪枝方法使用固定剪枝计划（如预设层或均匀间隔层），但VLA模型早期层无法判断哪些视觉区域对动作重要，早期看似无用的token可能在结合语言指令后变得有用，固定计划存在风险。
AI.method: 利用小校准集观察action-to-visual注意力随层变化，在注意力模式可靠后才选择剪枝层；每个选中层应用双路径剪枝规则：一路保护强注意力token，另一路保留有用的周边上下文。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、SIMPLER及真实机器人任务上，剪枝87.5%视觉token，推理加速最高1.718倍，同时保持有竞争力的任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: SAPrune为VLA推理提供了一种有效且免训练的视觉token剪枝方案，兼顾效率与任务性能。

title: SFlexRCA: Lightweight, Scalable, and Flexible Root Cause Analysis for IIoT Edge Systems
summary: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) systems generate high-dimensional sensor telemetry from interconnected components, where faults can propagate across the system. To address these challenges, we propose SFlexRCA (Scalable and Flexible Root Cause Analysis), a topology-free RCA framework designed for resource-constrained IIoT environments. SFlexRCA transforms multivariate telemetry into compact orthogonal representations and applies shared lightweight linear modeling, avoiding explicit graph construction, message passing, and per-variable or lag-specific parameter growth. We evaluate SFlexRCA on three publicly available IIoT datasets, BATADAL, SWaT, and WADI, spanning different numbers of monitored variables, temporal characteristics, and training-data regimes. SFlexRCA is compared with 10 statistical, causal, and non-causal baselines in terms of RCA accuracy, training efficiency, inference latency, and memory consumption. In addition, inference efficiency and memory consumption are evaluated on Raspberry Pi 3 and Raspberry Pi 5, while energy consumption is additionally measured on Raspberry Pi 5. We further investigate temporalcontext sensitivity, architectural and loss components, and alternative representations. Notably, SFlexRCA maintains strong localization performance on BATADAL despite its limited normal-operation training data, while its compact shared architecture avoids the parameter growth associated with causal and graph-based approaches. Its lightweight shared architecture further enables efficient deployment on resource-constrained IIoT edge devices. The SFlexRCA code is available at https://github.com/theamrzaki/RootCause- Analysis-Correlation-Attentive-Modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出SFlexRCA，一种无拓扑、可扩展的IIoT根因分析框架，将多元遥测转为紧凑正交表示并用共享轻量线性建模，在三个IIoT数据集上实现高定位精度且适合边缘部署。
AI.motivation: IIoT系统产生高维传感器遥测数据，组件互联、故障会跨系统传播，传统RCA方法依赖显式图构建、消息传递或大量参数，难以适应资源受限的IIoT边缘环境。
AI.method: SFlexRCA将多元遥测转化为紧凑正交表示，应用共享的轻量线性建模，避免显式图构建、消息传递以及按变量或时滞增长的参数；它无需拓扑信息。
AI.result: 在BATADAL、SWaT、WADI三个公开IIoT数据集上与10个统计、因果及非因果基线在RCA精度、训练效率、推理延迟和内存消耗方面对比；并在树莓派3/5上评估推理效率与内存，在树莓派5上测能耗。SFlexRCA在BATADAL训练数据有限时仍保持强定位性能，且参数不随节点/时滞增长。
AI.conclusion: SFlexRCA为资源受限的IIoT环境提供了高效、可扩展的根因分析方案，轻量共享架构支持边缘设备高效部署；代码已开源。

title: Do LLMs Understand Sequential Structure? A Controlled Study of Inference and Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as interactive agents and simulators, yet it remains unclear whether they can recover latent sequential structure beyond surface action frequencies. This distinction is critical for behavioral simulation, where actions are often shaped by prior context rather than marginal frequencies alone. We study this question using controlled two-player Rock--Paper--Scissors interactions and a one-player stochastic n-gram continuation task. Across these experiments, we test whether LLMs can identify latent strategies, follow simple Markov rules, and sustain higher-order conditional dependencies. Our framework separates distribution matching from conditional rule following. Results show that longer context does not improve identification, correct recognition does not ensure faithful simulation, and higher-order dependencies substantially degrade rule recovery. Apparent behavioral fidelity can therefore mask incorrect generative mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本研究检验LLM能否在表面动作频率之外恢复潜在的序列结构，通过石头剪刀布和n-gram延续任务发现：更长上下文不提升识别，正确识别不保证忠实模拟，高阶依赖显著削弱规则恢复。
AI.motivation: LLM日益作为互动代理和模拟器使用，但其能否恢复潜在的序列结构（而非仅匹配表面动作频率）尚不清楚。这对行为模拟至关重要，因为动作常由先前语境塑造而非仅边际频率。
AI.method: 采用受控的双人石头剪刀布交互和一玩家随机n-gram延续任务，测试LLM能否识别潜在策略、遵循简单马尔可夫规则并维持高阶条件依赖；框架将分布匹配与条件规则遵循分离。
AI.result: 更长上下文不改善识别；正确识别不确保忠实模拟；高阶依赖显著降低规则恢复；表面行为保真度可能掩盖错误的生成机制。
AI.conclusion: LLM表面行为保真度可能掩盖其错误的生成机制，需区分分布匹配与条件规则遵循来评估其序列结构建模能力。

title: Breaking Bureaucracy: Evaluating open-source LLMs for legal document review
summary: In this paper, we evaluate open-source generative LLMs on legal Natural Language Inference (NLI). Legal inspectorial processes take place in specific domains and often deal with confidential data. This creates a need for working with local models that do not require labeled training data. We evaluate our models on the ContractNLI benchmark and two NLI4Wills datasets. We successfully reproduce the baseline for the task (Span NLI BERT) and we evaluate multiple open-source LLMs on the same task. We analyze the invalid rate of the models, and their stability across temperature settings and domains. Among the generative models, Gemma-4 26B performs the best, reaching an accuracy of 81.2%, even outperforming the supervised model on one metric. On accuracy, it is not possible to beat the supervised model with zero-shot approaches. Qwen-3.6 35B performs well on both ContractNLI and additional datasets in the legal wills domain. Our findings indicate that zero-shot, open-source, generative LLMs are a viable alternative for real-world legal NLI when no supervised data is available. Our code is available at https://github.com/fbaratov/contractnli-llms.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了开源生成式LLM在法律自然语言推理任务上的表现，发现零样本方法在无监督数据场景下具有可行性。
AI.motivation: 法律推理过程常涉及机密数据且处于特定领域，因此需要无需标注训练数据的本地模型，避免数据泄露。
AI.method: 在ContractNLI基准和两个NLI4Wills数据集上，复现监督基线Span NLI BERT，并评估多个开源生成式LLM，分析其无效率和在不同温度与领域下的稳定性。
AI.result: Gemma-4 26B表现最佳，准确率达81.2%，在一个指标上甚至超过监督模型；零样本方法在准确率上无法超越监督模型；Qwen-3.6 35B在ContractNLI和法律遗嘱领域均表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 零样本、开源、生成式LLM在无监督数据时可作为现实法律NLI的可行替代方案。

title: Answer with Evidence: Consistency-Aware Grounded Visual Question Answering for Roadside Traffic Scenes
summary: Roadside traffic reasoning requires every free-form textual claim to be backed by visual evidence. Existing grounded multimodal large language models (MLLMs) frequently exhibit say-point mismatch, in which the textual answer contradicts the bounding boxes the model localizes. Evaluation metrics that score answers and boxes separately leave this failure unpenalized. We trace the mismatch to the conventional answer-then-ground factorization, which commits to a numerical claim before any object is enumerated. To measure it, we build RoadSceneVQA-G, a benchmark of 34.7K question-answer pairs in which every free-form answer is linked to the set of boxes that witnesses it, and we propose the Answer-Grounding Consistency (AGC) evaluation suite. To address it, we introduce Enumerate-then-Answer (EtA), which reverses the generation order so that answer-evidence agreement becomes a property of the output structure, and Enumeration-Consistent Policy Optimization (ECPO), a reinforcement learning stage that uses the union of multiple rollouts as a recall teacher without ground-truth boxes. EtA raises say-point consistency from 26.6\% to 93.7\% and grounding F1 from 52.2\% to 73.0\%, and ECPO further increases F1 to 75.6\% without per-box supervision. On gRefCOCO, the same framework outperforms the strongest compared method, indicating that it transfers beyond traffic scenes. The project is available at \url{https://github.com/GuanRunwei/RoadSceneVQA-G}.

AI.tldr: 论文针对grounded MLLM中"说-指不匹配"问题，提出"先枚举后回答"框架EtA及强化学习策略ECPO，显著提升答案-定位一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有grounded MLLM常出现say-point mismatch：文本答案与定位框矛盾。传统"先回答后定位"分解方式在枚举物体前就锁定数值断言，而分别评估答案与框的指标无法惩罚此失败。
AI.method: 构建RoadSceneVQA-G基准（34.7K QA对，每个自由答案关联证据框集）并提出AGC评测套件；提出Enumerate-then-Answer（EtA）反转生成顺序，使答案与证据一致性成为输出结构属性；提出Enumeration-Consistent Policy Optimization（ECPO），用多rollout并集作召回教师，无需真值框。
AI.result: EtA将say-point一致性从26.6%提升至93.7%，grounding F1从52.2%至73.0%；ECPO在无逐框监督下进一步将F1提至75.6%。在gRefCOCO上该框架优于最强对比方法，表明可跨场景迁移。
AI.conclusion: 通过反转生成顺序并引入无框监督的强化学习，能有效解决say-point不匹配，提升可迁移的grounded推理能力。

title: ScopeSAE: Model-Scope Feature Discovery with Interpretable Layer Selection
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are a central tool in mechanistic interpretability. However, existing SAEs are primarily trained per layer. The modeling subspace is therefore fixed by layer identity, independent of which token-layer states actually drive each prediction. We argue that this constraint contributes to several limitations observed in layer-wise SAEs, including low feature utilization, high dictionary redundancy, and features that lack direct behavioral grounding. In this paper, we propose ScopeSAE, which selects the modeling subspace per token by attributing each prediction to its most influential token-layer state via normalized gradient-based attribution, and learns features over the resulting prediction-relevant subspace. Empirically, ScopeSAE yields an effect we term reconstruction-better-than-original. Written-back reconstructions of the SAE produce lower next-token cross-entropy than the original activations, an outcome that, to our knowledge, has not previously been reported for SAEs. Through interventional analyses and a KL fine-tuning counter-experiment, we show that this effect is attributable to ScopeSAE's prediction-relevant subspace itself rather than to architectural changes. ScopeSAE further improves effective feature count, interpretability, utilization, and dictionary redundancy over existing layer-based baselines, suggesting that choosing the SAE modeling subspace by predictive relevance leads to more useful and behaviorally meaningful features.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ScopeSAE，通过归一化梯度归因在 token 级别选择最具预测影响力的 token-layer 状态作为建模子空间，而非固定层身份，从而学习更少冗余、更具行为意义的特征。
AI.motivation: 现有 SAE 通常按层训练，建模子空间由层身份固定，与真正驱动预测的 token-layer 状态无关，导致特征利用率低、字典冗余高、特征缺乏行为基础。
AI.method: ScopeSAE 对每个预测用归一化梯度归因，将预测归因到最有影响力的 token-layer 状态，从而为每个 token 选择预测相关的建模子空间，并在该子空间上学习特征。同时通过干预分析和 KL 微调对照实验验证效果来源。
AI.result: ScopeSAE 出现"重建优于原始"现象：SAE 写回重建使下一 token 交叉熵低于原始激活，这是此前未见报道的结果。干预与对照实验表明该效果源自预测相关子空间本身而非架构改动。此外在有效特征数、可解释性、利用率和字典冗余上均优于层基基线。
AI.conclusion: 按预测相关性选择 SAE 建模子空间能带来更有用、更具行为意义的特征，优于固定层的传统方法。

title: CIPO: Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization for Adaptive Tool Granularity Selection
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents solve complex tasks through multi-step interactions with external tools. These interactions often contain recurring local tool sequences. Treating such sequences as composite "Skills" can shorten tool-use trajectories and reduce repeated low-level decisions. However, when atomic tools and composite skills coexist, skill use becomes a policy problem: the agent must decide whether the current state requires atomic fine control or skill-level abstraction. In this paper, we argue that effective skill use should be studied as adaptive tool granularity selection. The most direct training signal for this problem is to compare the consequences of atomic and skill choices available from the same state. Based on this view, we propose CIPO, a Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization framework for adaptive tool granularity. CIPO constructs executable skills through budget-constrained mining of successful tool-use trajectories and trains granularity decisions with counterfactual branch rollouts. For each base rollout, CIPO branches at the first eligible granularity decision and replaces the chosen action with a feasible atomic or skill alternative. The paired outcome difference serves as a supplementary reward for policy optimization. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and model backbones show that CIPO improves task success and decision efficiency over baselines. Further analyses show that CIPO learns effective skill use by improving the choice between atomic tools and composite skills based on the current state, without simply increasing skill frequency.

AI.tldr: 论文将LLM智能体的技能使用建模为自适应工具粒度选择问题，提出CIPO框架，通过反事实分支rollout训练粒度决策，实验证明能提升任务成功率与决策效率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在工具交互中常出现重复的局部工具序列，可将其抽象为复合"技能"以缩短轨迹、减少低层决策。但当原子工具与复合技能共存时，如何选择成为策略问题：需判断当前状态该用细粒度原子控制还是技能级抽象。作者主张应把有效技能使用研究为"自适应工具粒度选择"，其最直接训练信号是比较同一状态下原子与技能选择的后果。
AI.method: 提出CIPO（Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization）框架。首先通过预算约束挖掘成功工具使用轨迹构建可执行技能；再以反事实分支rollout训练粒度决策：对每个基础rollout，在首个可用的粒度决策点分支，用可行的原子或技能替代动作，配对结果差异作为补充奖励用于策略优化。
AI.result: 在多个基准与模型骨干上，CIPO相较基线提升了任务成功率与决策效率。进一步分析表明，CIPO通过学习依据当前状态在原子工具与复合技能间做更好选择来掌握有效技能使用，而非单纯增加技能使用频率。
AI.conclusion: 将技能使用视为自适应工具粒度选择是有效的研究视角，CIPO通过反事实分支对比原子与技能的后果提供训练信号，能学到状态自适应的粒度决策，兼顾成功率与效率。

title: Ontology Concept Overlap as a Training Signal: Knowledge-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Clinical Question Answering
summary: Reinforcement learning post-training for language models relies on two reward designs: human preferences (RLHF, DPO) and binary verifiers (RLVR). Clinical question answering fits neither. Near-correct answers differ by a single substituted entity, and no executable check decides clinical correctness. We instantiate a soft verifier from a maintained controlled vocabulary: UMLS Concept Unique Identifier overlap (via scispaCy, set-level F1) gives a graded, externally specified reward computed without a model in the loop. We combine it inside GRPO with an entropy-normalised LLM judge, which covers the safety and evidence axes overlap cannot see, and a small consistency penalty on padding and repetition that keeps early-training samples scorable. This three-term composite improves over SFT on Phi-3-mini (3.8B) over MedQA by 2.9% on EM (0.700 vs 0.680) and 39% on Token-F1 (0.202 vs 0.145); on Llama-3.2-3B the corresponding gains are 14% on EM and 35% on Token-F1. We report Token-F1 as the primary metric because it credits partially-correct clinical content that EM discards at this open-generation scale. Main-table results are means over 3 seeds with standard deviations below 0.005. The method transfers to PubMedQA, where training on the PubMedQA train set with the same composite reward improves Token-F1 over SFT by 22% on Phi-3-mini and 17% on Llama-3.2-3B without retuning. A reward ablation on Phi-3, varying the judge-ontology split at a fixed consistency weight, attributes 3 EM points to the ontology term, the contribution that catches entity substitutions the judge cannot. Three negative findings constrain the design: DPO under random negatives underperforms SFT for strong-prior models but helps the weakest-prior one; PPO under a sparse neural reward diverges; GRPO with KL-in-loss collapses at 7B.

AI.tldr: 临床问答不适用传统RLHF/RLVR奖励。提出用UMLS概念重叠构建"软验证器"评分，结合熵归一化LLM裁判与一致性惩罚，在GRPO中训练，提升Phi-3-mini与Llama-3.2-3B在MedQA/PubMedQA上的EM与Token-F1。
AI.motivation: 语言模型后训练依赖人类偏好(RLHF/DPO)或二元验证器(RLVR)两类奖励。但临床问答两者都不适配：近正确答案仅差一个替换实体，且没有可执行检查能判定临床正确性。
AI.method: 从受控词表UMLS构建软验证器：基于scispaCy计算概念唯一标识符(CUI)重叠的集合级F1，得到分级、外部指定、无需模型参与循环的奖励。将其与熵归一化LLM裁判（覆盖安全与证据维度）及针对填充与重复的小型一致性惩罚组合成三项复合奖励，在GRPO中训练。
AI.result: Phi-3-mini(3.8B)在MedQA上EM提升2.9%(0.700 vs 0.680)，Token-F1提升39%(0.202 vs 0.145)；Llama-3.2-3B上EM+14%、Token-F1+35%。迁移至PubMedQA无调参提升Token-F1：Phi-3-mini +22%、Llama-3.2-3B +17%。消融显示本体项贡献3个EM点。三个负面发现：随机负样本DPO对强先验模型不如SFT但对最弱先验有帮助；稀疏神经奖励PPO发散；KL-in-loss的GRPO在7B崩溃。
