One explicit admissible basis repairs each failure (rank correlation 1.000). In or near the separable family, learned and engineered aggregation are substitutes, and the learned channel is never statistically behind at full sample size and specified capacity. Its advantages are incumbent-specific: a committed grid pays up to 0.019 AUC in decay regions it leaves uncovered (the learned channel stays within 0.004 of the strongest engineered consumer at every swept point); the highest-dimensional comparator degrades fastest with scarce data; and beyond the training support, grid-fed tree-ensemble scores go flat while a strictly increasing head keeps ranking. No single incumbent is dominated on all three axes.

AI.tldr: 论文以"方向单调性"作为规范性约束，在两侧同受约束的前提下，比较学习型聚合与手工聚合的差异。核心结论是存在子sumption边界：学习型单调通道能精确复现几何加权可分离手工统计量，但有结构性失效点，需显式可容许基修复。
AI.motivation: 既有部署流水线（单调手工聚合＋符号约束梯度提升）因组合天然满足逐输入单调性，因此"约束vs非约束"对比实际上为对手免费定价了一个它本就拥有的保证。作者希望固定可容许性，测量真正学习聚合本身的价值，而非衡量约束带来的收益。
AI.method: 采用状态为经典风险统计量（指数加权移动平均、带学习变换的高水位线）的循环网络，按构造对每个输入及每个MC-dropout样本单调。通过函数回归刻画学习型单调通道与手工统计量族的关系，并在衰减区域、稀缺数据、训练支撑外三个维度与现有对手比较。
AI.result: 学习型单调通道逐通道复现几何加权可分离族达到Spearman ρ≥0.996；窗口统计量存在可测上限；在连续性（ρ=0.924）和时间定位（0.628）上结构性失效，在暴露下限（0.829）上属可学习性边界。显式可容许基可修复每个失效（秩相关1.000）。在可分离族内学习与工程聚合可互为替代；学习通道在全样本与指定容量下从不统计落后。其优势具对手依赖性：未覆盖衰减区域网格可付高达0.019 AUC，学习通道始终在最强工程消费者0.004以内；最高维比较器在稀缺数据下退化最快；训练支撑外网格树集成分数趋于平坦而严格递增头仍能排序。
AI.conclusion: 在可分离族内外，学习与工程聚合可互为替代，显式可容许基能修复结构性与可学习性失效；没有任何单一现有对手在全部三个维度上被完全支配。

title: LifeLong Digital Twin: A Unified Modeling Paradigm and Agent Harness for Event-Driven Lifelong Health State Trajectories
summary: Human health is a continuous, dynamic trajectory shaped by the cumulative interplay of biological processes, clinical events, behaviors and environmental exposures across the life course. Unifying the full breadth of lifelong health information, including longitudinal records, genetic variation, molecular profiles and environmental histories, is essential for whole-person modeling and remains a major challenge. We introduce LifeLong Digital Twin, a unified, event-driven modeling paradigm that organizes Life Events into daily Health States and accumulates them into Lifelong Health Context. An accompanying Agent Harness incorporates multimodal evidence beyond the language model's textual context. We evaluate four language models across 25 disease endpoints on three tasks: Disease Trajectory Forecasting, Disease Risk Ranking and Multi-horizon Disease Prediction. The approach yields marked gains over the reference condition: model-averaged F1 increases by 22.0% for disease identification in trajectory forecasting and 18.3% for five-year disease outcomes; thyroid-disease F1 reaches 0.669. The framework provides a foundation for whole-person digital twins and research on personalized lifelong disease prevention.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LifeLong Digital Twin范式，将终生健康信息组织为事件驱动的健康状态序列，并配合Agent Harness整合多模态证据，实现全人建模与疾病预测。
AI.motivation: 人类健康是贯穿一生的动态轨迹，受生物过程、临床事件、行为和环境暴露共同影响。整合纵向记录、遗传变异、分子谱和环境史等全部终生健康信息对全人建模至关重要，但仍是一大挑战。
AI.method: 提出LifeLong Digital Twin——一种统一的、事件驱动的建模范式，将Life Events组织为每日Health States并累积为Lifelong Health Context；配套Agent Harness在语言模型文本上下文之外引入多模态证据。
AI.result: 在25个疾病终点、三项任务（疾病轨迹预测、疾病风险排序、多时间跨度疾病预测）上评估四个语言模型。模型平均F1在轨迹预测疾病识别上提升22.0%，五年疾病结局提升18.3%；甲状腺疾病F1达0.669。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为全人数字孪生及个性化终生疾病预防研究提供了基础。

title: End-to-End Autonomous Recursive Arborescence Deformable Flow and Non-Linear Hemodynamics for Patient-Specific Coronary Centerline Extraction
summary: Extracting patient-specific vascular trees from volumetric medical images is fundamental to computational angiography and non-invasive hemodynamic assessment. Conventional voxel segmentation models often sever delicate bifurcations, while heuristic Euclidean Minimum Spanning Trees introduce non-anatomical shortcuts. Moreover, linear Poiseuille flow neglects quadratic kinetic dissipation across arterial narrowings, underestimating ischemia. We formulate an end-to-end framework decoupling continuous geometric arborescence generation from non-linear hemodynamics. First, an autonomous 3D Ostium Landmark Localization Head with dual-sinus query channels and spherical-gated refinement eliminates centerline seeding dependency, achieving cohort mean localization error of 7.63 mm (7.43 mm LCA, 7.83 mm RCA; 71.4% <= 8.0 mm) from raw contrast context. Second, a Spatially-Grounded Deformable Step Flow Architecture queries continuous 3D feature pyramids via trilinear sampling, sequentially generating trajectories with anchor boundary enforcement (X(0) = P_start). Third, a Top-Down Recursive Arborescence State Machine detects bifurcation peaks via Tree-NMS and parameterizes predecessor parent pointers (p_k < k), guaranteeing single connected acyclic tree topology (beta_0 = 1, beta_1 = 0) with differentiable step termination. Fourth, an iterative Picard non-linear Kirchhoff solver with Young-Tsai / Gould quadratic dissipation enforces machine-precision mass conservation (residual 5.82e-11 mL/s). Across 14 development patients under standardized in-silico stenosis stress testing (Q_0 = 4.0 mL/s), linear Poiseuille flow misclassifies 75% diameter lesions as non-ischemic (FFR > 0.80) in 14/14 cases, whereas our non-linear solver captures functional ischemia (FFR = 0.5864, lesion disparity 32.89 mmHg, p = 6.10e-5) with 3.66x collateral shunting. Test set firewall isolation was maintained.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端框架，将连续几何血管树生成与非线性血流动力学解耦，联合解决血管中心线提取与缺血评估问题。
AI.motivation: 体素分割易断裂血管分叉，启发式欧氏最小生成树引入非解剖捷径；线性Poiseuille流忽略狭窄处的二次动能耗散，低估缺血。
AI.method: 四模块：3D开口标志点定位头（双窦查询+球形门控细化）；空间锚定可变形逐步流架构（三线性采样+锚点边界约束）；自顶向下递归树状态机（Tree-NMS分叉检测+父指针保证单连通无环树）；迭代Picard非线性Kirchhoff求解器（Young-Tsai/Gould二次耗散）。
AI.result: 定位误差均值7.63mm（LCA 7.43，RCA 7.83，71.4%≤8.0mm）；质量守恒残差5.82e-11 mL/s；14例狭窄压力测试中线性流14/14将75%直径病变误判为非缺血，非线性求解器捕获缺血（FFR=0.5864，压差32.89mmHg，p=6.10e-5，侧支分流3.66倍）。
AI.conclusion: 解耦几何生成与非线性血流动力学的端到端框架可稳定提取解剖合理血管树并准确识别功能性缺血，优于线性假设方法。

title: Cross-Time Directional Selection in Diffusion Sampling
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures. NeurIPS 2026 AI for Stochastic Dynamics Workshop (poster)
summary:
How strongly do the remaining diffusion-sampling steps amplify a perturbation at a late latent state? Standard measurements answer this question with newly sampled isotropic noise, even though perturbations encountered during sampling have already been transformed by earlier steps. We compare these two cases directly. For each trajectory, we transport a centered perturbation from an earlier step to a late state, then replay its direction at the same magnitude as a newly sampled isotropic perturbation; both then undergo the same remaining
  updates. Across the samplers we study, median paired shaped-to-fresh angular-gain ratios range from $1.14$ to $2.35$. Shaped angular gain exceeds its matched fresh counterpart in every trajectory in the original main cohorts. The same pattern appears when endpoint change is measured by latent RMS. The effect also appears in perceptual feature representations: earlier-sampling directions cause larger feature
  changes at the endpoint, even when the corresponding pixel-space change is comparable. Permuting shaped directions across trajectories weakens the effect, including within class, indicating that the advantage depends on alignment with the receiving trajectory as well as on shared directional structure.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了扩散采样中"早期被变换的扰动"与"新采样的各向同性噪声"在剩余采样步骤中的放大效应，发现前者具有系统性更强的角向增益。
AI.motivation: 标准测量用新采样的各向同性噪声回答"剩余扩散采样步骤对晚期隐状态扰动放大的强度"，但实际采样过程中遇到的扰动已被早期步骤变换过，二者的差异此前未被直接比较。
AI.method: 对每条轨迹，将中心化扰动从早期步骤传输到晚期状态，再以与新采样各向同性扰动相同的幅度重放其方向，两者随后经过相同的剩余更新，进行配对对比；并测量隐空间RMS端点变化、感知特征表示变化，以及跨轨迹置换方向作为对照。
AI.result: 在所研究的采样器中，形变扰动与新采样扰动的角向增益比中位数范围为1.14至2.35；原始主队列中每条轨迹的形变角向增益均超过匹配的新采样扰动；隐空间RMS端点变化与感知特征表示中同样出现该效应（即使像素空间变化相当）。跨轨迹置换形变方向会削弱该效应（包括类内），说明优势既依赖与接收轨迹的对齐，也依赖共享的方向结构。
AI.conclusion: 已被早期采样步骤变换过的扰动比新采样各向同性噪声在剩余步骤中被更强放大，且该放大在感知特征层面同样存在。效应依赖扰动方向与接收轨迹的对齐性，表明采样中的扰动演化具有轨迹特异性结构。

title: Factoriax: A GPU-Accelerated Factorio-Style Simulator for Reinforcement Learning
summary: We introduce Factoriax, a GPU-accelerated factory-building simulator written in JAX. In Factoriax, an agent must collect resources, build machines using those resources, and then automate the collection and crafting process by arranging machines on the map to build production pipelines. This paper discusses the structure of the Factoriax simulator and an initial benchmark called Easy Rocket in which an agent is tasked with building a resource-intensive machine called the Rocket in a limited number of game ticks to escape the planet. We also publish results from a number of PPO-based training runs on Easy Rocket. Factoriax is built to be fast. A 1-billion-step PPO training run, equivalent to 500,000 episodes, runs on Easy Rocket in about 8 minutes on a single NVIDIA A100. A standard laptop GPU can complete the same run in about 84 minutes. Our trained PPO agent learns to gather resources, craft machines from those resources, and place them on the map through a curriculum reward directly tied to a manually designed set of achievements. After training, the agent does not place machines in a functional spatial configuration, failing to fully complete the benchmark, and leaving the challenge open for future attempts.

AI.tldr: Factoriax是一个基于JAX的GPU加速工厂建造模拟器，包含Easy Rocket基准及PPO训练结果，速度快但智能体尚无法完成任务。
AI.motivation: 提供一个快速、GPU加速的工厂建造类强化学习环境与基准，推动自动化生产管线规划任务的智能体研究。
AI.method: 用JAX实现Factoriax模拟器，设计Easy Rocket基准（有限ticks内建造Rocket逃脱），采用与手工成就挂钩的课程奖励训练PPO智能体。
AI.result: 1-billion-step（50万episode）PPO训练在单张A100约8分钟、普通笔记本GPU约84分钟完成；智能体学会采集资源、合成机器并按课程奖励放置，但空间配置不具备功能性，未能完成基准。
AI.conclusion: Factoriax提供了快速模拟与基准，但Easy Rocket挑战仍未被解决，为未来研究留下开放问题。

title: Safe Image Generation via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent Text-to-Image (T2I) models achieve remarkable visual image generation performance, but they can still generate NSFW (Not-Safe-For-Work) contents, including violent or explicit images. Existing safety checker mechanisms are largely confined to pre-generation filtering (e.g. prompt-level text classifiers) or post-hoc moderation applied after an image is completely synthesized. However, adversarial attack methods operate over a much broader space. This imbalance highlights the need for a safety mechanism that intervenes during the generation process. We propose an in-generation safety framework that monitors the denoising trajectory and detects emerging NSFW signals from intermediate representations. Rather than merely detecting NSFW generations, our method applies reinforcement learning to generate safe images from NSFW prompts. By coupling in-generation detection with controllable steering, our approach mitigates unsafe trajectories even when NSFW signals emerge after generation has already begun. Experiments results show that our method consistently outperforms existing safe image generation methods across both standard and adversarial evaluation sets, while preserving perceptual quality and prompt fidelity. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种生成过程中(denoising轨迹)监控并检测NSFW信号的框架，结合强化学习从NSFW提示生成安全图像。
AI.motivation: 现有安全机制仅限生成前过滤(提示级分类器)或完全生成后审核，而对抗攻击空间更广，存在干预缺口。
AI.method: 在生成过程中监控去噪轨迹，从中间表示检测新兴NSFW信号；并引入强化学习实现可控引导，将NSFW提示转化为安全图像。
AI.result: 在标准与对抗评估集上均优于现有安全图像生成方法，且保持感知质量与提示保真度。
AI.conclusion: 生成的实时检测+可控引导可缓解不安全轨迹，即使NSFW信号在生成开始后才出现也有效。

title: Learning without Overwriting: A Theory of Self-Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning in Continual Reasoning
comment: main 11 pages, total 55 pages, main 2 figures, total 4 figures, 1 algorithm table in appendix
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) of large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated the ability to improve reasoning capabilities while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Despite substantial empirical success, the dynamics of OPSD in continual reasoning remain incompletely understood. Modeling LLM reasoning as search over a directed acyclic graph, we provide a unified theoretical analysis of both the dynamics of post-training---OPSD and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in continual learning---and the impact of pre-training on subsequent performance. Our findings establish three key insights with an optimization guarantee: (i) OPSD with hints from correct outputs enables continual learning without forgetting by sparse yet effective gradient descent updates induced by the hint structure. (ii) SFT on correct reasoning paths can lead to catastrophic forgetting due to dense updates along the training paths, which overwrite the information previously acquired. (iii) Diversity in pre-training is crucial for enabling a post-trained model to reach a correct output when a rollout starts from an intermediate state. Our results, supported by theoretical analysis, show that reliable continual reasoning depends on how post-training updates interact with the reasoning structure established during pre-training.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论上分析LLM持续推理中on-policy自蒸馏(OPSD)与监督微调(SFT)的动态差异，揭示OPSD抗遗忘、SFT易灾难遗忘，并强调预训练多样性的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 尽管OPSD在提升推理能力同时保持已有知识方面取得实证成功，但其在持续推理中的动态机制仍未被充分理解，尤其缺乏对后训练与预训练交互影响的理论刻画。
AI.method: 将LLM推理建模为有向无环图上的搜索过程，对OPSD与SFT在持续学习中的动态以及预训练对后续性能的影响进行统一理论分析，并给出优化保证。
AI.result: (i) 来自正确输出的hint使OPSD通过稀疏但有效的梯度更新实现无遗忘持续学习；(ii) 在正确推理路径上的SFT因沿训练路径的稠密更新而覆盖旧知识，导致灾难性遗忘；(iii) 预训练多样性对模型从中间状态rollout到达正确输出至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的持续推理取决于后训练更新与预训练阶段建立的推理结构之间的交互方式。

title: Better Retrieval, Limited Clustering Gains: A Controlled Study of Multilingual Company Entity Resolution
summary: Improved name retrieval may have little effect on company clusters when the pair classifier remains unchanged. We examine this dependency by adapting multilingual E5 encoders under fixed candidate budgets and downstream decision rules. Random-negative and hard-negative training use identical positive schedules. Checkpoints are selected before collecting a new GLEIF sample of 3,633 names, 2,880 source identities and 882 silver-positive pairs. At 72,660 candidate edges, adaptation with a multi-view selector increases direct pair recall from 53.74% to 76.98%. The primary matcher adds only seven correct and two incorrect co-cluster pairs: cluster recall rises from 32.54% to 33.33%, while precision falls from 95.99% to 95.45%. Of 208 newly retrieved silver-positive pairs, 202 fall below its decision threshold. Random-negative and hard-negative training produce identical final partitions. An AI-assisted, single-reviewer audit of 137 pairs supports the observed pattern, although its predominantly LEI-derived evidence does not establish independent gold labels. The results locate the immediate loss of retrieval gains at the existing confirmation stage and show why encoder evaluation must also measure final cluster quality.

AI.tldr: 在固定候选预算与下游决策规则下适配多语言E5编码器，检索召回大幅提升（53.74%→76.98%），但公司聚类质量几乎不变：聚类召回仅从32.54%升至33.33%，精确率微降。
AI.motivation: 探究"改进的名称检索能否真正改善公司聚类"，即检索增益是否受制于未改变的下游配对分类器/确认环节。
AI.method: 在固定候选预算与决策规则下适配多语言E5编码器；随机负样本与难负样本训练使用相同正样本计划；在新GLEIF样本（3,633个名称、2,880个源身份、882个银正样本对）上收集前选定检查点；采用多视图选择器。
AI.result: 72,660条候选边上，直接配对召回由53.74%升至76.98%。主匹配器仅新增7个正确、2个错误共聚类对：聚类召回32.54%→33.33%，精确率95.99%→95.45%。208个新检索银正对中202个低于其决策阈值；随机负与难负训练产生完全相同的最终划分。137对AI辅助单人审核支持该模式，但证据多为LEI衍生，不构成独立金标签。
AI.conclusion: 检索增益的即时损失发生在既有确认阶段；编码器评估必须同时衡量最终聚类质量，而非仅看检索指标。

title: AstraSR: Real-World Thermal Super-Resolution with GPT-6 Astra
summary: Real-world thermal super-resolution (SR) is constrained by limited sensor resolution and the difficulty of obtaining corresponding high-resolution (HR) observations for direct model supervision. Conventional SR methods typically construct training pairs by treating captured thermal images with real-world degradations as HR references and applying predefined degradation to generate synthetic low-resolution (LR) inputs. Such a construction not only introduces a domain gap between synthetic and captured LR observations but also retains acquisition degradations in the supervision. To address this issue, we propose AstraSR, a real-world thermal SR method guided by GPT-6 Astra, a frontier multimodal generative model endowed with emergent and transformative visual capabilities. Specifically, we construct a dataset of image pairs by using captured LR thermal images to condition GPT-based HR reference. We develop a direct generative supervision strategy that learns from captured thermal inputs paired with GPT-generated HR references. Pixel, gradient, and perceptual losses jointly supervise the transfer of intensity patterns, structural boundaries, and visual details from the generated references. Qualitative comparisons with seven existing state-of-the-art real-world SR methods show continuous object contours, distinct structural boundaries, and smooth intensity transitions in the thermal scenes. These results demonstrate that AstraSR outperforms existing real-world SR methods in both thermal clarity and structural coherence.

AI.tldr: 提出AstraSR，利用GPT-6 Astra生成HR参考，实现真实世界热成像超分辨率。
AI.motivation: 真实热成像SR受限于传感器分辨率低，且难以获取对应HR观测用于直接监督；传统方法用预定义退化生成合成LR，导致域间隙并保留采集退化。
AI.method: 用捕获的LR热图像条件化GPT-6 Astra生成HR参考，构建图像对数据集；采用直接生成监督策略，结合像素、梯度和感知损失共同监督强度、结构边界与视觉细节的迁移。
AI.result: 与七种现有SOTA真实世界SR方法定性比较，AstraSR在热场景中呈现连续物体轮廓、清晰结构边界和平滑强度过渡，在热清晰度和结构连贯性上更优。
AI.conclusion: AstraSR通过GPT引导的生成式监督有效缓解合成-真实域间隙，提升真实热成像SR质量。

title: Ranking Bandits for Carousel Interfaces with Observable Browsing Depth
summary: Carousel interfaces allow a recommender system to directly observe how far a user has browsed. This signal distinguishes displayed but unclicked items from items that were never displayed, whereas conventional ranking-bandit models, including cascade and position-based models, generally treat examination as latent. We formulate a ranking-bandit problem in which a learner presents a list of $L$ items, observes the user's maximum browsing depth, and receives click feedback only for positions up to that depth. The objective is to maximize the expected number of clicks under an unknown item-attractiveness vector and a browsing-depth distribution. We propose three algorithms based on UCB, Thompson Sampling, and DMED, all of which update item statistics only from observed exposures. We derive an instance-dependent logarithmic upper bound for our UCB-based algorithm and an asymptotic upper bound for our DMED-based algorithm that coincides with the lower bound as its parameter $α\downarrow 0$, establishing asymptotic optimality in this limit. Simulations in synthetic shallow- and deep-browsing environments, together with experiments parameterized from RecGaze interaction logs, show that OD-TS attains final mean regret similar to PBM-TS, while the proposed methods achieve lower final mean regret than PBM-UCB.

AI.tldr: 本文研究轮播界面的排序赌博机问题，利用用户最大浏览深度信号区分曝光与未曝光项，提出三种算法并给出理论界与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 传统排序赌博机模型（如cascade和position-based模型）通常将“是否被用户检查（examination）”视为隐变量。而轮播界面能直接观测用户最大浏览深度，可区分“已展示但未点击”与“从未展示”的项，因此可更精确地建模曝光信息。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为排序赌博机：学习器展示L个物品，观测用户最大浏览深度，仅获得该深度之前位置的点击反馈；目标是在未知物品吸引力向量和浏览深度分布下最大化期望点击数。提出基于UCB、Thompson Sampling和DMED的三种算法，仅利用已观测曝光更新物品统计量。
AI.result: 为UCB算法推导了实例相关的对数上界；为DMED算法推导了渐近上界，当参数α↓0时与下界重合，从而在该极限下达到渐近最优。合成浅浏览/深浏览环境及基于RecGaze交互日志参数的实验表明：OD-TS最终平均遗憾与PBM-TS相近，所提方法最终平均遗憾低于PBM-UCB。
AI.conclusion: 利用轮播界面的浏览深度观测可改进排序赌博机建模，所提算法在理论上具有最优性保证，实验上表现优于部分基线方法。

title: DREAM: Dynamic Resolution Assignment For Multimodal Multi-agent Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate (MAD) has emerged as an effective paradigm to improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and is increasingly being extended to multimodal settings. However, existing multimodal MAD frameworks typically expose agents to the same fixed visual input, ignoring substantial variation in the visual scale needed across samples and agents. In addition, these frameworks frequently suffer from groupthink, a phenomenon where agents prematurely abandon correct deductions to conform with confident but hallucinated peer responses. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce DREAM (Dynamic Resolution Assignment For Multimodal Multi-Agent Debate), which operates via two core components: (1) Dynamic Resolution Assignment, a zero-shot probe round where agents test multiple resolutions, quantify uncertainty using Average Normalized Log-Likelihood (ANLL), and use an adaptive threshold to assign each agent to its empirically optimal resolution; (2) Uncertainty-Guided Rollback Aggregation counters groupthink by tracking each agent's uncertainty over rounds and restoring early low-uncertainty answers overridden by group pressure. On six multimodal datasets, DREAM improves the accuracy-token trade-off over multi-agent debate baselines by 1.5-3.2% accuracy without dataset-specific tuning.

AI.tldr: DREAM是一个多模态多智能体辩论框架，通过动态分辨率分配和不确定性引导的回滚聚合，缓解视觉尺度固定与群体思维问题，在六个数据集上提升准确率1.5-3.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态多智能体辩论(MAD)框架对所有样本和智能体使用固定视觉输入，忽略视觉尺度需求差异；同时易出现群体思维，智能体因同伴自信但幻觉的回复而放弃正确推理。
AI.method: DREAM包含两个核心组件：(1) 动态分辨率分配——零样本探测轮，智能体测试多种分辨率，用平均归一化对数似然(ANLL)量化不确定性，并用自适应阈值将每个智能体分配到经验最优分辨率；(2) 不确定性引导回滚聚合——跨轮跟踪各智能体不确定性，恢复被群体压力覆盖的早期低不确定性答案。
AI.result: 在六个多模态数据集上，DREAM相比多智能体辩论基线在准确率-令牌权衡上提升1.5-3.2%准确率，且无需数据集特定调参。
AI.conclusion: DREAM通过自适应分辨率分配与不确定性引导回滚，有效改善多模态MAD的准确率-效率权衡并缓解群体思维。

title: Every View Counts: View-Consistent Panoptic Quality for Multi-view Panoptic Segmentation
comment: 23 pages, 8 figures. Under review. Youngmin Lee and Byungha Ko contributed equally
summary: Multi-view panoptic segmentation assigns a semantic class and a scene-level instance ID to every pixel of an unordered set of images, and recent feed-forward 3D models predict these labels for the input views in a single forward pass. Their predictions, however, have been evaluated with the scene-level PQ (PQ^scene) borrowed from per-scene optimization methods, typically on rendered held-out views. PQ^scene tiles all views of a scene into a single image, so that a missed appearance or a change of ID lowers the score of the matched pair only in proportion to its area. We propose View-Consistent Panoptic Quality (VC-PQ), which extends PQ from a single image to a set of input views, counts equally every view in which an instance is visible, and penalizes a prediction that is not visible in the same views as its ground truth. A decomposition of VC-PQ attributes the score a method loses to mask accuracy, view consistency, and the matching threshold. A single additional parameter recovers the area weighting of tiling for comparison. Under a fixed evaluation protocol on ScanNet++ and ScanNetv2, recent feed-forward methods are evaluated with VC-PQ and PQ^scene, and the decomposition shows where each of them loses its score. Controlled perturbations of the ground truth show that VC-PQ responds to the number of views in which an instance is missed or changes ID, whereas PQ^scene responds to their area. The aim of this work is to make view consistency part of the evaluation of multi-view panoptic segmentation, with VC-PQ reported alongside PQ^scene.

AI.tldr: 论文提出VC-PQ指标，将全景质量(PQ)从单图扩展到多视图，强调视图一致性评估。
AI.motivation: 现有多视图全景分割评估沿用场景级PQ，但其按面积加权，忽略视图一致性，无法惩罚只在部分视图可见的预测。
AI.method: 提出VC-PQ：对实例可见的每个视图等权计数，惩罚与真实标签视图可见性不一致的预测；通过分解将失分归因于掩码精度、视图一致性和匹配阈值，并用一个参数恢复面积加权以兼容tiling。
AI.result: 在ScanNet++和ScanNetv2固定协议下评估近期前馈方法，分解显示各方法失分来源；扰动实验证实VC-PQ对缺失或ID变化视图数敏感，PQ^scene对面积敏感。
AI.conclusion: 主张将视图一致性纳入多视图全景分割评估，VC-PQ应与PQ^scene并行报告。

title: EMG-GPT: Predictive Pretraining on Residual-Quantized EMG Tokens for Hand Pose Estimation
summary: Surface electromyography (sEMG) is a low-power, cost-effective biosignal for hand-pose estimation and gesture classification. In this work, we examine whether self-supervised pretraining on sEMG can yield transferable representations for continuous hand-pose estimation. We introduce EMG-GPT, a causal transformer-based model that operates on discrete sEMG representations from a frozen residual vector quantization (RVQ) tokenizer and learns temporal dynamics through depth-autoregressive future-code prediction. The model combines within-frame integration with causal temporal modeling while preserving the geometry of the pretrained codebook. EMG-GPT shows competitive results in both Regression and Tracking tasks, supporting EMG-only pretraining as a viable approach for learning transferable sEMG representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EMG-GPT，通过对离散 sEMG 表示的深度自回归预测进行自监督预训练，学习可迁移的肌电表征，用于连续手部姿态估计与手势分类。
AI.motivation: sEMG 低成本低功耗，适合手部姿态估计与手势分类；但连续手部姿态估计任务中，自监督预训练能否带来可迁移表征尚不明确。
AI.method: EMG-GPT 是一个因果 Transformer 模型，输入来自冻结的残差向量量化（RVQ）分词器产生的离散 sEMG 表示；通过深度自回归预测未来 code 学习时序动态，结合帧内整合与因果时序建模，同时保持预训练码本的几何结构。
AI.result: 在回归与跟踪任务上均取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 仅使用 EMG 进行预训练是学习可迁移 sEMG 表征的可行途径。

title: A Framework for Automated Multi-Source Satellite Data Analytics and LLM-Based Report Generation
summary: This paper presents the workflow for building an automated ArcGIS Pro tool using ArcPy to extract the Land Surface Temperature (LST) from Landsat 7, 8 and 9 datasets. The tool eliminates the need for manual band selection and repetitive raster computations by automating the multi-step workflow of radiometric calibration, NDVI-based emissivity correction, and thermal conversion. In addition to supporting batch and single-scene processing, the tool has an optional Large Language Model (LLM) for statistical result interpretation and reporting. Depending on batch size, the tool reduced the processing time from around 11-58 minutes when done manually to around 4-11 minutes using the tool. We tested the tool with data from Ras Al Khaimah (RAK) in the UAE, and the LST obtained for Ras Al Khaimah ranged from approximately 25C to 50C, demonstrating an accurate LST mapping compatible with the weather conditions of RAK. In summary, our tool reduces human errors and improves processing accuracy and efficiency for thermal and environmental remote sensing applications, in addition to providing an interactive LLM-based interface for result interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于 ArcGIS Pro/ArcPy 的自动化工具，用于从 Landsat 7/8/9 数据提取地表温度（LST），实现辐射定标、NDVI 发射率校正与热转换的全流程自动化，并可选集成 LLM 进行结果解读。
AI.motivation: 传统 LST 提取需要手动选择波段并进行大量重复的栅格计算，流程繁琐、耗时长且易产生人为错误，因此需要自动化工具来提高效率与精度。
AI.method: 使用 ArcPy 构建 ArcGIS Pro 自动化工具，自动完成辐射定标、基于 NDVI 的发射率校正和热红外转换；支持单景与批量处理，并可选接入 LLM 进行统计结果解读与报告生成。
AI.result: 处理时间由手工的约 11–58 分钟缩短至约 4–11 分钟（随批量规模而定）。以阿联酋哈伊马角（RAK）为测试区，LST 约 25–50°C，与当地天气条件相符，验证了制图准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该工具减少人为误差，提升热红外与环境遥感应用的效率与精度，并提供基于 LLM 的交互式结果解读界面。

title: Prompt and Refinement: Asymmetric Mutual Learning for Infrared Small Target Detection with Noisy Labels
comment: The code will be released at https://github.com/fuyimin96/PAR upon acceptance
summary: Existing data-driven infrared small target detection (ISTD) methods typically require large-scale datasets with accurate pixel-level annotations for model training. However, such labor-intensive requirements are difficult to satisfy in real-world applications due to the heavy reliance on expert knowledge and the inherently weak distinctiveness of infrared small targets. Consequently, the presence of noisy labels during model training is inevitable, which can severely mislead the learning of target perception toward spurious patterns. To address this challenge, we propose Prompt and Refinement (PAR), a label-noise-robust asymmetric mutual learning paradigm for ISTD. Specifically, PAR comprises a pretrained Segment Anything Model (SAM) and an ISTD-specific detector trained from scratch, which learn collaboratively through a peer-teaching scheme. Coupled with local contrast regularity, the predictions of the two asymmetric peer models are mutually exploited as rectification cues for the supervisory masks of their counterparts. The interaction between complementary inductive biases effectively prevents the label correction process from degenerating into the self-confirmation loop of a single model, enabling progressive refinement of the annotations toward intrinsic target characteristics. In addition, the detector predictions are utilized as corrective mask prompts to facilitate task-specific adaptation of the vision foundation model. Moreover, an evidential uncertainty estimation strategy is introduced into the optimization process to further alleviate the adverse effects of noisy labels. Extensive experiments under diverse noisy label scenarios on three ISTD datasets demonstrate that PAR consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 PAR 范式，用 SAM 与 ISTD 检测器进行非对称互学习，结合局部对比度与证据不确定性估计，在噪声标签下实现鲁棒红外小目标检测。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标检测依赖大规模像素级标注，但专家知识依赖强、目标辨识度低，真实场景中噪声标签不可避免，会误导模型学习虚假模式。
AI.method: PAR 包含预训练 SAM 和从零训练的 ISTD 检测器，通过 peer-teaching 协同学习；利用两模型非对称预测互为监督掩码修正线索，结合局部对比度正则，避免单一模型自我确认循环；检测器预测作为修正掩码提示以适配视觉基础模型；引入证据不确定性估计优化过程。
AI.result: 在三个 ISTD 数据集、多种噪声标签场景下，PAR 持续取得最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 非对称互学习与不确定性估计可有效缓解噪声标签影响，推动标注向目标内在特征渐进修正，提升 ISTD 鲁棒性。

title: Pythia: Toward Foundation World Models for Multimodal Time Series
summary: Time-series foundation models offer a unified approach to forecasting across heterogeneous domains. Textual context and auxiliary observations provide complementary information about temporal dynamics, yet reusable multimodal predictive representations remain underexplored. We introduce Pythia, a foundation world model that learns context-conditioned latent dynamics across datasets through a joint-embedding predictive architecture. A stop-gradient numerical reference guides contextual corrections to predicted future states. A separate probabilistic decoder then adapts to the frozen predictive representation and observed history, decoupling world-model pretraining from observation-space forecasting. On MUSE, Pythia-Tiny's normalized mean absolute scaled error (MASE) and weighted sum quantile loss (WSQL) are 0.6879 and 0.4269, reducing errors by 6.26% and 5.00% relative to the strongest model evaluated in the published MUSE leaderboard. Through a series of controlled experiments, we investigate how to design a time-series world model through shared pretraining and how joint-embedding predictive learning can incorporate multimodal information. The results support separating predictive representation learning from probabilistic readout and show complementary contributions from entity descriptions, events, and covariates.

AI.tldr: 提出Pythia——基于联合嵌入预测架构的时间序列基础世界模型，可跨数据集学习上下文条件潜动态，在MUSE上超越最强基线。
AI.motivation: 时间序列基础模型需跨异构领域统一预测，文本上下文与辅助观测能补充时序动态信息，但可复用的多模态预测表示尚缺乏研究。
AI.method: 采用联合嵌入预测架构学习上下文条件潜动态；用stop-gradient数值参考引导对未来状态预测的上下文修正；用独立概率解码器适配冻结的预测表示与历史观测，解耦世界模型预训练与观测空间预测。
AI.result: 在MUSE上，Pythia-Tiny的MASE为0.6879、WSQL为0.4269，相对已发表榜单最强模型分别降低误差6.26%与5.00%。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明应将预测表示学习与概率读出分离，实体描述、事件与协变量提供互补贡献，并揭示共享预训练设计时序世界模型的方式。

title: The GenAI4IDN Benchmark 3.0 - a Public Tool to Assess Generative AI Tools for the Design of Interactive Digital Narratives
comment: Accepted for publication at ICIDS 2026, Bangkok, Thailand
summary: This paper presents GENAI4IDN Benchmark 3.0, the third iteration of an evaluation framework to assess Generative AI tools for creating Interactive Digital Narratives (IDNs). Moving beyond manual testing, this iteration introduces AI-assisted evaluation through a publicly accessible web application (https://genai4idn.com), enabling the community to run benchmarks on demand, add new models, and propose new tasks. The revised evaluation framework is "blinded" to avoid model-bias, and can handle complex media such as music, videos, and full IDNs that previously required human raters. A significant addition - responding to concerns raised during ICIDS 2025 - is the addition of fact-checking and bias detection with dedicated tasks and rubrics, validated by human raters with lived experience in the depicted contexts. Findings from a diverse range of models report on maturing creative capabilities while observing runaway thinking and overzealous safety filters as limitations. Fact-checking reliably caught subtle historical inaccuracies, anachronisms, and fabricated claims while the bias rater consistently exposed structural assumptions, tropes, and marginalized group erasures.

AI.tldr: 发布GENAI4IDN Benchmark 3.0，通过公开Web应用实现AI辅助评估，新增事实核查与偏见检测任务。
AI.motivation: 超越人工测试，满足社区按需评测、添加模型与任务的需求，并回应ICIDS 2025提出的担忧，减少模型偏差。
AI.method: 构建公开可访问的Web应用评测框架（genai4idn.com），采用“盲测”设计，支持音乐、视频及完整IDN等复杂媒介；新增经人类评分者验证的事实核查与偏见检测任务及评分标准。
AI.result: 多模型评测显示创意能力日趋成熟，但存在“失控思考”和过度安全过滤问题；事实核查能可靠发现细微历史错误、时代错置与虚构主张，偏见评分能持续揭示结构性假设、刻板印象与边缘群体抹除。
AI.conclusion: GENAI4IDN Benchmark 3.0推动IDN生成式AI评估向自动化、社区化与更全面伦理审查方向发展。

title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Personal Context Recognition on ExtraSensory
summary: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) have attracted increasing attention in recent years, with applications across a wide range of AI tasks. In this paper, we evaluate several KAN variants on the ExtraSensory dataset for personal context recognition and compare them with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and TabM. We conduct the main experiments using five user folds and three random seeds per fold and report the average Macro-F1, Micro-F1, and training time. We also perform shallow ablation studies on grid size, the number of grids, and data normalization to examine their effects on KAN performance. The results show that all evaluated KAN variants significantly outperform MLP in terms of Macro-F1 and Micro-F1 and achieve performance comparable to TabM. However, KAN variants generally require more training time, while TabM provides a more favorable balance between predictive performance and training efficiency. These results suggest that KANs are promising for personal context recognition, while their computational efficiency remains an important challenge. Our source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/hoangthangta/ExtraSensory-KANs.

AI.tldr: 本文评估多种KAN变体在ExtraSensory个人情境识别数据集上的表现，与MLP和TabM对比，发现KAN在Macro-F1/Micro-F1上显著优于MLP、与TabM相当，但训练时间更长。
AI.motivation: KANs近年受到广泛关注并应用于多种AI任务，但其在个人情境识别任务上的效果尚不明确，需要系统评估。
AI.method: 在ExtraSensory数据集上评估多个KAN变体，并与MLP和TabM对比；主实验采用5个用户折、每折3个随机种子，报告Macro-F1、Micro-F1和训练时间；并对网格大小、网格数量和数据归一化进行浅层消融研究。
AI.result: 所有KAN变体在Macro-F1和Micro-F1上显著优于MLP，性能与TabM相当；但KAN训练时间通常更长，TabM在预测性能与训练效率之间平衡更好。
AI.conclusion: KANs在个人情境识别中具有潜力，但计算效率仍是重要挑战。源代码已公开。

title: Visual Grounding Safety in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly trained to generate structured outputs like points and bounding boxes that downstream interfaces, agents, and robots can act on, yet safety alignment of this output channel has not been systematically analyzed. We study visual grounding safety by repurposing three safety benchmarks spanning direct harm (VLSU), social bias (BBQ-V), and situational safety (Asimov-2.0) into 15,401 matched pairs of harmful requests that differ only in the requested output: a free-text answer (VQA) or a grounding (point or bounding box). Across five VLMs, models that refuse a harmful request posed as a question often comply when the same request asks for a grounding: averaged over models, grounding refusal trails VQA refusal by 31-59 percentage points, depending on the domain, and safety system prompts do not close this gap. We propose a fine-tuning approach that combines grounding-form refusals with capability grounding data and self-distilled benign data to counter over-refusal. For Qwen3-VL-8B and VisionReasoner-7B, it improves grounding refusal by 77-95 percentage points on VLSU and BBQ-V and by 64-85 points on the held-out Asimov-2.0 domain, while also improving VQA refusal, preserving grounding capability, and keeping over-refusal limited. Representation analysis shows that fine-tuning moves harmful requests toward each model's refusal direction, most strongly for grounding, while leaving benign requests near the harmless reference.

AI.tldr: 研究视觉定位输出的安全对齐漏洞：有害请求改为要求point/bbox时模型拒绝率大幅下降，提出微调方法显著恢复拒绝率。
AI.motivation: VLM越来越多生成结构化输出（点、边界框）供下游使用，但该输出通道的安全对齐尚未被系统分析。
AI.method: 将VLSU、BBQ-V、Asimov-2.0三个安全基准重构为15,401对匹配请求，仅在输出形式（VQA文本vs定位）上不同；提出结合定位形式拒绝数据、能力定位数据与自蒸馏良性数据的微调方法以抑制过度拒绝。
AI.result: 五个VLM中定位拒绝比VQA拒绝低31-59个百分点，安全系统提示无法弥补；对Qwen3-VL-8B和VisionReasoner-7B，VLSU/BBQ-V定位拒绝提升77-95点，留出域Asimov-2.0提升64-85点，同时提升VQA拒绝、保持定位能力并限制过度拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 定位输出通道存在系统性安全对齐缺失，所提微调可有效修复，表征分析显示有害请求被推向拒绝方向（定位最强），良性请求保持接近无害参考。

title: ReMem: Streaming Video Understanding With Long Context Retention
summary: Despite their impressive performance on a wide range of video understanding tasks, current Vision Language Models (VLMs) are predominantly designed for offline scenarios and struggle to handle online streaming videos that demand low latency response. Several studies have explored memory and token compression strategies in an attempt to adapt offline VLMs for streaming video understanding tasks. However, through our probing experiment, we identify that most existing works tend to progressively lose long context information as length of input stream increases. To address this, we propose ReMem, a novel training-free adaptation technique that enables VLMs to process streaming videos of arbitrary lengths while improving their long context information retention capability. ReMem exploits memory from two perspectives, implemented as two core components. The Streaming Context Memory (SCM) continuously compresses historical context with query-independent attention. The Retrieved Vision Memory (RVM) then retrieves the most salient, query-relevant context from memory to augment the VLM's input. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed ReMem achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across a variety of widely used benchmarks, spanning both streaming video and general long video understanding tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的ReMem技术，通过双记忆机制提升VLM对任意长度流式视频的长上下文保持能力，达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM主要面向离线场景，难以处理需低延迟的在线流式视频。虽有内存与token压缩策略，但探测实验发现这些方法随输入流增长会逐渐丢失长上下文信息。
AI.method: ReMem为无需训练的适配技术，含两个核心组件：流式上下文记忆（SCM）用查询无关注意力持续压缩历史上下文；检索视觉记忆（RVM）从记忆中检索最显著、与查询相关的上下文以增强VLM输入。
AI.result: 在多个广泛使用的流式视频及通用长视频理解基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: ReMem使VLM能处理任意长度流式视频并增强长上下文信息保持能力，在流式与长视频理解任务上均表现优异。

title: Loopy: Low-Bit Quantization Framework for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models provide a parameter-efficient way to scale iterative test-time computation by repeatedly executing a shared recurrent core. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce the memory footprint and inference cost of looped language models, but errors introduced by a quantized shared core affect subsequent cores. Among PTQ methods, channel scaling and orthogonal rotations preserve the floating-point computation while producing representations with different quantization quality. We find that quantization configuration candidate rankings can change with recurrent depth, motivating configuration selection at the target deployment depth. However, evaluating every candidate over the full calibration set at this depth is costly. We therefore propose Loopy, a PTQ framework that formulates shared-core quantization through a recurrent-depth-aware objective, selecting shared low-bit representations by their final prediction loss at the target deployment depth. Channel scaling and orthogonal rotations parameterize the candidate representations. To approximately solve this selection problem efficiently, Loopy progressively allocates calibration windows to promising candidates while preserving complete target-depth execution, using only forward evaluations. Across eight settings, Loopy achieves the state-of-the-art results among different baselines. On Ouro-1.4B under W4A4, Loopy reduces LAMBADA perplexity by 36.5% relative to SpinQuant. Our code is available at https://github.com/Shameless0817/Loopy-review.git.

AI.tldr: 提出 Loopy,一种面向循环语言模型共享核心的循环深度感知训练后量化(PTQ)框架,在目标部署深度选择最优低位表示,取得 SOTA 效果。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型通过重复执行共享循环核心来高效扩展测试时计算;PTQ 可降低其内存和推理开销,但量化后的共享核心误差会累积影响后续循环。现有通道缩放与正交旋转方法在浮点计算等价,但量化质量不同,且候选排名会随循环深度变化,因此需在目标部署深度选择配置。然而在该深度下对整个校准集评估每个候选代价高昂。
AI.method: 将共享核心量化建模为循环深度感知的目标,依据候选表示在目标部署深度上的最终预测损失来选择共享低位表示;用通道缩放和正交旋转参数化候选表示;为高效近似求解,Loopy 逐步将校准窗口分配给更有前景的候选,同时保持完整目标深度执行,仅使用前向评估。
AI.result: 在八种设置下,Loopy 在不同基线中取得 SOTA 结果。在 Ouro-1.4B 的 W4A4 下,Loopy 相比 SpinQuant 将 LAMBADA 困惑度降低 36.5%。
AI.conclusion: Loopy 通过在目标部署深度进行循环深度感知的量化配置选择,有效提升循环语言模型低位量化的性能,验证了深度感知选择的必要性与效率。

title: How Should a Prompt Optimizer Spend a Tight Budget? BudgetAPO with Noise-Adaptive Evaluation
summary: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has been widely employed to adapt large language models without updating their weights, yielding promising results. However, existing methods such as GEPA and OPRO assume hundreds to thousands of subject-model calls, far more than is practical behind paid, rate-limited APIs. Under tight budgets they fail in two ways: multi-stage pipelines can exhaust the budget and return the seed prompt unchanged, while single-stage methods compare candidates on fixed-size minibatches, regardless of each task's noise. As a remedy, we introduce BudgetAPO, a single-stage optimizer for the tight-budget regime. BudgetAPO incorporates (1) a noise-adaptive rule that sizes the evaluation slice to each task's noise, measured by a short probe; (2) a fixed slice that turns every accept/reject decision into a paired comparison; and (3) a reflective operator that rewrites reasoning strategy and output format jointly. Extensive results across seven benchmarks and five subject models demonstrate that BudgetAPO ranks first on every subject and beats every baseline under Holm-corrected paired tests, while returning the seed in 13% of runs at 250 calls against 86% for GEPA. On GPT-OSS-20B, GEPA needs 4.5 times as many calls to match BudgetAPO's 100-call score.

AI.tldr: BudgetAPO 是一种面向紧预算场景的单阶段自动提示优化器，通过噪声自适应评估、固定切片配对比较和反射式算子，在有限调用下显著优于 GEPA/OPRO。
AI.motivation: 现有 APO 方法（如 GEPA、OPRO）假设成百上千次模型调用，在付费、限速 API 下不实用：多阶段流程易耗尽预算并返回原始提示，单阶段方法用固定小批量比较候选，忽视任务噪声。
AI.method: BudgetAPO 采用单阶段优化，包含三部分：(1) 噪声自适应规则，通过短探测按任务噪声确定评估切片大小；(2) 固定切片，使每次接受/拒绝决策成为配对比较；(3) 反射式算子，联合重写推理策略与输出格式。
AI.result: 在 7 个基准和 5 个主体模型上，BudgetAPO 在每个主体上排名第一，在 Holm 校正配对检验下击败所有基线；250 次调用时仅 13% 运行返回原始提示，而 GEPA 为 86%。在 GPT-OSS-20B 上，GEPA 需 4.5 倍调用才能达到 BudgetAPO 100 次调用的分数。
AI.conclusion: BudgetAPO 在紧预算下比现有 APO 方法更高效、稳健，是面向限速付费 API 的实用提示优化方案。

title: JLD: Perceptual Distance Through A Jacobian Lens
summary: Image compression, restoration, and generation all require a way to measure how different two images look to a person. Pixel error ignores how people see, while the most accurate perceptual distances are typically fitted to human judgments, tying them to a fixed data and resolution. For example, when image resolution is doubled, the correlation of DISTS with human scores on TID2013 drops from 0.815 to 0.717. We introduce the Jacobian Lens Distance (JLD), which derives its perceptual geometry from a frozen vision encoder rather than from human labels. JLD combines the locality of early patch features with the perceptual sensitivity captured by later encoder representations. Specifically, we use the encoder Jacobian to identify directions in the early feature space that most strongly affect the encoder output, producing a fixed metric tensor, $E[J^\top J]$, which we call the Jacobian lens. The lens is fitted only once from 100 unlabeled images, taking about 35 seconds. Locally, this construction defines a pullback metric in pixel space, giving JLD a clear geometric interpretation that can be directly analyzed on real images. Across four standard perceptual databases, JLD achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently outperforms LPIPS, DISTS, PieAPP, and DreamSim. JLD is also robust to changes in image resolution, on TID2013, its lens-term correlation remains nearly unchanged when the resolution is doubled, decreasing only from 0.850 to 0.845. We further introduce JLD-fast, which is $4\times$ faster than LPIPS-VGG while achieving a mean correlation of 0.911. Finally, JLD naturally extends to video, reaching a correlation of 0.786 on Waterloo IVC 4K compared with 0.611 for VMAF.

AI.tldr: 提出 Jacobian Lens Distance (JLD)，一种从冻结视觉编码器推导感知几何的图像距离度量，跨四个数据库达到 SOTA 且对分辨率鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 像素误差不符合人类感知，而现有最优感知距离依赖人工标注拟合，受限于固定数据和分辨率（如分辨率翻倍时 DISTS 相关性从 0.815 降至 0.717）。
AI.method: 利用冻结编码器的 Jacobian 识别早期 patch 特征中对输出影响最大的方向，构造固定度量张量 E[J^⊤J]（Jacobian lens），仅用 100 张无标注图像一次拟合（约 35 秒），在像素空间定义 pullback 度量，具清晰几何解释；并派生 JLD-fast 与视频扩展 JLD。
AI.result: 跨四个标准感知数据库达 SOTA，优于 LPIPS、DISTS、PieAPP、DreamSim；TID2013 分辨率翻倍时 lens 项相关性仅从 0.850 降至 0.845；JLD-fast 比 LPIPS-VGG 快 4 倍且平均相关性 0.911；视频 Waterloo IVC 4K 上相关性 0.786（VMAF 为 0.611）。
AI.conclusion: JLD 以冻结编码器为感知几何来源，无需人工标注，兼具准确性、分辨率鲁棒性、高效性与视频可扩展性。

title: A Unified Scaling Law for Time Series Foundation Models
summary: We develop a Unified Scaling Law and a Unified Theory of Time Series Learning to understand how model capacity and historical information support forecasting. Across different lookback lengths and forecast horizons, we analyze 18,768 experimental cells from 21 checkpoints on 23 dataset-frequency tasks spanning six domains. Our empirical methodology integrates local resource relations into a parsimonious, fitted five-parameter law: capacity gains increase with history, context gains diminish toward saturation, and horizon effects enter as a common shift. Fitted without Toto 2.0, the law predicts its horizon-averaged capacity-scaling curves with mean absolute percentage errors of 1.09% and 1.50% at input lengths 2048 and 4096. To understand how history supports prediction, our learning theory uses Gaussian regression to analyze rule identification and predictive capability. We hypothesize that full-shot models learn by accumulating information in weights, while frozen time series foundation models (TSFMs) use history by extracting information through activations. Matched-history comparisons establish the predictive value of additional history. Controlled parameter exchanges and activation interventions provide evidence that history-derived rule information can be retained, reused across queries, and used to recover a contribution to long-context prediction. Together, these findings inform capacity scaling, context allocation, and the development of models that retain and apply historical rules. Code and main results are available at https://github.com/Fifthky/UniScale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一缩放律与时间序列学习理论，揭示模型容量与历史信息如何共同支撑预测，并用大量实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对模型容量与历史长度如何协同影响时间序列预测的统一理解，尤其是在不同回看长度和预测跨度下的规律不明。
AI.method: 基于23个数据集-频率任务、21个检查点、18,768个实验单元，拟合五参数统一缩放律；用高斯回归构建学习理论，区分全样本模型与冻结TSFM的信息利用机制，并进行匹配历史对比与激活干预实验。
AI.result: 未使用Toto 2.0拟合的定律在输入长度2048与4096下预测其容量缩放曲线的平均绝对百分比误差分别为1.09%和1.50%；验证了历史信息可被保留、跨查询复用并贡献长上下文预测。
AI.conclusion: 研究为容量缩放、上下文分配及能保留和运用历史规则模型的开发提供了理论与实践指导。

title: Do Time-Series QA Systems Read the Time Series? Evidence Use and Reasoning Reliability
summary: In recent years, time-series question answering (QA) systems have made significant progress. However, generating a correct answer does not show whether retaining the supplied numerical series improves task performance, nor whether the prediction is sensitive to changes in that input. While some systems provide rationales, answer accuracy also does not show whether their numerical claims are grounded in the supplied series or whether the stated inference is valid. In this work, we focus on evaluating four time-series QA systems: TimeOmni-1, ChatTS, TimeOmni-VL, and Time-MQA. First, for three systems with released evaluation data, we reproduce their reported results and compare the performance of the systems with their backbones. Then, we introduce a benchmark named COMMON-TSQA, which collects public evaluation datasets from existing time-series benchmarks and unifies their sample representation, task definitions, and answer schemas, while evaluating each system through its own interface under common evaluation criteria. The evaluation uses the original condition and six interventions while keeping the question and target fixed. Our analysis shows that aggregate performance alone can obscure how systems use numerical evidence. Similar task-level scores can arise despite substantial changes in individual predictions. Some interventions induce simple fallback behavior rather than preserved task ability. We also evaluate rationales for factual grounding, inference validity, and consistency with the final answer. We find that rationales often contain time-series claims unsupported by the input. Moreover, the rationale audit shows that agreement between a rationale and its final answer can coexist with incorrect numerical descriptions or invalid intermediate inferences.

AI.tldr: 本文评估四个时间序列QA系统的真实鲁棒性与推理可靠性，提出统一基准COMMON-TSQA，通过原条件与六种干预，发现聚合性能掩盖了系统对数值证据的使用方式，且理由常含不实主张。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列QA仅看答案准确率，无法判断系统是否真正利用输入序列、预测是否对输入变化敏感，也无法验证理由中的数值主张是否有据、推理是否有效。
AI.method: 针对TimeOmni-1、ChatTS、TimeOmni-VL、Time-MQA四个系统：先复现三个有公开评估数据系统的报告结果并与骨干模型对比；再提出COMMON-TSQA基准，统一公开数据集的样本表示、任务定义与答案模式，在各系统自有接口下用统一标准评估，保持问题与目标不变，施加原条件及六种干预。
AI.result: 聚合性能会掩盖系统如何使用数值证据：任务级分数相近，个体预测却可能大幅变化；部分干预诱发简单退化行为而非保持任务能力。理由审计显示理由常含输入不支持的时间序列主张，且理由与最终答案一致时仍可能伴随错误的数值描述或无效的中间推理。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭答案准确率不足以评估时间序列QA系统，需结合干预敏感性与理由的事实依据、推理有效性和一致性进行综合评估。

title: Label-Free Coreset Selection with Foundation Models for Efficient Annotation in Computational Pathology
summary: Computational pathology has the potential to improve clinical outcomes through a demonstrated increase in diagnostic and prognostic accuracy. However, the development and validation of deep learning algorithms still require annotated data, a costly procedure involving expert pathologists who already face critical workforce shortages. Existing coreset selection methods to optimize annotation efforts currently all rely on hyperparameters tuned on natural-image benchmarks that do not transfer to histopathology and are cumbersome to use in clinical practice. In this study, we present GCcore, a novel label-free coreset selection method that embeds every image of a dataset with any pathology foundation model and greedily selects the samples that collectively maximize the global coverage of the embedding space. The proposed method provides a lower-bound guarantee on the global coverage of the returned coreset for any coreset size, while being completely hyperparameter-free and deterministic. We demonstrate GCcore's superior performance over 14 baselines including state-of-the-art methods across 10 tasks and datasets spanning whole slide image classification, tile classification, and tissue segmentation, where it ranks first on six and within the top three on nine, while also demonstrating how existing methods can shift by up to five rank positions depending on their hyperparameter settings. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/OncoAI-ULBHUB/GCcore.

AI.tldr: 提出GCcore，一种无需标签、无超参数、确定性的coreset选择方法，通过贪心最大化病理基础模型嵌入空间的全局覆盖度，在多样病理任务上优于14个基线。
AI.motivation: 深度病理模型训练依赖专家标注，成本高且病理学家短缺；现有coreset选择方法依赖在自然图像上调的超参数，无法迁移到病理图像且临床使用不便。
AI.method: 用任意病理基础模型嵌入全部图像，贪心选择使嵌入空间全局覆盖最大化的样本；方法对任意coreset大小提供全局覆盖下界保证，且完全无超参数、确定性。
AI.result: 在10个任务与数据集（WSI分类、切片分类、组织分割）上与14个基线（含SOTA）比较，6项排名第一、9项进入前三；现有方法随超参数设置排名可波动达5位。
AI.conclusion: GCcore为病理coreset选择提供了无需标签、无需调参且理论有保证的方案，显著提升标注效率，代码已开源。

title: Fast Convergence through Distributed Augmentation for Class-Imbalanced Federated Learning
summary: In federated learning, mitigating class imbalance is essential to improve minority-class performance. A common approach to address this problem is to augment minority-class samples to achieve local class balance. Existing approaches treat augmentation as a heuristic and do not establish how the amount of augmentation influences the convergence of federated learning, leading to excessive augmentation and increased training time. To address this limitation, we first establish the relationship between augmentation and the convergence behavior of federated learning. Leveraging this insight, we propose DAFL, a distributed augmentation framework that determines the minimum augmentation required for each client-class pair by jointly minimizing augmentation and training time while constraining global class imbalance, thereby improving minority-class F1-score. Experimental results demonstrate that DAFL consistently improves minority-class F1-score while substantially reducing training time, particularly under severe global class imbalance and high label proportion imbalance.

AI.tldr: 提出DAFL框架，通过建立增强量与联邦学习收敛关系，为每个客户端-类别确定最小增强量，减少训练时间并提升少数类F1-score。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中类不平衡损害少数类性能，现有方法将数据增强视为启发式手段，未建立增强量对收敛的影响机制，导致过度增强和训练时间增加。
AI.method: 先建立增强量与联邦学习收敛行为的关系，据此提出分布式增强框架DAFL，联合最小化增强量和训练时间并约束全局类不平衡，为每个客户端-类别对确定最小增强量。
AI.result: DAFL持续提升少数类F1-score并显著减少训练时间，在严重的全局类不平衡和高标签比例不平衡下尤为有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论建立增强与收敛的关联并按需最小化增强量，可兼顾少数类性能提升与训练效率。

title: Toward AI Trustworthiness: Finding Analytically Proven Forward-Invariant Sets for AI-Controlled Systems
summary: Neural-network (NN) controllers are increasingly used in nonlinear control systems, but their highly nonlinear behavior makes them difficult to explain and verify, raising trustworthiness concerns in safety- and mission-critical applications. A key step toward certifiable trustworthiness is to find a Forward-Invariant Set (FIS): a state-space region such that any trajectory starting inside remains inside. If the FIS excludes unsafe states, safety can be guaranteed for initial states within it. Finding an analytically proven FIS for a given AI-controlled system with a fixed controller is difficult. We propose a framework that uses an Invertible Neural Network (INN) to transform the original state space into a latent space where a regular-shaped FIS is more likely to exist. We train the INN so that a preferred hyper-rectangular candidate becomes invariant in the latent space, then formally verify it. We prove that, whenever verification succeeds, both the latent-space candidate and its inverse-transformed counterpart in the original state space are analytically proven FISs. We evaluate the approach on 45 AI-controlled systems across three representative control testbeds. Our method finds certified FISs for all 45 systems, whereas an adapted state-of-the-art baseline finds none. It is also faster on 40 of the 45 systems, and the centers of the resulting FISs roughly match domain-expert preferences.

AI.tldr: 提出用可逆神经网络(INN)将状态空间变换到潜空间，使规则形状的前向不变集(FIS)更易存在并形式化验证，从而为AI控制器提供安全保证。
AI.motivation: 神经网络控制器非线性强、难解释和验证，在安全攸关场景中可信度不足。寻找前向不变集(FIS)是通往可认证可信的关键一步，但对固定控制器的系统解析证明FIS很困难。
AI.method: 用INN将原状态空间映射到潜空间，训练使一个偏好的超矩形候选在潜空间中成为不变集，然后对其进行形式化验证。证明验证成功时，潜空间候选及其逆变换回原空间的对应集合都是解析证明的FIS。
AI.result: 在三个代表性控制测试平台的45个AI控制系统中评估：本方法为全部45个系统找到认证FIS，而适配的最先进基线一个都找不到；在40/45个系统上更快，且所得FIS中心大致符合领域专家偏好。
AI.conclusion: 基于INN的潜空间变换框架能有效、可证明地为AI控制系统寻找前向不变集，提升安全认证可信度。

title: From Transformation to Target State: Rethinking Query Representation for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed image retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a desired target image from a query consisting of a reference image and a modification text. This task exhibits an unusual representational asymmetry: the modification text specifies a transition from the reference state, whereas retrieval candidates depict completed target states. This creates a representation mismatch for zero-shot methods that query pretrained vision-language spaces directly with transformation-oriented language. We study this mismatch and reformulate zero-shot composed image retrieval as target-state reconstruction followed by retrieval. We instantiate this formulation with ASAP-CIR, a training-free framework that reconstructs a static target representation using a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM). The representation combines multiple holistic descriptions with a variable set of importance-weighted atomic semantics, thereby preserving both overall target identity and fine-grained visual constraints. Retrieval then integrates holistic state alignment, atomic constraint grounding, and calibrated target-state evidence aggregation. A controlled text-only diagnostic shows that target-side static query formulations achieve more reliable retrieval than dynamic composed query formulations, particularly when source-state semantics must be suppressed or transformed. Experiments on FashionIQ, CIRR, and CIRCO further characterize the effectiveness and limitations of this representation principle, with the clearest gains on the multi-target CIRCO benchmark. These results show that how composed intent is represented before retrieval is a consequential design choice, distinct from the choice of retrieval backbone itself.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究零样本组合图像检索(CIR)中的表示不对称问题，将其重构为"目标状态重建+检索"两阶段，提出免训练框架ASAP-CIR，在CIRCO等多目标基准上取得明显提升。
AI.motivation: CIR任务中修改文本描述的是从参考状态到目标状态的"转换过程"，而检索候选却是已完成的"目标状态"，这种表示不对称导致直接用转换式语言查询预训练视觉-语言空间的零样本方法存在表示不匹配。作者希望专门研究并解决这一错配。
AI.method: 将零样本CIR重构为目标状态重建后再检索，并实现免训练框架ASAP-CIR：用冻结的多模态大模型(MLLM)重建静态目标表示，该表示由多个整体描述加一组可变数量的重要性加权原子语义组成，兼顾目标整体身份与细粒度视觉约束；检索阶段融合整体状态对齐、原子约束接地以及校准后的目标状态证据聚合。此外用纯文本对照诊断验证静态查询公式的可靠性。
AI.result: 纯文本诊断显示，目标侧静态查询公式比动态组合查询公式检索更可靠，尤其在需抑制或转换源状态语义时。在FashionIQ、CIRR、CIRCO上的实验验证了该表示原则的有效性与局限，其中在多目标CIRCO基准上增益最明显。
AI.conclusion: 组合意图在检索前的表示方式是一个关键设计选择，与检索骨干网络的选择相互独立；将CIR重构为目标状态重建能有效缓解转换式语言的表示不匹配问题。

title: Smoothed Gradient Method for Nonconvex Federated Stochastic Bilevel Optimization
summary: In recent years, federated stochastic bilevel optimization has attracted increasing attention due to its wide range of applications in machine learning. To reduce the computational overhead associated with second-order Hessian and Jacobian matrices, several first-order methods have been proposed. However, existing methods typically impose restrictive assumptions on the lower-level function, suffer from a strong dependence on the condition number in their convergence rates, and require different learning-rate scales for variables across the upper- and lower-level problems, limiting their practical applicability and complicating hyperparameter tuning. To address these challenges, we propose a stochastic doubly smoothed gradient method for nonconvex federated stochastic bilevel optimization problems, which decouples the learning rates of upper- and lower-level variables and does not require a strongly-convex lower-level loss function. We establish rigorous theoretical guarantees for the proposed algorithm, demonstrating an improved convergence rate of $O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)$ and a communication complexity of $O(κ^{4}/ε^3)$, where $κ$ denotes the condition number and $ε$ represents the solution accuracy. Notably, these bounds exhibit significantly better dependence on the condition number $κ$ than those of existing methods. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出随机双平滑梯度法用于非凸联邦随机双层优化，解耦上下层学习率且不要求下层强凸，收敛率为O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)，通信复杂度O(κ^4/ε^3)。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦随机双层优化的一阶方法存在局限：对下层函数设限严格、收敛率强烈依赖条件数、上下层变量需不同学习率尺度，实用性与调参困难。
AI.method: 提出随机双平滑梯度法(stochastic doubly smoothed gradient method)，解耦上下层变量的学习率，且无需下层损失函数强凸。
AI.result: 理论证明收敛率为O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)，通信复杂度为O(κ^4/ε^3)，对条件数κ的依赖显著优于现有方法；实验验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法缓解了现有联邦双层优化的假设限制和调参难题，在条件数依赖上取得改进，并获实验支持。

title: From Token-Max to Outcome-Max: How You Use AI Determines Its Productivity
summary: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) models can perform increasingly complex tasks, yet greater AI usage does not necessarily translate into proportional productivity gains. We identify token-max as one source of this inefficiency: when token consumption is treated as productive effort, agents are encouraged to over-exert and expend computation beyond what is necessary. We instead propose outcome-max, which rewards independently verified task completion per unit cost and induces a principled stopping rule. Then, to study these objectives, we develop a three-level simulation framework spanning immediate interaction, long-run behavioral adaptation, and organizational collaboration. Across all three levels, outcome-max improves the efficiency of AI-assisted production while largely preserving verified task performance. To further align these incentives with outcome-max, we introduce OutcomeShare, an incentive mechanism. Theory and simulation show that OutcomeShare can induce participation while generating shared gains for employees, firms, and LLM providers. Together, our results suggest that AI productivity not only depends on model capability, but also on how to construct the objectives governing AI use.

AI.tldr: 论文指出AI使用量增加未必带来生产力同比提升，提出"token-max"导致过度消耗算力的问题，改为以"outcome-max"（按单位成本验证任务完成度）作为目标，并设计OutcomeShare激励机制的框架。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI能执行越来越复杂的任务，但更多AI使用并未带来成正比的生产力增益。作者认为"token-max"（把token消耗当作生产努力）会激励智能体过度消耗计算资源、超出必要范围，是一种低效来源。
AI.method: 提出outcome-max目标，奖励单位成本下经独立验证的任务完成，并由此形成有原则的停止规则；构建三层次仿真框架：即时交互、长期行为适应、组织协作；进一步提出OutcomeShare激励机制，并用理论与仿真分析。
AI.result: 在三个层次上，outcome-max都提升了AI辅助生产的效率，同时基本保持了经核验的任务表现；OutcomeShare能促使参与并带来员工、企业、LLM提供方的共享收益。
AI.conclusion: AI生产力不仅取决于模型能力，还取决于如何构建支配AI使用的目标与激励。

title: Investigating Query-Insensitive Behavior in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
summary: Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) aims to localize objects or events described by natural language queries in both space and time. Existing STVG models are typically trained and evaluated under the assumption that each query is relevant to the input video. In this work, we challenge this assumption by studying the behavior of state-of-the-art STVG models under irrelevant queries and missing textual input. Our experiments show that current models can still produce plausible spatio-temporal predictions even when the query is unrelated to the video or removed entirely. We further analyze HCSTVG-v2 and VidSTG to identify dataset regularities that may encourage such query-insensitive behavior. Our study highlights an underexplored limitation of STVG models and motivates negative-aware evaluation protocols and architectures that explicitly assess query relevance.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战STVG模型假设查询必与视频相关的常规，发现无关查询或缺失文本时模型仍能输出合理预测，指出查询不敏感问题并呼吁负样本感知评估。
AI.motivation: 现有STVG模型训练与评测均假设每个查询与输入视频相关，忽视了查询无关或缺失的情形，存在未探索的局限性。
AI.method: 在无关查询和缺失文本输入条件下测试最先进STVG模型的行为，并分析HCSTVG-v2与VidSTG数据集中的规律。
AI.result: 当前STVG模型即使查询无关或完全移除，仍能生成看似合理的时空预测；数据集规律可能助长这种查询不敏感行为。
AI.conclusion: 揭示STVG模型查询不敏感的局限，倡导负样本感知的评测协议和显式评估查询相关性的架构。

title: Erased, Rerouted, or Rescaled? Post-Training and the Causal Quotient of a Language Model's Belief State
summary: What happens to information a pretrained model already encodes when post-training no longer rewards using it? The common language of representation compression conflates three fates: information may be erased, rerouted away from the decision while still represented, or rescaled to occupy less variance while still represented and used. We make these fates identifiable in models whose pretraining recovers Bayesian belief states. A reward that reads only a coarse function of the hidden state defines an exact reward-null kernel. The kernel lets us separately measure whether the information remains recoverable, whether decisions causally depend on it, and how much activation variance it occupies. Theory says what is protected: KL-anchored reinforcement learning preserves the reference policy's log-odds among equally rewarded outputs, supervised and unanchored objectives carry no such constraint, and spectral compression implies neither erasure nor loss of use. In controlled worlds, post-training mostly reroutes or rescales reward-null information and leaves it decodable. Without an anchor decisions can stop using it although the representation survives, and with one they keep using it. Erasure appears only under prolonged weight decay, for distinctions that neither reward nor next-token prediction can see. Open language models show the same dissociation: in-context belief geometry stays decodable under late-layer spectral compression, and within-class behavior depends on the anchor. Post-training thus selects a causal quotient of the pretrained belief state: the reward defines decision-equivalence, the anchor and the state update protect part of what it ignores, and optimization decides whether the rest is erased, rerouted, or rescaled.

AI.tldr: 后训练后预训练信息的去向被区分为擦除、改道和缩放三种命运，并通过奖励零核在贝叶斯信念模型中被单独测量，发现信息多被改道或缩放而非擦除。
AI.motivation: 表示压缩的常见说法混淆了信息在后训练中的三种不同命运：被擦除、仍被表示但决策不再使用（改道）、仍被表示和使用但占更少方差（缩放），需要将其可识别地加以区分。
AI.method: 在预训练可恢复贝叶斯信念状态的模型中，利用仅读取隐藏状态粗粒函数的奖励定义精确的奖励零核，分别测量信息是否可恢复、决策是否因果依赖它、以及其激活方差占比；并结合理论分析KL锚定强化学习、监督与非锚定目标及谱压缩的约束。
AI.result: 在受控世界中，后训练大多对奖励零信息进行改道或缩放并保持可解码；无锚定时决策可停止使用但表示仍存在，有锚定时继续使用；擦除仅在长期权重衰减下对奖励和下一词预测均不可见的区分出现。开源语言模型显示同样的分离现象。
AI.conclusion: 后训练选择了预训练信念状态的因果商：奖励定义决策等价性，锚定与状态更新保护其忽略的部分，优化决定其余信息是被擦除、改道还是缩放。

title: Second-Order Problem Solving for Recursive Self-Improvement in Formal Verification
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables agents to iteratively optimize their workflows via execution feedback. However, standard RSI typically operates as a first-order optimizer: it repeatedly patches surface-level parameters in response to immediate failure symptoms, often leading to trial-and-error thrashing without resolving underlying mechanisms. To address this limitation, we introduce SO-RSI, a framework that elevates workflow optimization to a second-order diagnostic inquiry, investigating why failures occur before committing to structural interventions. SO-RSI passively monitors execution traces for three structural anomalies (recurrence, opposing edits, and expectation mismatch) to trigger targeted mechanism investigations. By executing lightweight diagnostic probes and maintaining persistent inquiry memory across RSI rounds, SO-RSI accumulates causal evidence to guide systematic workflow edits rather than parameter patches. Across Lean 4 proof generation and Verus-based verifiable code generation, SO-RSI improves final held-out pass rates over Naive RSI by 21.8 and 25.8 percentage points under matched 24-hour search budgets. Behavioral analyses further confirm that SO-RSI substantially suppresses failure recurrence and eliminates unproductive zero-progress optimization loops.

AI.tldr: 提出SO-RSI框架，将递归自我改进从一阶参数修补提升为二阶诊断式查询，通过监测三种结构异常并执行诊断探针来指导系统性工作流编辑。
AI.motivation: 标准RSI作为一阶优化器，仅针对即时失败症状反复修补表层参数，导致试错震荡，无法解决底层机制问题。
AI.method: SO-RSI被动监测执行轨迹中的三种结构异常（复现、对立编辑、期望不匹配）以触发针对性的机制调查；通过执行轻量级诊断探针并维护跨RSI轮次的持续查询记忆，积累因果证据以指导系统性工作流编辑而非参数修补。
AI.result: 在Lean 4证明生成和Verus可验证代码生成中，相同24小时搜索预算下，SO-RSI相比Naive RSI将最终留出通过率分别提升21.8和25.8个百分点；行为分析证实其显著抑制失败复现并消除无产出的零进展优化循环。
AI.conclusion: 将工作流优化上升为诊断式二阶查询（先探究失败原因再实施结构干预）能有效克服一阶RSI的试错震荡问题，显著提升代理自我改进效果。

title: Patch-based Querying Identifies Structures of Interest in Electron Microscopy
comment: 41 pages, 20 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in Computers in Biology and Medicine
summary: Volume electron microscopy (vEM) has emerged as an essential sensing technique in biomedical research, allowing the three-dimensional imaging of biological cells and tissues at nanometer-scale resolution. The ability to generate extensive datasets has reached the limitations of downstream analysis processes, which depend significantly on the intervention of human experts for preprocessing and annotation. We propose an efficient and reliable patch-based retrieval framework based on self-supervised learning of local image descriptors to locate self-similar structures in vEM datasets. Given a few manual annotations of a given cellular structure, our method can retrieve similar structures across the EM volume. Our framework is interactive, allowing the human expert to refine the search queries and retrieve relevant image patches quickly and using little labeled data. Experiments on real-world vEM images of biological tissues demonstrate that our framework can reliably identify relevant cellular structures, generalize across different organelles and acquisition modalities, and substantially reduce the search space for downstream analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出基于自监督局部描述子的patch检索框架，用于vEM数据中自相似结构的快速定位。
AI.motivation: vEM可生成大规模纳米级三维数据，但下游分析严重依赖人工预处理与标注，成为瓶颈。
AI.method: 基于自监督学习局部图像描述子的patch检索框架，利用少量人工标注作为查询，交互式地在EM体积中检索相似结构。
AI.result: 在真实生物组织vEM图像上，框架能可靠识别细胞结构，跨细胞器与成像模态泛化，并显著缩小下游分析搜索空间。
AI.conclusion: 该方法高效、可靠且交互友好，可用极少标注数据加速vEM数据的下游分析。

title: FlexCast: Adaptive Weather Forecasting from Arbitrary Field Sets
summary: Most deep learning weather models assign a fixed set of variables and pressure levels to predefined channels, limiting transfer across atmospheric field configurations. This dependence on a fixed field set limits the transferability of trained models across atmospheric field configurations. We propose FlexCast, a field-adaptive weather forecasting model that uses a single set of parameters to produce identity-aligned forecasts for variable-cardinality subsets drawn from a 69-field ERA5 registry. Specifically, a metadata-conditioned adapter the first encodes variable identity, pressure level, and field type and combines them with spatial features. Then, shared rank-16 projec?tions are modulated by metadata-dependent gates to produce field?specific features, while masked set fusion aggregates the available fields into a fixed-width representation. Subsequently, a multiscale U-Transformer processes the fused atmospheric features, while an identity-aware query decoder produces forecasts for the requested fields. Finally, FlexCast learns a standardized six-hour increment and applies it recursively to generate forecasts at longer lead times. Experiments on the 2020 ERA5 test set demonstrate that FlexCast operates across varying field configurations. Compatible cross-field context is associated with lower forecast errors, whereas mismatched context increases them.

AI.tldr: FlexCast是一种字段自适应天气预测模型，用单一参数集对ERA5中69个字段的任意变量子集生成对齐预测，通过元数据条件适配与掩码集合融合实现跨字段配置灵活性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习天气模型将固定变量和气压层绑定到预定义通道，限制了跨大气场配置的迁移能力；论文希望模型能适应可变的字段子集。
AI.method: 元数据条件适配器先编码变量身份、气压层和字段类型并与空间特征结合；共享rank-16投影由元数据门控调制生成字段特定特征；掩码集合融合聚合可用字段为固定宽度表示；多尺度U-Transformer处理融合特征；身份感知查询解码器输出所请求字段预测；学习标准化六小时增量并递归生成更长预报。
AI.result: 在2020年ERA5测试集上，FlexCast可在不同字段配置下运行；兼容的跨字段上下文对应更低预测误差，而不匹配上下文会增加误差。
AI.conclusion: FlexCast实现了对可变字段子集的自适应天气预测，表明字段身份与跨字段上下文对预测质量有重要影响，为更灵活的天气建模提供了方向。

title: FreSia: Frequency-Semantic Instantiation and Alignment for Multivariate Time Series Analysis
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential in multivariate time series forecasting and anomaly detection. Existing studies predominantly inject temporal information into LLMs via direct numerical tokenization or heuristic textual descriptions. However, LLMs still face difficulty in perceiving the underlying structural patterns of numerical time series, particularly the seasonal and trend components obscured by discrete numerical tokens. To bridge this gap, we propose FreSia, a frequency-aware framework that establishes an effective alignment between the semantic space of LLMs and the frequency space of time series. Specifically, FGPrompt, a Frequency-Guided Prompt mechanism within FreSia, distills the frequency-domain structures of time series and projects them into prompts tailored to the semantic space of LLMs. Furthermore, we introduce a Global-driven Context Learning (GCL) component, which uses a global CLS-driven probe to generate global context to bridge the time-frequency domain gap and fuse the multi-modal information. Experiments on eight forecasting benchmarks show that FreSia achieves average improvements of 13.48% and 8.06% in MSE and MAE, respectively.

AI.tldr: FreSia是一个频率感知框架，通过将时间序列的频域结构对齐到LLM语义空间，提升多变量时间序列预测与异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多通过直接数值分词或启发式文本描述将时间信息注入LLM，但离散数值token掩盖了时间序列的周期性和趋势结构，LLM难以感知其底层结构模式。
AI.method: 提出FreSia框架，包含FGPrompt（频率引导提示机制，提取时频域结构并投影为适配LLM语义空间的prompt）和GCL（全局驱动上下文学习组件，用全局CLS驱动的探针生成全局上下文，弥合时频域鸿沟并融合多模态信息）。
AI.result: 在八个预测基准上，FreSia在MSE和MAE上平均提升13.48%和8.06%。
AI.conclusion: 通过建立LLM语义空间与时间序列频率空间的有效对齐，FreSia能更好地让LLM感知时间序列的结构模式，显著提升预测性能。

title: Scalable Minimal-Change Learning for Controllable Image Editing
comment: 29 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Revised version with additional off-target, reward and SFT control, human evaluation, and OmniGen2 transfer results; clarified related work and experimental scope
summary: Image editing should change only the attributes specified by an instruction while preserving everything else, yet current methods often make unintended changes. We treat this minimal-change principle as an optimization objective for instruction-based editing. Latent L1 regularization is a poor proxy for output locality in modern nonlinear generators and often requires supervision unavailable at scale. We instead optimize edit outcomes with reinforcement learning. An agentic vision-language reward model audits each source image, instruction, and edited image for two failure types: unimplemented requested changes and unintended changes. A group-level rubric merges and verifies these issues to provide consistent rewards across candidate edits without per-instruction human annotations. On FLUX.1 Kontext-dev, ARRO raises average EditScore from 5.21 to 5.88 across MinEval, MagicBrush, AnyBench, and Emu-Edit. On 600 evaluation examples, it reduces off-target pixel change by 8.4% relative to the base editor. Reward and SFT controls, blinded human evaluations, and transfer to OmniGen2 provide complementary evidence. Code: https://github.com/Showwwwwwwww/ARRO

AI.tldr: 提出ARRO方法，将"最小改动原则"作为指令图像编辑的优化目标，用强化学习配合智能体视觉语言奖励模型审计并校验编辑结果，在FLUX.1 Kontext-dev上提升EditScore并减少误改像素。
AI.motivation: 当前基于指令的图像编辑常产生非预期改动，而"只改指定属性、保留其余"的最小改动原则难以用潜在L1正则或需监督的代理指标来实现。
AI.method: 将最小改动原则作为优化目标，改用强化学习优化编辑结果；引入智能体视觉语言奖励模型，对源图、指令、编辑图审计两类失败（未实现改动、非预期改动）；用组级评分准则合并并验证问题，无需逐指令人工标注即可给出稳定奖励。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1 Kontext-dev上，ARRO将MinEval、MagicBrush、AnyBench、Emu-Edit的平均EditScore从5.21提升至5.88；在600个样本上，相对基础编辑器减少8.4%的离靶像素改动。奖励与SFT对照、盲测人工评估及向OmniGen2的迁移提供了佐证。
AI.conclusion: ARRO通过强化学习与视觉语言奖励模型有效实现图像编辑的最小改动原则，提升编辑质量并减少误改，具备可迁移性。代码已开源。

title: Do Neural Networks Learn Structure-Preserving Maps? A Case Study in Latent-to-Hilbert Embeddings
summary: We ask whether a neural network can learn a structure-preserving map from a compressed latent space to a Hilbert-space representation. Using an 8-dimensional autoencoder bottleneck on MNIST and $n$-qubit product-state targets from PCA-based angle encoding, we report four findings. Although the target angles are generated by a nonlinear sigmoid transformation of the latent projections, the resulting mapping is well approximated by a linear function over the observed latent distribution: linear regression from $z$ to the true target angles achieves $R^{2} = 0.98$, while regression to the MLP's recovered angles achieves $R^{2} = 0.91$. The learned map's primary direction is strongly aligned with the target-induced direction, with cosine similarity $0.989$, while remaining nearly orthogonal to the input's principal direction, with cosine similarity $0.002$. The map is genuinely rank-4: removing any singular direction degrades inner-product preservation by $2.5$--$5.9\times$ despite a singular-value spectrum with two dominant and two small values. The learned subspace does not coincide with the PCA basis used to construct the target, and different random seeds recover the same primary direction but diverge in higher ranks. Finally, kernel ridge regression with an RBF kernel outperforms a tuned MLP (IP error $0.0144$ vs.\ $0.0197$), suggesting that for approximately linear structure-preserving mappings, classical kernel methods may be a simpler and more effective alternative.

AI.tldr: 论文研究神经网络能否学习从压缩隐空间到Hilbert空间表示的结构保持映射，发现该映射近似线性、rank-4且方向对齐目标，核方法优于MLP。
AI.motivation: 探究神经网络是否能在压缩隐空间与Hilbert空间（量子态）表示之间学习保持结构的映射。
AI.method: 在MNIST上用8维自编码器瓶颈，以基于PCA的角度编码生成n量子比特乘积态目标，训练MLP并用线性回归、奇异值分析与核岭回归（RBF）评估。
AI.result: 映射近似线性（R²=0.98）；主方向与目标方向余弦相似度0.989，与输入主方向近正交（0.002）；映射为真正rank-4，去除任一奇异方向使内积保持下降2.5–5.9倍；学习子空间与PCA基不一致，不同随机种子主方向一致但高秩分歧；RBF核岭回归内积误差0.0144优于MLP的0.0197。
AI.conclusion: 对近似线性的结构保持映射，经典核方法可能是更简单有效的替代方案。

title: Mining Agent Skills from Production Traces
summary: Agent skills that record procedural instructions are increasingly mined from execution traces rather than curated by hand. Skill-mining pipelines often use known task outcomes or feedback to guide skill construction. In production, reliable information on whether a run has succeeded may be unavailable. We study how the sampling of execution traces, access to success or failure information, and the form of the mined skills affect downstream task performance. Holding the mining pipeline fixed, we compare six combinations of mining evidence and skill forms. Mining evidence has three levels: successful trajectories only, successes and failures with their outcome labels, or the same mix with labels withheld. Skill form has two types: an ordered workflow plan, or a declarative ontology of entities, states, and policies. We evaluate the mined skills on two enterprise benchmarks, ThinkingBox-Bench and APEX-Agents. Analysis of task-level paired differences shows that the benefits of different configurations of mining evidence and skill forms depend on the enterprise domain. On ThinkingBox-Bench, paired differences show that workflows score better than ontology by 1.7 pp, Goldilocks beats success-only evidence type by 2.4 pp and Goldilocks blind simulating skills learnt without outcomes is worse by 3.1 pp. APEX-Agents shows a moderate preference for ontologies and no clear preference between evidence regimes. Within each domain, task structure related constraints drive uneven performance with mined skills. These findings motivate tailoring meta-skills to the demands of the target tasks rather than adopting a one-size-fits-all approach.

AI.tldr: 研究执行轨迹采样、成败信息可得性与技能形式如何影响下游任务表现，在两种企业基准上比较六种组合，发现最优配置依赖领域，需按任务需求定制元技能。
AI.motivation: 技能挖掘流水线常依赖已知任务结果或反馈来指导技能构建，但生产环境中关于运行是否成功的可靠信息可能不可得，因此需明确采样方式、成败信息可得性与技能形式对下游性能的影响。
AI.method: 保持挖掘流水线固定，比较六种组合：挖掘证据三档（仅成功轨迹、成功+失败且带结果标签、同样混合但隐藏标签），技能形式两类（有序工作流计划、声明式本体）。在 ThinkingBox-Bench 和 APEX-Agents 两个企业基准上做任务级配对差异分析。
AI.result: ThinkingBox-Bench 上工作流比本体高 1.7pp，Goldilocks 证据比仅成功高 2.4pp，无结果的盲模拟差 3.1pp；APEX-Agents 对本体略有偏好，证据机制间无明显偏好。领域内任务结构相关约束导致性能不均。
AI.conclusion: 应针对目标任务需求定制元技能，而非采用一刀切方案。

title: Casual Flash Lighting for Gaussian Splat Inverse Rendering
summary: Recovering geometry, materials, and lighting from photographs is highly ambiguous when only static illumination is available. Active-lighting setups reduce the ambiguity but require dark rooms or specialized hardware. Instead, we synergize both static and flash lighting from casual indoor capture, with the flash on or off, each from independent viewpoints. The flash residual constrains albedo and the BRDF, while static lighting captures grazing-angle specular highlights that flash misses. With a 2DGS reconstruction framing, our key contribution is a GS-anchored diffuse field: a hash-encoded MLP is queried at the rasterized 2DGS depth. As it depends only on world position, it is view consistent in 3D and allows the flash residual to drive material decomposition instead of being absorbed by alpha-blending drift across views. At the same time, we render static lighting with deferred shading such that it can also supervise material decomposition. On five synthetic and three real indoor scenes, our method outperforms six recent baselines on diffuse color, albedo and roughness material parameters, and in relighting where PSNR improves by 4.17 dB over the next-best baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合静态光照与闪光灯（flash）的室内逆渲染方法，基于2DGS重建并引入“GS锚定的漫反射场”，在材质分解与重光照上显著优于六个基线。
AI.motivation: 从照片恢复几何、材质和光照在仅有静态光照时高度病态；主动光照可降歧义但需暗室或专用硬件。作者希望利用随手拍摄的闪光/非闪光图像（各来自独立视角）兼顾两者优势。
AI.method: 协同静态与闪光光照；闪光残差约束albedo与BRDF，静态光照捕获闪光遗漏的掠射角高光。以2DGS重建为框架，核心是GS锚定的漫反射场：在光栅化2DGS深度处查询hash编码MLP，因仅依赖世界坐标而具3D视角一致性，使闪光残差驱动材质分解而非被跨视角alpha混合漂移吸收；静态光照用延迟着色渲染以监督材质分解。
AI.result: 在5个合成与3个真实室内场景上，方法在漫反射颜色、albedo和roughness参数上优于6个最新基线；重光照PSNR相比次优基线提升4.17 dB。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将休闲拍摄的静态与闪光光照协同、并以GS锚定漫反射场进行分解，可有效缓解逆渲染歧义，提升材质估计与重光照质量，无需暗室或专用硬件。

title: ASCENT: Online Test-Time Training of Long-Horizon Agents via Self-Distillation of Verified Experience
summary: A large language model (LLM) agent solves long-horizon tasks through many reasoning-action turns, with one verification signal at termination. Deployed agents face streams of related tasks, making their trajectories a natural resource for improvement. In-context adaptation agents store reflections, memories, or skills as text, so reuse depends on retrieving the right experience and on a frozen policy executing it.
