Ablations identify episodic whitening as the primary source of these gains, while showing that it is not a universally beneficial preprocessing step. Across both variants, the gains concentrate on queries for which simple support prototypes favor the wrong class or provide little separation between the true class and competing classes. Transduction provides its largest additional gains when limited support coverage gives a misleading view of class separation. Together, these results demonstrate that a shared few-shot prediction procedure can generalize beyond the representation spaces observed during training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RepShiftBench 基准与 RepICL 元学习器，证明可跨数据集与表征空间复用同一少样本预测过程，超越逐任务重训的 Logistic Regression。
AI.motivation: 冻结表征虽被广泛复用，但每个新任务仍需重新拟合预测器。作者想探究：少样本预测过程本身能否一次学习、跨数据集与表征空间复用，并系统评估其泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建 RepShiftBench，含 1,218 个编码器–数据集任务，覆盖文本、图像、音频，并分设对未见数据集、未见编码器、二者联合未见及未见模态的泛化评测。提出 RepICL：通过 episodic whitening（情节白化）对每个 episode 做规范化后再预测的元训练 in-context 学习器，含归纳式 RepICL-I 与直推式 RepICL-T。
AI.result: 基准显示逐 episode 独立拟合的 Logistic Regression 在所有设置下均优于所有评测的 in-context 学习器。RepICL-I 在全部 12 个基准设置中超越 Logistic Regression，RepICL-T 显著优于既有直推方法。消融表明 episodic whitening 是主要增益来源，但并非普遍有益的预处理。增益集中在简单支持原型指向错误类或类间区分度低的查询上；直推式在支持集覆盖有限、类分离视图具误导性时额外收益最大。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，共享的少样本预测过程能够泛化到训练时未见过的表征空间，为复用式少样本预测提供了可行路径与评测基准。

title: On Hyperparameter Tuning on the Test Set
summary: "Don't tune hyperparameters on the test set" is often stated in machine learning textbooks. Violating it is considered a cardinal sin that produces misleadingly optimistic results, corrupts benchmark integrity, and thus can even be interpreted as scientific fraud. Yet evidence suggests that test set hyperparameter tuning does occur in practice, making it all the more important to understand its actual consequences. So how bad is it, really? In this work we question this dogma and put it to an empirical test. We systematically study the magnitude of the performance inflation caused by tuning the hyperparameters on the test set for MNIST-1D, CIFAR-10, and three tasks from the GLUE benchmark. Our experiments show that while the effect is real and significant, it is frequently small relative to other sources of noise. In many cases, we find that tuning on the test set recovers exactly the same model as when tuning on the validation set. Most importantly, we find that the rankings of models remain essentially preserved after tuning on the test set and therefore that consistent test-set tuning may not invalidate benchmarks or model selection. Our results call for a more nuanced view of tuning hyperparameters on the test set, stimulating researchers to openly report test tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文实证挑战"禁止在测试集上调超参"的教条，发现在MNIST-1D、CIFAR-10和GLUE任务上，测试集调参导致的性能膨胀虽真实但常小于其他噪声，模型排序基本保持，因而其危害可能被夸大。
AI.motivation: 机器学习界普遍将测试集调超参视为"重罪"，认为会产生误导性乐观结果、破坏基准公正甚至构成学术造假。然而实践中此类行为确实存在，因此需要弄清其真实后果究竟有多严重，而非仅凭教条判断。
AI.method: 在MNIST-1D、CIFAR-10及GLUE基准的三个任务上，系统对比在测试集与验证集上调参所得结果的差异，量化测试集调参引发的性能膨胀幅度，并考察模型排序是否被改变。
AI.result: 测试集调参带来的性能膨胀真实且显著，但常小于其他噪声来源；在许多情况下，测试集调参与验证集调参会选出完全相同的模型；更重要的是，调参后模型排序基本保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 一致的测试集调参未必使基准或模型选择失效，应对该做法持更细致的看法，并鼓励研究者公开报告测试集调参情况。

title: The Blind Spot Paradox: When Adaptive Classifiers Defeat Drift Detectors
comment: Accepted at IEEE ICDM 2026 Workshops (OWAD 2026). 10 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/TheBlindSpotParadox/TheBlindSpotParadox-Experiments
summary: Monitoring concept drift from an adaptive classifier's error stream creates an operational conflict with the model's own update loop. When internal adaptation outpaces evidence accumulation, accuracy recovers before cumulative detectors (CUSUM, Page-Hinkley) can reach threshold. Instrumenting an Adaptive Random Forest (ARF) shows that surviving trees absorb 98.6% of the post-drift error transient through incremental leaf updates alone. The first background tree swap accounts for just 0.71% of this erased error volume, but drops external detection rates by 31 percentage points. We derive the finite-horizon boundary where cumulative evidence fails to cross threshold and measure a critical magnitude floor ($Δe_c = 0.120$) below which false-alarm budgets preclude detection. This failure manifests as missed shifts on stationary streams and false-alarm flooding triggered by internal tree swaps on noisy baselines. We validate on synthetic shifts, ARMA-GARCH series (ProteuS), and tabular benchmarks (BAF, INSECTS); on the synthetic sweep at a standard threshold, the blind spot appears at $Δe \approx 0.25$, showing why classical benchmarks like SEA ($Δe \le 0.21$) failed to reach it.

AI.tldr: 自适应分类器的内部更新会先于累积检测器积累证据，导致概念漂移被"自愈"而漏检。论文推导有限时域边界与临界幅度下限，实验验证了该盲区。
AI.motivation: 累积漂移检测器（CUSUM、Page-Hinkley）依赖误差流积累证据，但自适应模型自身的更新循环会快速吸收漂移后的误差瞬态，造成检测与更新之间的操作冲突。
AI.method: 对ARF进行插桩分析，量化树木吸收误差瞬态的贡献；推导有限时域检测失效边界与临界幅度下限Δe_c；在合成漂移、ARMA-GARCH(ProteuS)、表格基准(BAF、INSECTS)上验证。
AI.result: 存活树仅靠叶子更新吸收98.6%的漂移后误差瞬态；首个背景树替换仅占0.71%却使外部检测率下降31个百分点；临界幅度下限Δe_c=0.120；标准阈值下盲区出现在Δe≈0.25，解释了SEA(Δe≤0.21)等经典基准未能触及该盲区。
AI.conclusion: 内部自适应速度超过证据积累速度时，累积检测器存在结构性盲区；该失效表现为平稳流漏检和噪声基线下的假警报泛滥。

title: Beyond Transport Cost: Routing Differences between Flow Matching and Optimal Transport
summary: In generative models, Optimal Transport (OT) is used to improve Flow Matching (FM) by reducing noise-data coupling cost. However, different noise-to-output assignments can yield nearly equal costs, raising a key question. Is cost alone sufficient to guide coupling design? We address this question by separating transport cost from routing, i.e., the destination reached by each noise sample. We show numerically how FM and OT can differ in routing while remaining close in cost. We examine its consequences in learned neural FM. Using the exact FM routing as an oracle, we further construct a routing-aware training coupling and find that it yields a directionally consistent improvement in generation over a cost-matched, cost-only counterpart. Our findings highlight what cost minimization can overlook and motivate using both cost and routing to evaluate the design of OT-based FM couplings. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文质疑最优传输(OT)的成本是否足以指导Flow Matching(FM)的耦合设计，提出分离"传输成本"与"路由"来评估耦合。
AI.motivation: 现有方法用OT改进FM以降低噪声-数据耦合成本，但不同噪声到输出的分配可产生几乎相同的成本，因此仅靠成本能否充分指导耦合设计成为关键疑问。
AI.method: 将传输成本与路由（每个噪声样本所到达的目标）分离；数值展示FM与OT在成本相近但路由不同；以精确FM路由作为oracle，构造路由感知的训练耦合，并与成本匹配但仅考虑成本的对照进行比较。
AI.result: 数值上FM与OT可在成本相近时路由显著不同；在学习的神经FM中，路由感知耦合相比仅成本对照在生成质量上取得方向一致的提升。
AI.conclusion: 成本最小化会忽略路由信息，应同时用成本与路由来评估基于OT的FM耦合设计。

title: TurboPairFormer: Fast and Stable Protein Folding Model Training with an Optimized Triangle Attention Kernel
summary: Triangular attention is a core computation in AlphaFold3-style biomolecular models, with cubic cost in token count. Its shared pair bias adds a gradient reduction across attention slices to the usual reductions over queries and keys. The open-source backends we examine handle these reductions through repeated probability recomputation, floating-point atomics, or full score-gradient storage. Separately, computing the softmax backward correction from BF16-rounded forward outputs loses numerical precision. We present TurboPairFormer, a triangular attention implementation for NVIDIA Hopper GPUs that addresses both issues. Our key-tile-parallel backward algorithm recomputes each probability tile once for the query, key, value, and pair-bias gradients, using ordered partial reductions for deterministic accumulation without floating-point atomics or full score-gradient storage. Output-residual compensation retains a BF16 approximation of the output-rounding residual to compute the backward correction more accurately in FP32, without changing the BF16 output. With BF16 inputs at crop sizes 384, 640, and 768 and head dimensions 16 and 32, TurboPairFormer achieves the lowest mean query, key, and pair-bias gradient RMSE against an FP64 reference among the implementations compared in this paper. Residual compensation reduces these RMSE values by 28-47% in controlled ablations. All four gradients are bitwise identical across five repeated calls in all 600 input cases under fixed execution conditions. Integrated into OpenFold3 with our triangle multiplication kernels, TurboPairFormer achieves the lowest GPU computation time per optimizer step among the evaluated backend configurations on 16 H100 GPUs, with speedups of $1.73\times$ over OpenFold3's Triton backend and $1.13\times$ over cuEquivariance at crop size 768.

AI.tldr: TurboPairFormer为AlphaFold3风格三角注意力提供高效GPU实现，通过关键块并行反向算法与输出残差补偿，实现确定性、高精度、低显存开销且加速训练。
AI.motivation: 三角注意力的立方复杂度加上共享pair bias引入的额外梯度归约，使现有开源后端依赖概率重算、浮点原子操作或全分数梯度存储；同时从BF16前向输出计算softmax反向校正会损失精度。
AI.method: 面向NVIDIA Hopper GPU的关键块并行反向算法，对每个概率块仅重算一次以同时获得query、key、value和pair-bias梯度，采用有序部分归约实现确定性累加，无需浮点原子操作或全分数梯度存储；并提出输出残差补偿，保留BF16的输出舍入残差近似，在FP32下更精确计算反向校正而不改变BF16输出。
AI.result: 在crop size 384/640/768、head dim 16/32、BF16输入下，对FP64参考的query、key、pair-bias梯度RMSE最低；残差补偿在受控消融中使RMSE降低28–47%；600个输入案例中五次重复调用四种梯度逐位一致；集成OpenFold3后于16张H100上每优化步GPU时间最低，crop size 768时比Triton后端快1.73×、比cuEquivariance快1.13×。
AI.conclusion: TurboPairFormer同时解决了三角注意力反向的精度、确定性与效率问题，在精度和速度上均优于现有后端。

title: MEND: RL For Flow Models via Proximal Velocity Matching
summary: Reward post-training of flow models either reweights the model's own samples under a KL penalty or a frozen reference, often for thousands of updates, or backpropagates the reward and moves every sample without checking that the move is worth its size. We introduce MEND, a reinforcement learning method built on proximal velocity matching. MEND caps rewards within each prompt group, so samples that already score well receive no move. Below the cap, it proposes moves along the reward gradient and accepts one only when its capped reward gain exceeds a quadratic displacement price. The model then regresses onto the resulting velocity targets, with no KL term, frozen reference model, or advantage weights. In 100 updates, MEND outperforms Flow-GRPO (about 4k updates) on five of six evaluators at the same distance to base-model images. Under an equal-budget protocol, it surpasses ReFL and DiffusionNFT at every evaluated update across four training rewards, reaching PickScore 24.03 versus 23.92 and 23.43, respectively. A 300-update three-reward run also surpasses the five-reward DiffusionNFT model on all three rewards it trains on. MEND is general and easy to adopt: it applies to any flow backbone with a differentiable reward.

AI.tldr: MEND是一种基于近端速度匹配的强化学习方法，通过组内奖励封顶和带位移代价的移动接受机制，仅需100步即超越需约4000步的Flow-GRPO。
AI.motivation: 现有流模型奖励后训练要么在KL惩罚或冻结参考下重加权自身样本并需数千次更新，要么直接反向传播奖励移动所有样本而不检查移动是否值得其幅度。
AI.method: 提出MEND：在每个prompt组内对奖励封顶，已高分的样本不移动；低于阈值时沿奖励梯度提出移动，仅当封顶奖励增益超过二次位移代价时接受；模型回归到得到的速度目标，无需KL项、冻结参考模型或优势权重。
AI.result: 100次更新内，在相同与基模型图像距离下，六个评测器中的五个超越Flow-GRPO（约4k更新）；等预算协议下在每个评测更新点超越ReFL和DiffusionNFT（PickScore 24.03 vs 23.92、23.43）；300次三奖励运行在所有三个奖励上超越五奖励DiffusionNFT模型。
AI.conclusion: MEND通用且易于采用，适用于任何具备可微奖励的流模型骨干。

title: CCQ: A Multi-State Child Care Quality Dataset to Support AI for Children's Health Research
comment: 29 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/GAIN-Lab/CCQ ; Code: https://github.com/Veeeeeee7/CCQ
summary: High-quality child care in early life is a critical determinant of children's growth and development. Research on child care quality has been constrained by fragmented, non-research-friendly, and privacy-bound datasets. We present CCQ (Child Care Quality), a large-scale, de-identified dataset for applied data science research at the intersection of AI and early childhood health. CCQ integrates 59,372 child care provider records across 12 U.S. states, covering diverse provider types as well as data schemas. To ensure research utility while protecting privacy, we implement an automated, LLM-based curation pipeline that anonymizes, cleans, and standardizes raw state records into two complementary releases: a cleaned textual release and a fully preprocessed tabular release. We also benchmark traditional machine learning models, tabular foundation models, and language models on quality rating prediction and important features analytics. Within a state, tabular classifiers on the preprocessed tables perform best. Across states, zero-shot transfer is near chance, but modest target-state supervision recovers most of the within-state performance, and pretraining on other states benefits finetuned language models. We release both datasets with all code to accelerate AI-driven research on child care quality and ultimately improve children's health and development.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了CCQ——一个大规模、去标识化的儿童托育质量数据集，整合12个州59,372条记录，并基于LLM自动管线产出文本和表格两种版本，同时基准测试了质量评分的预测与特征分析。
AI.motivation: 幼儿期高质量托育是儿童成长发展的关键决定因素，但现有托育质量研究受限于数据碎片化、不利于研究且受隐私约束，缺乏可用的数据集。
AI.method: 整合12个美国州、59,372条托育机构记录，涵盖多样机构类型与数据模式；采用基于LLM的自动化策管管线进行匿名化、清洗和标准化，产出清洗文本版与预处理表格版两个发布版本；并基准测试传统机器学习、表格基础模型和语言模型在质量评分预测与重要特征分析上的表现。
AI.result: 州内任务上，预处理表格上的表格分类器表现最佳；跨州零样本迁移接近随机水平，但少量目标州监督即可恢复大部分州内性能，且在其他州预训练对微调语言模型有益。
AI.conclusion: 公开数据集与全部代码，以加速AI驱动的托育质量研究，最终改善儿童健康与发展。

title: Ultrasound Operator Guidance Using World Modeling and Retrieval Based Action Planning
summary: Ultrasound is widely used, but acquisition quality is heavily dependent on the operator's knowledge and expertise. With demand for examinations outpacing the supply of trained sonographers, operator-guidance systems aim to close this gap by instructing a less trained user how to move the probe toward a target view. In this paper, we propose a retrieval-induced latent transition model for ultrasound acquisition dynamics, formulating ultrasound operator guidance as multi-step planning and retrieval in a world model. Using a V-JEPA 2.1 backbone, observations are first encoded into a latent space where anatomically related views lie close together. We then retrieve similar views from a reference database containing encoded latent states and corresponding probe positions and orientations. Rather than learning a parametric transition function, we directly use physically executed transitions from the database to establish our nonparametric, retrieval-induced transition model that supports receding-horizon planning. At deployment, guidance is generated from the live ultrasound image feed alone, without any probe tracking hardware. Applied to carotid ultrasound, the proposed planner reaches the target view in 86% of retrospective closed-loop episodes, versus 52% and 43% for representative baselines, outperforming both on every target view, including the challenging longitudinal internal and external carotid artery views. A prospective feasibility study on unseen volunteers, run in real time on a CPU using distillation, reaches 83% target-view reachability. Because planning is driven by proximity to any encodable goal latent, the same world model can navigate back to any previously acquired, patient-specific frame, supporting reproducible longitudinal imaging for e.g. perioperative or follow-up monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出检索诱导的潜在转移模型，将超声操作引导建模为世界模型中的多步规划与检索，仅凭实时图像实现无硬件探针引导，闭环到达率达86%。
AI.motivation: 超声采集质量高度依赖操作者经验，而检查需求增长快于熟练技师供给，需要引导系统帮助低经验用户将探头移动到目标视图。
AI.method: 用V-JEPA 2.1将观测编码到解剖相关视图相近的潜在空间；从含潜在状态与探头位姿的参考库中检索相似视图，直接使用库中物理执行的转移构建非参数检索诱导转移模型，支持滚动时域规划；部署时仅用实时图像，无需探针追踪硬件，并用蒸馏在CPU实时运行。
AI.result: 颈动脉超声中，回顾性闭环达目标视图86%，优于基线52%与43%，在所有目标视图（含困难的纵向ICA/ECA视图）均领先；对未见志愿者的前瞻可行性研究实时CPU运行达83%可达性。
AI.conclusion: 规划由任意可编码目标潜在的接近度驱动，同一世界模型可导航回任何既往采集的患者特定帧，支持围术期或随访监测的可重复纵向成像。

title: Global Communication or Graph-Specific Memory?
summary: Scalable Graph Transformers are commonly trained and evaluated on static large graphs in a transductive setup. Many scalable Graph Transformer components can be formulated as a constant-size shared memory, similar to virtual nodes, providing compressed information about the whole graph. The counterpart of these models in language models and other domains is justified as the input changes, and this mechanism learns to compress some useful information about the input. In transductive learning on a single fixed graph, however, any shared memory can be seen as a constant at test time. This raises the question of what exactly this shared memory does in this static setup. We give preliminary evidence that optimizing a shared memory directly performs similarly to global communication methods, and so normal local message-passing models can embed similar information in their weights. Thus, these settings may be a poor fit for evaluating global communication in graph neural networks.

AI.tldr: 该论文质疑在静态图传导式设置下评估可扩展图Transformer全局通信机制的有效性，认为共享记忆在测试时等价于常数。
AI.motivation: 许多可扩展图Transformer组件可建模为类似虚拟节点的固定大小共享记忆，用于压缩全图信息。在语言模型等领域，这种机制因输入变化而合理；但在单一固定图的传导式学习中，共享记忆在测试时是常数，因此其真实作用存疑。
AI.method: 作者通过直接优化共享记忆的初步实验，并与全局通信方法及普通局部消息传递模型进行对比分析。
AI.result: 初步证据显示，直接优化共享记忆的表现与全局通信方法相似，普通局部消息传递模型也能在权重中嵌入类似信息。
AI.conclusion: 静态图传导式设置可能不适合评估图神经网络中的全局通信机制。

title: OGAM: Connecting Systematic Testing to Runtime Assurance through Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring for VLA Policies
summary: Benchmarks expose vision-language-action (VLA) policies to few canonical instructions, while exhaustive deployment testing is impossible. We introduce Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring (OGAM), connecting systematic testing to runtime assurance: testing reveals attention divergence between successful and failed executions, and OGAM uses this signal to stop failures beyond the finite suite. We generate scene-grounded instructions through pairwise combinations of action templates and objects, and separately test meaning-preserving paraphrases. All 87 out-of-benchmark cases reveal problematic behavior across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, UniVLA, and $π_{0.5}$: none completes any of the 24 feasible instructions, while infeasible or hazardous requests also trigger behavior substitution. At each action query, we project gradient-weighted visual attention through object masks and group it by instruction role for comparison across tasks and policies. Dynamic time warping aligns this course with a successful reference despite speed differences; conformal calibration on successful episodes sets the early-stopping threshold for sustained deviations, with a nominal false-stop target of $α=0.05$. Across four policies, OGAM stops 87-100% of failed episodes at median times of 5-12s within a 20s budget, with observed false-stop rates of 3-5%, without failure-labeled training. Finite testing thus identifies attention patterns that support online intervention before failure fully unfolds.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring (OGAM)，将系统性测试与运行时保障连接起来：测试发现成功与失败执行间的注意力差异，OGAM利用该信号在有限测试套件之外停止失败。
AI.motivation: 基准测试通常只用少量规范指令评估VLA策略，而穷尽式部署测试不可行，因此需要一种能在运行时检测并阻止未见失败的方法。
AI.method: 通过动作模板与物体的成对组合生成场景接地指令，并单独测试保持语义的改写句。在每个动作查询处，将梯度加权的视觉注意力经物体掩码投影并按指令角色分组比较；用动态时间规整与成功参考对齐，并通过成功回合的保形校准设定早停阈值（名义误停目标α=0.05）。
AI.result: 87个基准外案例在OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、UniVLA和π0.5上均暴露问题：无模型完成24条可行指令，不可行或危险请求也触发行为替换。OGAM在四个策略上于20s预算内以5-12s中位时间停止87-100%的失败回合，实测误停率为3-5%，且无需失败标注训练。
AI.conclusion: 有限测试可识别注意力模式，从而支持在失败完全展开前进行在线干预。

title: Loss-Invariant Projections as Passive Probes of Learned Representations
summary: Learned feature representations in neural networks often contain structure beyond that directly used by the final task output. We study this structure using $\textit{passive probes}$ that apply fixed, untrained, property-independent projections to representations as they evolve during training. We motivate this approach through the task of prediction on $S^2$ where equivalent vector and Hermitian parameterizations reveal an additional loss-invariant trace coordinate. This motivates a general construction in which fixed random projections serve as observers of learned features. Because the observer is loss-invariant and independent of the property being studied, changes in accessibility reflect changes in the representation relative to the fixed observer rather than adaptation of the observer itself. We show that ensembles of passive probes can directly reflect task-relevant information such as target alignment. Under our constructions, the accessibility of eventual difficulty evolves differently across tasks. It increases during training in the regression tasks of surface-normal estimation and image inpainting but remains near its initial level in image classification. Comparisons with learned linear probes further show that recoverability and passive accessibility can evolve differently during training. Together, these results show how passive probes can separately characterize changes in representation geometry and the accessibility of eventual task difficulty.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"被动探针"——固定、未训练、与属性无关的随机投影，用于观察训练中表征几何结构及任务难度可及性的演化，区别于传统可学习的线性探针。
AI.motivation: 神经网络学习到的特征表征常含有超出最终任务直接使用的结构。作者希望通过一种不受探针自身适应影响的方法，来刻画表征随训练的变化及其与任务难度的关系。
AI.method: 从S²预测任务出发（向量与厄米参数化揭示额外的损失不变迹坐标），提出通用构造：用固定随机投影作为观测器。因观测器与损失、属性无关，可及性变化反映的是表征相对固定观测器的变化。还构建被动探针集成直接反映目标对齐等任务相关信息。
AI.result: 在表面法向估计与图像修复的回归任务中，最终难度的可及性随训练上升；在图像分类中则维持初始水平。与可学习线性探针比较表明，可恢复性与被动可及性可随训练产生不同演化。
AI.conclusion: 被动探针能分别刻画表征几何结构的变化与最终任务难度的可及性，为理解学习表征提供新视角。

title: The Optimization Landscape of Learning Compacted Context Models
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents
summary: Many works approach continual learning through the lens of infinite context windows. As an agent puts more observation into context (concretely the KV cache), compacting said context is akin to direct memory manipulation, without affecting the base model's weights. Many works pose KV compaction as an optimization problem: learn a smaller set of KV vectors that matches the behavior of the full KV cache. While this preserves base model behavior, optimizing through a frozen base model results in a highly nontrivial optimization problem with a brittle and flat loss landscape. In this paper, we characterize what makes these optimization problems difficult and demonstrate that a heavily simplified Perceiver-based architecture not only matches performance of a full Perceiver transformer in continuous context compaction, but outperforms baselines on compaction utility. Results are presented on MCQ tasks across Finance, Legal, Gutenberg, and Code.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究持续学习中的KV缓存压缩问题，指出通过冻结基座模型优化压缩KV会导致病态优化，并提出简化的Perceiver架构来更有效地进行上下文压缩。
AI.motivation: 将上下文压缩视为对记忆的直接操作，可避免修改基座模型权重；但现有方法把KV压缩建模为优化问题，在冻结模型下优化，导致损失曲面平坦且脆弱，优化困难。
AI.method: 作者分析此类优化问题为何困难，并设计了一个大幅简化的Perceiver架构用于连续上下文压缩。
AI.result: 简化的Perceiver架构不仅性能与完整Perceiver Transformer相当，还在压缩效用上优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 实验在金融、法律、Gutenberg和代码领域的多选题任务上验证了方法的有效性。

title: LeAVJEPA: A Minimalist Architecture for Audio-Visual Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Prior audio-visual self-supervised learning methods rely on mechanisms such as EMA target encoders, prediction heads, reconstruction decoders, and contrastive losses. We introduce LeAVJEPA, the first audio-visual encoder trained under LeJEPA's collapse-free objective. A single early-fusion Vision Transformer processes audio, video, and joint audio-video inputs. Modality dropout treats a missing modality as another view of the same event, making cross-modal alignment implicit in the objective. The model aligns global embeddings with modality-specific local embeddings, and SIGReg prevents representational collapse. A controlled ablation identifies modality dropout as the key mechanism for audio-visual alignment. Despite the architectural simplicity, LeAVJEPA reaches 36.0 mAP on AudioSet-20K and 91.3% accuracy on ESC-50 under frozen evaluation. After fine-tuning, it reaches 61.1% accuracy on VGGSound, and its embeddings support zero-shot audio-visual retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出LeAVJEPA，首个在LeJEPA无坍缩目标下训练的音频-视觉编码器，用单一早期融合ViT处理音视频，通过模态dropout实现跨模态对齐，无需EMA、预测头等复杂机制。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频自监督方法依赖EMA目标编码器、预测头、重建解码器和对比损失等复杂机制，架构冗杂。
AI.method: 单一早期融合ViT同时处理音频、视频与联合输入；模态dropout将缺失模态视为同一事件另一视图，使跨模态对齐隐式融入目标；对齐全局嵌入与模态特定局部嵌入，并用SIGReg防止表征坍缩。
AI.result: 冻结评估下AudioSet-20K达36.0 mAP、ESC-50达91.3%准确率；微调后VGGSound达61.1%；嵌入支持零样本音视频检索。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验表明模态dropout是音视频对齐的关键机制；尽管架构简单，LeAVJEPA仍取得有竞争力的性能。

title: Collaborative Personalized Preference Alignment for LLMs under Data Deficiency
summary: Real-world users often exhibit highly heterogeneous preferences over multiple objectives for LLM responses. A lightweight aligner can tailor these responses to individual preferences, but scarce user-specific feedback makes personalized training difficult. Learning shared initializations across users can support few-shot adaptation. However, heterogeneous preferences and competing objectives cause gradient conflicts across users and within each user, hindering effective initialization learning. This raises a central question: \textbf{how can we collaboratively learn aligner initializations that support few-shot adaptation to diverse user preferences?} To answer this question, we propose \textbf{A}pproximate \textbf{P}areto \textbf{O}ptimality (APO). We first group users whose updates are compatible, so that their information can be combined with less interference. Within each group, we combine gradient descent with controlled ascent to coordinate competing objectives and move towards preference-specific points on the Pareto front. This produces an initialization that is close to the optima of the users in the group. We then iteratively refine it using updates from few-shot local adaptation, making it more effective for personalization. Furthermore, we establish conditional suboptimality bounds for a one-local-step collaborative update and characterize how initialization error affects subsequent stochastic adaptation. Experiments on Fed-ChatbotPA and UltraFeedback show consistent improvements over existing methods using only 20 local examples.

AI.tldr: 提出APO方法，通过用户分组和梯度下降与受控上升结合来学习支持少样本个性化的对齐器初始化，在隐私联邦场景下实现多目标帕累托最优。
AI.motivation: 真实用户对LLM响应的多目标偏好高度异质，而用户特定反馈稀缺导致个性化训练困难。共享初始化可支持少样本适应，但用户间及用户内的异质偏好与竞争目标造成梯度冲突，阻碍有效初始化学习。
AI.method: APO方法：1)将更新兼容的用户分组，减少信息合并时的干扰；2)组内结合梯度下降与受控上升，协调竞争目标，朝帕累托前沿上偏好特定的点移动，得到接近组内用户最优的初始化；3)用少样本本地适应的更新迭代精炼初始化，增强个性化效果。
AI.result: 在Fed-ChatbotPA和UltraFeedback数据集上，仅用20个本地样本即持续优于现有方法；理论上传立了一步本地更新协作的条件次优性界，并刻画了初始化误差对后续随机适应的影响。
AI.conclusion: APO通过兼容性分组与近似帕累托最优初始化，有效解决多用户异质偏好下的个性化对齐难题，在少量反馈下显著提升个性化性能。

title: Improving Proactive AI Assistance with Hierarchical Procedural Understanding
summary: Proactive AI assistants continuously observe a user's activity and decide whether to provide new guidance or remain silent. They should provide appropriate guidance for the task, determine when to provide the next guidance based on task progress, and adjust the guidance level to the user's expertise and needs. Supporting these capabilities requires training and evaluation data that reflect procedural structure and capture how guidance should adapt to task progress and user needs. However, existing datasets either focus on detection-based proactive understanding or provide procedural guidance at a fixed granularity. Fixed-granularity guidance provides limited information about fine-grained progress and broader procedural context, making it difficult to determine completion and adapt guidance granularity. To address these limitations, we introduce the ProactiveCoach suite, comprising ProactiveCoach-Instruct for training, ProactiveCoachBench for evaluation, and fine-tuned VLMs with an adaptive guidance system. ProactiveCoach-Instruct provides hierarchically structured guidance at the phase, step, and action levels for learning task progress and procedural context. ProactiveCoachBench evaluates whether models provide appropriate guidance at the right time across different guidance levels and adapt when the requested level changes. We fine-tune pretrained VLMs on ProactiveCoach-Instruct and demonstrate its effectiveness across backbones. Compared with fixed-granularity supervision, hierarchical supervision improves overall performance across backbones by up to 9.6%p. We further build an adaptive guidance system by combining our fine-tuned model with a lightweight guidance router. Without additional fine-tuning, our system outperforms the in-context adaptation baseline by 57.1%p across four guidance-level transitions. Our project page is available at https://jinsuby.github.io/ProactiveCoach/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ProactiveCoach 套件，通过层次化指导数据训练和评估主动式 AI 助手，实现按任务进度自适应提供不同粒度指导。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集要么只做检测式主动理解，要么仅提供固定粒度的流程指导，难以判断任务完成度并自适应调整指导粒度。
AI.method: 构建 ProactiveCoach 套件：ProactiveCoach-Instruct（阶段/步骤/动作三级层次化指导训练数据）、ProactiveCoachBench（评估合适时机与不同指导级别及切换适应能力），并微调 VLM 结合轻量级 guidance router 构建自适应指导系统。
AI.result: 层次化监督相较固定粒度监督使各骨干整体性能最高提升 9.6%p；自适应系统在四种指导级别切换上比上下文适应基线高出 57.1%p，且无需额外微调。
AI.conclusion: 层次化指导数据与自适应路由机制能有效提升主动式 AI 助手的指导质量与灵活性，为主动助手训练评估提供新基准与方案。

title: Detecting Nighttime Anomalies from NASA Black Marble Using a Generalized Spatio-Temporally Robust Framework of Machine Leaning Ensembles
summary: Nighttime lights from NASA's Black Marble product suite capture thermal and light emission signals from anomalous events including fires, volcanic eruptions, and gas flaring. Existing detection approaches rely primarily on thermal bands, limiting sensitivity to weaker signals. We propose a novel machine learning framework that jointly models Black Marble M-band and Day/Night Band (DNB) signals to derive a generalized, spatio-temporally robust ensemble of anomaly detectors. The framework iteratively builds detectors that scale across regions, seasons, anomaly classes, and extends over land and ocean. Detection sets at varying confidence levels are derived based on relevant bands and detector agreement. The approach improves true detection rate while reducing spurious detections and results demonstrate strong generalizability with applications in natural hazard monitoring and energy extraction.

AI.tldr: 提出联合建模Black Marble M波段与DNB信号的新机器学习框架，构建跨时空、跨区域的异常检测器集成，用于夜间灯光异常事件监测。
AI.motivation: NASA Black Marble产品可捕捉火灾、火山喷发、天然气燃烧等异常事件的热与光信号，但现有检测方法主要依赖热红外波段，对较弱信号灵敏度不足，且缺乏跨区域、季节、异常类别的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出一种新的机器学习框架，联合建模Black Marble的M波段与昼夜波段（DNB）信号，迭代式构建异常检测器集成；检测器可跨区域、季节、异常类别扩展，并覆盖陆地与海洋；基于相关波段与检测器一致性推导不同置信水平的检测集合。
AI.result: 相比现有方法提高了真实检测率，同时减少了虚假检测，实验结果展现出较强的泛化能力，并应用于自然灾害监测与能源开采场景。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过多波段联合建模与检测器集成，实现了更强泛化性和更高精度的夜间异常事件检测，适用于自然危害监测和能源开采等实际应用。

title: CoHyFuse: Condition-wise Hypergraph Fusion with Global Connectome in Task-fMRI
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM 2026)
summary: Task-fMRI connectomes reveal state-dependent neural reconfigurations, yet conventional methods marginalize these signals by aggregating distinct conditions into static pairwise graphs, thereby obscuring condition-specific multi-ROI organization. We introduce CoHyFuse, a condition-aware ROI-centered hypergraph framework that constructs a task-state-specific incidence matrix from condition-wise functional connectivity (FC)-profile embeddings, allowing the same ROI to form different multi-ROI hyperedges across task phases. Condition-specific neighborhood sizes $K_q$ further adapt the hyperedge scale to each task state, and the resulting condition embeddings are fused with a complementary whole-session FC branch for prediction. In the AABC cohort (N=1,074), CoHyFuse achieved the best mean out-of-fold predictive performance among evaluated baselines on FACENAME Fluid Cognition Composite (FCC) prediction (7.83$\pm$0.10 MAE, 0.439$\pm$0.026 \(R^2\)) and VISMOTOR age prediction (7.52$\pm$0.37 MAE, 0.592$\pm$0.022 \(R^2\)). In an auxiliary CMI-HBN attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) classification benchmark (N=223), CoHyFuse obtained 72.0$\pm$2.1\% macro-AUC and 74.2$\pm$2.9\% accuracy. Ablation studies support the contributions of condition-wise incidence construction and dual-view fusion, suggesting that state-resolved ROI-set structure provides complementary predictive information beyond whole-session FC alone. Occlusion analysis identifies the Distraction condition as the primary driver of model prediction, pointing toward the Salience/Ventral Attention Network (SAN)--FrontoParietal Network (FPN) and within-SAN hyperedge-defined ROI-set motifs as candidate model-relevant patterns. This framework provides an interpretable, state-resolved view of the connectome for downstream cohort analysis.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoHyFuse——一种条件感知、以 ROI 为中心的超图框架，利用按任务状态构建的关联矩阵刻画多 ROI 组织，在 AABC 与 ADHD 基准上取得优于基线的预测与分类表现，并提供可解释的状态分辨连接组视图。
AI.motivation: 任务态 fMRI 连接组隐含状态依赖的神经重配置，但传统方法把不同条件聚合成静态成对图，抹平了条件特异的信号，掩盖了任务阶段特有的多 ROI 组织，因此需要一种能保留状态分辨结构的建模方式。
AI.method: CoHyFuse 基于各条件的功能连接（FC）剖面嵌入构建任务状态特异的关联矩阵，使同一 ROI 在不同任务阶段可形成不同的多 ROI 超边；对每个条件使用条件特异的邻域规模 K_q 自适应调节超边尺度；所得条件嵌入再与互补的全时段 FC 分支融合，用于预测。
AI.result: 在 AABC 队列（N=1,074）中，FCC 预测达 7.83±0.10 MAE、0.439±0.026 R²，VISMOTOR 年龄预测达 7.52±0.37 MAE、0.592±0.022 R²，均为所评估基线中最优；在 CMI-HBN ADHD 分类基准（N=223）上取得 72.0±2.1% macro-AUC 与 74.2±2.9% 准确率。消融实验支持条件特异关联构建与双视图融合的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 状态分辨的 ROI 集合结构可提供全时段 FC 之外的互补预测信息。遮挡分析显示 Distraction 条件为预测的主要驱动因素，指向 SAN–FPN 及 SAN 内部超边定义的 ROI 集合模式，为下游队列分析提供了可解释、状态分辨的连接组视角。

title: Large Stepsizes Federated Learning on Logistic Regression with Linearly Separable Data: The Case of Heterogeneous Devices
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, accepted to the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control
summary: This paper revisits the distributed learning problem for training a multinomial logistic regression model with the Federated Averaging ($\texttt{FedAvg}$) algorithm. We concentrate on a scenario with arbitrarily large stepsizes and heterogeneous update rules where the devices may perform a different number of local updates in each round. We show that, with linearly separable data, $\texttt{FedAvg}$ is stable with any stepsizes and the objective values converge to zero at the rate of ${\cal O}(1/R)$, where $R$ is the number of communication rounds. Our result also demonstrates that the effects of device heterogeneity vanish asymptotically. For sufficiently large $R$, the objective values decrease monotonically and is bounded by ${\cal O}( 1 / (R T_{\rm avg}))$, where $T_{\rm avg}$ is the average number of local update steps per communication round across devices. Numerical experiments support our findings.

AI.tldr: 研究FedAvg在任意大步长与设备异质性下的收敛性，证明线性可分数据下目标值以O(1/R)收敛到零。
AI.motivation: FedAvg在设备更新规则异质、步长任意大时缺乏理论保证，尤其每轮本地更新次数可能不同的分布式学习场景收敛性尚不明确。
AI.method: 针对多分类逻辑回归，分析任意大步长及异质本地更新（每轮不同本地步数）下的FedAvg稳定性与收敛性，聚焦线性可分数据。
AI.result: 线性可分数据下，FedAvg对任意步长稳定，目标值以O(1/R)收敛至零；设备异质性影响渐近消失；R足够大时目标值单调下降且上界为O(1/(R·T_avg))。
AI.conclusion: 理论表明FedAvg在异质场景下仍具稳健收敛性，异质性影响渐近消失，并通过数值实验验证。

title: Non-invasive Seizure Detection Using Wearable Wrist-worn Accelerometry and Deep Learning
summary: Seizure monitoring and detection are crucial for reducing the morbidity and mortality associated with seizures. Current epilepsy care, often involving expensive video-electroencephalography (VEEG) monitoring, requires specialized expertise and is limited to in-hospital settings, and intrusive in nature. Seizure diaries, on the other hand, suffer from unreliability due to under-reporting, leading to incorrect therapeutic decisions. Wearable non-invasive seizure detection may offer a more tolerable and feasible solution for long-term ambulatory monitoring. This study explores a wearable remote monitoring system utilizing a single wrist-worn accelerometer device and capable of detecting multiple types of seizures, including shorter duration events. We enrolled 79 patients under video-electroencephalography monitoring to wear accelerometer devices and collect data. Concurrent VEEG recordings were reviewed by board-certified epileptologists to produce annotations, including seizure onset, offset, and seizure type. Using this data, we constructed a deep neural network based on the time-series ResNet architecture, which could discriminate among seizure and non-seizure events. Our proposed approach achieved a seizure detection sensitivity of 95.65% and an overall false alarm rate of 0.15/24 hours during the evaluation, which spanned 5576 hours of total recording. Additionally, it resulted in an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) of 0.98 and an area under the precision-re call curve (AUC-PRC) of 0.67 when averaged over 20 patients who experienced 46 convulsive seizures. These promising results suggest that the proposed seizure detection system can be effectively used for long-term ambulatory seizure monitoring. Future steps include validating our findings in larger datasets and assessing the utility of detection for additional seizure types.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种基于单腕部加速度计的可穿戴癫痫检测系统，利用ResNet时序深度神经网络，实现95.65%的敏感度与0.15次/24小时的误报率。
AI.motivation: 现有癫痫护理依赖昂贵的视频脑电图(VEEG)监测，需专业知识且局限于院内；癫痫日记因漏报而不可靠。可穿戴无创检测有望提供更耐受、可行的长期动态监测方案。
AI.method: 招募79名VEEG监测患者佩戴加速度计设备采集数据，由癫痫专家对同步VEEG进行标注（发作起始、结束及类型），据此构建基于时序ResNet架构的深度神经网络，用于区分癫痫与非癫痫事件。
AI.result: 在5576小时总记录中，敏感度达95.65%，误报率0.15次/24小时；20名患者46次惊厥性发作中，AUC-ROC为0.98，AUC-PRC为0.67。
AI.conclusion: 系统可有效用于长期动态癫痫监测；未来需在更大数据集上验证，并评估对其他癫痫类型的检测效用。

title: The Arbitrary-Placement Problem in Entropy-Minimizing Selection, and a Residual-Entropy Formulation
summary: Entropy-based selection objectives suffer from a fundamental degeneracy: minimizing Shannon entropy $H(p_A)$ rewards confident selection regardless of whether the selected candidate is informative. We address this limitation with the residual entropy $D = H(p_A) - H(p_β)$, where $p_β$ is induced by candidate trust weights. We prove the exact identity $D = -\mathrm{KL}(p_A\Vert p_β) - Δ$, where $Δ$ measures whether the score-induced distribution and trust profile favor the same candidates. Boundary cases establish basic safety: under uniform trust, $D\leq0$ automatically, so an equal-trust, non-starving state is never penalized, while at any one-hot limit, $D\to0$ regardless of the selected candidate. For the intermediate regime where selection occurs, we prove that $D\leq0$ when candidate ordering by trust agrees pairwise with ordering by informativeness, and derive a tighter certificate based on the leading candidate's margin over its competitors. These results are independent of the candidate-scoring function and apply to both stationary and dynamically changing information. Experiments with a gradient-based mixture-of-experts router confirm that the ordering conditions can hold during real optimization and show that correct ordering improves downstream performance when candidates are non-interchangeable and selections are used directly rather than averaged. Beyond routing, margin-based reweighting matches or outperforms fixed-strength baselines in a class-imbalance task, while informative selection in a production video-prediction system reduces MSE by approximately 20$\%$ and transfers to a related species. Residual entropy, therefore, provides a safety criterion for selection and a usable signal for deciding when that selection is informative.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"残差熵" D = H(p_A) - H(p_β)，用以解决最小化香农熵在候选选择中只奖励"自信"而非"有信息量"的退化问题，并证明其安全性与信息性判据。
AI.motivation: 基于熵的选择目标存在根本退化：最小化 H(p_A) 只奖励自信的选择，无论所选候选是否有信息量。
AI.method: 引入残差熵 D = H(p_A) − H(p_β)（p_β 由候选信任权重诱导），并证明精确恒等式 D = −KL(p_A‖p_β) − Δ，其中 Δ 衡量分数诱导分布与信任轮廓是否倾向同一候选；进一步分析边界情形与中间选择区间的排序条件及基于领先候选裕度的更紧界。
AI.result: 边界情形保证基本安全（均匀信任下 D≤0，one-hot 极限下 D→0）；中间区间证明当信任排序与信息量排序逐对一致时 D≤0，并给出更紧的裕度证书。实验表明：MoE 路由中排序条件在真实优化中可满足且提升下游性能；裕度重加权在类别不平衡任务中匹配或优于固定强度基线；生产视频预测系统 MSE 降低约 20% 并可迁移。
AI.conclusion: 残差熵既为选择提供安全判据，也为判断选择何时具有信息量提供可用信号，且结论与候选打分函数无关，适用于静态与动态信息。

title: ThunderSyncRL: Lossless Acceleration of Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Language models are moving beyond generating answers to pursuing long-horizon goals in interactive environments. Post-training these agents requires long, heterogeneous trajectories, and synchronous systems leave learner engines idle until rollout and verification finish. To squeeze out these pipeline bubbles, asynchronous training overlaps rollout and learning across updates, but comes at the cost of policy staleness. We introduce ThunderSyncRL, which starts gradient computation as soon as all required inputs are fixed, without policy staleness. For group relative policy optimization (GRPO), ThunderSyncRL computes each trajectory's score gradient as soon as the reward for that trajectory arrives, without waiting for the group. For on-policy distillation (OPD), it computes gradients for each completed agentic turn's teacher-scored actions while tool calls run in the sandbox. We prove that gradient streaming produces the same GRPO and OPD updates as batch-synchronous training, without changing either objective. On SWE-bench Verified and Terminal Bench 4.0, we train models to the same performance up to $1.9 \times$ faster than synchronous training. With zero policy staleness, ThunderSyncRL also outperforms asynchronous training at a fixed budget by up to $2.47$ percentage points.

AI.tldr: ThunderSyncRL 提出"梯度流式"训练方法,在无策略滞后的前提下尽早开始梯度计算,使 GRPO 与 OPD 训练速度提升最高 1.9×,并优于异步训练。
AI.motivation: 训练长时程交互智能体需要长且异构的轨迹,同步系统会让学习引擎在 rollout 与验证期间闲置(流水线气泡)。异步训练虽能重叠 rollout 与学习,但代价是策略滞后(policy staleness),可能损害性能。
AI.method: ThunderSyncRL 在所有必需输入确定后立即开始梯度计算,且不引入策略滞后。针对 GRPO,每条轨迹奖励到达即计算其分数梯度,无需等待整个 group;针对 OPD,在每个已完成 agentic turn 的教师评分动作上计算梯度,同时工具调用在沙箱中并行执行。作者证明梯度流式产生的 GRPO 与 OPD 更新与批量同步训练完全一致,且不改变目标函数。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 Terminal Bench 4.0 上,达到相同性能的训练速度比同步训练快最多 1.9×;在固定预算下,零策略滞后的 ThunderSyncRL 比异步训练性能高最多 2.47 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ThunderSyncRL 通过梯度流式消除了同步训练的流水线气泡,同时保持与同步训练等价的更新,在无策略滞后的情况下实现加速并超越异步训练。

title: Discovered, Not Designed: Population Evolution for Collaborative and Compute-Intensive Model Discovery
summary: LLM-driven evolution enables iterative model development, but two practical goals remain underexplored: finding model designs that transfer across related tasks and sustaining improvement when training is expensive. We introduce Population Evolution (PE), a collaborative, hierarchical framework that connects ongoing local searches through shared experimental evidence. PE evaluates code changes across related training instances and shares the results to guide subsequent proposals and promotion to larger training scales. For expensive targets, PE searches small training subsets and screens candidates through peer and intermediate evaluations before full-target training. We introduce RMD-Bench to evaluate both settings across ranking, watch-time prediction, RL algorithm discovery, and LLM/VLM pretraining. Compared with standalone evolution at matched source iterations, PE raises mean best local gains from 7.01% to 8.97% in ranking and from 2.84% to 3.85% in watch-time, while improving the best larger-scale outcome in all three joint-discovery families. In watch-time discovery, PE improves best larger-scale gains with four of five harnesses and all four proposers. On new recommendation datasets under shared target-side calibration, every evaluated PE design improves over the reference in mean performance. Under matched total GPU compute, completed LLM discovery runs yield a best relative accuracy gain of 2.48% and 13 successful candidates for PE, versus 0.92% and none for direct evolution. VLM loss reduction reaches 8.78% versus 5.05% under matched total GPU compute.

AI.tldr: 提出Population Evolution (PE)分层协作框架，通过共享实验证据连接本地搜索，实现在多任务间迁移的模型设计发现与昂贵训练下的持续改进。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的进化虽支持迭代模型开发，但两个实际目标仍未充分探索：发现跨相关任务迁移的模型设计，以及在训练昂贵时维持持续改进。
AI.method: PE为分层协作框架，将正在进行中的本地搜索通过共享实验证据连接。跨相关训练实例评估代码改动并共享结果以指导后续提案及向更大训练规模晋升。对昂贵目标，先搜索小训练子集，通过同伴与中间评估筛选候选，再进行全目标训练。同时提出RMD-Bench基准评估排序、观看时长预测、RL算法发现、LLM/VLM预训练等场景。
AI.result: 相同源迭代下，PE将排序平均最佳本地增益从7.01%提至8.97%，观看时长从2.84%提至3.85%，并在三个联合发现家族中改善最佳大规模结果。观看时长发现中五个harness的四个及全部四个proposer均提升大规模增益。新推荐数据集共享目标端校准下所有PE设计均优于参考。相同总GPU算力下，LLM发现最佳相对准确率增益2.48%、13个成功候选，对比直接进化0.92%、0个；VLM损失降低8.78% vs 5.05%。
AI.conclusion: PE通过共享实验证据的协作分层进化，在跨任务迁移设计与昂贵训练持续改进两方面均取得一致且显著的提升，验证了其有效性。

title: Physics-Informed but Not Physics-Consistent: Error Geometry and Subspace Projection for Neural AC Power Flow
summary: Recent neural power-flow solvers, including emerging foundation models, achieve accurate voltage predictions, yet such accuracy does not necessarily imply physically consistent solutions. Even small complex voltage errors can yield large AC power-balance residuals. We study this accuracy-consistency gap across PIGNN-GC, GridSFM, gridfm-graphkit, and LUMINA on realistic 2224-bus Great Britain network (GBnetwork) scenarios, with cross-grid evaluation of GridSFM over 31 systems. Using a singular value decomposition (SVD) basis fitted to training AC power-flow solutions, we find that neural prediction errors contain substantial components outside the dominant solution subspace. To address this mismatch, calibrated solution-subspace projection (CSP) suppresses off-subspace prediction components after train-only bias calibration, reducing Mean PB by 67.0%, 37.8%, 40.5%, and 68.9% for PIGNN-GC, GridSFM, gridfm-graphkit, and LUMINA, respectively, relative to calibrated predictions, while improving voltage-magnitude accuracy in all four models. These results identify output-error geometry as an important factor in physics-consistent neural AC power flow. Code: https://github.com/Kimchangheon/neural-acpf-error-geometry

AI.tldr: 神经潮流求解器电压预测准确≠物理一致，误差含大量落在解子空间外的分量；提出标定解子空间投影(CSP)抑制该分量，显著降低功率平衡残差。
AI.motivation: 现有神经潮流求解器（含基础模型）电压预测准确，但小电压误差可导致很大交流功率平衡残差，即精度与物理一致性之间存在差距。
AI.method: 用拟合训练集交流潮流解的SVD基；分析误差在主导解子空间外的分量；提出标定解子空间投影(CSP)：先做仅用训练的偏置标定，再投影抑制子空间外分量。
AI.result: 在GBnetwork(2224节点)及GridSFM跨31系统评测：相对标定预测，PIGNN-GC、GridSFM、gridfm-graphkit、LUMINA的Mean PB分别降低67.0%、37.8%、40.5%、68.9%，且电压幅值精度均提升。
AI.conclusion: 输出误差几何是物理一致神经交流潮流求解的关键因素，CSP可有效兼顾一致性与精度。

title: Strategic Multi-Agent Learning for Interpretable Action Valuation of All Players in Football
summary: Valuing player actions in football requires accounting for strategic interactions among 22 players, including off-ball movements and defensive positioning. Existing reinforcement-learning-based methods commonly aggregate decisions at the team level or estimate player values independently, leaving strategic interdependence among players insufficiently represented. This study proposes an action valuation framework inspired by Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE) for all players. Each possession is modeled as a finite-horizon dynamic game, with each player represented as an autonomous agent whose policy depends on the current game state. MPE is used as a motivating solution concept rather than an exact equilibrium. To improve interpretability, we use Expandable Decision-Making States (EDMS) and decompose the Q-value into a successor-feature basis and a linear reward-weight vector. The value basis is estimated by linear TD initialization followed by nonlinear refinement. Using tracking and event data from 95 J1 League matches, we compare the proposed formulation with an independent reinforcement learning baseline. Because the two formulations define TD errors in different target spaces, TD MSE is used only for within-formulation consistency. With EDMS fixed, the independent baseline assigns the highest value to forward movement in 99.21% of evaluated off-ball states, whereas the most frequent direction under the proposed formulation accounts for 17.63%. Team-level average Q-values show a negative association with season-level expected goals for the baseline and a weakly positive association for the proposed formulation. Qualitative analyses illustrate context-dependent valuations of off-ball movements and defensive positioning. Overall, the proposed formulation produces more context-sensitive action rankings, although the comparison does not isolate the MPE-inspired component.

AI.tldr: 提出受MPE启发的足球动作估值框架，将回合建模为有限期动态博弈，用EDMS提升可解释性，并用J1联赛数据与独立RL基线对比。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法多按队伍聚合决策或独立估计球员价值，无法充分刻画22名球员间的策略互依（含无球跑动与防守站位）。
AI.method: 将每次控球建模为有限期动态博弈，每名球员为自主智能体，策略依赖当前状态；以MPE为动机性解概念而非精确均衡。采用EDMS，将Q值分解为后继特征基与线性奖励权重向量；值基先由线性TD初始化，再非线性精化。
AI.result: 用95场J1联赛跟踪与事件数据对比独立RL基线。因两者TD误差目标空间不同，仅做同框架内一致性比较。EDMS固定时，基线在99.21%的无球状态中把前向移动估为最高价值，而所提框架最常见方向仅占17.63%。队均Q值与赛季xG：基线负相关，所提框架弱正相关。定性分析显示无球跑动与防守站位估值具情境依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架产生更具情境敏感性的动作排序；但对比未隔离MPE启发组件的作用。

title: Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization
summary: Diffusion policies provide expressive action distributions for continuous-control reinforcement learning. However, safety-aware online diffusion policy optimization remains underexplored, particularly methods that use predictive reachability information without an explicit dynamics model. We propose Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization (RADPO), a model-free method that combines predictive first-hit safety estimation with cumulative-cost budget feedback. RADPO learns a discounted first-hit reachability value that captures the discounted risk of a cost event, assigns larger weight to events that occur sooner, and uses this signal to shape the reward. A separate dual-like multiplier adjusts the shaping strength according to realized episodic costs relative to a prescribed budget. The diffusion actor improves through weighted denoising regression on candidate actions scored by the reward critic. Our approach requires neither a learned dynamics model, action gradients through the critics, nor differentiation through the reverse diffusion sampler. We establish theoretical properties of the reachability value and show that accumulated reachability penalty provides a conservative surrogate for future discounted cumulative cost. Across ten continuous-control safety tasks, RADPO achieves competitive reward-cost trade-offs, with substantial reductions in constraint violations on several tasks relative to the compared baselines. Our theoretical and empirical analysis supports that combining reachability with cumulative budget feedback is a viable approach to safety-aware diffusion policies.

AI.tldr: 提出RADPO，一种无模型的安全感知扩散策略优化方法，结合预测性首次命中可达性与累积成本预算反馈，在十个连续控制安全任务上实现竞争性的奖励-成本权衡并显著降低约束违规。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略能为连续控制强化学习提供表达力强的动作分布，但安全感知的在线扩散策略优化研究不足，尤其是无需显式动力学模型即可利用预测性可达性信息的方法尚属空白。
AI.method: RADPO学习折扣首次命中可达性价值，捕捉成本事件的折扣风险并对更早发生的事件赋予更大权重，以此塑造奖励；通过类似对偶的乘子根据实际回合成本与预算的偏差调整塑造强度；扩散actor通过加权去噪回归在奖励critic评分的候选动作上改进。方法无需学习动力学模型、无需通过critic的动作梯度、也无需对反向扩散采样器求导。
AI.result: 在十个连续控制安全任务上，RADPO取得了具有竞争力的奖励-成本权衡，并在若干任务上相较基线大幅降低约束违规。理论上建立了可达性价值的性质，并证明累积可达性惩罚可保守替代未来折扣累积成本。
AI.conclusion: 理论与实证分析表明，将可达性与累积预算反馈结合是构建安全感知扩散策略的可行途径。

title: Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation for RL-Improved Reasoning Teachers
summary: Reinforcement learning can substantially improve a reasoning teacher, but it is unclear which of those improvements survive when the teacher supervises a smaller on-policy student. We study this question in mathematical reasoning by comparing teacher lineages before and after GRPO, multiple student scales, direct GRPO, and several on-policy distillation objectives. The central finding is that transfer is structured rather than scalar: teacher strength alone does not make dense distillation competitive, while an RL-improved teacher creates useful but metric-dependent student gains. This motivates Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation (TS-OPD), which screens training problems by the joint sampled success of the student and teacher, routes acquisition problems to gated forward KL, routes consolidation problems to gated reverse KL, and adds an entropy brake to protect sampled coverage. Across the main comparison, TS-OPD is the strongest student objective for macro average correctness with the GRPO-improved teacher, while pass@K remains more mixed. Ablations show that the gains come from routing and token gating rather than skipping problems. These results support a transfer-aware view of OPD: stronger teachers help when the supervision direction and token budget match the student's observed ability, not merely because the teacher endpoint is stronger.

AI.tldr: 研究RL提升的教师监督小策略学生时哪些改进能保留，提出TS-OPD方法按学生-教师联合成功筛选问题并路由KL方向。
AI.motivation: RL能显著提升推理教师模型，但教师提升能否在监督更小的on-policy学生时保留尚不清楚，且教师强度本身不保证密集蒸馏有效。
AI.method: 比较GRPO前后教师谱系、多学生规模、直接GRPO和多种on-policy蒸馏目标；提出Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation (TS-OPD)，按学生与教师联合采样成功筛选训练问题，将acquisition问题路由到gated forward KL，consolidation问题路由到gated reverse KL，并加入熵刹车保护采样覆盖。
AI.result: 迁移是结构化的而非标量；TS-OPD在GRPO改进教师下取得最佳学生宏观平均正确率，但pass@K仍混杂；消融显示收益来自路由和token gating而非跳过问题。
AI.conclusion: 支持transfer-aware的OPD观点：教师更强有帮助需在监督方向和token预算与学生观察能力匹配时，而非仅因教师端点更强。

title: EpicWorldModel: Exploration-driven Planning with Latent World Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 18 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables (11 pages main text, 4 pages appendix)
summary: Latent world models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) are deterministic by design. While successful in fully observable scenarios, this paradigm breaks down when past observations and actions lead to multiple plausible future possibilities, e.g., due to occlusion. We introduce EpicWorldModel, a framework to train stochastic JEPAs for environments and tasks with inherent uncertainty under partially observability. We jointly train the EpicWorldModel predictor with its latent representation space to directly predict multiple potential future states using a flow-matching objective, when the goal-relevant scene content is absent from the conditioning history. We show that flow predictive variance, motivated by its relation to an upper bound on predictive entropy, serves as a useful exploration guidance for planning. By incorporating this uncertainty signal into Cross-Entropy Method (CEM)-based planning, our approach balances goal-reaching with exploration of uncertain regions where occluded goals are most likely to be located. We demonstrate the effectiveness of EpicWorldModel through a series of latent planning experiments with the best or on-par performance across tasks, showing up to 22% empirical improvement in success rate over LeWorldModel.

AI.tldr: 提出EpicWorldModel，用流匹配目标训练随机JEPA，在部分可观测环境下预测多个潜在未来，并利用流预测方差引导CEM规划探索。
AI.motivation: 现有JEPA潜在世界模型本质是确定性的，在完全可观测场景有效，但当历史观测与动作对应多个可能未来（如遮挡导致）时会失效，因此需要建模固有不确定性。
AI.method: 联合训练EpicWorldModel预测器及其潜在表示空间，当条件历史缺少目标相关场景内容时，采用流匹配目标直接预测多个潜在未来状态；将流预测方差（与预测熵上界相关）作为探索引导信号，融入基于CEM的规划中，以在目标可达性与对遮挡目标可能所在不确定区域的探索之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在系列潜在规划实验中达到最佳或同等性能，成功率相比LeWorldModel最高提升22%。
AI.conclusion: 随机JEPA结合流匹配预测与不确定性引导探索，可有效应对部分可观测环境中的固有不确定性，提升规划的成功率与探索能力。

title: Langevin Flow Maps: Efficient Molecular Dynamics and Transition Path Sampling
summary: Molecular dynamics simulations proceed by integrating the Langevin equations over many small femtosecond timesteps. This poses a challenge for estimating ensemble properties and transition dynamics that occur on much longer timescales. We introduce Langevin Flow Maps, which extend machine-learned force-fields to additionally learn the stochastic Langevin integrator. We show that Langevin Flow Maps enable large-timestep molecular dynamics and recover accurate dynamical properties of the system, while running an order of magnitude faster than current machine-learned force fields. Further, by training on a diverse molecular dataset, we demonstrate a path towards transferable Langevin Flow Maps.

AI.tldr: 提出 Langevin Flow Maps，将机器学习力场扩展为学习随机 Langevin 积分器，实现大步长分子动力学，速度提升一个数量级并保持动态性质准确。
AI.motivation: 传统分子动力学需以飞秒级小步长积分 Langevin 方程，难以高效估计长时标下的系综性质与转移动力学。
AI.method: 在机器学习力场基础上，额外学习随机 Langevin 积分器（Langevin Flow Maps），支持大时间步长的分子动力学模拟，并在多样化分子数据集上训练以实现可迁移性。
AI.result: Langevin Flow Maps 能进行大步长分子动力学，准确恢复系统动态性质，速度比现有机器学习力场快约一个数量级；在多样数据集上展现出可迁移 Langevin Flow Maps 的路径。
AI.conclusion: Langevin Flow Maps 兼顾精度与效率，为大规模长时标分子模拟及可迁移模型提供了可行方向。

title: Learning While Scheduling Jobs under Context-Dependent Service Rates: An Anytime Rate-Optimal Algorithm
summary: We study contextual queueing bandits, where a learner schedules jobs while learning unknown service rates modeled by logistic functions of job-server features. Performance is measured by queue length regret, the expected excess queue length at round $t$ relative to an oracle that knows the service rates. Existing decaying-regret guarantees either have a suboptimal decay rate or require a known fixed horizon. They also assume context-wise slack and a strictly positive minimum eigenvalue of the feature covariance. In this paper, we propose WISE (Widest Interval Selection with Elimination), achieving rate-optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(t^{-1/2})$ queue length regret at every sufficiently large time without knowing the horizon. We assume capacity slack, meaning that expected incoming workload under best-server service is below service capacity, and impose no covariance lower bound. Our analysis uses a workload potential measuring the expected service attempts needed by waiting jobs on their best servers. Its drift on nonempty rounds combines a negative term ensured by capacity slack with errors from suboptimal service choices. Then an elliptical potential count bounds how often WISE selects wide confidence intervals, thereby limiting the number of rounds with large service errors. We also sharpen the arrival-rate dependence of an existing lower bound and make its dependence on feature dimension and server count explicit. We prove another lower bound that quantifies the increase in regret as the normalized capacity slack decreases; to our knowledge, this is the first such lower bound for CQB. Simulations show small regret even when context-wise slack fails.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WISE算法，在上下文排队赌博机中实现无需已知时域的最优队列长度遗憾率。
AI.motivation: 现有衰减遗憾保证要么次优，要么需已知固定时域，还依赖上下文松弛和特征协方差最小特征值正定等强假设。
AI.method: 提出WISE（最宽区间选择与消除）算法，采用工作量势能分析漂移；用椭圆势能计数限制宽置信区间选择次数。假设容量松弛，不设协方差下界。
AI.result: 达到率最优的Õ(t^{-1/2})队列长度遗憾，无需已知时域；改进现有下界的到达率依赖并显式化特征维度与服务器数；给出容量松弛下降时遗憾增大的新下界。
AI.conclusion: WISE在弱假设下实现最优遗憾，并首次为CQB刻画容量松弛与遗憾的关系，仿真验证上下文松弛失效时仍具小遗憾。

title: Spectral Geometry of Attention: From Information Routing to Uncertainty
comment: This paper has been accepted as poster at Neurips 2026
summary: In this work, we study transformer attention through the lens of spectral geometry and operator theory. We view each attention head as a functional map between Hilbert spaces of functions on the token sequence and derive a Token Difference Operator, whose spectral structure controls how token-space information is routed to the output. We show that standard Euclidean spectra are structurally biased by sinks, conflating mass concentration with genuine routing capacity. By recasting token space in the intrinsic probability geometry induced by attention, the token difference spectrum disentangles sink effects from routing capacity and provides a spectral description of the dimensionality of the head output. This yields a unified framework for analyzing attention maps, explaining sinks, routing collapse, and output dimensionality within a single operator-theoretic framework. In practice, by grounding attention heuristics in spectral geometry, we develop a novel attention-based uncertainty estimator that complements probability-based scores, with the largest gains on long-context inputs.

AI.tldr: 从谱几何与算子理论视角分析Transformer注意力，提出Token Difference Operator，并用内在概率几何解耦sink效应与路由容量，还研发出基于注意力的不确定性估计器。
AI.motivation: 标准欧氏谱受sink影响而有结构性偏差，会把"质量集中"与"真实路由能力"混为一谈，需要一个能区分二者的统一分析框架。
AI.method: 将每个注意力头视为token序列上函数Hilbert空间之间的泛函映射，导出Token Difference Operator；把token空间改为注意力诱导的内在概率几何，从而分离sink效应与路由容量，并谱式刻画头部输出维度。
AI.result: 统一的算子理论框架可同时解释attention maps、sinks、路由坍缩(routing collapse)与输出维度；所提出的注意力不确定性估计器可与基于概率的分数互补，在长上下文输入上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 将注意力启发式方法建立在谱几何之上可行且有效，既提供理论统一，也带来实用的不确定性估计改进。

title: Adaptive Expert Guidance for Efficient On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
summary: With massively parallel simulation, on-policy Reinforcement Learning methods such as PPO have become standard in many domains. However, learning from scratch is sample-inefficient and fails to exploit the potential existence of a suboptimal expert, such as a heuristic, a model-based controller, or a policy trained on a related task. Such an expert is often available and can guide early training, but its sub-optimality limits final performance. The challenge then becomes balancing expert guidance against learning from rewards. Existing methods set the expert's influence through a blending weight, a schedule, or an evaluation-driven curriculum. Alternatively, they adapt it with additional learned components such as critics over expert actions or auxiliary agents. However, none optimizes it using the same on-policy objective as the policy itself. We propose a method in which the learner and the expert alternate control within each training episode, and the expert's share of control is a single learnable parameter optimized jointly with the policy. The learner benefits from the expert early in training, but its share of control declines as the learner becomes more competent, until eventually vanishing completely. This leaves the learner acting alone and better than the suboptimal expert. We evaluate our method on 34 tasks across two benchmarks, spanning discrete and continuous action spaces, using both learned and model-based experts. Our method improves sample efficiency over guided and unguided baselines while requiring minimal hyperparameter variation. The expert's share decays to zero as the learner improves, vanishing when the expert is no longer useful.

AI.tldr: 提出一种让学习者和专家在每个训练回合内交替控制的方法，专家控制占比作为单个可学习参数与策略联合优化，随学习者变强而衰减至零，在34个任务上提升样本效率。
AI.motivation: 从零开始的on-policy RL（如PPO）样本效率低，且未利用可能存在的次优专家（启发式、基于模型控制器或相关任务策略）。现有方法通过混合权重、调度或课程设置专家影响，或引入额外学习组件（专家动作critic、辅助智能体），但都没有用与策略相同的on-policy目标来优化专家影响。
AI.method: 学习者与专家在每个训练回合内交替控制，专家控制占比为单个可学习参数，与策略联合优化。早期学习者受益于专家，随能力提升其控制份额下降直至完全消失。
AI.result: 在两个基准的34个任务上（离散与连续动作空间，学习型与基于模型的专家），相较有引导和无引导基线提升样本效率，且超参数变化极小。
AI.conclusion: 专家控制份额随学习者进步衰减至零，在专家不再有用时消失，最终学习者独立行动且优于次优专家。

title: Joint Precision Neural Networks: Task-Aware Dependency and Predictive Learning
summary: Exploiting meaningful latent structures from data to solve downstream tasks is a fundamental challenge in signal processing and machine learning. While Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and coVariance Neural Networks (VNNs) successfully leverage the covariance matrix to process data, they inherently capture both direct and indirect correlations. The precision matrix (inverse covariance) overcomes this by explicitly encoding conditional independencies, making it largely studied in graphical lasso and graph topology identification. However, finite-sample precision estimates are notoriously unstable, and regularized estimators remain task-agnostic. In this work, our principal contribution is tackling the challenging problem of task-aware graph inference. We propose Precision Neural Networks-Joint (PNN-Joint), a framework that jointly estimates a sparse, statistically grounded precision matrix alongside graph neural network weights via an alternating optimization scheme. As a foundational framework to support this, we introduce Precision Neural Networks (PNNs), a broader class of graph convolutional networks operating on precision estimators, and establish their spectral connections to PCA and VNNs alongside their stability to finite-sample errors. Extensive empirical evaluations on synthetic data, as well as real-world neuroimaging and motion sensor datasets, demonstrate that PNN-Joint yields highly interpretable task-aware graphs, exhibits remarkable robustness in low-data regimes, and consistently achieves the best or second-best performance among competitors on real-world tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PNN-Joint框架，通过交替优化联合估计稀疏精度矩阵与GNN权重，实现任务感知的图推断，在低数据场景下鲁棒且性能优异。
AI.motivation: PCA和VNN仅利用协方差矩阵，捕捉的是直接与间接相关性；精度矩阵（逆协方差）能显式编码条件独立性，但有限样本下估计不稳定，且现有正则化估计器与任务无关。
AI.method: 提出PNN-Joint，采用交替优化方案，联合估计稀疏、具统计基础的精度矩阵与图神经网络权重；并引入更广泛的精度神经网络（PNNs）类别，建立在精度估计器上的图卷积网络，分析其与PCA、VNN的谱联系及对有限样本误差的稳定性。
AI.result: 在合成数据及真实神经影像、运动传感器数据集上，PNN-Joint生成高度可解释的任务感知图，在低数据场景下鲁棒性强，并在真实任务中持续取得最优或次优性能。
AI.conclusion: PNN-Joint有效解决了任务感知图推断问题，兼顾可解释性与鲁棒性，为基于精度矩阵的图学习方法提供了理论基础与实践框架。

title: MercerFlow: Flow Matching in a Kernel-Induced Latent Space for Probabilistic Forecasting
summary: Recent work has shown that probabilistic flow matching for time series forecasting benefits from a data-matched prior. The resulting prior introduces local correlations, which a sequential architecture usually absorbs: a recurrent neural network (RNN), a structured state-space model (S4), or a Transformer. However, such a backbone costs GPU memory and time per epoch. A cheaper alternative is MLP-based latent-space flow matching: embed the time series via an invertible map to a single latent vector and learn the flow there, so a tabular MLP can treat the series as a set of features. The relationship between the prior and the choice of linear latent map is understudied in conditional flow matching (CFM) forecasting, yet we found it strongly affects performance. Fixed transforms such as Fourier or discrete cosine (DCT) are only well-conditioned for Ornstein--Uhlenbeck priors, while a principal-component (PCA) map fit to the data is a strong but training-set-dependent reference sensitive to train--test shift. Instead, we propose to use the Mercer eigenbasis of the prior kernel: it diagonalises the centred covariance exactly, decouples from training data, and adapts to non-stationary and periodic priors. On five GluonTS benchmarks (ETTh1, ETTh2, Weather, Electricity, Traffic) under a shared protocol with TSFlow, the resulting MLP matches or beats it on CRPS at about $4.7\times$ less training memory and $3.5\times$--$4.4\times$ less time per epoch.

AI.tldr: 论文研究条件流匹配(CFM)时间序列预测中，线性潜映射与先验的关系，提出用先验核的Mercer特征基替代Fourier/DCT/PCA映射，使MLP在五个基准上以更低内存和时间达到或超越TSFlow。
AI.motivation: 数据匹配先验引入了局部相关性，通常由RNN、S4或Transformer等序列架构来吸收，但这类骨干网络每epoch的GPU内存和时间开销大。更廉价的替代是MLP潜空间流匹配，但潜映射与先验的关系在CFM预测中研究不足，且实验发现其强烈影响性能：Fourier/DCT仅对OU先验良态，PCA映射依赖训练集、对训练-测试偏移敏感。
AI.method: 将时间序列经可逆映射嵌入为单一潜向量，用表格MLP在其上学习流。提出使用先验核的Mercer特征基作为线性潜映射：该基精确对角化中心协方差，与训练数据解耦，并能适应非平稳和周期先验。
AI.result: 在GluonTS的五个基准（ETTh1、ETTh2、Weather、Electricity、Traffic）上，在与TSFlow共享的协议下，所得MLP在CRPS上匹配或超越TSFlow，同时训练内存约减少4.7倍，每epoch时间约减少3.5–4.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 先验核的Mercer特征基是一种理论上更优、与数据解耦且适应性强的潜映射选择，配合MLP可在CFM时间序列预测中以显著更低的计算成本取得或超越序列架构的精度。

title: GO-Based Clustering for Learning Cluster-Level Causal Gene Regulatory Networks
summary: Discovery of causal relationships in high-dimensional Gene Regulatory Networks (GRN) is computationally challenging and often difficult to interpret due to dense connections. Therefore, grouping genes together into functional modules can improve tractability and biological interpretability. However, existing cluster level causal discovery methods assume access to a predefined admissible partitions, requiring the graph over clusters to be acyclic. Constructing such partitions is therefore challenging. In this work, we introduce GO-based Clustering for Causal Discovery (GO4CD), an algorithm that uses Gene Ontology (GO) to construct biologically meaningful gene partitions at multiple levels of granularity, while favoring those more likely to be admissible for causal discovery. GO4CD groups together genes participating in a shared biological process, and propagates gene annotations through the ontology hierarchy to achieve different granularity of partitions. Furthermore, we integrate GO4CD with Causal Learning over Clusters (CLOC) algorithm and evaluate recovery of true Markov equivalence class both with an oracle of conditional independencies and on simulated gene expression data using multivariate conditional independence tests. We evaluate GO4CD on multiple E.coli regulatory subnetworks and find that it is inadmissible in 18.1% of the cases, compared with 65.3-82.3% for the semantic-similarity baselines. Our results indicate that GO4CD is substantially better suited to learning causal GRNs defined over biologically meaningful gene clusters.

AI.tldr: GO4CD利用Gene Ontology构建多粒度、生物学有意义的基因分群以支持因果发现，显著降低不可容许分群比例。
AI.motivation: 高维基因调控网络因果关系难以发现且难以解释，聚类到功能模块可提升可处理性与可解释性，但现有簇级因果发现方法需预设可容许分群（簇间图须无环），构造困难。
AI.method: 提出GO4CD，用GO构建多层次粒度的生物学基因分群，将参与同一生物过程的基因归为一组，并通过本体层级传播注释；将其与CLOC算法集成用于簇级因果学习。
AI.result: 在E.coli多个调控子网络中，GO4CD不可容许率仅18.1%，而语义相似度基线为65.3-82.3%；并在有条件下独立预言机及模拟基因表达数据（多变量条件独立检验）下评估了真实马尔可夫等价类的恢复。
AI.conclusion: GO4CD更适合学习基于生物学有意义基因簇定义的因果基因调控网络。

title: Pay to Learn, Share to Earn: Incentivized Federated Multi-Player Bandits
summary: Federated multi-player multi-armed bandit problems model collaborative sequential decision-making where multiple players interact with a common bandit environment and share information through a central server to accelerate learning. Existing federated bandit frameworks typically assume that all players willingly share their local observations with the server. However, this assumption is often unrealistic in practical settings where players are self-interested and may not participate in collaboration without explicit incentives. To address this challenge, we propose an incentive-aware federated bandit framework in which players receive rewards for sharing information with the server and incur costs when buying information from the server. We develop a UCB-based algorithm, termed Buying-UCB, that balances individual exploration and collaborative learning by incorporating both sharing incentives and information acquisition costs into the learning process. We theoretically analyze the proposed algorithm and derive upper bounds on the group regret and buying cost. Our analysis further characterizes the trade-off between fully collaborative federated learning and completely independent learning. Extensive numerical experiments validate the theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework under different collaboration and pricing regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出激励感知的联邦多玩家多臂老虎机框架与Buying-UCB算法，在玩家自利、需付费/获奖励分享信息的情形下平衡个体探索与协作学习。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦老虎机框架假设所有玩家愿意无偿分享观测，但现实中玩家自利，缺乏激励则不参与协作，该假设不切实际。
AI.method: 构建激励感知联邦老虎机框架：玩家分享信息获奖励、购买信息付成本；设计基于UCB的Buying-UCB算法，将分享激励与信息获取成本纳入学习过程，平衡个体探索与协作学习。
AI.result: 理论上推导了群体遗憾与购买成本的上界，并刻画了完全联邦协作学习与完全独立学习之间的权衡；大量数值实验验证了理论结论，并在不同协作与定价机制下展现框架有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在玩家自利且存在定价机制的场景下实现有效联邦协作学习，并量化协作程度与成本之间的权衡。

title: Boosting Transferable Adversarial Attacks against Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Most adversarial attacks on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) assume white-box access to the victim policy, which rarely holds in practice. This paper studies transfer-based black-box attacks on DRL: the attacker crafts observation perturbations on a white-box surrogate agent and feeds them to an unknown victim. We formulate the attack as return minimization under a per-step perturbation budget. We first show that transplanting transferable image-classification attacks (FGSM, MI-FGSM, and NI-FGSM) with a per-step objective yields perturbations that transfer but are no stronger than random noise of the same budget. We then propose a trajectory-level attack that optimizes a sequence of perturbations over a receding horizon through a differentiable model of the environment and a temperature-smoothed surrogate policy, with the same optimizers. On CartPole-v1 with ten DQN and DDQN agents and 100 surrogate--victim pairs, the trajectory-level attack outperforms per-step attacks and random noise in the white-box, cross-model, and cross-algorithm settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于迁移的黑盒DRL攻击，提出轨迹级攻击方法，在无法访问受害者策略时优于逐步骤攻击与随机噪声。
AI.motivation: 多数DRL对抗攻击假设白盒访问受害者策略，实际中很难满足；本文关注更现实的基于迁移的黑盒攻击场景。
AI.method: 将攻击形式化为每步扰动预算下的回报最小化问题；先将FGSM、MI-FGSM、NI-FGSM等图像分类迁移攻击移植到逐步骤目标，再提出轨迹级攻击：在滚动时域上通过可微分环境模型和温度平滑代理策略优化扰动序列。
AI.result: 移植的逐步骤攻击虽能迁移，但不强于同预算随机噪声；轨迹级攻击在CartPole-v1上、10个DQN/DDQN代理、100对代理-受害者组合中，在白盒、跨模型、跨算法设置下均优于逐步骤攻击和随机噪声。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级优化比逐步骤迁移更适合黑盒DRL对抗攻击，能有效提升扰动迁移性和攻击效果。

title: Lossy Compression of PDE Training Inputs: Field Reconstruction Error Does Not Order the Cost to a Trained Operator
summary: Operator-learning benchmarks are stored at full precision and have grown to terabyte scale. Rate-distortion theory says how many bits the stored field needs, while a practitioner needs to know how accurate an operator trained on the compressed data will be. We show that the first does not determine the second, and measure why, compressing the input fields while targets and test inputs stay at full precision. A solution operator attenuates a perturbation of its input. Pushing a compressed field through a surrogate already trained at full precision measures how much of the perturbation that surrogate transmits. The fraction is consistent with the smoothing behaviour of the underlying equation, and it spans more than two orders of magnitude across PDE families. Field reconstruction error is computed before the attenuation and cannot see it. For operators trained with mean squared error it inverts 36 of 104 cost comparisons across datasets, where a probe built from the same forward passes inverts 12. Two families that PDEBench stores with identical initial conditions differ threefold downstream at identical field error. Under the relative-L2 objective of the reference recipe the separation narrows, while the ordering of the family-level median transmission factors is unchanged. After one full-precision training run, the probe evaluates an entire rate curve by forward passes alone. It ranks datasets and rates consistently across the codecs and architectures we test, while its magnitude does not transfer between them.

AI.tldr: 论文指出：压缩数据上的场重建误差无法决定算子训练精度，同一场误差下不同PDE家族的算子泛化性能差异显著；作者提出用"扰动透射率"探针量化该效应。
AI.motivation: 算子学习基准数据已达TB级全精度存储，率失真理论能告诉我们需要多少比特存储场，但实践者真正关心的是在压缩数据上训练出的算子精度如何。核心问题是：存储所需比特数并不决定算子精度，二者之间存在被忽视的差距。
AI.method: 在保持目标与测试输入全精度的前提下压缩输入场；将压缩场输入已在全精度上训练好的代理算子，测量该代理对输入扰动透射（衰减）的比例，作为探针。该探针只需一次全精度训练，即可仅靠前向传播评估整条率曲线。
AI.result: 透射率与底层方程的平滑行为一致，跨PDE家族跨越两个数量级。场重建误差在衰减之前计算，无法观察到该效应。对MSE训练的算子，在104组成本比较中该误差颠倒36组，探针仅颠倒12组。PDEBench中初始条件相同的两个家族，在相同场误差下下游性能相差三倍。相对L2目标下分离度收窄，但家族级中位透射率的排序不变。探针在不同编解码器与架构间排序一致，但幅度不可迁移。
AI.conclusion: 压缩存储的比特数不能决定算子训练精度，场重建误差具有误导性。扰动透射探针能一致地排序数据集与码率，是可用的算子学习压缩评估指标，但其绝对幅度不具备跨设置迁移性。

title: On the Geometry of Multimodal Saturation: Riemannian VICReg
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the Proceedings Track of the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps)
summary: In self-supervised learning, a third modality should improve, or at least preserve, performance. Across nine image-text-tabular datasets, we show that it instead harms performance: the trimodal model underperforms its own best bimodal subset in 55.6% of paired runs under VICReg. The same failure occurs in 51.1% of paired runs under SimSiam. We call this failure multimodal saturation. We propose that the failure lies in the alignment geometry. Riemannian VICReg (R-VICReg) generalizes classical VICReg: it aligns views by squared geodesic distance on learnable negative-curvature product factors and recovers VICReg exactly as curvature vanishes. Over the same 45 paired runs, R-VICReg raises the probability that the third modality helps from 44.4% to 64.4%, with gains concentrated where VICReg saturates.

AI.tldr: 三模态自监督学习中添加第三模态反而损害性能（多模态饱和），作者提出黎曼VICReg通过平方测地距离对齐视图来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习通常认为增加第三模态应提升或至少保持性能，但作者发现三模态模型常劣于其最佳双模态子集，并将此失败称为多模态饱和，认为问题出在对齐几何上。
AI.method: 在9个图像-文本-表格数据集上，用VICReg和SimSiam评估三模态与其最佳双模态子集的配对运行；提出Riemannian VICReg（R-VICReg），在可学习的负曲率乘积因子上用平方测地距离对齐视图，曲率为零时退化为经典VICReg。
AI.result: VICReg下55.6%、SimSiam下51.1%的配对运行中三模态劣于最佳双模态。R-VICReg在45次配对运行中将第三模态带来帮助的概率从44.4%提升至64.4%，增益集中在VICReg饱和处。
AI.conclusion: 多模态饱和源于对齐几何，R-VICReg通过黎曼几何推广VICReg可有效提升第三模态的增益概率。

title: Flash-OPD: Fast On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but generating and evaluating long rollouts incurs substantial training cost. Existing acceleration methods reduce this cost through open-loop rollout schedules or closed-loop horizon adaptation. However, supervision compatibility can vary substantially across trajectories, making a single rollout horizon difficult to match their heterogeneous reliable lengths: an overly short horizon may truncate useful supervision, while an overly long one wastes computation beyond reliable regions. Our key insight is that the trajectory-specific reliability boundary need not be predicted before generation. By viewing reliability as the first-passage of accumulated low teacher--student compatibility events, the boundary is inherently unknown before sampling, yet whether it has been reached can be determined exactly from the observed prefix. Building on this insight, we propose *Flash-OPD*, which shifts from rollout-horizon control to adaptive trajectory-level boundary verification. *Flash-OPD* interleaves cached generation with teacher verification and independently stops each trajectory according to its observed compatibility events. To reduce verification overhead, the recent event rate is used only to schedule the next verification point, while the actual stopping decision always relies on the exact cumulative count. This separation prevents estimation errors from causing premature termination while enabling efficient verification during generation. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and teacher--student settings show that *Flash-OPD* achieves $2.2\times$--$7.5\times$ speedups over standard OPD while maintaining or improving accuracy.

AI.tldr: Flash-OPD 通过将 OPD 的长轨迹开销问题从"预测/控制 rollout 长度"转为"在生成过程中按观测到的师生兼容性事件自适应地验证轨迹边界",实现 2.2–7.5 倍加速。
AI.motivation: On-policy distillation 需要对学生生成的长轨迹做密集教师监督,生成与评估成本高。现有加速方法用开环调度或闭环调整单一 horizon,但不同轨迹的可靠监督长度异质,单一 horizon 要么截断有用监督、要么在不可靠区域浪费计算。
AI.method: 核心观点:轨迹可靠性边界在采样前不必也无法预测,可视作"低师生兼容性事件的首次到达",只能由已观测前缀精确判断是否到达。据此提出 Flash-OPD,将 rollout-horizon 控制改为轨迹级自适应边界验证:交错进行缓存生成与教师验证,每条轨迹按观测到的兼容性事件独立停止;近期事件率仅用于安排下一个验证点,真正停止决策依赖精确累计计数,从而避免估计误差导致过早终止,同时降低验证开销。
AI.result: 在多种数据集和师生设置上,Flash-OPD 相比标准 OPD 取得 2.2×–7.5× 加速,同时保持或提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性边界应作为生成时验证的首次到达事件而非预先控制的 horizon,自适应轨迹级验证可在保证监督质量的同时显著降低 OPD 训练成本。

title: ORCA: The Annealed Spectral Conditioning Optimizer for Faster, Better LLM Training
summary: Modern LLM optimizers such as Muon often produce weight matrices with higher effective rank than Adam, yet further spectral control has delivered only modest gains. We identify a tension behind this result: concentrated spectra can suppress gradient directions in coupled weight matrices and slow optimization, while constraints maintained throughout training can limit task-specific adaptation and raise the attainable loss floor. We introduce ORCA (Orthogonal Regularization, Cooled After), a minimal optimizer intervention that applies strong but temporary soft orthogonality regularization early in training, then removes it. This allows the weights to benefit from a broader spectrum early on and adapt freely afterward. Across LLaMA, Qwen3, and fine-grained mixture-of-experts models ranging from 130M to 8B parameters, ORCA achieves lower final validation loss than Muon. Its loss reduction relative to Muon matches or exceeds Muon's reduction relative to Adam. Ablations support the early-shaping, later-release design. Further, ORCA requires no architectural changes and adds minimal overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出ORCA优化器，在训练早期施加暂时性软正交正则、后期移除，兼顾早期谱扩展与后期自由适应，在多模型上取得优于Muon损失。
AI.motivation: Muon等优化器虽权重有效秩更高，但进一步谱控制收益有限。存在张力：集中谱会抑制耦合权重中的梯度方向、拖慢优化；而全程维持的约束又会限制任务适应、抬高损失下限。
AI.method: ORCA(Orthogonal Regularization, Cooled After)：一种极简优化器干预，在训练早期施加较强但临时的软正交正则，随后移除，使权重早期受益于更宽谱、后期自由适应。无需架构改动、开销极小。
AI.result: 在LLaMA、Qwen3及细粒度MoE模型（130M–8B）上，ORCA最终验证损失低于Muon；相对Muon的损失下降幅度达到或超过Muon相对Adam的下降幅度。消融验证了“早期塑造、后期释放”设计。
AI.conclusion: 通过早期谱塑造加后期释放的临时正则策略，ORCA在不改架构、低开销下优于Muon，验证了分阶段谱控制的有效性。

title: Mind the Drift: Diagonal Linear Networks Under Large Learning Rates
summary: Large learning rates can qualitatively change the trajectory of neural network training, often pushing optimization into regimes far from classical gradient-flow behavior. The Edge of Stability (EoS) offers a valuable lens on the dynamics such learning rates induce. We study corresponding dynamics in diagonal linear networks, where we uncover a competition between two distinct implicit biases that jointly determine the sparsity of the recovered solution in regression settings. Complementary to the Gain, which captures the average discretization error accumulated by Gradient Descent relative to Gradient Flow, we derive a closely associated but overlooked quantity: the Drift.
