We show that our model recovers both modes in each case, while a neural operator baseline suppresses spiking near threshold and blurs the gap between modes at depolarization block.

AI.tldr: 该论文用条件流匹配生成模型学习单神经元电生理的随机响应分布，克服传统确定性替代模型的局限。
AI.motivation: 同一刺激对同一神经元可产生不同电压响应，传统详细生物物理模型需用大量参数集合捕捉变异性，代价高达数十万CPU小时，现有机器学习替代模型仍只能将刺激映射为单一响应。
AI.method: 提出条件生成模型，采用流匹配（flow matching），速度场以输入电流为条件，用于单神经元电生理建模。
AI.result: 在两类人类皮层中间神经元生物物理模型上，生成响应能复现电生理特征分布、放电时间结构和兴奋性曲线，甚至匹配对应人类皮层神经元实验记录；在阈值附近能恢复放电与非放电共存，在高幅值去极化阻滞附近恢复低放电与高放电双模态，而神经算子基线在阈值处抑制放电、在去极化阻滞处模糊模态间隙。
AI.conclusion: 条件流匹配生成模型可有效捕捉单神经元电生理响应变异性与多模态行为，优于确定性神经算子替代模型。

title: WaveGSSM: Graph Wave State Space Models for Propagating Spatio-Temporal Patterns
summary: Spatio-temporal graph models typically encode each snapshot with a GNN and then connect the resulting representations through a temporal module. This space-then-time design is effective, yet it does not explicitly represent how a pattern moves across the graph. We show empirically that, for a propagating process, the same present field can lead to different futures when its recent rate of change differs, motivating an explicit representation of motion in the predictive state. We introduce WaveGSSM, a second-order graph state-space model that maintains two coupled latent states at each node, one for the current pattern and one for its temporal rate of change. A graph-wave transition updates the motion state through graph interactions and uses it to advance the pattern state, coupling spatial propagation and temporal evolution within a single rollout. We evaluate WaveGSSM on four temporal-graph benchmarks and global weather forecasting. It consistently achieves the best mean performance across the temporal-graph benchmarks and reduces the geopotential RMSE by 20.2% on average for 1- to 5-day weather forecasts relative to a backbone-matched snapshot model, while better preserving large-scale atmospheric patterns.

AI.tldr: WaveGSSM 提出一种二阶图状态空间模型，在每个节点维护模式状态与变化率状态，通过图-波转移显式建模运动，用于时序图与天气预报任务。
AI.motivation: 传统时空图模型采用"先空间后时间"设计，无法显式表达模式在图上如何传播；实验表明相同当前场在近期变化率不同时会有不同未来，因此需要在预测状态中显式表示运动。
AI.method: WaveGSSM 是二阶图状态空间模型，每个节点维护两个耦合隐状态（当前模式与时间变化率）；图-波转移通过图交互更新运动状态，并用其推进模式状态，在一次 rollout 中耦合空间传播与时间演化。
AI.result: 在四个时序图基准与全球天气预报上评估，在时序图基准上取得最佳平均性能；相对同骨干快照模型，1-5天天气预报的位势 RMSE 平均降低 20.2%，并更好保留大尺度大气模式。
AI.conclusion: 显式运动表示能提升传播过程的预测能力，WaveGSSM 在时序图与天气预报任务上均验证了其有效性。

title: A Fine-Grained Analysis of the LoRA Fine-Tuning Landscape with Implications for Data Selection
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a standard approach for parameter-efficient fine-tuning, yet a fundamental practical question remains unresolved: how should the adapter rank be chosen? An overly small rank may lead to a poorly conditioned optimization landscape, whereas an unnecessarily large rank sacrifices the efficiency that motivates LoRA in the first place. Existing theoretical analyses provide only limited guidance on this trade-off, and their guarantees are typically established under restrictive theoretical settings. We address this gap by developing a substantially sharper landscape theory for LoRA, building on modern results from nonconvex low-rank matrix sensing. Our central insight is that the appropriate adapter rank should depend on the quality of the data-induced optimization geometry, rather than on the model alone. To formalize this connection, we introduce LoRA-RIP, a data-dependent restricted-isometry metric that characterizes the conditioning of the cross-entropy (CE) objective along LoRA-relevant low-rank directions. We prove that sufficient rank over-parameterization, with the required rank explicitly determined by the LoRA-RIP constant, eliminates spurious local minima, thereby extending existing RIP-based guarantees beyond the classical 1/3 regime. This characterization further enables principled data selection under a fixed rank budget. Experiments across language and vision tasks support these theoretical predictions, showing that rank and data quality are two coupled resources that should be jointly considered for more efficient and reliable LoRA fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 该论文为LoRA的适配器秩选择提供了更锐利的损失景观理论，提出数据依赖的LoRA-RIP指标，证明由该指标决定的秩过参数化可消除虚假局部极小，并将秩与数据质量视为耦合资源。
AI.motivation: LoRA中秩的选择缺乏实用指导：秩过小导致优化景观病态，秩过大则牺牲效率；现有理论分析结论有限，且多依赖严格的理论设定。
AI.method: 借鉴非凸低秩矩阵感知的现代结果，发展更锐利的LoRA景观理论；提出LoRA-RIP这一数据依赖的受限等距度量，刻画交叉熵目标在LoRA相关低秩方向上的条件数，并据此确定所需秩。
AI.result: 证明足够的秩过参数化（所需秩由LoRA-RIP常数显式确定）能消除虚假局部极小，将现有基于RIP的保证推广到经典1/3区间之外；该刻画还支持固定秩预算下的原则性数据选择。
AI.conclusion: 语言与视觉任务实验支持理论预测，表明秩与数据质量是应联合考虑的两种耦合资源，有助于更高效、可靠的LoRA微调。

title: Empirical Variational Autoencoder
summary: We present Empirical Variational Autoencoder, a general generative framework for continuous-valued (i.e., non-vector-quantized) sequences. EVA is based on the evidence lower bound of the Variational Autoencoder (VAE) but learns autoregressive latent priors empirically from training data, which can be implemented only by an additional single linear layer on top of VAEs. By replacing the conventional standard-Gaussian constraint with the self-predicted priors, EVA significantly alleviates the latent distribution gap between prior and posterior which is typically observed in conventional VAEs, and leads to high-fidelity ancestral sampling for sequential data generation. Extensive experiments on image and sound synthesis demonstrate that EVA achieves competitive generation quality with autoregressive diffusion baselines despite its much faster inference time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出经验变分自编码器（EVA），一个面向连续值序列的通用生成框架。它在VAE基础上仅额外加一个线性层，从训练数据中经验学习自回归隐先验，替代标准高斯约束，从而缓解先验与后验之间的分布差距，实现高保真的序列生成，并在图像与声音合成上以更快推理速度达到与自回归扩散基线相当的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 传统VAE对隐变量施加标准高斯先验，导致先验与后验之间存在明显的分布差距（latent distribution gap），影响序列数据的生成质量，尤其是连续值序列的高保真采样。
AI.method: EVA基于VAE的证据下界（ELBO），但用从训练数据中经验学习的自回归隐先验替代常规标准高斯约束。实现上仅在VAE之上增加一个线性层即可，通过自预测先验来对齐先验与后验。
AI.result: 在图像和声音合成任务上的大量实验表明，EVA能实现与自回归扩散基线相当的生成质量，同时推理速度显著更快。
AI.conclusion: 通过经验自回归先验替代固定高斯先验，EVA有效缩小了先验—后验分布差距，为连续值序列生成提供了一个结构简单、推理高效且质量有竞争力的通用生成框架。

title: LinearPFN: Amortized Variable Selection for Linear Models with Interactions
summary: Spike-and-slab regression is a standard Bayesian formulation of variable selection: it returns a posterior distribution over which candidate effects are active rather than a single selected subset, so that every candidate effect carries an inclusion probability. Its cost grows exponentially with the number of candidate effects, so the posterior can be enumerated exactly only when the number of predictors is small. Beyond that reach, the posterior has to be approximated, typically by Markov chain Monte Carlo over the model space, which requires a fresh run for every dataset and, within a fixed budget of steps, may fail to converge. We present LinearPFN, a prior-data fitted transformer network that amortizes spike-and-slab inference for linear models with main effects and pairwise interactions. The network is pretrained once on synthetic datasets, drawn from an explicitly specified prior, and a single forward pass over a new dataset returns posterior inclusion probabilities, posterior-mean coefficients and posterior predictive distributions with no per-dataset fitting. The prior is conjugate by design, so that the posterior for each fixed set of active effects has a closed form, and wherever the exact posterior is still computable by enumeration we verify the network's outputs against it. On real predictor matrices from published social-science datasets, with outcomes drawn from the prior so that the true active set is known, LinearPFN attains a higher per-dataset selection AUC and a higher F1 under the median probability model rule than five classical baselines. The lead holds when the coefficients, the interactions or the noise depart from the prior. Code: https://github.com/schiekiera/LinearPFN. Trained model: https://huggingface.co/schiekiera/LinearPFN.

AI.tldr: LinearPFN是一种预训练Transformer，通过摊销spike-and-slab推断，一次前向传播即可为线性模型（含主效应与成对交互）输出后验包含概率、系数和预测分布，无需逐数据集拟合，性能优于五种经典基线。
AI.motivation: spike-and-slab回归虽能给出候选效应的后验包含概率，但其代价随效应数指数增长：预测变量少时可精确枚举，超出后只能用MCMC近似，而MCMC需对每个数据集重新运行，且固定步数预算下可能不收敛。
AI.method: 提出LinearPFN，一个prior-data fitted transformer网络，将spike-and-slab推断摊销到线性模型（含主效应和成对交互）。网络在符合显式先验的合成数据上预训练一次，对新数据集单次前向传播即可输出后验包含概率、后验均值系数和后验预测分布。先验设计为共轭，使固定活跃效应集的后验有闭式解。
AI.result: 在可枚举计算精确后验的情形下，验证了网络输出与精确后验一致。在已发表社会科学数据集的真实预测矩阵上（结果从先验抽取、真实活跃集已知），LinearPFN在每数据集选择AUC和中位数概率模型规则下的F1上均高于五种经典基线；当系数、交互或噪声偏离先验时优势依然保持。
AI.conclusion: LinearPFN通过摊销式预训练实现了高效、无需逐数据集拟合的spike-and-slab推断，在真实社会科学数据上优于经典基线，且在偏离先验设定下保持稳健。代码与训练模型均已开源。

title: Separators Make Carry Propagation Learnable:The Geometry of Latent Carry in a Multiplication Transformer
summary: Transformers asked to multiply multi-digit numbers in a single forward pass often fail, and interpretability studies of pretrained language models find arithmetic solved by input-range heuristics rather than by an explicit carry. We train small Llama-style transformers from scratch on 4x4 multiplication without chain of thought and find that the input format is decisive: inserting a space token between digits raises exact-match accuracy from 1% to 89%. Output positions are learned in carry-chain order, with the middle digits, which have the longest-range dependencies, learned last. Inside the model, the separator token that predicts each digit (its prediction slot) encodes the carry-in as an angle on a ring in the residual stream; examples with more distinct carry values fill more of the ring. Activation patching between examples matched on the column sum shows that this state is causally used before the last layer: patching the prediction slot alone transfers the source carry in up to 84% of cases after block 4 for one middle column of our best model, while for other columns the carry is first assembled at the neighboring answer slot before reaching its own. Remaining errors are almost always off by one, consistent with a small error on the carry or on the circular digit code.

AI.tldr: 训练Llama式小模型做4x4乘法，输入格式（数字间加空格）使准确率从1%升至89%；模型按进位链顺序学习输出位置，残余流中进位以环形角度编码并被因果使用。
AI.motivation: Transformer单次前向做多位数乘法常失败，可解释性研究发现预训练模型靠输入范围启发式而非显式进位来解算术，需探究其内部机制。
AI.method: 从头训练小型Llama式Transformer做4x4乘法（无思维链），改变输入格式，分析输出位置学习顺序，并用电激活修补（activation patching）检验进位的因果作用。
AI.result: 数字间插入空格使精确匹配从1%升至89%；输出位置按进位链顺序习得，中间数字最晚学会；分隔符token的残余流以环形角度编码进位；块4后修补预测槽单独可转移源进位至多84%；其余错误几乎均为差一。
AI.conclusion: 输入格式对乘法学习至关重要，模型确实学习并因果地使用显式进位表征，而非仅依赖范围启发式。

title: Differentially Private Mixing of Public Datasets Improves Private Learning
summary: Many machine learning applications involve sensitive data and therefore require training under differential privacy (DP). However, DP training often degrades model utility. In some cases, first pre-training the model on "public" data before finetuning with DP on the sensitive data can reduce the drop in utility. However, the success of this depends on how relevant the selected public dataset is to the sensitive data. We introduce the first pipeline that privately learns the mixture of several public datasets to pretrain on for a given sensitive downstream task. Our key insight is that we can privately find the best mixture of multiple public datasets by privately learning a low-dimensional linear model. We tested our method on the NIH dataset for X-ray classification and the ENRON email dataset for language modeling. Applying our method to find tailored mixtures of X-ray datasets to pretrain on for diseases in the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset, we improved macro AUC by up to 0.037 across privacy budgets compared to the baselines, with gains as large as +22.8% relative AUC on Cardiomegaly at $ε=1$. For DP training on the ENRON dataset, pre-training on our mixture of The Common Pile (a collection of public-domain text datasets) decreased test perplexity by 16% relative to the baseline mixtures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个在差分隐私下学习多个公开数据集混合比例以预训练的方法，用于敏感下游任务。
AI.motivation: DP训练会降低模型效用，而公共数据预训练可缓解此问题，其效果依赖于公开数据集与敏感数据相关性，需要自动寻找最佳混合。
AI.method: 关键洞察是可通过在差分隐私下学习一个低维线性模型来私有地找到多个公开数据集的最佳混合比例。
AI.result: 在NIH ChestX-ray14上macro AUC提升高达0.037，ε=1时Cardiomegaly相对AUC提升+22.8%；在ENRON上预训练于The Common Pile的混合使困惑度相对降低16%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效为敏感下游任务定制公开数据混合，在多种隐私预算下提升DP训练效用，适用于视觉与语言任务。

title: Beyond the Model: The Critical Role of Data Filtering in Clinical Machine Learning
summary: Machine learning (ML) studies using clinical data often rely on preprocessing and filtering pipelines before model development. The filtering decisions made in these pipelines can alter the dataset's statistical structure and may artificially reduce or increase the complexity of the prediction task. We argue that filtering choices should be treated as part of the scientific method rather than as a routine preprocessing step. We further discuss the need for explainable and transparent preprocessing pipelines that allow researchers to understand why specific filtering choices are made and how these choices affect the resulting data distribution and model performance. All of the source code for this work is available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 该论文主张将临床机器学习中的过滤/预处理决策视为科学方法的一部分，而非例行预处理步骤，并呼吁建立可解释、透明的预处理流程。
AI.motivation: 临床ML研究常依赖预处理与过滤流程，但过滤决策会改变数据统计结构，可能人为地增减预测任务复杂度，带来偏差风险。
AI.method: 论文以立场/观点论证为主，分析过滤选择对数据分布和模型性能的影响，并提出对可解释、透明预处理流程的需求；源代码已公开于GitHub。
AI.result: 指出过滤决策会人为改变任务复杂度，强调需理解过滤原因及其对数据分布和模型性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 过滤应被纳入科学方法范畴，研究者应建立透明可解释的预处理流程以提升研究严谨性和可复现性。

title: Considering Context: When World Models Need Context Encoders
summary: Methods for generalization in model-based reinforcement learning typically assume that an agent cannot recover the latent context governing the environment dynamics from its own experience, and therefore supplies it externally. We formalize and test this assumption with \emph{predictive sufficiency}, which quantifies what access to the context adds to next-step prediction under the visitation distribution an agent induces, and separates that quantity into a history-recoverable part, a residual requiring the true context, and the deficit added by a finite model. We classify context-aware algorithms by the predictive risk their conditioning set can target and demonstrate across environments of increasing identification difficulty that the headroom does not follow the MDP class. The same task under different priors leaves predictive headroom in one setting and nothing distinguishable from zero in another, where the agent's behavior implicitly identifies the context and any benefit of such a mechanism cannot be attributed to missing information. Where headroom persists, the learned state exposes it only partially, and adding the true context still lowers the risk. Our contribution is a practical criterion for matching contextual mechanisms to the information available to them, estimated from the ordinary trained agent without a reference policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"预测充分性"来量化和检验模型基强化学习中"智能体无法自行恢复潜在上下文、需外部提供"这一常见假设。它将上下文对下一步预测的增益分解为历史可恢复部分、需真实上下文的残差及有限模型的不足，并据此分类上下文感知算法。实验表明，预测增益并不随MDP类别变化：某些设定下智能体行为已隐含识别上下文，其收益无法归因于缺失信息；而在增益存在时，学习状态只能部分体现，仍需真实上下文。贡献是给出从普通训练智能体估计、无需参考策略的实用判据。
AI.motivation: 模型基强化学习的泛化方法通常假设智能体无法从自身经验中恢复支配环境动态的潜在上下文，因而需外部提供该上下文。文章旨在形式化并检验这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 引入"预测充分性"指标，量化上下文对在智能体诱导的访问分布下下一步预测的增益，并将其分解为历史可恢复部分、需真实上下文的残差和有限模型带来的不足。同时对上下文感知算法按其所依赖条件集可针对的预测风险进行分类，并在识别难度递增的环境中测试。
AI.result: 预测增益（headroom）并不随MDP类别变化。同一任务在不同先验下，有的设定存在预测增益，有的与零不可区分——此时智能体行为已隐含识别上下文，机制收益无法归因于缺失信息。增益存在时，学习状态只能部分体现，加入真实上下文仍可降低风险。
AI.conclusion: 文章给出一个实用判据，用于将上下文机制与智能体可获得的信息相匹配，且该判据可从普通训练好的智能体上估计，无需参考策略。

title: The Birkhoff Geometry of Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections: Two Channels, Vertex Viscosity, and Sinkhorn as a Retraction
summary: Hyper-connections widen the residual stream of a Transformer to $n$ parallel streams. Their manifold-constrained version (mHC) mixes the streams at each layer with a doubly stochastic matrix, which it computes by Sinkhorn normalization of exponentiated logits. We give a geometric theory of this design on the Birkhoff polytope. First, a doubly stochastic mixer splits the stream into a mean channel, on which mHC is exactly a residual network, and a difference channel, which each layer contracts by its second singular value $σ_2 \le 1 - n \min_{ij} H_{ij}$. Thus the extra width is a fading memory with a horizon of $1/(1-σ_2)$ layers, and among nonnegative mixers only the permutations do not collapse. Second, the Sinkhorn-logit map is a global chart, and its logit gradient is exactly the Fisher-Rao gradient. Thus logit gradient flow follows a squared Fisher-Rao metric, and the straight-through update is exactly entropic mirror descent. Third, under logit gradient flow the logarithm of each entry moves at a rate of at most $4n^3\|\nabla f\|_\infty \varepsilon$, where $\varepsilon$ is the distance to the nearest permutation. Thus gradient flow approaches and leaves the vertices only at rate $1/t$, but mirror descent moves at an exponential rate. Fourth, the local convergence factor of Sinkhorn is $σ_2^2$, so a fixed iteration budget limits the horizon. Experiments confirm the predicted rates.

AI.tldr: 本文在Birkhoff多胞形上为mHC（流形约束超连接）建立了几何理论：双随机混合器把残差流分解为均值通道（等价于残差网络）和差分通道（按第二奇异值收缩），并以Sinkhorn对数映射的Fisher-Rao几何刻画其梯度流与收敛速率。
AI.motivation: 超连接将Transformer残差流拓宽为n条并行流，mHC用双随机矩阵逐层混合以保持流形约束，但该设计缺乏理论理解，作者希望从几何角度解释其表达力、记忆衰减与优化动力学。
AI.method: 在Birkhoff多胞形框架下分析：(1) 双随机混合器分解为均值/差分通道，用第二奇异值σ₂刻画层间收缩；(2) 证明Sinkhorn-logit映射是全局图册，其对数梯度即Fisher-Rao梯度，直线传播更新等价于熵镜像下降；(3) 推导logit梯度流下逐项对数变化率上界与到顶点的接近/离开速率；(4) 分析Sinkhorn局部收敛因子。
AI.result: 均值通道上mHC精确等价于残差网络；差分通道每层收缩因子σ₂≤1−n·min H_ij，形成视界为1/(1−σ₂)层的衰减记忆，非负混合器中仅置换不塌缩；logit梯度流遵循平方Fisher-Rao度量，优于镜像下降的指数速率（梯度流仅1/t）；Sinkhorn局部收敛因子为σ₂²，固定迭代预算限制记忆视界。实验验证了预测速率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作用Birkhoff多胞形上的几何理论统一解释了mHC的宽度收益、记忆衰减与优化行为，表明额外宽度本质上是有界视界的衰减记忆，且Sinkhorn迭代预算直接制约可用记忆长度，为设计受限混合器提供了理论指导。

title: TrustmeWatcher: An Application for Workplace Micro-Sensing and Explainable Well-Being Feedback
comment: 4 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at XAI for U 2026, the 3rd International Workshop on Explainable AI for Ubiquitous, Pervasive and Wearable Computing, co-located with UbiComp/ISWC 2026
summary: Workplace sensing studies combine long-running behaviour traces with self-reports, yet the tools that collect those data often sit apart from the interface that returns results. We present TrustmeWatcher, the application built for the TRUST-ME project to connect this work. TrustmeWatcher reuses ActivityWatch's OS-level watchers for computer-activity collection and adds its own application layer. It turns the collected traces into an interactive screen-time dashboard, synchronizes responses from short questionnaires completed on the StreamDeck, and presents questionnaires alongside video highlights. Activity records and self-reports are aligned into labelled records for model development. The scope of this paper is limited to ActivityWatch data as model input. Artificial intelligence (AI) uses these activity records to predict six normalized state scores and an overall well-being score. The trained model runs locally, and the dashboard presents its predictions in semantic bands. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) helps users understand how recorded activity contributed to a prediction. Privacy Control lets users pause or resume the camera and eye tracker used by the study. We describe the workflow, its user-device and sensing-setup boundaries, and its use with records from 17 participants. The result is a deployed application and study workflow that integrates activity review, study data collection, privacy control, local prediction, and a participant-facing interface for XAI evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 TrustmeWatcher，一个为 TRUST-ME 项目构建的集成应用，将 ActivityWatch 的计算机活动采集、StreamDeck 问卷、屏幕时间看板、本地 AI 预测与 XAI 解释、隐私控制整合为统一的工作流，并已在 17 名参与者数据上使用。
AI.motivation: 工作场所感知研究通常将长期行为轨迹与自我报告结合，但数据采集工具与结果反馈界面往往彼此分离，缺乏整合。
AI.method: 复用 ActivityWatch 的 OS 级监测器采集计算机活动，并添加自有应用层：将轨迹转为可交互屏幕时间看板，同步 StreamDeck 短问卷，结合视频高亮展示问卷，把活动记录与自我报告对齐为带标签记录。以 ActivityWatch 数据为模型输入，AI 预测六个归一化状态分数与整体幸福感分数，模型本地运行，看板以语义区间展示预测，并用 XAI 解释活动对预测的贡献。提供隐私控制以暂停/恢复摄像头与眼动仪。
AI.result: 构建出已部署的应用与研究流程，集活动回顾、研究数据采集、隐私控制、本地预测与面向参与者的 XAI 评估界面于一体，并在 17 名参与者的记录上进行了使用。
AI.conclusion: TrustmeWatcher 弥合了数据采集与结果反馈之间的鸿沟，提供了一个可部署、集成的参与者面向工作流，支持本地预测与 XAI 评估。

title: Learning What to Imitate: Entropy-Aware Distribution Mixing
summary: Small language models are often post-trained as students on reasoning traces from stronger teacher models to efficiently learn new skills. However, token-level imitation on traces that lie far outside the student's expected distribution often produces \textit{confident conflicts}, whereby the student is required to imitate a continuation that it deems unlikely (i.e., low-probability) despite being confident in a different continuation (i.e., in a low-entropy state). To mitigate the degradation in generalisation and catastrophic forgetting caused by these conflicts, we propose \textbf{Entropy-Aware Mixing}: a dynamic per-token interpolation of the student and teacher distributions, gated by the student's predictive entropy. We implement both convex and geometric interpolations for both offline trace generation (via speculative decoding, then SFT) and on-policy forward-KL distillation. Our results show that entropy-aware mixing stabilises distillation, improving in-distribution and out-of-distribution math reasoning while better preserving general capabilities than fixed-teacher supervision. Nonetheless, the optimal entropy schedule depends on the training source, with offline-generated traces favouring concave schedules (greater overall teacher influence) and on-policy training favouring linear or convex schedules (teacher concentrated in high-entropy states).

AI.tldr: 提出“熵感知混合”（Entropy-Aware Mixing），通过基于学生预测熵的逐 token 动态插值师生分布，缓解在推理蒸馏中因“自信冲突”导致的泛化下降与灾难性遗忘。方法在离线（推测解码+SFT）与在线（forward-KL 蒸馏）均实现凸/几何插值。结果显示该方法稳定蒸馏，提升分布内/外数学推理并更好保留通用能力，但最优熵调度依赖训练来源。
AI.motivation: 小模型常以强教师模型的推理轨迹做学生后训练，但教师轨迹常偏离学生分布。逐 token 模仿这些轨迹会引发“自信冲突”：学生需模仿其认为低概率的续写，而它其实坚信另一种续写（低熵状态）。这类冲突会损害泛化并造成灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出 Entropy-Aware Mixing：按学生预测熵门控，对教师与学生分布做逐 token 动态插值。实现两种插值形式（凸插值与几何插值），并用于两类场景：1）离线轨迹生成（先推测解码再 SFT）；2）在策略 forward-KL 蒸馏。
AI.result: 熵感知混合能稳定蒸馏，相较固定教师监督，提升分布内与分布外数学推理性能，同时更好保留通用能力。最优熵调度因训练来源而异：离线生成的轨迹偏好凹调度（整体教师影响更大）；在线策略训练偏好线性或凸调度（教师影响集中在高熵状态）。
AI.conclusion: 熵感知混合通过对学生熵的自适应门控有效缓解自信冲突，是提升推理蒸馏稳定性与泛化的可行方案；但需根据离线或在线训练来源选择匹配的熵调度策略。

title: Improved Convergence of Large Stepsize Gradient Descent for Logistic Regression
summary: We study gradient descent (GD) with a large constant stepsize for logistic regression on linearly separable data. Existing analysis shows an accelerated rate of $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrtε)$ to reach loss $ε$ with an aggressive stepsize, although the loss may initially oscillate. Tighter control of the oscillatory dynamics has been available only for two-dimensional data. We prove a substantially faster rate in arbitrary dimension: GD with a large stepsize $η=1/ε$ reaches loss $ε$ within $O(\ln^{p}(1/ε))$ steps, where $p$ depends only on the margin and the rank of the data. Our proof improves the bound on the transition time of GD from the oscillatory to the stable phase, after which the loss decreases monotonically. We split the oscillatory phase into recursively nested intervals. The margin and the rank bound the nesting depth, and a counting argument bounds the number of intervals at each depth, together yielding the polylogarithmic step complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究线性可分数据上逻辑回归的大步长梯度下降，证明在任意维度下，步长η=1/ε时可在O(ln^p(1/ε))步内达到损失ε，p仅依赖间隔和数据秩。
AI.motivation: 已有分析显示大步长GD能达到Õ(1/√ε)的加速率，但损失可能初期振荡；更紧的振荡动态控制此前仅限二维数据，缺乏任意维度下的快速收敛保证。
AI.method: 证明通过改进GD从振荡阶段到稳定阶段的过渡时间界：将振荡阶段拆分为递归嵌套区间，用间隔和秩限制嵌套深度，再用计数论证限制每层区间数量。
AI.result: 在任意维度下，GD以大步长η=1/ε可在O(ln^p(1/ε))步内达到损失ε，其中p仅取决于数据间隔和秩，显著快于已有Õ(1/√ε)速率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将大步长GD振荡动态的紧致分析从二维推广到任意维度，给出了多对数步复杂度，深化了对不稳定阶段过渡的理解。

title: Closing the Context Gap: Activation Alignment for Tabular In-Context Learning
summary: Tabular foundation models perform in-context learning (ICL) by conditioning predictions on labeled training examples provided as context. Unlike traditional models that separate training from inference, these models must process all training examples in every forward pass, making each prediction expensive. Restricting the number of training examples reduces this cost but substantially degrades performance. Instead of discarding context, we propose activation alignment, a method that leverages the full context to teach a model how to behave when seeing only a subset. This is achieved by training a lightweight linear transformation on synthetic unlabeled data to map the intermediate activations of a data-constrained "student" (using partial context) toward those of a full-context "teacher" (using all data). Training the aligner requires no GPU and converges in seconds to minutes on commodity hardware. We evaluate on 38 classification datasets from the TabArena benchmark using the leading two tabular foundation models, TabPFN-3 and TabFM. Across all context budgets, the aligned student yields broad, statistically significant improvements over the unaligned baseline for both models. In low-data regimes, alignment recovers nearly half of the teacher's predictive advantage. The method provides a practical, low-overhead approach to achieving the inference speed of compact contexts while closing a significant fraction of the performance gap to the full-context teacher.

AI.tldr: 提出激活对齐方法，用全上下文教师指导受限上下文学生，在保持推理速度的同时接近全上下文性能。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型通过上下文学习预测，但每次前向需处理所有训练样本，成本高；减少样本虽降成本却显著损害性能。
AI.method: 在合成无标签数据上训练轻量线性变换，将受限上下文学生的中间激活对齐到全上下文教师的激活，无需GPU，数秒至数分钟收敛。
AI.result: 在TabArena的38个分类数据集上，用TabPFN-3和TabFM评估，各上下文预算下对齐学生均优于未对齐基线，低数据场景恢复约一半教师优势。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以低开销实现紧凑上下文的推理速度，并显著缩小与全上下文教师的性能差距。

title: OVAL: Output-Aware Local Page Bases for KV Cache Retrieval
summary: Long context inference with large language models becomes increasingly expensive as attention must operate over an ever growing KV cache. Page sparse attention reduces this cost by representing each KV page compactly and retrieving only a subset for each query. Existing retrieval methods are designed to estimate attention scores or page relevance, but their objectives do not directly account for how approximation errors affect the resulting value weighted attention output. We introduce \method{}, an output aware page encoding derived from the joint structure of keys and values while preserving the key information needed for accurate retrieval. \method{} is training free and requires no additional value dependent statistics at inference time. Once constructed, its stored representation has the same size and decode time scoring cost as a key only spectral representation. Across long reasoning, long context understanding, and long generation benchmarks, \method{} consistently improves over the key only spectral baseline and performs competitively with recent KV cache compression and retrieval methods. On long reasoning benchmarks, it achieves strong avg@\(k\) performance across model benchmark pairs, while matching or surpassing leading baselines on several long context understanding and generation settings with modest decoding overhead. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/Ashkan13776/oval-kv}.

AI.tldr: 提出 Oval-KV,一种输出感知的页编码方法,用于长上下文 KV 缓存稀疏注意力,无需训练,在多种长上下文任务上优于仅键谱基线。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理中 KV 缓存不断增长导致注意力计算昂贵;现有页稀疏检索方法仅估计注意力分数或页相关性,未直接考虑近似误差对加权注意力输出的影响。
AI.method: Oval-KV 基于键与值的联合结构构建输出感知的页编码,同时保留检索所需的键信息;无需训练,推理时不需要额外的值相关统计;其存储表示在大小和解码打分开销上与仅键谱表示相同。
AI.result: 在长推理、长上下文理解与长生成基准上持续优于仅键谱基线,与近期 KV 缓存压缩和检索方法竞争;长推理基准上跨模型-基准对取得较强 avg@k 表现,在若干理解与生成设置上匹配或超越领先基线,解码开销适中。
AI.conclusion: Oval-KV 通过输出感知的页编码改进了页稀疏注意力,兼顾检索准确性与输出近似质量,且无训练、开销低,代码已开源。

title: Adapting prior-data fitted networks for tabular anomaly detection
comment: Submitted for a review to ICLR 2027
summary: While deep features have transformed anomaly detection in images and video, their impact on tabular data has been less substantial, partly due to the limited availability of strong deep representations. Recently, prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have emerged as a promising source of such representations for tabular data. In this work, we investigate how PFN representations can be adapted and leveraged for anomaly detection. The question is harder than it looks. No anomalies are available before deploy- ment, so model parameters cannot be tuned with supervision, and the reference set that defines normal behavior may itself contain the very anomalies it is supposed to reveal. We begin our study using frozen TabPFN features. Scoring each sam- ple by its distance to its nearest neighbors in feature space already gives strong results. We identify which layers to use and a feature-extraction procedure suited to the task. Next, to further improve performance, we use the reference set to fine- tune the model, so that the resulting features better separate normal samples from anomalies. On the ADBench benchmark, our fine-tuning free approach (ZEN) reaches a higher mean AUROC than every baseline, and our fine-tuned method (FOCUS) improves on it further. Our approach also generalizes across PFN models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何将PFN（prior-data fitted networks）表征用于表格数据异常检测，提出无需微调的ZEN与微调的FOCUS方法，在ADBench上取得领先的AUROC。
AI.motivation: 深度特征已显著提升图像和视频异常检测，但对表格数据影响有限，主要因缺乏强深度表征。PFN近期成为表格数据表征的潜在来源，本文探究如何适配和利用PFN表征做异常检测。该问题较难：部署前无异常样本可监督调参，且定义正常行为的参考集本身可能包含异常。
AI.method: 先用冻结的TabPFN特征，在特征空间中按样本到最近邻的距离打分，并识别适用的层及特征提取流程（ZEN方法）。随后利用参考集对模型进行微调，使特征更好地区分正常与异常样本（FOCUS方法）。
AI.result: 在ADBench基准上，无需微调的ZEN平均AUROC高于所有基线，微调的FOCUS进一步提升性能，且方法可泛化到不同PFN模型。
AI.conclusion: PFN表征可有效用于表格异常检测，简单最近邻距离打分已具竞争力，利用参考集微调可进一步改善，方法在不同PFN模型间具有泛化性。

title: To Learn is to Wander: Learning Across Graphs and Tasks with Random Walks
summary: Graph foundation models aim to transfer across graphs, feature spaces, relational schemas, and prediction tasks, yet existing approaches typically generalize only within particular graph modalities or tasks. We propose Wander, a graph foundation model designed to operate across these settings within a single pretrained checkpoint. Following the prior-predictive perspective, we formulate graph learning as completion of a partially observed graph. We realize this task-general view through a common interface based on random walks, allowing the same model to operate across homogeneous and multi-relational graphs with varying features, labels, and relational schemas. Wander can increase its structural context at inference time without changing its learned parameters and, under suitable assumptions, universally approximates the corresponding Bayes-optimal predictor on bounded connected graphs. Empirically, a single pretrained checkpoint achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive results across node classification, homogeneous link prediction, and knowledge-graph link prediction. Moreover, joint pretraining across graph modalities and tasks preserves performance in specialized settings while enabling positive transfer and the composition of separately learned capabilities at inference time.

AI.tldr: 提出 Wander，一个可在单一预训练检查点内跨同质图/多关系图、不同特征/标签/关系模式及多种任务运行的图基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有图基础模型通常只能在特定图模态或任务内泛化，无法跨图、特征空间、关系模式与预测任务迁移。
AI.method: 从先验预测视角将图学习建模为部分观测图的补全，并基于随机游走构建统一接口，使同一模型适用于同质与多关系图；推理时可增长结构上下文而不改参数。
AI.result: 在合适假设下可通用逼近有界连通图上的贝叶斯最优预测器；单一检查点在节点分类、同质链接预测和知识图谱链接预测上达到最优或极具竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态与任务的联合预训练在保持专用场景性能的同时，带来正向迁移，并支持推理时组合分别学到的能力。

title: BRANCH-MoE: Balance-Aware Tree Routing for Large Embedding Models
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity without a proportional increase in per-example computation. However, conventional flat routers can yield imbalanced expert utilization and treat experts as an unstructured collection, whose indices carry no topological meaning. We introduce {\bf BRANCH-MoE}, a routing architecture that places \(E\) experts at the leaves of a binary decision tree of depth \(\log_2 E\). At each internal node the branching probability is centered on the arrival-weighted mean score of the traffic reaching that node. This mean is estimated using an exponential moving average, which promotes utilization of both child subtrees without an auxiliary load-balancing loss. We show that this moving-average estimate admits an explicit noise-lag trade-off. We prove that for linear node maps and log-concave arrival distributions, this mechanism prevents routing-mass collapse. We further establish that, under a frozen router, an expert's execution frequency controls its stochastic-gradient convergence rate, and that confident decisions near the root bound cross-device communication when experts are assigned to devices by tree prefix. We evaluate BRANCH-MoE against Switch softmax, DeepSeek-V3 dynamic-bias, Skywork logit-normalized, and deterministic hash routing on Criteo click-through-rate prediction, Forest Covertype, HIGGS, and YearPredictionMSD, using \(E=16\), top-\(4\) routing, and five random seeds. Our results show that hierarchical routing can preserve task quality and balanced utilization while inducing a topology that supports localized expert co-activation and reduced communication.

AI.tldr: BRANCH-MoE用二叉树结构组织专家，通过滑动平均的动态分支概率实现负载均衡，无需辅助损失，并支持通信局部化。
AI.motivation: 传统MoE的扁平路由器导致专家利用不均衡，且将专家视为无拓扑结构的集合，索引无拓扑意义。
AI.method: 将E个专家置于深度log2(E)的二叉树叶子节点；内部节点分支概率以到达该节点流量的加权平均分为中心，用指数移动平均估计，促进两棵子树利用而无辅助负载均衡损失；专家按树前缀分配到设备以限制跨设备通信。
AI.result: 理论上证明移动平均估计存在噪声-滞后权衡，对线性节点映射和对数凹分布可防止路由质量崩塌；冻结路由器下专家执行频率控制随机梯度收敛率，根附近的高置信决策可限制跨设备通信。在Criteo、Forest Covertype、HIGGS、YearPredictionMSD上（E=16, top-4, 5个随机种子）与Switch softmax、DeepSeek-V3动态偏置、Skywork logit归一化、确定性哈希路由对比，层级路由保持任务质量和均衡利用。
AI.conclusion: 层级路由能保持任务质量与均衡利用，同时形成支持局部专家共激活和减少通信的拓扑结构。

title: Decoupling Time and Space: A Temporally Conditioned Refinement for EEG Source Imaging
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers millisecond temporal resolution, but inferring underlying neural sources is a severely ill-posed spatial inverse problem. While deep learning has advanced spatial reconstruction, current architectures face a critical dilemma: frame-by-frame models discard vital temporal context, whereas full 4D spatiotemporal networks introduce an architectural trade-off between reconstruction accuracy and inference cost. We propose a novel two-stream framework that explicitly decouples global temporal representation learning from per-time-point spatial refinement. A Transformer-based Temporal Condition Encoder processes the entire EEG sequence via factorized spatiotemporal attention, retaining sensor-resolved features. A fixed inverse then maps these features into source-indexed conditioning for a per-timestep Source-Space Transformer or volumetric convolutional refiner. Extensive evaluations on realistic synthetic data demonstrate that this temporal prior dramatically improves spatial localization, outperforming classical and spatiotemporal baselines, particularly in high-noise and multi-source regimes. Training across diverse leadfields and explicit operator mismatches improves transfer to unseen head geometries and brings template-based reconstruction closer to subject-specific inversion. Furthermore, we apply the model trained only on synthetic EEG data to real-world EEG. A logistic regressor fit on source power differences in eyes-open, eyes-closed conditions successfully decodes age groups.

AI.tldr: 提出双流框架，将全局时间表征学习与逐时刻空间细化解耦，用Transformer+固定逆算子完成EEG源定位，性能优于经典与时空基线。
AI.motivation: EEG源定位是严重病态的逆问题。现有深度学习架构存在两难：逐帧模型丢失时间上下文，而完整4D时空网络在重建精度与推理成本间难以权衡。
AI.method: 双流框架：Transformer时间条件编码器通过分解时空注意力处理整段EEG序列，保留传感器级特征；固定逆算子将其映射为源索引条件，供逐时间步的源空间Transformer或体积卷积细化器使用。
AI.result: 在逼真合成数据上，时间先验显著提升空间定位，尤其在高噪声与多源场景超越经典及时空基线；跨导联场与算子失配训练提升对新头几何的迁移，使模板重建接近个体化反演。仅用合成数据训练的模型应用于真实EEG，基于睁眼/闭眼源功率差异的逻辑回归可成功解码年龄组。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦时间与空间建模可缓解EEG源成像的精度-成本权衡，并具备向真实数据与个体化解剖结构迁移的潜力。

title: Hyperbolic Graph Representation Learning: Embed in One Metric, Optimize with Another
summary: Hierarchical graphs embed in hyperbolic space with lower distortion than in Euclidean space owing to its negative curvature. However, their gradient-based learning is hampered at large radii, where the Poincaré ball and the Lorentz hyperboloid models fail numerically. Polar coordinates avoid this problem, but the hyperbolic metric scales the angular step by the hyperbolic sine of the radius, freezing angular motion. We observe that this factor is a choice, silently fixed by existing implementations: the Euclidean tangent parametrization, for instance, uses the radius itself. We show that other choices are not only possible but preferable. They are endpoints of a one-parameter family of optimization preconditioners with curvatures from $-1$ to $0$, while the embedding remains at curvature $-1$. We show that since the Euclidean preconditioner rearranges a layout but refines it poorly, while an intermediate one refines far better once a layout is in place, combining them in two stages reduces the loss on real-world trees by 46-74% over the best single curvature.

AI.tldr: 双曲空间虽能低失真嵌入层次图，但大半径处梯度学习受数值问题困扰。作者发现角步长的缩放因子只是一种可选择的度量约定，从而提出一族由曲率-1到0的优化预条件器，并将欧氏与中间预条件器分两阶段结合，使真实树数据损失较最优单一曲率降低46-74%。
AI.motivation: 层次图在双曲空间中嵌入的失真低于欧氏空间，得益于负曲率。然而在大半径处，Poincaré球与Lorentz双曲面模型的梯度学习存在数值失效；极坐标虽避开该问题，但双曲度量将角度步长按sinh(半径)缩放，导致角向运动被冻结，妨碍优化。
AI.method: 作者指出该缩放因子并非必然，而是现有实现（如欧氏切空间参数化使用半径本身）默认固定的选择。他们提出一个单参数优化预条件器族，其曲率从-1到0变化，而嵌入本身仍保持在曲率-1。其中欧氏预条件器善于重新布局，中间预条件器善于在已有布局上精化，因此将二者分两阶段组合使用。
AI.result: 在真实世界树结构数据上，两阶段组合策略相比最佳单一曲率预条件器将损失降低46-74%。
AI.conclusion: 角步长的双曲缩放是可选择的度量约定而非硬性约束；引入曲率介于-1与0之间的预条件器族，并结合欧氏布局与中间曲率精化的两阶段优化，可显著提升双曲层次嵌入的学习效果。

title: MatrixFormer: A Foundation Model for Matrix Completion
summary: Matrix completion underlies problems from tabular imputation to causal inference, yet existing tabular foundation models treat it as entry-by-entry prediction, repeating context for every target and discarding the matrix's two-dimensional structure. We introduce MatrixFormer, a pre-trained matrix-native transformer that predicts a full distribution for every missing entry in a single forward pass. MatrixFormer is trained entirely on synthetic low-rank and latent-factor matrices under diverse missingness patterns. Applied zero-shot and with the same model weights, MatrixFormer achieves competitive performance on causal inference panel-data tasks, language-model benchmark-score completion, tabular imputation, and recommendation systems matrix completion. These results position MatrixFormer as a general-purpose foundation model for matrix completion.

AI.tldr: MatrixFormer是一种矩阵原生预训练Transformer，单次前向即可为所有缺失项预测完整分布，在因果推断、表格填补和推荐系统等任务上零样本取得竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型将矩阵补全视为逐项预测，每个目标都需重复上下文，且丢弃了矩阵的二维结构。
AI.method: 提出MatrixFormer，矩阵原生Transformer，一次前向预测所有缺失项分布；仅在合成的低秩与隐因子矩阵上、在多样缺失模式下预训练。
AI.result: 同一模型权重零样本应用于因果推断面板数据、语言模型基准分数补全、表格填补和推荐系统矩阵补全，均达竞争力表现。
AI.conclusion: MatrixFormer可作为矩阵补全的通用基础模型。

title: Round-Trip KNN Clustering: multiscale hierarchical cluster detection on directed nearest-neighbour graphs
comment: Submitted to Knowledge and Information Systems (KAIS). 32 pages, 6 figures
summary: We introduce Round-Trip KNN Clustering (RTKNNC), a graph-based method for finding cluster structure at several neighbourhood scales without requiring the number of clusters in advance. Unlike approaches that first make a $k$-nearest-neighbour (KNN) graph undirected, RTKNNC keeps both directions of the neighbour relation: which points a given point selects and which points select it. Incoming selections are treated as weighted votes that help decide which local connections remain visible during a recursive forward-and-reverse traversal. Repeating the procedure for increasing $K$ reveals how groups persist or merge as the neighbourhood scale grows; for the reference inverse-square model before structural refinement, clusters can merge but do not split. Because graph connectivity can occasionally join distinct groups through a sparse bridge or a small region of overlap, we add an optional label-free refinement. It first tests whether an already formed component is better described by two or three Gaussian subpopulations, and accepts a subdivision only when the proposed groups are large enough and consistent with the visible KNN graph. Across eight synthetic datasets and $K=2,\ldots,16$, independent C and Python implementations produced identical partitions in all 120 reference runs. Refinement increased adjusted Rand index from $0.7817$ to $0.9627$ on a variable-density benchmark and from $0.8083$ to $0.9853$ on a sparse-bridge benchmark. Comparisons with seven external clustering methods show competitive performance while preserving a label-free cluster-construction process.

AI.tldr: RTKNNC是一种保留KNN双向关系的图聚类方法，可在多尺度下无需预设簇数发现簇结构，并配有可选的无标签细化步骤。
AI.motivation: 传统KNN图聚类常将邻接关系强行无向化，丢失了"谁选择谁"的方向信息；同时图连通性可能通过稀疏桥或小重叠区错误合并不同簇，且希望无需预先给定簇数。
AI.method: 保留KNN双向邻接：既看点选择了谁，也看谁选择了该点；将入选择作为加权投票，在递归前向-反向遍历中决定哪些局部连接保留。随K增大重复该过程，观察簇的持续与合并。另加可选无标签细化：检验已形成组件是否更适合由2或3个高斯子群描述，仅当子群足够大且与KNN图一致时接受细分。
AI.result: 8个合成数据集、K=2…16下，独立C与Python实现120次运行结果完全一致。细化将调整兰德指数在变密度基准上从0.7817提升至0.9627，在稀疏桥基准上从0.8083提升至0.9853。与7种外部聚类方法比较表现具竞争力，同时保持无标签的簇构建过程。
AI.conclusion: RTKNNC通过保留双向KNN关系实现多尺度、无需预设簇数的聚类，细化为稀疏桥/重叠导致的错误合并提供无标签修正，性能与主流方法相比具竞争力且可复现。

title: Sharpen Without Search: On-Policy Distillation of Sequence-Level Power Distribution
summary: A language model can give a correct answer more probability than any single incorrect answer and still usually sample an incorrect one, because the incorrect answers together hold more probability. The power distribution raises each complete answer's probability to a power above one and renormalizes, shifting probability toward answers the model finds most likely (sharpening). Sampling from it improves reasoning without changing parameters, but needs many scored candidates per query. We show that a model can instead be trained to produce such answers in one generation. On-policy power distillation (OPPD) runs a sequential Monte Carlo sampler in which the model being trained generates candidates and a frozen teacher's power distribution weights them; the same probabilities weight each answer in a maximum-likelihood update. Training raises single-generation accuracy by up to 23.0 points on MATH500 and 27.3 on GSM8K over the untrained model at the same temperature, and one generation scores 2.4 and 3.5 points above published power sampling with 64 candidates, recovering 94 percent of the gain that 16 candidates give the untrained model. For context, against GRPO trained with verified rewards from the same checkpoint and budget, OPPD scores 3.8, 4.0 and 5.4 points higher on MATH500, GSM8K and AIME using no reference answers; the two are complementary, and OPPD applied after GRPO adds up to 9.3 points. Trained only on mathematics, OPPD raises HumanEval accuracy by up to 5.3 points. One loss coefficient moves the sharpening exponent the model absorbs between 1.19 and 2.02, against 1.14 for ordinary on-policy distillation, and it rises mostly on the model's own answers. Gains hold across model families and sizes, including a model already trained with verified rewards, where lowering the temperature gives nothing and OPPD adds 4.4 points on MATH500. Code: https://github.com/ArminAzizi98/OPPD.

AI.tldr: 提出OPPD方法，通过训练使模型一次生成即达到power sampling效果，在数学与代码推理任务上大幅提升准确率，且与GRPO互补。
AI.motivation: 语言模型正确answer的概率虽高于任一错误answer，但所有错误answer概率之和更大，导致采样常出错。Power sampling通过锐化分布提升推理，但需大量候选评分，成本高。
AI.method: OPPD用顺序蒙特卡洛采样器：被训练模型生成候选，冻结教师模型的power分布对其加权，同一概率用于最大似然更新，从而让模型一次生成即产出锐化后的答案。
AI.result: 单次生成在MATH500、GSM8K上比未训练模型提升最高23.0和27.3分；超过64候选的power sampling 2.4/3.5分；对比GRPO在MATH500/GSM8K/AIME高3.8/4.0/5.4分，GRPO后再用OPPD额外提升最高9.3分；仅数学训练使HumanEval提升5.3分；锐化指数可调1.19–2.02。
AI.conclusion: OPPD能将power sampling的锐化效果蒸馏进单次生成，无需参考答案，跨模型族与规模有效，与GRPO互补。

title: H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning
summary: Long-horizon planning with latent world models requires reasoning across timescales and levels of abstraction. Existing task-agnostic JEPA world models predict and plan at a single timescale or with multiple horizons in one shared latent space. We introduce H-JEPA, an end-to-end recipe for training a hierarchy of action-conditioned JEPAs in which each level predicts farther ahead in its own learned latent space. Planning proceeds top-down: the top level optimizes progress toward the goal, and each level's predictions become subgoals for the planner below it. When factors in the data evolve at separated timescales, higher levels discard fast, unpredictable detail and retain slower task-relevant state. Across four simulated navigation and manipulation environments, hierarchical planning improves over a flat JEPA; on Visual AntMaze, a three-level hierarchy raises success from 18% to 73% using less planner compute. Ablations attribute these gains to both temporal decomposition and higher-level goal representations. With inverse-dynamics supervision, the approach extends to diverse real-robot videos from DROID, where hierarchy improves offline planning fidelity at lower planner compute.

AI.tldr: 提出H-JEPA，通过端到端训练分层动作条件化JEPA世界模型，每层在各自潜空间预测更远的未来，自上而下规划，显著提升长时程规划性能并降低计算量。
AI.motivation: 现有任务无关的JEPA世界模型仅在单一时间尺度或多个horizon共享同一潜空间进行预测与规划，难以处理跨时间尺度和抽象层级的长时程规划。
AI.method: 端到端训练一组动作条件化JEPA构成层级结构，每层在自身学习到的潜空间中预测更远的未来；规划自上而下进行，顶层优化目标进展，各层预测成为下层的子目标。当数据因素在分离的时间尺度上演化时，高层丢弃快速不可预测的细节，保留缓慢且任务相关的状态。
AI.result: 在四个模拟导航与操作环境中，分层规划优于扁平JEPA；Visual AntMaze上，三层结构将成功率从18%提升至73%，且规划计算量更少；消融实验表明增益来自时间分解与高层目标表征。结合逆动力学监督可扩展到DROID真实机器人视频，分层在更低计算量下提升离线规划保真度。
AI.conclusion: 分层、多时间尺度的JEPA世界模型能有效提升长时程规划的成功率与效率，并可迁移到真实机器人数据。

title: Block Disentanglement in CRL: Bridging Identifiability and Visual State Estimation
summary: Causal representation learning (CRL) is the process of recovering causally-related latent variables from high-dimensional observations. As a label-free inference method, CRL is particularly attractive for applications where data labels are unavailable or impractical to obtain. While there has been significant progress in understanding the identifiability guarantees of CRL, such guarantees often hold under highly stylized assumptions, which temper the direct application to real-world problems. This paper has a two-fold objective for interventional CRL. First, it establishes identifiability guarantees for substantially weaker interventional assumptions, resulting in block disentanglement of the causal variables, where the block structure depends on the realistically available intervention mechanisms. Secondly, the block disentanglement framework is used for embodied visual state estimation, in which the objective is to recover the latent physical variables of a robotic system directly from visual data (images and videos) without labeled data. These two components are critically complementary. The block disentanglement theory delineates identifiability guarantees under weakened assumptions, and the application demonstrates that the resulting objective remains effective in a controlled embodied setting despite further assumption violations, providing a theory-to-practice bridge needed to translate the promise of label-free CRL into practical problems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对干预式因果表示学习(CRL)，在更弱的干预假设下建立可识别性保证，得到因果变量的块解耦，并将其应用于具身视觉状态估计。
AI.motivation: 现有CRL的可识别性保证常依赖过于理想化的假设，难以直接应用于现实问题；同时缺乏从理论到实践的桥梁。
AI.method: 建立更弱干预假设下的可识别性保证，提出块解耦框架（块结构依赖实际可用的干预机制）；并将该框架用于具身视觉状态估计，直接从图像/视频无标签地恢复机器人系统的潜在物理变量。
AI.result: 在弱化的干预假设下获得了块解耦的可识别性保证；在受控具身场景中，即使存在进一步的假设违背，该方法目标依然有效。
AI.conclusion: 理论（弱假设下的可识别性）与应用（具身状态估计）互补，为将无标签CRL转化为实际问题提供了理论到实践的桥梁。

title: Private online learning and prediction for Littlestone classes
summary: We study mistake bounds for differentially private online learning and online prediction under oblivious realisable adversaries. Online learning requires the learner to release a hypothesis at each time step whereas in online prediction, the learner only needs to make predictions without releasing a hypothesis. Using a novel lower bound for private online learning and an upper bound for private prediction, we show that the sample complexity of these two problems are separated by a factor that grows with the time horizon for every class of finite Littlestone dimension $d$. First, we prove that every $\br{ε,δ}$-private online learner has a deterministic realisable stream of length $T$ on which the mistake bound is at least $\bE\bs{M_T}=\Om{\frac dε\log\br{ T}^{2/3}}$. In particular, this is the first non-trivial lower in the range $1/T<δ<1/\log T)$ left open in earlier works[SR22,DSS24,LWY24]. Second, we prove that for every class of of Littlestone dimension $d$, there exists an $(ε,δ)$-jointly private predictor with at most $2^{2^{cd^2}}ε^{-2}\log^2\br{2/\br{εδ}}$ expected mistakes, independently of $T$, for some absolute constant $c>0$. Thus, for every fixed class of finite Littlestone dimension when $δ=Θ\br{1/\log T}$, private learning requires $\Om{\br{\log T}^{2/3}}$ expected mistakes, whereas private prediction admits $\bigO{\br{\log\log T}^2}$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究差分隐私在线学习与在线预测在可实现对手下的错误界，证明两者的样本复杂度相差随时间 $T$ 增长的因子。
AI.motivation: 在线学习需每步发布假设，而在线预测只需给出预测。作者想探究隐私约束下这两类问题的复杂度是否存在本质差异，尤其是填补前期工作未解决的低 $\delta$ 范围下界空白。
AI.method: 提出新的隐私在线学习下界，结合隐私预测的上界构造进行对比分析。下界针对确定性可实现流，上界构造 $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-联合私有预测器。
AI.result: 证明任何 $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-私有在线学习器存在长度 $T$ 的流，期望错误至少 $\Omega(\frac{d}{\varepsilon}\log T^{2/3})$，首次覆盖 $1/T<\delta<1/\log T$ 范围；对任意 Littlestone 维 $d$ 的类，存在联合私有预测器期望错误至多 $2^{2^{cd^2}}\varepsilon^{-2}\log^2(2/(\varepsilon\delta))$，与 $T$ 无关。
AI.conclusion: 当 $\delta=\Theta(1/\log T)$ 时，私有学习需 $\Omega((\log T)^{2/3})$ 错误，而私有预测仅需 $O((\log\log T)^2)$，二者复杂度按随时间增长的因子分离。

title: Deep Learning for Sleep Heart Rate Estimation from Accelerometers: Toward Population-Scale Cardiac Insight Without Optical Sensors
summary: Large longitudinal cohorts often contain wrist accelerometry without optical heart-rate sensing, motivating recovery of cardiac information from motion signals already collected during sleep. We present SeqSmoother, a transformer-based temporal corrector for sleep heart rate (HR) estimation from wrist accelerometry. SeqSmoother combines spectral descriptors with an intermediate Nightbeat-derived frequency anchor and a physics-motivated sub-harmonic feature designed to identify harmonic frequency lock-on. All inference-time features are derived from wrist accelerometry, while ECG is used only to construct reference HR labels and training-label quality weights. We evaluate SeqSmoother using 13 participant-disjoint held-out folds and compare it with the official Nightbeat implementation under a matched 60-s window and 15-s step protocol. Across all out-of-fold predictions, SeqSmoother achieved a participant-macro MAE of 1.60 bpm. On Nightbeat-retained matched intervals, Nightbeat achieved lower absolute error than SeqSmoother (0.615 versus 1.091 bpm), while SeqSmoother provided estimates over a larger portion of the eligible recording; Nightbeat produced final estimates for 72.85% of the SeqSmoother-eligible out-of-fold grid. Separately, the proposed sub-harmonic ratio achieved an AUROC of 0.972 for identifying reference-defined harmonic lock-on candidates. These findings reveal an accuracy-availability trade-off between learned temporal modeling and quality-gated signal processing while providing empirical support for a physics-informed approach to identifying frequency-tracking failures in accelerometer-based sleep HR estimation.

AI.tldr: SeqSmoother是一种基于Transformer的时序校正器，从腕部加速度信号估计睡眠心率，通过结合频谱特征、Nightbeat频率锚点与物理启发的次谐波特征，在准确性与覆盖率间形成权衡。
AI.motivation: 大规模纵向队列常包含腕部加速度数据但缺少光学心率传感，因此希望从睡眠期间已采集的运动信号中恢复心脏信息。
AI.method: SeqSmoother结合频谱描述符、Nightbeat派生的中间频率锚点，以及用于识别谐波频率锁定失败的物理启发次谐波特征；所有推理特征均来自腕部加速度，ECG仅用于构建参考HR标签和训练标签质量权重。采用13个受试者不重叠的留出折进行评测，并与Nightbeat在60秒窗口、15秒步长的匹配协议下比较。
AI.result: 所有折外预测中，SeqSmoother的受试者宏平均MAE为1.60 bpm；在Nightbeat可保留的匹配区间上，Nightbeat绝对误差更低（0.615 vs 1.091 bpm），但SeqSmoother覆盖更大比例的合格记录（Nightbeat仅覆盖SeqSmoother合格网格的72.85%）；次谐波比在识别参考定义的谐波锁定候选上AUROC达0.972。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了学习式时序建模与质量门控信号处理之间的准确性-可用性权衡，并为识别加速度睡眠HR估计中的频率跟踪失败提供了物理启发方法的实证支持。

title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points
summary: Every recurrence of a looped language model adds cost in training, decoding, prefill, and reinforcement learning (RL). The closer recurrent states get to fixed points, the less the path to them matters. This enables truncated backpropagation in training; terminal key-value (KV) sharing for decoding with almost no loss in accuracy; a distilled student that prefills up to 1.79x faster; and RL updates that compute gradients from saved rollout states, 2x faster than backpropagating through the replayed trajectory. We therefore improve the two components of training that shape these fixed points: the depth prior and input injection. Fixed-depth training breaks KV sharing, and Huginn's broad depth prior supports sharing but dilutes supervision at the target depth more than sharing requires; we learn the prior from prediction feedback, with an entropy term that keeps it broad. Existing injection schemes let the state's component along the input amplify or cancel the injection; we remove this component with orthogonal injection. From 100M to 1.6B parameters, the learned prior and orthogonal injection lower perplexity at every scale relative to Huginn's prior and existing injection schemes, respectively. At 1.6B, the learned prior with a 3x smaller KV cache matches the downstream average of fixed-depth training with the full cache.

AI.tldr: 循环语言模型的收敛特性使截断训练、KV共享、快速预填充和RL加速成为可能，本文通过反馈学习深度先验（加熵项保持广度）和正交注入去除状态沿输入分量，在多尺度上降低困惑度。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型的每次循环都增加训练、解码、预填充和强化学习成本；但循环状态越接近不动点，其路径越不重要，这为各种加速提供了机会，而塑造不动点的两项训练组件（深度先验与输入注入）存在缺陷：固定深度训练破坏KV共享，Huginn的宽先验稀释目标深度监督，现有注入方案会放大或抵消注入。
AI.method: 1) 从预测反馈中学习深度先验，并加入熵项保持其广度；2) 采用正交注入，去除状态中沿输入方向的分量，避免放大或抵消注入。
AI.result: 在100M至1.6B参数规模上，学习先验与正交注入相比Huginn先验和现有注入方案均在每个规模降低困惑度；在1.6B规模，学习先验配合3倍小的KV缓存即可匹配固定深度训练加完整缓存的下游平均表现。同时支持训练截断、终端KV共享（几乎无精度损失）、快1.79x的蒸馏预填充、以及快2x的RL梯度更新。
AI.conclusion: 通过改进深度先验和输入注入以塑造更好的循环不动点，可在保持或提升性能的同时大幅降低循环语言模型各阶段的成本。

title: Game Plan: What AI can do for Football, and What Football can do for AI
summary: The rapid progress in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning has opened unprecedented analytics possibilities in various team and individual sports, including baseball, basketball, and tennis. More recently, AI techniques have been applied to football, due to a huge increase in data collection by professional teams, increased computational power, and advances in machine learning, with the goal of better addressing new scientific challenges involved in the analysis of both individual players' and coordinated teams' behaviors. The research challenges associated with predictive and prescriptive football analytics require new developments and progress at the intersection of statistical learning, game theory, and computer vision. In this paper, we provide an overarching perspective highlighting how the combination of these fields, in particular, forms a unique microcosm for AI research, while offering mutual benefits for professional teams, spectators, and broadcasters in the years to come. We illustrate that this duality makes football analytics a game changer of tremendous value, in terms of not only changing the game of football itself, but also in terms of what this domain can mean for the field of AI. We review the state-of-the-art and exemplify the types of analysis enabled by combining the aforementioned fields, including illustrative examples of counterfactual analysis using predictive models, and the combination of game-theoretic analysis of penalty kicks with statistical learning of player attributes. We conclude by highlighting envisioned downstream impacts, including possibilities for extensions to other sports (real and virtual).

AI.tldr: 本文综述了AI（统计学习、博弈论、计算机视觉）在足球分析中的应用，论证足球分析是AI研究的独特缩影，对AI和足球双向受益。
AI.motivation: 职业球队数据采集激增、算力提升与机器学习进步，使AI可用于足球。预测性和规范性足球分析面临新科学挑战，需在统计学习、博弈论和计算机视觉交叉处取得进展。
AI.method: 综述性方法：提供统揽视角，回顾足球分析的最新技术，展示上述领域结合可实现的各类分析，如利用预测模型进行反事实分析、博弈论点球分析与球员属性统计学习相结合。
AI.result: 展示了结合这些领域所实现的分析类型，包括反事实分析与点球博弈论-统计学习结合的示例，说明该交叉领域对AI研究具有独特价值。
AI.conclusion: 足球分析既是改变足球本身的变革者，也对AI领域有重要意义；展望下游影响，包括向其他体育（真实与虚拟）扩展的可能性。

title: Broaden Your Views for Self-Supervised Video Learning
comment: This paper is an extended version of our ICCV-21 paper. It includes more results as well as a minor architectural variation which improves results
summary: Most successful self-supervised learning methods are trained to align the representations of two independent views from the data. State-of-the-art methods in video are inspired by image techniques, where these two views are similarly extracted by cropping and augmenting the resulting crop. However, these methods miss a crucial element in the video domain: time. We introduce BraVe, a self-supervised learning framework for video. In BraVe, one of the views has access to a narrow temporal window of the video while the other view has a broad access to the video content. Our models learn to generalise from the narrow view to the general content of the video. Furthermore, BraVe processes the views with different backbones, enabling the use of alternative augmentations or modalities into the broad view such as optical flow, randomly convolved RGB frames, audio or their combinations. We demonstrate that BraVe achieves state-of-the-art results in self-supervised representation learning on standard video and audio classification benchmarks including UCF101, HMDB51, Kinetics, ESC-50 and AudioSet.

AI.tldr: BraVe：一种引入时间维度的视频自监督学习框架，通过窄时间窗与宽内容视图的对齐实现SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有视频自监督方法沿用图像技术，通过裁剪和增强生成两个视图，忽略了视频中关键的时间维度。
AI.method: 构建两个视图：一个仅访问视频的窄时间窗，另一个访问更广的视频内容；模型学习从窄视图泛化到广视图。两视图使用不同backbone，允许在宽视图中引入光流、随机卷积RGB帧、音频或组合等增强或多模态信息。
AI.result: 在UCF101、HMDB51、Kinetics、ESC-50和AudioSet等标准视频与音频分类基准上取得自监督表征学习的SOTA结果。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入时间维度并允许异构视图/多模态增强，可显著提升视频（及音频）自监督表征学习效果。

title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
summary: Modern artificial intelligence (AI) systems are powered by foundation models. This paper presents a new set of foundation models, called Llama 3. It is a herd of language models that natively support multilinguality, coding, reasoning, and tool usage. Our largest model is a dense Transformer with 405B parameters and a context window of up to 128K tokens. This paper presents an extensive empirical evaluation of Llama 3. We find that Llama 3 delivers comparable quality to leading language models such as GPT-4 on a plethora of tasks. We publicly release Llama 3, including pre-trained and post-trained versions of the 405B parameter language model and our Llama Guard 3 model for input and output safety. The paper also presents the results of experiments in which we integrate image, video, and speech capabilities into Llama 3 via a compositional approach. We observe this approach performs competitively with the state-of-the-art on image, video, and speech recognition tasks. The resulting models are not yet being broadly released as they are still under development.

AI.tldr: Llama 3 是一套新型基础模型，最大为 405B 参数、128K 上下文窗口的密集 Transformer，原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用，质量媲美 GPT-4，并公开预训练与后训练版本及 Llama Guard 3。
AI.motivation: 构建强大的基础模型以驱动现代 AI 系统，并提供一个在多种任务上可与领先模型（如 GPT-4）比肩、且公开开放的模型家族。
AI.method: 训练一个语言模型家族（最大 405B 参数密集 Transformer，128K 上下文），原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用；并通过组合式方法将图像、视频、语音能力集成进 Llama 3。
AI.result: 在大量任务上质量可与 GPT-4 等领先模型媲美；图像、视频、语音识别任务上组合式方法与最先进水平竞争；公开释放预训练和后训练的 405B 模型及 Llama Guard 3 安全模型。
AI.conclusion: Llama 3 展现了开源基础模型的强竞争力，多模态集成具潜力，但多模态模型仍在开发中，尚未广泛发布。

title: Evolutionary feature selection for spiking neural network pattern classifiers
comment: Published at Portuguese Conference on Artificial Intelligence (EPIA 2005), eds. Bento et al., IEEE, pp. 24-32
summary: This paper presents an application of the biologically realistic JASTAP neural network model to classification tasks. The JASTAP neural network model is presented as an alternative to the basic multi-layer perceptron model. An evolutionary procedure previously applied to the simultaneous solution of feature selection and neural network training on standard multi-layer perceptrons is extended with JASTAP model. Preliminary results on IRIS standard data set give evidence that this extension allows the use of smaller neural networks that can handle noisier data without any degradation in classification accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文将生物逼真的JASTAP神经网络模型应用于分类任务，并扩展了原有的进化方法以同时进行特征选择与网络训练，在IRIS数据集上取得初步结果。
AI.motivation: 作为基本多层感知器（MLP）模型的替代方案，探索生物逼真的JASTAP模型在分类任务中的可行性，并借助进化程序提升性能。
AI.method: 将先前用于标准多层感知器的特征选择与神经网络训练同时求解的进化程序，扩展到JASTAP神经网络模型上。
AI.result: 在IRIS标准数据集上的初步结果表明，该扩展允许使用更小的神经网络，且能在不降低分类准确率的前提下处理噪声更大的数据。
AI.conclusion: 将进化程序扩展到JASTAP模型是可行的，可得到更小、更抗噪的神经网络，为分类任务提供了一种有潜力的替代方案。
